title: On the Performance of Randomly Generated Codebooks in Near-Field Communications
summary: Near-field communication with large antenna arrays requires beamforming techniques that account for spherical wavefront effects. While predefined codebooks are widely used in multiple-antenna wireless systems, the performance of randomly generated codebooks in the near-field region has not been investigated. In this work, we study four randomly generated codebooks for near-field communications: random vector quantization (RVQ), random phase (RP), random far-field (RFF), and random near-field (RNF) codebooks. We use the known RVQ gain distribution as a benchmark. For RP, we derive a large-array bulk approximation and characterize the high-gain tail behavior of the gain distribution. For RNF, we characterize the high-gain tail behavior of the gain distribution. For RFF, we derive an analytical approximation for the maximum achievable beamforming gain when far-field beams are used to serve near-field users, along with the corresponding maximizing far-field direction. We also analyze the maximum-gain scaling with codebook size. Monte Carlo simulations verify the analytical results and show that RVQ and RP degrade significantly as the array size increases, while RNF achieves the most favorable high-gain scaling. RFF can outperform RVQ and RP for finite codebook sizes, but its maximum gain saturates below one due to the phase mismatch between the far-field beams and the near-field channel. These results show how codebook structure, array size, and codebook size affect random beamforming performance in the near-field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究近场通信中四种随机码本（RVQ、RP、RFF、RNF）的波束成形增益性能，通过理论推导与仿真揭示码本结构、阵列规模及码本大小对性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 近场通信中大规模天线阵列需考虑球面波前效应，而随机生成码本在近场区域的表现尚未被研究，需要系统分析不同随机码本的增益特性以指导码本设计。
AI.method: 以已知的RVQ增益分布作为基准；对RP推导大阵列渐近近似并刻画增益分布的高增益尾部；对RNF刻画增益分布高增益尾部；对RFF推导远场波束服务近场用户时的最大可达波束成形增益解析近似及最优远场方向；同时分析最大增益随码本大小的缩放规律，并用蒙特卡洛仿真验证。
AI.result: RVQ与RP随阵列规模增大性能显著退化；RNF具有最优的高增益缩放；RFF在有限码本规模下可优于RVQ和RP，但其最大增益因远场波束与近场信道的相位失配而饱和在1以下。
AI.conclusion: 码本结构、阵列规模和码本大小共同决定近场随机波束成形性能，RNF在高增益缩放方面最具优势，为近场码本设计提供了理论依据。

title: Simultaneous Direct and Indirect Channel Estimation for RIS-Assisted MIMO Communications
summary: This paper introduces an enhanced channel estimation method for reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) communications. Considering the presence of both the direct link from the base station (BS) to the user equipment (UE) and the indirect link \textit{via} the RIS, we formulate a tensor-based receiver for joint direct and indirect channel estimation called the TenDICE algorithm. The proposed receiver relies on an extended parallel factor analysis (PARAFAC) tensor model for the received pilot signals, from which the involved (direct and indirect link) channels are estimated using a simple alternating least squares scheme. The proposed TenDICE method is compared with the state-of-the-art least squares (LS) method, Khatri-Rao factorization (KRF) method, enhanced trilinear alternating least squares (E-TALS), and the theoretical Cramér-Rao lower bound (CRLB) based on normalized mean square error (NMSE) and spectral efficiency (SE). The proposed TenDICE outperforms the LS and E-TALS methods and performs similarly to the KRF methods while estimating the direct channel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TenDICE算法，用于RIS辅助MIMO通信中直连与经RIS间接链路的联合信道估计，基于扩展PARAFAC张量模型并采用交替最小二乘求解，性能优于LS和E-TALS，与KRF相当。
AI.motivation: 在RIS辅助MIMO系统中，同时存在基站到用户的直连链路和经RIS的间接链路，需要一种能联合估计两条链路信道的方法，并需与现有主流方法进行性能对比验证。
AI.method: 针对接收导频信号构建扩展PARAFAC张量模型，设计张量接收机（TenDICE），通过简单的交替最小二乘（ALS）方案联合估计直连与间接链路信道。
AI.result: 以NMSE和SE为指标，与LS、KRF、E-TALS及理论CRLB对比。TenDICE在估计直连信道时优于LS和E-TALS，性能与KRF方法相近。
AI.conclusion: TenDICE是一种有效的RIS辅助MIMO联合信道估计方法，在直连信道估计上表现优于LS和E-TALS，与KRF相当，验证了张量方法在此场景下的有效性。

title: Low-Complexity Tensor-Based Channel Parameter Estimation for mmWave MIMO-Assisted Systems
summary: This paper presents a low-complexity tensor-based channel estimation framework for downlink mmWave massive MIMO systems using passive Butler-matrix beamforming. By modeling received signals as a third-order PARAFAC tensor, we exploit known pilot structures via bilinear alternating least-squares (BALS) optimization to reduce computational overhead. The decoupled spatial factors are then processed via 1D and 2D ESPRIT to extract angles of arrival and departure with automatic pairing. Additionally, we derive the Cramer--Rao lower bound (CRLB) for this architecture. Simulations confirm the proposed estimator outperforms conventional least-squares, achieving accurate channel reconstruction and approaching the CRLB at moderate-to-high signal-to-noise ratios.

AI.tldr: 本文针对采用无源Butler矩阵波束成形的下行毫米波大规模MIMO系统，提出一种低复杂度的张量信道估计框架。将接收信号建模为三阶PARAFAC张量，利用已知导频结构通过双线性交替最小二乘（BALS）优化降低计算开销；对解耦的空间因子采用1D和2D ESPRIT提取到达角与离开角，并实现自动配对；同时推导了该架构的Cramer-Rao下界（CRLB）。仿真表明该估计器优于传统最小二乘方法，可实现精确信道重构，并在中高信噪比下逼近CRLB。
AI.motivation: 毫米波大规模MIMO系统信道估计面临高计算复杂度问题，尤其在使用无源Butler矩阵波束成形架构时，需要低复杂度且高精度的估计方法。
AI.method: 将接收信号建模为三阶PARAFAC张量，利用已知导频结构，通过双线性交替最小二乘（BALS）优化降低计算开销；对解耦的空间因子分别使用1D和2D ESPRIT提取到达角和离开角，并实现自动配对；推导该架构的CRLB。
AI.result: 仿真验证所提估计器性能优于传统最小二乘方法，可实现准确的信道重构，并在中高信噪比下逼近CRLB。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的低复杂度张量信道估计框架适用于无源Butler矩阵波束成形的下行毫米波大规模MIMO系统，兼顾低复杂度与高估计精度。

title: Multistatic Terahertz ISAC for Object Shape Identification
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026 Workshops (Third Workshop on Positioning and Sensing Over Wireless Networks)
summary: 6G networks are expected to sense their surroundings using the same waveforms that carry data. We ask how much can be learned about the shape of an object from the terahertz echoes that user equipment transmissions produce as they scatter from that object on their way to a ceiling-mounted access point, with no sensing hardware beyond the communication link itself. We build a physics-based multistatic forward model at a 300 GHz carrier with 50 GHz of bandwidth, combining Physical Optics (PO) and Physical Theory of Diffraction (PTD) scattering with an image-source multipath lattice, molecular absorption and directional horn antennas. The model makes explicit a property of the PO mechanism hierarchy that is usually left implicit. Six physically distinct mechanisms share only three frequency exponents, so the spectral slope does not by itself determine which mechanisms a target presents and therefore cannot by itself determine its geometry. Angular diversity is accordingly a requirement for identifiability rather than an optional refinement. We compare a transmitter-count-invariant 2D-CNN with a physics-informed RBF-SVM on object orientations never seen in training. Accuracy climbs from roughly 70 percent with one transmitter to 96-97 percent with 20. The CNN gains in two regimes, irregular placement and lossy targets, while on metal under quasi-uniform placement the SVM baseline is fully competitive. Performance falls off gradually under occlusion, holding 78 percent with three quarters of the surface hidden and 63 percent when the classifier has never seen an occluded target. Multi-object scenes are limited by interference between overlapping returns rather than by angular coverage, so presence detection saturates after roughly four transmitters.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建300 GHz、50 GHz带宽的物理多静态前向模型（结合PO/PTD散射、镜像源多径、分子吸收与定向喇叭天线），证明太赫兹通信链路本身可在无专用感知硬件下推断物体几何，且角度分集是几何可辨识性的必要条件；20个发射机下分类精度达96-97%。
AI.motivation: 6G网络期望用承载数据的同一波形完成环境感知。作者要探究：仅依靠用户设备发射信号经物体散射后到达天花板接入点的太赫兹回波，在没有任何通信链路之外感知硬件的条件下，能获取多少关于物体形状的信息，并厘清几何反演的可辨识性条件。
AI.method: 在300 GHz载波、50 GHz带宽下建立基于物理的多静态前向模型，融合物理光学（PO）与物理绕射理论（PTD）散射、镜像源多径格点、分子吸收以及定向喇叭天线；模型显式揭示了PO机制层级中通常隐含的性质。采用发射机数量不变的2D-CNN与物理信息RBF-SVM，在训练未见过的物体朝向上进行对比评估，并考察遮挡与多目标场景。
AI.result: 六种物理上不同的机制仅共享三个频率指数，因此谱斜率本身无法判定目标呈现的机制，也无法单独确定其几何，角度分集因此成为可辨识性的必要条件而非可选优化。分类精度随发射机数从1个时约70%提升至20个时96-97%。CNN在非规则布设与有损目标两种情形占优，而在金属目标加准均匀布设下SVM基线完全可比。遮挡下性能平缓下降，表面隐藏四分之三时保持78%，未见遮挡目标时保持63%。多目标场景受重叠回波干扰而非角度覆盖限制，存在性检测约4个发射机后饱和。
AI.conclusion: 太赫兹通信链路可在无额外感知硬件下支持物体几何推断，但前提是具备足够角度分集；CNN相较物理信息SVM仅在非规则布设和有损目标等特定情形带来增益。遮挡下性能退化平缓，而多目标场景的瓶颈是回波叠加干扰，约4个发射机后存在性检测即饱和，为6G通感一体化的波形与部署设计提供了可辨识性视角。

title: UV Fluorescence Sensing of Medical-Chemical-and- Biological Analytes by an AlGaN/Si-on-Sapphire Optoelectronic Chip
summary: This paper proposes and analyzes a compact fluorescence-photometer lab-on-a-chip that is simpler than a fluorescence spectrometer, and that does not require spectrum reconstruction by a computer. An on-chip AlGaN VCSEL lasing at 280 nm, or at 310 nm, pumps an on-chip sample in the form of liquid or solid or tissue, thereby exciting signature fluorescence in the 300 to 540 nm wavelength range. This emission signal is detected and read out by an on-chip UV-enhanced Silicon photodiode. The 2 cm x 5 cm chip consists of C-plane (0001) Sapphire, and no lenses, prisms, or mirrors are utilized in the photometer. The chip is opto-electronic and features co-packaged electronics using tiny electronic chiplets that are bonded to the sapphire. These consist of an LD driver and transimpedance amplifier for the UV photonics, together with ASICs, ADC, microcontroller, micro-battery and RF-wireless or Ethernet chiplets. The mission of this self-contained cost-effective chip is sensing targeted medical-chemical-biological (MCB) agents in a local or network setting. Eight significant MCB applications are detailed here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一种紧凑型荧光光度计芯片实验室：以片上280/310 nm AlGaN VCSEL泵浦样品，激发300–540 nm特征荧光，由片上紫外增强硅光电二极管探测读出，芯片基于C面(0001)蓝宝石，无透镜/棱镜/反射镜，并共封装LD驱动、跨阻放大器、ASIC、ADC、微控制器、微电池及RF/以太网芯片。
AI.motivation: 传统荧光光谱仪体积大、成本高且需计算机进行光谱重建，难以在本地或网络化场景中低成本、便携地检测医用-化学-生物（MCB）靶标。作者希望构建一种比荧光光谱仪更简单、无需光谱重建的自持式芯片，以满足现场与联网传感需求。
AI.method: 采用2 cm×5 cm C面(0001)蓝宝石衬底作为光电平台，集成片上AlGaN VCSEL（280 nm或310 nm）作为激发源，泵浦液态、固态或组织样品；以片上紫外增强硅光电二极管探测300–540 nm荧光发射，无需透镜、棱镜或反射镜；通过键合到蓝宝石的微型电子芯片实现共封装：LD驱动、跨阻放大器、ASIC、ADC、微控制器、微电池，以及RF无线或以太网芯片。
AI.result: 实现了紧凑、自包含、成本有效的荧光光度计芯片实验室，无需透镜等光学元件与计算机光谱重建；论文详细列举了八项重要的MCB应用，显示其在本地或网络化环境中检测目标MCB因子的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该芯片将紫外激发、荧光探测与共封装电子学集成于蓝宝石平台，构成自持式低成本传感方案，可用于本地或联网的MCB靶标检测，并被作者总结为具有八项重要应用前景。

title: Broadband soliton microcombs in the biological window enabled by a resonant coupler
summary: Broadband soliton microcombs near 1 $μ$m offer coherent, evenly spaced optical lines for measurements in the biological window. However, combining broad spectral coverage with closely spaced comb lines increases the pump-power requirement and makes thermally stable soliton access more difficult. Here, we demonstrate broadband silicon nitride (Si3N4) soliton microcombs enabled by a resonant coupler that enhances pump delivery to the nonlinear resonator. The device generates a spectrum spanning 930-1380 nm with an approximately 98-GHz comb-line spacing at on-chip pump powers of tens of milliwatts, while providing reliable thermally stable access to the single-soliton state. These results provide a route to compact, power-efficient microcomb sources that combine broad spectral coverage with closely spaced comb lines for spectroscopy and imaging in the biological window.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用谐振耦合器增强泵浦光向非线性谐振腔的传输，在近1 μm波段实现了宽带、热稳定的氮化硅孤子光频梳。
AI.motivation: 近1 μm宽带孤子光频梳适用于生物窗口内的测量，但宽带谱覆盖与密集梳齿间距的结合会提高泵浦功率需求，并增加热稳定孤子获取的难度。
AI.method: 采用氮化硅（Si3N4）平台，引入谐振耦合器以增强泵浦光向非线性谐振腔的耦合传输，从而在较低片上泵浦功率下实现宽带孤子光频梳。
AI.result: 器件在数十毫瓦量级的片上泵浦功率下产生930–1380 nm的宽带光谱，梳齿间距约98 GHz，并可可靠、热稳定地进入单孤子态。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为面向生物窗口光谱与成像的紧凑、低功耗微梳光源提供了可行路径，兼具宽带谱覆盖与密集梳齿间距优势。

title: VortexSynth: Profile-guided benchmark reconstruction for GPU architecture research
summary:
GPU architecture research requires representative benchmarks that can execute on new designs. However, many vendor-tailored workloads and library kernels cannot run directly on research architectures because their implementations are closed-source or rely on programming models unsupported by the target architecture. Migrating existing kernels requires manual effort to adapt their implementations and validate their behavior. This creates a need to automate workload migration to target platforms.
  We present VortexSynth, a framework that uses profile-guided benchmark reconstruction to construct GPU benchmarks from reference workloads. Our workflow selects hot kernels through profiling, synthesizes implementations in the target programming language, verifies output equivalence, and measures profile differences using a translated proxy implementation. The resulting profile signature gap is supplied to an agent for iterative refinement. We evaluate the method on Vortex, an open-ISA GPGPU, using robotics as the application domain. All active kernel pairs pass both output-equivalence checks, and the case studies show that iterative refinement can reduce profile distance.

AI.tldr: VortexSynth：面向GPU架构研究的profile引导基准重建框架，从参考workload自动生成目标平台可运行的benchmark，并在Vortex开放ISA GPGPU上以机器人应用验证。
AI.motivation: GPU架构研究需要能在新设计上运行的代表性benchmark，但厂商定制的workload和库kernel因闭源或依赖目标架构不支持的编程模型而无法直接迁移；手工迁移与验证代价高昂，因此需要自动化workload迁移。
AI.method: 提出VortexSynth框架，采用profile-guided benchmark reconstruction：通过profiling选取hot kernels，在目标编程语言中合成实现，验证输出等价性，并利用翻译后的proxy实现测量profile差异；将profile signature gap反馈给agent进行迭代精化。
AI.result: 在开放ISA GPGPU Vortex上以机器人作为应用域进行评估，所有活跃kernel对均通过输出等价性检查，案例研究表明迭代精化可降低profile距离。
AI.conclusion: VortexSynth能够自动重建可运行于目标架构的GPU基准，保证功能等价并缩小profile特征差距，为架构研究提供可行的自动迁移路径。

title: AutoIndexer: Flexible-Order Decoding by Training Causal Models on Chains of Edits
summary: Autoregressive decoding is less suited to non-causally ordered data, e.g., cross-references or future dependencies, since their outputs cannot be revised post hoc, unlike iterative human reasoning. Diffusion LLMs partially mitigate this limitation but still cannot flexibly insert or remove arbitrary numbers of tokens from a pre-generated context. We design AutoIndexer as a generative model with a novel training and decoding mechanism that simulates a Chain of Edits, allowing the model to flexibly modify its prior outputs in hindsight via token insertions, substitutions, and deletions. The model learns to predict marker tokens for opening and closing edits, simultaneously moving a cursor to positions in the existing token sequence, analogous to a text editor. Training sequences are obtained by perturbing ground-truth labels with inverse chained edit operations, and the model learns to edit by undoing those inverses. The perturbation training allows AutoIndexer to be robust to erroneous context and adaptable to editing tasks such as code correction. We demonstrate that our method exhibits post-generation context-editing capabilities that most autoregressive and diffusion models lack without compromising performance on standard LLM benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/autoindexer.

AI.tldr: AutoIndexer 是一种支持"编辑链"的生成模型，通过标记 token 实现插入、替换、删除等后验编辑，突破自回归与扩散 LLM 无法灵活修改已生成上下文的限制。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码难以处理非因果顺序数据（如交叉引用、未来依赖），输出无法事后修正；扩散 LLM 虽部分缓解该问题，但仍无法在已生成上下文中灵活增删任意数量 token。
AI.method: 提出 AutoIndexer，模拟 Chain of Edits 机制：模型学习预测编辑开关的 marker token 并移动游标定位到现有序列位置（类似文本编辑器），支持插入/替换/删除；训练序列通过逆向链式编辑操作扰动真值标签获得，模型通过"撤销这些逆操作"来学习编辑；扰动训练使模型对错误上下文鲁棒，可适配代码纠错等任务。
AI.result: AutoIndexer 展现出大多数自回归与扩散模型不具备的生成后上下文编辑能力，同时在标准 LLM 基准上性能未受损害。
AI.conclusion: AutoIndexer 通过编辑链式训练与解码机制，在不牺牲标准基准性能的前提下，赋予生成模型灵活的后验上下文编辑能力，代码已开源。

title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
comment: Presented at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself - a behavior referred to as unfaithfulness or infidelity. Faithfulness can be interpreted as the degree of approximation between an explanation and the model. Computing faithfulness in a rigorous manner would thus make it possible to quantify one of the various elements of trustworthiness of an explanation. However, existing metrics present significant limitations, making this quantification either infeasible or computationally expensive. In this position paper, we outline five major shortcomings of current faithfulness metrics and propose four possible avenues for research to bolster their reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出可解释AI（XAI）未能如预期提升信任，反而助长过度依赖；其核心缺陷在于解释与模型的“忠实性”不足，而现有忠实性度量存在五大缺陷，作者据此提出四个研究方向以提升其可靠性。
AI.motivation: 过去十年证据显示，XAI作为提升机器学习模型信任度的手段总体上未达目标，反而促成对错误预测的过度依赖，并可能引发算法厌恶。XAI实际上更适合作调试工具（如获取模型所学特征的轶事性洞察）。其根本问题之一是XAI方法常过度简化模型内部机制，导致解释与模型本身不一致，即“不忠实”（unfaithfulness/infidelity）。忠实性可理解为解释与模型之间的近似程度，严格计算它可量化解释可信度的一个要素，但现有度量存在显著局限，使该量化难以实施或计算代价高昂。
AI.method: 立场论文（position paper）：梳理并归纳当前忠实性度量（faithfulness metrics）的五项主要缺陷，并在此基础上提出四条可能的研究路径。
AI.result: 总结出当前忠实性度量的五大缺陷，使忠实性的量化要么不可行，要么计算成本过高；并提出四个研究方向以增强其可靠性。
AI.conclusion: XAI提升信任的初衷总体落空，其价值更偏向调试；提升XAI可信度的关键在于改进忠实性度量的可靠性，作者以指出缺陷与提出研究议程的方式推动该方向发展。

title: CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models maintain a growing attention key-value (KV) cache, making memory a key bottleneck for long video generation. Recently, clustering-based quantization has emerged as an effective method to compress video KV caches by grouping similar key and value vectors then quantizing residual errors. However, when later frames attend to the compressed history, small reconstruction errors can compound as the video grows. Beyond the within-layer similarity exploited by clustering, we find strong dependencies across cache layers in video models. This motivates Coral-KV - Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, and Adapted Locally - a KV-cache compression framework that uses cache states in each layer to predict keys and values in subsequent layers, then quantizes the remaining prediction residuals. We construct compact block-diagonal-plus-low-rank (block-DPLR) predictors: block-diagonal components model channel relationships within each attention head, while a global low-rank term models dependencies between heads. Coral-KV exposes a flexible fidelity-memory trade-off: it can reuse its predictors across videos or refit lightweight block-diagonal predictors to the current video for higher fidelity. Across extensive evaluations on both HY-WorldPlay and MAGI-1, our reusable configuration improves PSNR over QVG-4 by 0.32 dB and 4.95 dB, respectively, while using 48% and 37% less cache memory. Against QVG-Pro, our video-adapted configuration improves MAGI-1 PSNR by 3.77 dB while using 33.7% less cache memory. Coral-KV also maintains higher reconstruction fidelity over extended generation and reduces temporal discontinuities while retaining comparable generation latency.

AI.tldr: Coral-KV 是一种视频扩散模型 KV 缓存压缩框架，利用跨层依赖关系预测后续层的键值并量化预测残差，实现高保真、低内存的长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型需要维护不断增长的注意力 KV 缓存，内存成为长视频生成的关键瓶颈。已有的基于聚类的量化方法虽能压缩缓存，但当后续帧关注被压缩的历史信息时，小的重建误差会随视频增长而累积。此外，现有方法仅利用层内相似性，忽略了视频模型中缓存层间存在的强依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出 Coral-KV（校准离线、残差编码、局部适配）框架：利用每层的缓存状态预测后续层的键和值，再对预测残差进行量化。构造紧凑的块对角加低秩（block-DPLR）预测器，其中块对角分量建模每个注意力头内的通道关系，全局低秩项建模头间依赖。提供灵活的保真度-内存权衡：可跨视频复用预测器，也可针对当前视频重新拟合轻量级块对角预测器以获得更高保真度。
AI.result: 在 HY-WorldPlay 和 MAGI-1 上的广泛评估中，可复用配置相比 QVG-4 分别将 PSNR 提升 0.32 dB 和 4.95 dB，同时减少 48% 和 37% 的缓存内存；视频适配配置相比 QVG-Pro 在 MAGI-1 上提升 PSNR 3.77 dB，同时减少 33.7% 缓存内存。Coral-KV 在长时生成中保持更高重建保真度，减少时间不连续性，并保持相当的生成延迟。
AI.conclusion: Coral-KV 通过挖掘 KV 缓存跨层依赖并结合残差量化，在显著降低内存占用的同时提升了重建保真度，为长视频扩散生成提供了一种高效且灵活的缓存压缩方案。

title: Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications
summary: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. Motivated by these properties, we introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and provide results demonstrating that AIQ achieves competitive accuracy compared to the industry-standard MX format across a diverse set of models and benchmarks at equivalent bit-per-parameter budgets. The experiments presented in this article employ algebraic integers of degree two (quadratic integers); generalizations to higher-order and, in particular, multidimensional algebraic integers promise even greater computational advantages and remain a promising direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出代数整数数值格式（AINF）框架及面向大语言模型推理的有损压缩格式代数整数量化（AIQ），实现无误差乘累加与可配置精度压缩计算。
AI.motivation: 浮点与定点格式在精度与压缩效率上存在固有限制，缺乏针对特定用例数值特征灵活定制的数值格式，因此需要一种可高度配置且精确的压缩计算框架。
AI.method: 提出AINF，其核心是可规约为纯整数运算，从而支持无误差乘累加；据此构建矩阵乘法引擎；并引入AIQ作为LLM推理的有损压缩格式，实验采用二次代数整数（degree two）。
AI.result: 矩阵乘法引擎性能处于最高效数值对应方案的可预测倍数范围内；AIQ在等效每参数比特预算下，在多种模型与基准上取得与业界标准MX格式相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: AINF与AIQ具备高可配置性与竞争性精度优势；向高阶及多维代数整数的推广有望带来更大计算优势，是未来有前景的方向。

title: Generative Control of Time-Modulated Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces for Scalable Directional Modulation
summary: Time-modulated intelligent reflecting surfaces (TM-IRS) achieve directional modulation by switching their elements on and off at designed instants and durations, so that an undistorted signal reaches the intended user while appearing scrambled elsewhere. We propose a Flow Matching (FM)-based generative framework that designs these parameters for strong scrambling and reliable reception simultaneously. For orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) signals, we introduce a physics-informed reward that maximizes the time-modulation harmonic energy radiated in the null space of the legitimate-user response, subject to a minimum per-subcarrier signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), without requiring knowledge of adversary directions. Unlike prior generative flow network (GFlowNet) approaches, which assign discretized parameters sequentially, the FM model generates complete continuous configurations jointly, decoupling the generation depth from the number of elements and accelerating training. It also learns a distribution over configurations that can be resampled to vary the scrambling pattern. Numerical results show that, compared with a GFlowNet baseline, the proposed approach reduces the time to training loss near-saturation by $99.4\%$ on average for $3{\times}3$ to $12{\times}12$ surfaces, attains higher final rewards, scales to $80{\times}80$, and confines the low-symbol-error region more tightly around the legitimate user.

AI.tldr: 提出基于流匹配的生成框架，为时间调制智能反射面联合设计调制参数，实现强扰码与可靠接收。
AI.motivation: TM-IRS可通过对单元的通断定时实现定向调制，但需同时保证合法用户信号无失真、其他方向被扰码。既有GFlowNet方法逐序离散分配参数，生成深度随单元数增长，训练慢。
AI.method: 面向OFDM信号，设计物理知情奖励：在合法用户响应零空间内最大化时间调制谐波能量，同时满足每子载波最小SINR约束，无需已知窃听者方向。FM模型一次性联合生成完整连续配置，将生成深度与单元数解耦，并学习配置分布以便重采样变换扰码图样。
AI.result: 相比GFlowNet基线，3×3至12×12表面训练损失接近饱和的时间平均减少99.4%，最终奖励更高，可扩展至80×80，低误符号区域更紧地局限于合法用户周围。
AI.conclusion: FM生成框架在TM-IRS参数设计中兼顾扰码强度与合法接收可靠性，训练效率与可扩展性显著优于顺序离散生成方法。

title: Coherent ultraviolet frequency combs generated by resonant dispersive waves
summary: Resonant dispersive wave (RDW) emission in gas-filled anti-resonant hollow-core fibers (AR-HCF) offers a wavelength-tunable route to ultraviolet (UV) and vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) frequency comb generation. RDW emission is expected to be coherent fundamentally, but various noise sources are expected to limit the coherence, including amplitude-to-phase fluctuations due to input pulse intensity noise and plasma formation. It is critical, therefore, to establish the limits of the coherence of UV RDW pulses to determine their applicability for precision spectroscopy. Here, we demonstrate the coherence of RDW emission at 260~nm generated with an amplified Yb-doped fiber system at a 2-MHz repetition rate with a self-heterodyne beat measurement between the RDW and the fourth harmonic of the source. We isolate the RDW contribution to the frequency noise by coherently subtracting the carrier-envelope offset noise contribution measured simultaneously with an f-2f interferometer. We observe a beatnote linewidth below 10~kHz over timescales longer than 100~ms, and we find a conservative upper bound of 1~rad on the integrated RMS phase deviations over a frequency range spanning 1 to 30~kHz. The dominant frequency noise contributions are consistent with environmental noise of the interferometers and AR-HCF coupling fluctuations. These results provide strong evidence that RDW emission is coherent under well-controlled experimental conditions, confirming its potential for UV and VUV frequency comb generation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自外差拍频测量，证明气体填充反谐振空芯光纤中260 nm共振色散波发射具有高相干性，支持其用于紫外/真空紫外频率梳生成。
AI.motivation: 共振色散波（RDW）发射为紫外（UV）与真空紫外（VUV）频率梳生成提供了波长可调路径，理论上应具相干性，但输入脉冲强度噪声引起的幅相波动与等离子体形成等噪声源可能限制相干性，因此需确定UV RDW脉冲的相干性极限以评估其在精密光谱中的适用性。
AI.method: 在2 MHz重复频率下使用放大的掺镱光纤系统，在气体填充反谐振空芯光纤（AR-HCF）中产生260 nm RDW；采用RDW与源四次谐波之间的自外差拍频测量，并通过同时用f-2f干涉仪测得的载波包络偏移噪声进行相干扣除，以分离RDW对频率噪声的贡献。
AI.result: 在超过100 ms的时间尺度上观测到低于10 kHz的拍频线宽；在1至30 kHz频率范围内，积分均方根相位偏差的保守上界为1 rad。主导频率噪声贡献与环境干涉仪噪声及AR-HCF耦合波动一致。
AI.conclusion: 在良好控制的实验条件下，RDW发射具有相干性，证实其在UV与VUV频率梳生成中的潜力。

title: CacheFlex: Direct Software-Managed Access to Higher-Level Cache for Scalable Vector Support
comment: To appear in MICRO 2026. 15 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables
summary: Wider vector/SIMD lanes multiply compute throughput, but cache improvements remain challenging. We identify L1 data cache capacity as the most impactful parameter for performance and efficiency. L1 capacity is constrained by pipeline coupling and latency requirements; private L2 offers an order of magnitude more capacity but is inaccessible from software. This work proposes CacheFlex, an ISA and microarchitecture co-design that enables software-managed, direct access to private L2 SRAM by allowing runtime conversion of parts of L2 into a scratchpad memory (SPM). Through a lightweight ISA extension, software explicitly controls data placement and lifetime within the L2. CacheFlex integrates into an out-of-order pipeline with cross-domain memory consistency and OS context-switch support, with merely 2.02% area overhead relative to the L2 in a post-layout 12 nm implementation. We prototype CacheFlex based on the Armv8-A SVE ISA, model it in gem5, and evaluate it using optimized general matrix multiplication (GEMM) kernels with diverse model-derived shapes, FlashAttention-based fused attention, and full-layer workloads from LLaMA-3.2-1B and BERT-Base in the prefill phase. As the vector length (VL) scales from VL = 4 (512-bit) to VL = 16 (2048-bit), CacheFlex's kernel-level geometric-mean speedup and memory-subsystem energy reduction grow from 1.12x and 26% to 1.44x and 40%, respectively, bridging the widening gap between per-instruction data demand and memory performance. On full transformer layers combining CacheFlex with FlashAttention, the design delivers up to 1.78x speedup and 45% memory-subsystem energy savings (BERT-Base, sequence length T=4096, VL = 16; LLaMA-3.2-1B: 1.64x and 38%). CacheFlex is complementary to hardware prefetching, and its benefit grows as vector width and peak compute throughput increase for compute-intensive AI kernels.

AI.tldr: 提出 CacheFlex，一种 ISA 与微架构协同设计，允许软件将私有 L2 SRAM 运行时转换为暂存存储器（SPM），实现软件管理的数据放置与生命周期。
AI.motivation: SIMD 向量宽度增加提升了计算吞吐，但缓存改进滞后。作者指出 L1 数据缓存容量是影响性能与能效的最关键参数，然而 L1 容量受流水线耦合与延迟要求限制，私有 L2 虽容量大一个数量级却无法被软件访问，导致每指令数据需求与内存性能之间差距不断扩大。
AI.method: CacheFlex 通过轻量级 ISA 扩展让软件显式控制数据在 L2 中的放置与生命周期，将 L2 部分区域动态转换为 SPM；集成到乱序流水线中，支持跨域内存一致性与 OS 上下文切换。基于 Armv8-A SVE 指令集在 12nm 后布局实现中验证，仅带来相对 L2 的 2.02% 面积开销，并在 gem5 中建模。
AI.result: 在 VL 从 4（512-bit）扩展到 16（2048-bit）时，内核级几何平均加速比与内存子系统能耗降低分别从 1.12x、26% 增长到 1.44x、40%。在结合 FlashAttention 的完整 Transformer 层上，BERT-Base（T=4096，VL=16）取得最高 1.78x 加速与 45% 内存子系统能耗节省，LLaMA-3.2-1B 为 1.64x 与 38%。
AI.conclusion: CacheFlex 能有效弥合每指令数据需求与内存性能之间不断扩大的差距，且与硬件预取互补，其收益随向量宽度与峰值计算吞吐提升而增大，尤其适用于计算密集型 AI 内核。

title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each turn, the Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions. It proposes and implements a new feature with feature tests, then embeds a subtle bug in that feature along with sealed bug-triggering tests. The resulting pull request is admitted only if (1) it passes the feature tests and the repository's existing tests while failing exactly the bug tests, and (2) a fresh session of the same agent can repair the bug blind, which rules out unsolvable tasks. The Blue agent then reviews the pull request without being told a bug exists. It wins only if its revision passes all three test suites, and then the two agents swap roles. We run a tournament among 11 model-harness participants on 15 repositories in five languages for 1,500 turns. The leaders win in different ways. GPT-5.5 with Codex CLI ranks first as the strongest solver, repairing 98.3% of the defects it reviews. Claude Opus 4.8 with mini-swe-agent ranks second as the strongest task author, with a 27.3% Red win rate. Finally, within one model family, tasks written by the newest version defeat a fixed-reference solver far more often than those of older versions (42.9% vs. 4.0%), giving preliminary evidence that task difficulty scales with task authoring capability.

AI.tldr: 提出自扩展（self-scaling）基准理念与 SWE-Duel 竞技场，让两个编码智能体通过镜像红蓝回合互相出题与解题，任务与判定在评测时生成，避免泄漏与饱和。
AI.motivation: 静态编码基准在发布时即固定，其任务会逐渐泄漏进训练数据，且更强的智能体会最终使基准饱和，从而失去区分度；因此需要一种任务与判定都在评测时产生、难度由参与智能体决定的基准。
AI.method: SWE-Duel 采用镜像红蓝回合机制：Red 智能体在三个上下文隔离会话中对真实仓库提出并实现新功能（含功能测试），随后植入隐蔽 bug 与封存的触发测试；PR 仅在同时满足两项条件时被接纳——通过功能测试与仓库既有测试且恰好失败于 bug 测试，以及同一智能体的全新会话能盲修该 bug（排除不可解任务）。Blue 智能体在不知存在 bug 的情况下评审 PR，仅当其修改通过全部三套测试才算获胜，随后双方交换角色。实验在 15 个仓库、5 种语言、11 个模型-harness 组合上进行，共 1,500 回合。
AI.result: 领先者以不同方式取胜：GPT-5.5 + Codex CLI 作为最强解题者排名第一，修复其所评审缺陷的 98.3%；Claude Opus 4.8 + mini-swe-agent 作为最强出题者排名第二，Red 胜率 27.3%。同一模型族内，最新版本所写任务击败固定参考解题者的频率远高于旧版本（42.9% vs. 4.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 实验初步表明任务难度随出题能力而扩展，验证了 self-scaling 基准在抗泄漏、抗饱和及区分智能体能力方面的可行性与潜力。

title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
summary: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.

AI.tldr: EliteTable 是一种由大语言模型引导的自改进程序搜索算法，用固定容量高分解表引导提案、编辑与重组；在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上，多数任务搜索分数中位数提升，部分任务获胜方案增益可迁移至新回合，但组件贡献与相对性能仍需对比与消融验证。
AI.motivation: 利用大语言模型驱动程序搜索，并通过高分解表机制复用优质解，以提升搜索过程中的解质量及其向新回合的迁移能力。
AI.method: 维护固定容量的高分解表，据其引导新提案生成、对现有解进行编辑以及多解重组；在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上评估，每任务十代、每代五十个候选槽位，每任务运行十次独立初始化的搜索。
AI.result: 六个任务的候选分数中位数从首代到末代均上升，五个任务中入选获胜者的搜索分数中位数上升；CartPole-v1 中十次搜索的获胜者在首代即达搜索分数上限；六个任务中有四个任务的十组配对留出端点全部改善；BipedalWalker-v3 与 CarRacing-v3 有改善但未达标；Acrobot-v1 十次搜索中有六次在留出回合上下降，配对变化中位数为负。
AI.conclusion: 结果记录了程序搜索过程中的改进，以及部分任务中获胜方案增益向新回合的迁移；仍需通过对比实验与消融研究确定 EliteTable 的相对性能及各组件贡献。

title: TraceICL: Thread-Resolved Demonstration Curation with Consistency Calibration for Robust Multimodal In-Context Learning
summary: Interleaved multimodal in-context learning (ICL) lets frozen large vision-language models (LVLMs) acquire new tasks from a handful of image-text-answer demonstrations, yet it remains fragile: demonstrations bind to the wrong images, redundant exemplars crowd out informative ones, and noisy answers are copied verbatim into predictions. We present AVA, a training-free framework that organizes the demonstration pipeline of multimodal ICL into three composable stages. A Thread-Resolved Decomposer (TRD) segments the interleaved context into per-sample threads and re-stitches them with explicit boundaries, restoring image-text binding. An Influence-scored Demonstration Selector (IDS) estimates each candidate's marginal influence with one extra forward pass, removes redundancy, and orders the survivors by descending value. A Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration (WSC) module scores each demonstration by a weak sibling model's reconstruction confidence and softly reweights its contribution during decoding. On five vision-language benchmarks with interleaved 4-shot prompts, AVA improves the strongest same-setting baseline by +1.7 points on average, with gains of up to +2.4 points on VizWiz, shrinks the require-visual performance gap on ScienceQA-IMG, and retains most of its gain under 30% noisy demonstrations, at a 26% latency overhead that an offline cache amortizes. No gradients are ever computed; the LVLM stays frozen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练框架AVA，将交错多模态上下文学习（ICL）的示例流程拆解为三个可组合阶段，修复图文绑定、示例冗余与噪声答案复制问题，在5个视觉语言基准上平均提升最强同设定基线1.7分。
AI.motivation: 交错多模态ICL虽能让冻结的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）从少量图文答案示例中获取新任务，但仍较脆弱：示例与错误图像绑定、冗余示例挤占信息量大的示例、噪声答案被逐字复制进预测结果。
AI.method: AVA为免训练框架，含三阶段：Thread-Resolved Decomposer（TRD）将交错上下文切分为逐样本线程并以显式边界重新拼接，恢复图文绑定；Influence-scored Demonstration Selector（IDS）通过一次额外前向传播估计每个候选示例的边际影响，去除冗余并按价值降序排列；Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration（WSC）用弱同级模型的重建置信度对每个示例打分，并在解码时软性重加权其贡献。全过程不计算梯度，LVLM保持冻结。
AI.result: 在5个视觉语言基准的交错4-shot提示下，AVA相比最强同设定基线平均提升+1.7分，VizWiz上最高提升+2.4分，缩小了ScienceQA-IMG上的需视觉性能差距，并在30%噪声示例下保留大部分增益；延迟开销为26%，可通过离线缓存摊销。
AI.conclusion: AVA无需训练即可显著且稳健地提升冻结LVLM的交错多模态ICL性能，并对噪声示例具备一定鲁棒性，代价是可摊销的延迟开销。

title: Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality
summary: Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1--15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. The two attention variants tested at 3\,000 steps (LiZAttention2 and window attention alone) reach a minimum loss near $10^{-3}$. After 600 steps, the mean minimum loss ranges from 0.018 (patch codec) to 0.354 (depthwise convolutional codec) with an identical ranking on three seeds. An apparent advantage of shared over separate attention projections closes with more steps or more diverse data and reverses when the projections are frozen: it is a convergence-speed effect, not a capacity effect. These checks suggest that the implementation optimizes; they say nothing about generalization, multimodal training or comparison with existing models, which a planned pretraining run is meant to address. The Discussion sizes a 200M-total/25M-active target analytically; none of its throughput figures is measured. Code is available at https://github.com/fabienfrfr/Kairos . Python package at https://pypi.org/project/kairos-fm/ .

AI.tldr: Kairos 是一个面向单机小规模训练的语言模型架构组合，本报告通过过拟合单句的收敛性检查验证其各组件能否正常优化，而非验证其泛化或实用性。
AI.motivation: 在单台本地机器上训练小语言模型，留给架构试错的空间很小，因此需要先确认复杂架构组合是否至少能被优化，再讨论其是否有用。
AI.method: 架构上结合双向门控 DeltaNet 线性注意力与滑动窗口注意力共享投影（LiZAttention2）、块级 Attention-Residual 聚合、稀疏 MoE 前馈层及多尺度字节级编解码器，在统一的字节空间上以均匀噪声去噪目标训练。实验为收敛性健全性检查：在 1–15M 参数、纯文本、单条 440 字节句子上过拟合，编解码器与注意力选择用三个随机种子，其余七个因素做单次扫描；并给出各组件（含跨会话循环状态记忆门）由代码导出的算法。
AI.result: 两种注意力变体（LiZAttention2 与单独窗口注意力）在 3000 步时最低损失接近 1e-3。600 步后平均最低损失从 0.018（patch 编解码器）到 0.354（深度可分离卷积编解码器），三个种子排序一致。共享注意力投影相对独立投影的表面优势随步数或数据多样性增加而消失，且在投影冻结时反转，说明这是收敛速度效应而非容量效应。
AI.conclusion: 这些检查表明实现是可优化的，但不能说明泛化性、多模态训练或与现有模型的比较，这些将由计划中的预训练来考察。讨论部分仅对 2 亿总参数/2500 万激活参数的目标做了分析性规模估计，所有吞吐量数字均非实测。

title: Self-Calibration DOA Estimation for Moving Dilated Arrays with Gain and Phase Errors
summary: Moving dilated arrays (MDAs) can increase the uniform degrees of freedom (uDOFs) while alleviating mutual coupling, but their performance is susceptible to unknown gain and phase errors (GPEs). To deal with this problem, we investigate self-calibration direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation for MDAs with unknown GPEs. First, multi-position observations are phase aligned to construct an equivalent virtual array with an enlarged aperture. Next, the motion-induced relationships among the GPEs are exploited to establish explicit calibration constraints. By leveraging the orthogonality between the steering vectors and the noise subspace, the joint estimation of the DOAs and GPEs is formulated as a constrained optimization problem. To solve this problem, a two-stage alternating optimization (AO) algorithm is developed. In the first stage, the GPEs are estimated in closed form with the DOAs fixed. In the second stage, the estimated GPEs are used to calibrate the covariance matrix, after which the DOAs are refined using the multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm. To obtain reliable initial estimates, a rotational invariance-like (RIL) initialization method is further developed by exploiting two translated virtual subarrays with identical GPEs. Furthermore, the Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) is derived to characterize the theoretical performance limit of the considered system. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method converges reliably and achieves accurate DOA estimation under different array apertures, numbers of snapshots, GPE levels, and numbers of sources.

AI.tldr: 针对存在未知增益相位误差(GPE)的移动稀疏阵列(MDA)，提出基于多位置相位对齐与交替优化的自校准DOA估计方法。
AI.motivation: 移动稀疏阵列(MDA)能提升均匀自由度(uDOF)并缓解互耦，但其性能对未知增益相位误差(GPE)敏感，因此需要研究MDA在未知GPE下的自校准DOA估计问题。
AI.method: 1) 对多位置观测进行相位对齐，构造孔径扩大的等效虚拟阵列；2) 利用运动引起的GPE间关系建立显式校准约束，结合导向矢量与噪声子空间的正交性，将DOA与GPE联合估计建模为约束优化问题；3) 提出两阶段交替优化(AO)算法：第一阶段固定DOA闭式估计GPE，第二阶段用估计的GPE校准协方差矩阵并用MUSIC精化DOA；4) 提出类旋转不变(RIL)初始化方法，利用具有相同GPE的两个平移虚拟子阵获得可靠初值；5) 推导CRB以刻画系统理论性能极限。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明所提方法能够可靠收敛，并在不同阵列孔径、快拍数、GPE水平及信源数下均实现准确的DOA估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为存在未知GPE的移动稀疏阵列提供了有效的自校准DOA估计方案，并通过CRB与仿真验证了其理论性能与鲁棒性。

title: Theory of Disorder-Induced Multimode Coupling in a Fabry-Pérot Cavity
summary: Strong light--matter interactions have attracted significant interest in physical chemistry due to the potential for modifying molecular processes by hybridizing with cavity photons and forming polaritonic states. However, for a disordered molecular ensemble within an optical cavity capable of supporting multiple photon modes, theoretical understanding of multimode polaritons remains incomplete, particularly regarding whether and how distinct photon modes are mutually coupled through molecules. In this work, we generalize the collective mode expansion formalism to incorporate multiple photonic modes and show that spatial and orientational disorder in the light--matter coupling strength (originating from dipole orientation fluctuations and photonic field inhomogeneity) can mediate cross-mode coupling. This disorder-induced coupling allows for energy transfer to otherwise unexcited photon modes through a mechanism termed disorder-induced multimode activation (DIMA). Using an effective one-dimensional Fabry--Pérot cavity as a test system, we demonstrate that the cross-mode energy transfer through DIMA can be controlled by changing the molecular layer thickness and the optical properties of the mirrors. Furthermore, we show that DIMA is robust against weak energetic disorder. This mechanistic understanding lays the foundation for a systematic control of multimode photon coupling using disorder-induced effects.

AI.tldr: 本文将集合模式展开形式推广到多光子模式，揭示空间与取向无序可介导腔模间耦合，提出"无序诱导多模激活"(DIMA)机制，并在1D法布里-珀罗腔中验证其可控性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 强光-物质相互作用可通过腔光子与分子杂化形成极化激元态来调控分子过程，但多模光腔中无序分子集合的多模极化激元理论尚不完善，尤其不清楚不同光子模式是否以及如何通过分子相互耦合。
AI.method: 将集合模式展开(collective mode expansion)形式推广至含多个光子模式的情形；引入由偶极取向涨落与光子场不均匀性产生的光-物质耦合强度的空间与取向无序；以有效一维法布里-珀罗腔为测试体系进行理论分析。
AI.result: 耦合强度无序可介导跨模式耦合，使能量转移到原本未被激发的光子模式，即DIMA机制；该跨模式能量转移可通过改变分子层厚度和镜子光学性质进行调控；同时DIMA对弱能量无序具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该机理为利用无序诱导效应系统性地调控多模光子耦合奠定了基础。

title: TPCS: A Cycle-Level Simulation Paradigm with Native Execution Semantics for RTL Modeling and Generation
summary: The growing diversity of domain-specific architectures and microarchitectural designs demands fast and accurate evaluation methods during early design stages. However, existing approaches suffer from a fundamental trade-off: high-level simulators offer speed but lack fidelity, while RTL-based tools provide accuracy at the cost of significant simulation overhead. This gap limits efficient pre-RTL microarchitecture exploration. Therefore, we propose Transaction-Pruned Cycle Simulation (TPCS), a novel modeling and simulation framework. It serves as a unified intermediate abstraction spanning microarchitecture modeling, cycle-accurate simulation, and synthesizable RTL implementation. TPCS organizes combinational logic as transaction-based function invocations and leverages host CPU control flow to naturally prune inactive logic, eliminating the need for explicit event scheduling or signal tracking. This enables cycle-accurate simulation with significantly improved performance. TPCS preserves structural correspondence with RTL and supports automatic generation of synthesizable designs. TPCS achieves 36$\times$-42$\times$ speedups over parallel Verilator on SMP systems and 3.4$\times$-7.2$\times$ over single-threaded Verilator on accelerators, with cycle-level waveform agreement on the evaluated traces. The generated RTL demonstrates comparable timing and area to handcrafted implementations, with relative changes of -4.7\% to +2.6\% in clock period and -3.3\% to +4.0\% in standard-cell area. By bridging the abstraction gap between high-level modeling and RTL design, TPCS enables a unified and agile pre-RTL workflow, allowing efficient microarchitecture exploration with both high performance and implementation fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出事务剪枝周期仿真（TPCS）框架，统一微架构建模、周期精确仿真与可综合RTL生成，兼顾高性能与实现保真度。
AI.motivation: 领域专用架构与微架构设计日益多样，早期设计阶段亟需快速且准确的评估手段。现有方法存在根本性权衡：高层模拟器速度快但保真度低，RTL工具准确但仿真开销巨大，导致pre-RTL微架构探索效率受限。
AI.method: TPCS将组合逻辑组织为基于事务的函数调用，借助宿主机CPU控制流天然剪除不活跃逻辑，无需显式事件调度或信号追踪；该抽象保持与RTL的结构对应，并支持自动生成可综合设计。
AI.result: 在SMP系统上相比并行Verilator实现36×-42×加速，在加速器上相比单线程Verilator实现3.4×-7.2×加速，且波形与周期级一致；生成RTL的时钟周期变化为-4.7%~+2.6%，标准单元面积变化为-3.3%~+4.0%，与手工实现相当。
AI.conclusion: TPCS弥合了高层建模与RTL设计之间的抽象鸿沟，实现了兼具高性能与实现保真度的统一、敏捷pre-RTL工作流，支持高效的微架构探索。

title: Contextual Correction of Parallel Draftsfor Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by the target model. Recent diffusion-based drafters make this paradigm particularly attractive: deep attention-based neural backbones provide strong predictions, while drafting multiple future positions in parallel avoids the sequential cost of autoregressive generation. This parallelism, however, comes at a cost. Tokens within a draft block are predicted without access to the realized identities of preceding draft tokens, removing intra-block dependencies that would naturally be available under autoregressive generation. We introduce DCOCO (DFlash Contextual Corrector), a lightweight mechanism that restores these dependencies while preserving parallel drafting. Rather than committing to each position's top prediction, DCOCO retains multiple candidate tokens and evaluates their contextual compatibility across adjacent draft positions in parallel, enabling contextually informed token selection at low additional cost. Across four verifier backbones and ten benchmarks, DCOCO achieves the highest average throughput in every evaluated configuration, spanning greedy and stochastic decoding with and without extended reasoning, with speedups of up to 6.6x over vanilla decoding. Its advantage persists under concurrent serving: DCOCO outperforms the strongest competing method by 6-23% across 4-32 concurrent requests, while other sequential correctors fall below uncorrected DFlash at these loads. These results demonstrate that recovering intra-block dependencies through parallel contextual scoring delivers consistent acceleration across decoding regimes and serving loads.

AI.tldr: 提出 DCOCO，一种轻量级并行上下文校正机制，恢复扩散式草稿器中缺失的块内依赖，在四种验证器与十个基准上取得最高平均吞吐，最高达 6.6 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散式草稿器虽能并行预测多个未来位置的 token，但同一草稿块内的 token 在预测时无法获知前序草稿 token 的真实身份，丢失了自回归生成中天然存在的块内依赖，导致草稿质量受限。
AI.method: DCOCO 不直接采用每个位置的 top-1 预测，而是为各位置保留多个候选 token，并行评估相邻草稿位置之间的上下文兼容性，从而以较低额外开销实现上下文感知的 token 选择，同时保持并行草稿。
AI.result: 在四种验证器骨干与十个基准、覆盖贪心与随机解码、含与不含扩展推理的所有配置中均取得最高平均吞吐，相对原始解码最高加速 6.6 倍；在并发服务下，于 4–32 并发请求时比最强对比方法高 6–23%，而其他串行校正器在此负载下甚至低于未校正的 DFlash。
AI.conclusion: 通过并行上下文打分恢复块内依赖，可在多种解码模式与服务负载下稳定带来加速，验证了该思路的有效性与通用性。

title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Preregistered negative result with an open evaluation protocol; companion artifacts archived at 10.5281/zenodo.22929494 and 10.5281/zenodo.22930513
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart list scheduler with no search tree as the control; and a textbook-UCT MCTS arm as a registered follow-up on the same domain. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starvation: on the separate exploration pool restarts self-improve by 1.85% where MCTS gains 0.24%, and 700 of 720 of MCTS's first results are merely the warm start it was handed. The studied selection rule locks deterministically onto the first-expanded child, keeping its trials correlated while restarts draw gains from the tails; the causal link to makespan remains an inference. A structural map locates where the tree stops paying: restarts win on sparse irregular workflows, no difference is detectable on regular layered ones, and dense ones leave no room to improve. Swapping the rule for textbook UCT removes most of the deficit (-0.26%, 95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]) without reversing its sign. Results are confined to a controlled synthetic domain (N in {8,16,32} tasks, 2-8 processors, budgets up to 2048); we make no claim about larger budgets.

AI.tldr: 在等预算（2048次调度评估）的对照实验下，MCTS调度DAG工作流比无搜索树的随机重启列表调度差2.88%；用教科书式UCT替换其选择规则可消除大部分劣势（-0.26%），优势区间限于稀疏不规则工作流，结论受限于受控合成域。
AI.motivation: 既有大量工作将MCTS用于DAG工作流调度，但多数研究未做"给更简单方法同等搜索努力"的反驳性对照实验，因此MCTS的实际增益缺乏被证伪的机会。本文旨在以受控协议补上这一关键对照。
AI.method: 采用预注册与锁定分析计划的受控协议：所有实验组获得相同预算（构建并评估的候选调度数相同）。主实验组为MCTS调度方法，对照组为无搜索树的随机重启列表调度器，另设教科书式UCT-MCTS作为同域注册后续实验。确认阶段96个实例、共768个调度由独立检查者验证有效且完工时间正确；另设独立探索池考察自改进；并做结构化实例映射（稀疏不规则/规则分层/稠密）与选择规则替换的消融。
AI.result: 主预算2048次评估下，MCTS比随机重启差2.88%（95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]；96个留出实例中72个存在正的基线相对改进空间）。劣势并非预算不足：探索池中重启自改进1.85%，MCTS仅0.24%，且720次MCTS首次结果中700次只是其被赋予的热启动。所研究的选择规则确定性锁定首个扩展子节点，导致试次相关；与完工时间的因果关系仍属推断。结构映射显示：稀疏不规则工作流上重启胜出，规则分层工作流无显著差异，稠密工作流无可改进空间。换成教科书UCT后劣势大部分消失（-0.26%，95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]），但符号未反转。
AI.conclusion: 在受控合成域（任务数N∈{8,16,32}，2-8个处理器，预算至2048）内，MCTS在该DAG调度任务上未能超越同等搜索努力的简单随机重启方法，其缺陷主要源于选择规则的确定性锁定而非预算不足；对更大预算不作任何推断。研究强调领域内需开展等努力对照实验，并对MCTS的适用条件（工作流结构特征）作明确界定。

title: TerraAgent: Demonstration-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Long-Context Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
summary: Remote sensing visual question answering (RS-VQA) requires answers that truly depend on image evidence, yet current remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS MLLMs) are still evaluated mainly by accuracy, which cannot reveal whether a correct answer was produced without using the image. This setting introduces three challenges: demonstrations retrieved across different ground sample distances (GSD), sensors, and city textures may be poorly matched; real queries often involve long visual contexts from multi-scale tiles, multi-temporal frames, and retrieved knowledge, where evidence can be diluted and errors can propagate through multi-step reasoning; and prior-only answering remains invisible to standard metrics. We present AVA, a training-free framework that wraps a frozen RS MLLM with three modules. GDR performs GSD-bucketed, scene-graph-based demonstration retrieval and filters demonstrations whose answers are unsupported by their images. MACE decomposes each query into an evidence-typed sub-question DAG, routes sub-questions to suitable perception tools, and records verified provenance in a shared evidence ledger with bounded re-perception. CVA audits the final answer through counterfactual perturbations of cited evidence, including ablation and swap, and computes a visual-dependency score for confidence calibration and evidence-forcing re-query. On RSVQA-LR/HR, VRSBench, and LHRS-Bench, AVA improves average accuracy by up to 2.40 points over the strongest same-setting baselines, raises the visual-dependency score from 0.28 to 0.49, reduces the prior-only answer rate from 46.2 percent to 21.7 percent, and lowers the hallucination rate from 17.1 percent to 9.8 percent, with 2.6x the cost of a single backbone forward pass and no fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: AVA 是一个免训练框架，通过 GDR、MACE、CVA 三个模块包裹冻结的遥感多模态大模型，在提升准确率的同时显著增强视觉依赖、降低先验作答与幻觉。
AI.motivation: 当前遥感视觉问答（RS-VQA）评测主要依赖准确率，无法判断正确答案是否真正基于图像证据而产生，导致"仅凭先验作答"（prior-only answering）难以被察觉。该场景存在三大挑战：跨 GSD、传感器与城市场景纹理检索到的示例匹配度差；真实查询涉及多尺度瓦片、多时相帧与检索知识的长期视觉上下文，证据易被稀释且多步推理中误差会传播；先验作答对常规指标不可见。
AI.method: 提出 AVA，一个免训练框架，用三个模块包裹冻结的 RS MLLM：（1）GDR：按 GSD 分桶、基于场景图的示例检索，并过滤掉答案不受其图像支持的示例；（2）MACE：将查询分解为证据类型化的子问题有向无环图（DAG），将子问题路由到合适的感知工具，并在共享证据账本中记录经核验的来源，配合有界重感知；（3）CVA：通过对引用证据进行反事实扰动（消融与替换）审计最终答案，计算视觉依赖分数用于置信度校准与证据强制重查询。
AI.result: 在 RSVQA-LR/HR、VRSBench 与 LHRS-Bench 上，AVA 相较最强同设定基线平均准确率最高提升 2.40 分，视觉依赖分数从 0.28 提升至 0.49，先验作答率从 46.2% 降至 21.7%，幻觉率从 17.1% 降至 9.8%，成本为单骨干前向传播的 2.6 倍且无需微调。
AI.conclusion: AVA 通过免训练的检索、证据分解与反事实审计机制，将 RS-VQA 的评测与推理从单一准确率推进到可验证的视觉依赖性，在多个基准上同时改善准确率与可信度相关指标。

title: An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models
summary: Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. In 6M-parameter character-level models on WikiText-2, the input-dependent phase matches the original at the training length and removes its failure beyond it: trained on 256 tokens and tested on 1024, perplexity falls from 12.81 to 3.76. We trace the failure to long-memory heads that accumulate more history than training exposed them to. The learned phase tracks the current character rather than distance and does not improve retrieval.

AI.tldr: 将 ResonatorLM 每个头的读出相位改为当前 token 的函数，在参数量仅增 0.2% 的前提下保持精确卷积路径，并消除训练长度之外的性能崩溃。
AI.motivation: 固定状态序列模型需在两类设计间取舍：输入依赖的状态转移能带来内容相关记忆，但代价是必须使用基于 FFT 的训练；固定转移保留 O(T log T) 卷积路径，却对所有输入以相同方式读取记忆。作者希望在不放弃精确卷积的前提下，为读出环节注入输入依赖性。
AI.method: 以 ResonatorLM（每头通过固定学习相位读取一组阻尼复振荡器）为基础，把读出相位改为当前 token 的函数，使输入依赖仅存在于读出环节。用未经训练的振荡器组分析相位对经过时间的编码能力，并在 WikiText-2 上以 6M 参数、字符级模型进行训练长度 256、测试长度 1024 的实验，对比原始模型与输入依赖相位版本。
AI.result: 未训练振荡器组的分析表明相位确实编码了经过时间，但普通 token 在 2-8 步内即低于背景，且无论怎样选择阻尼，线性可重建范围都不超过约 16 个 token。在 WikiText-2 的 6M 字符级模型上，输入依赖相位在训练长度处与原模型持平，并在超出训练长度时消除其失效：训练 256、测试 1024 时困惑度从 12.81 降至 3.76。
AI.conclusion: 性能崩溃可归因于累积历史超出训练所见范围的长期记忆头。学习到的相位跟踪的是当前字符而非距离，且未改善检索能力。

title: Lightweight Time-Frequency Vibration Sensing for Consumer Device Condition Monitoring
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, and 4 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE 2027)
summary: Consumer rotating devices, including washing machines, air conditioners, electric fans, robotic vacuum cleaners, and home fitness equipment, increasingly rely on vibration sensing for intelligent condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Ensuring reliable operation in these resource-constrained appliances requires efficient, lightweight artificial intelligence (AI) solutions capable of processing non-stationary signals under real-world operational interference. This paper proposes a lightweight AI-assisted vibration sensing framework that employs continuous wavelet transform (CWT) and Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) to convert one-dimensional (1-D) vibration time-series signals into two-dimensional (2-D) time-frequency representations. These representations are subsequently analyzed using lightweight deep learning architectures, specifically MobileNetV3-Small, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and the You Only Look Once version 11 classification model (YOLOv11-cls). Public bearing benchmark datasets, including Case Western Reserve University (CWRU), Paderborn University (PU), and Intelligent Maintenance Systems (IMS), are utilized as representative rotating components to investigate model generalization. The proposed framework is designed with eventual embedded deployment in consumer electronics in mind. Experimental results demonstrate that CWT combined with YOLOv11-cls achieves high diagnostic accuracy, while MobileNetV3-Small provides an attractive low-latency alternative for computationally constrained edge platforms. Conventional random splitting is also compared with dataset-specific structured isolation. The results highlight the importance of avoiding data leakage and quantify tradeoffs in classification accuracy, parameter count, floating-point operations (FLOPs), model footprint, preprocessing cost, and central processing unit (CPU) inference latency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于CWT/HHT与轻量网络(MobileNetV3-Small、ConvNeXt-Tiny、YOLOv11-cls)的振动传感AI框架，在CWRU/PU/IMS轴承数据集上验证诊断精度与边缘部署的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 消费类旋转设备（洗衣机、空调、电风扇、扫地机器人、家用健身器材）日益依赖振动感知实现智能状态监测与预测性维护，但受限于资源受限的运行环境，需在真实工况干扰下处理非平稳信号，因而需要高效、轻量的AI方案。
AI.method: 采用连续小波变换(CWT)与希尔伯特-黄变换(HHT)将1-D振动时序转为2-D时频表示；用轻量深度架构MobileNetV3-Small、ConvNeXt-Tiny、YOLOv11-cls进行分析；以CWRU、Paderborn、IMS公共轴承基准代表旋转部件考察泛化；并对比常规随机划分与数据集专属结构化隔离。
AI.result: CWT结合YOLOv11-cls取得较高诊断准确率；MobileNetV3-Small在算力受限边缘平台上提供低延迟替代方案；同时量化了准确率、参数量、FLOPs、模型体积、预处理开销与CPU推理延迟之间的权衡，并揭示了数据泄漏对结果的影响。
AI.conclusion: 面向消费电子嵌入式部署的轻量AI振动感知框架可行；强调必须避免数据泄漏并采用结构化隔离评估，且需在精度与计算/延迟成本间做显式权衡。

title: Phantom Zernike Wavefront Sensor: Phase Contrast with Engineered Focal Plane Reference Speckles
summary: We introduce the Phantom Zernike Wavefront Sensor (phantom ZWFS), an engineered reference extension of phase-contrast wavefront sensing in which controlled pupil plane modulation generates off-axis coherent speckle structures that undergo localized focal plane phase shifts. These references may replace the central ZWFS reference when the on-axis PSF core is required for another optical function, such as photonic science coupling, or may augment a conventional central ZWFS response to provide additional wavefront information. Using a monochromatic scalar model, we derive the resulting carrier structure and show how the engineered references can be recovered through spatial demodulation and incorporated into calibrated reconstruction. A simple four-reference realization demonstrates that the reference geometry redistributes photon sensitivity across spatial frequency magnitude and orientation, producing mode dependent changes in linearity and cross-talk rather than a uniform improvement over a classical ZWFS. We then consider differential piston on a seven segment aperture as an application specific example. A hybrid sensor retaining the central ZWFS phase region and adding six engineered references that match the segment geometry gives similar precision near the phased state but substantially improved performance at larger piston excursions. Under the adopted photon-noise-limited benchmark, the hybrid reduces the nonlinear reconstruction error and provides better conditioned optical encoding of the piston state than an idealized vector ZWFS, allowing more precise piston estimation from the same detected photon flux at larger piston excursions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Phantom Zernike波前传感器（phantom ZWFS），通过在瞳面引入受控调制产生离轴相干散斑结构并施加局部焦面相移，作为可替代或补充中心ZWFS的参考；以四参考实现与七段差分活塞应用为例，验证其在较大活塞偏移下优于传统与理想矢量ZWFS的重建性能。
AI.motivation: 传统中心ZWFS参考占据轴上PSF核心，当该核心需用于其他光学功能（如光子科学耦合）时无法兼用；同时经典ZWFS在较大波前偏移下线性度下降、交叉耦合增强，需要一种可重新分配光子灵敏度、改善编码条件数的参考结构。
AI.method: 基于单色标量模型推导phantom ZWFS的载波结构，通过空间解调恢复工程化参考并纳入定标重建；构造四参考实现，分析参考几何对空间频率幅度与方向上光子灵敏度的重分布；以七段孔径的差分活塞为应用场景，设计保留中心ZWFS相位区并增加六个匹配分段几何的工程参考的混合传感器，并在光子噪声受限基准下与经典ZWFS及理想矢量ZWFS对比。
AI.result: 四参考实现表明，参考几何将光子灵敏度在空间频率幅度与方向上重新分配，导致线性度与交叉耦合出现模式依赖变化，而非相对经典ZWFS的均匀提升；七段差分活塞的混合传感器在相位锁定态附近精度与中心ZWFS相当，但在较大活塞偏移下性能显著改善，降低了非线性重建误差，相比理想矢量ZWFS提供条件数更优的活塞状态光学编码，在相同探测光子通量下实现更精确的活塞估计。
AI.conclusion: Phantom ZWFS通过离轴工程化参考实现了对中心ZWFS的替代或增强，其收益具有模式与场景依赖性；在七段差分活塞这一具体应用中，混合参考设计在保持近相位态精度的同时显著提升大偏移下的重建性能与编码条件数，为波前传感参考设计提供了兼顾多光学功能的灵活方案。

title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Demo of a Cooperative Intersection where Cars don't Stop
comment: 3 pages, 3 figures, accepted at IEEE CSCN 2025
summary: The road transportation sector is undergoing a radical transformation, working for a future where all vehicles will be autonomous and connected. A key challenge in this vision concerns intersections, which will no longer rely on traffic lights or traditional right-of-way rules. Instead, algorithms and communication protocols will be employed to optimize traffic flow. In this context, we are developing a testbed where cars equipped with wireless connectivity exchange information with a remote controller and coordinate their maneuvers. As the vehicles navigate through different types of intersections with various routes, they communicate with the controller, adjusting their speed to pass through intersections without stopping. This demo specifically showcases a hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) implementation of such intelligent intersection, using the SUMO traffic simulator to emulate vehicle positions. Real hardware and software components, which are designed for use in vehicles and roadside infrastructure, are employed to enable real-time data exchange of contextual and control information, running the cooperative coordination algorithm.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍了一个面向无信号灯智能交叉口的硬件在环（HiL）测试平台，车辆通过无线通信与远程控制器交互，协同调速实现不停车通过交叉口，并以SUMO仿真车辆位置进行演示。
AI.motivation: 道路运输正朝全自动驾驶与网联化方向发展，交叉口将不再依赖红绿灯和传统路权规则，而由算法与通信协议优化交通流。该愿景的实现面临交叉口协同控制的实际验证难题，需要可复现、可验证的测试环境。
AI.method: 构建硬件在环（HiL）测试平台：采用面向车载与路侧基础设施的真实硬件与软件组件，车辆通过无线连接与远程控制器交换上下文与控制信息；使用SUMO交通仿真器模拟车辆位置；在多种类型交叉口和不同路线上运行协同协调算法，实时调整车速以不停车通过。
AI.result: 演示验证了该智能交叉口HiL实现的可行性：真实硬件与软件组件与SUMO仿真耦合，实现了上下文与控制信息的实时数据交换，并成功运行协同协调算法完成不停车通过交叉口的场景。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可连接真实车路组件与交通仿真的智能交叉口测试平台，为无信号灯、基于协同算法的交叉口通行方案的验证与进一步研发提供了基础。

title: CLUE: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Unsupervised Event Type Induction and Annotation
summary: Event ontology is the foundational framework for defining events in a dataset. Event type induction generally involves domain experts who define guidelines for creating event types and their names based on the dataset's domain and scope. However, this process is resource-intensive in terms of annotation costs and is prone to human biases. To alleviate the need for manual event ontology creation, we propose the CLUE framework for event type induction, naming, and annotation. Our main contributions in this work are: 1) designing a novel joint embedding representation for expressing both the verb-centric view and the semantic view of events; 2) event type induction using contrastive loss guided clustering; 3) event naming and refinement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is available at https://github.com/PratikMaitra/CLUE.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLUE 框架，用于事件类型归纳、命名与标注，减少人工事件本体构建成本。
AI.motivation: 事件本体是数据集中定义事件的基础框架，传统事件类型归纳依赖领域专家依据领域与范围制定指南并命名事件类型，但标注成本高且易受人为偏差影响。
AI.method: 1）设计新的联合嵌入表示，同时表达以动词为中心的事件视图和语义视图；2）使用对比损失引导聚类进行事件类型归纳；3）进行事件命名与细化。
AI.result: 实验证明了该方法的有效性，代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: CLUE 可缓解人工事件本体创建需求，实现事件类型归纳、命名与标注。

title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
summary: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $τ^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.

AI.tldr: EvoSyn是一个由学习反馈驱动的多智能体合成框架，通过可修订的合成状态将学习者反馈转化为合成修订，实现合成空间内的自适应与合成空间扩展，在τ²-Bench和CAR-Bench上平均任务成功率提升13.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能力提升日益依赖合成经验，但面向交互式智能体的有效数据合成不仅需要可执行、可验证的轨迹，还需要对当前任务智能体具有学习价值的交互。现有方法虽引入环境反馈、数据验证或学习者失败信息，却存在"反馈到决策的鸿沟"：观察到的弱点无法直接指明未来合成应如何调整，也无法判断这些弱点能否被当前合成空间所表示。
AI.method: 提出EvoSyn，一个学习反馈驱动的多智能体框架，围绕"可修订状态"组织合成，该状态明确哪些交互因素可被有意生成、以及合成努力应分配到何处。系统包含角色专门化的多智能体架构：将学习者反馈转化为合成修订；由Designer分配合成方向，由Planner将方向落地为可执行经验。该过程支持两类机制：空间内自适应（面向薄弱或覆盖不足区域）与合成空间扩展（将新发现因素提升为显式生成控制）。
AI.result: 在τ²-Bench和CAR-Bench上，EvoSyn相比最强合成基线平均任务成功率提升13.3个百分点，同时生成质量更高、结构更广的合成经验，并发现缺少学习者反馈时会被遗漏的可控因素。
AI.conclusion: EvoSyn通过将学习者反馈闭环到合成过程的决策层，弥合了反馈与合成决策之间的鸿沟，同时兼顾合成空间内的精调与空间本身的扩展，验证了学习反馈驱动多智能体合成的有效性与必要性。

title: MIRAGE: Metric Inference and Reliability-Aware Gaussian Estimation from Feed-Forward Vision
summary: Feed-forward 3D priors enable high-quality reconstruction from image streams but often lack reliable metric scale and suffer from long-term trajectory drift. In contrast, LiDAR--inertial estimation provides metrically accurate motion but lacks the image-space consistency needed for high-fidelity reconstruction. We propose $MIRAGE$, which anchors feed-forward visual geometry to LiDAR--IMU metric motion and regulates online pose corrections according to correspondence support and cross-modal agreement, jointly enabling accurate metric pose estimation and high-fidelity Gaussian reconstruction. Experiments on Oxford Spires, M2DGR and INS show that MIRAGE achieves accurate metric trajectory estimation, outperforming COLMAP, a widely used but computationally expensive reference for vision-only benchmarks. Motivated by the scarcity of long-horizon monocular benchmarks for large-scale indoor reconstruction, we further build a multimodal data-collection platform and use MIRAGE to establish accurate 6-DoF reference trajectories for a new vision-only benchmark. We benchmark recent monocular large-scale reconstruction methods on this dataset, providing a systematic evaluation of their performance in long-horizon indoor scenes.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE通过将前馈视觉几何锚定到LiDAR-IMU度量运动，并依据对应点支持度与跨模态一致性调控在线位姿修正，同时实现精确的度量位姿估计与高保真高斯重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D先验虽能从图像流实现高质量重建，但缺乏可靠度量尺度且存在长期轨迹漂移；LiDAR-惯性估计虽具备度量准确的运动，却缺乏高保真重建所需的图像空间一致性。二者互补，需一种联合框架弥合差异。
AI.method: 提出MIRAGE：以LiDAR-IMU度量运动为锚，约束前馈视觉几何；根据对应点支持度与跨模态一致性对在线位姿修正进行调控，从而在统一框架内协同优化度量位姿与高斯重建。此外构建多模态数据采集平台，用于生成新基准的6-DoF参考轨迹。
AI.result: 在Oxford Spires、M2DGR与INS数据集上，MIRAGE实现精确的度量轨迹估计，性能优于计算代价高昂的视觉-only参考方法COLMAP；并据此为新的视觉-only大规模室内重建基准建立了精确6-DoF参考轨迹，对近期单目大规模重建方法进行了系统评测。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE有效融合前馈视觉几何与LiDAR-IMU度量运动，兼顾度量精度与重建保真度；同时揭示长时程单目大规模室内重建基准的稀缺性，所建数据集与评测为后续研究提供参考。

title: CircuitTree: Composing Circuits into A Syllable Transcriber
summary: The goal of circuit discovery is to decompose a monolithic neural network into tiny modular subnetworks which are interpretable in the sense that each does an identifiable subtask. We develop a practical method for composing arbitrarily many circuits into a single model. We propose a greedy, density-scaled composition algorithm that overcomes limitations of previous attempts to compose circuits by naive union, then generalize it to $N$ circuits via CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a $Θ(N\log N)$ tree-compose schedule. We compose circuits pruned from HuBERT for classifying individual phonemes into a syllable classifier, a capability none of the 39 phoneme circuits has individually. Chaining CircuitTrees into a hierarchy-of-circuits pipeline, we transcribe open syllables at 64.8\% accuracy, within 1.2 points of a 66.0\% ceiling that shares no circuitry at all, with 99.5\% of circuit components shared.

AI.tldr: 本文提出电路组合方法CircuitTree，通过贪心、密度缩放的组合算法与Θ(N log N)树形组合调度，将任意多个可解释子网络组合成单一模型，并成功用于语音任务。
AI.motivation: 电路发现旨在将单体神经网络分解为可解释的模块化子网络，每个子网络完成可识别的子任务。然而，现有组合电路的方法多依赖朴素并集，存在明显局限，缺乏将任意多个电路有效组合成单一模型的实用方法。
AI.method: 提出一种贪心、密度缩放的电路组合算法，克服朴素并集组合的局限；进一步将其推广到N个电路，构建CircuitTree数据结构，基于Θ(N log N)的树形组合调度实现多电路组合；并将CircuitTree串联为层次化电路流水线。
AI.result: 从HuBERT中剪枝得到的39个音素电路被组合成音节分类器，实现了单个音素电路不具备的能力；将CircuitTree串联为层次化流水线后，开放音节转写准确率达到64.8%，仅比不共享任何电路的66.0%上限低1.2个百分点，且99.5%的电路组件被共享。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展、可推广的多电路组合框架，验证了通过组合可解释子网络构建复杂能力与层次化流水线的可行性，在极大程度共享组件的同时保持接近专用模型的性能。

title: Certified Outage Dimensioning of Fluid Antenna Receivers: Required SNR, Aperture, and Port Count
summary: We study the SNR, aperture, and port count needed to meet a target outage in a single-user downlink with a fixed transmit antenna and a single-RF fluid antenna receiver. For known spatially correlated Rayleigh channels and ideal port selection, a sampling-free residual certificate controls reduced-rank outage error over a continuous SNR interval. Positive Bessel features support large arrays, and bounded importance sampling converts the certificate into simultaneous design intervals. At 1 bit/s/Hz and outage $10^{-5}$, a four-wavelength, ten-port receiver requires 4.40--4.55 dB. Reducing its port count from 256 to ten costs 0.70--1.25 dB under a joint 95\% probability statement. At 3.5 wavelengths, ten ports require 4.90--5.05 dB. Integer-port screening across 3--8 dB shows how aperture and port requirements change with available SNR; an effective-SNR transformation extends these decisions to other rates. The reported intervals include model and sampling uncertainty under checked Gaussian covariance inputs. A constructive slow-growth rank bound and a 16--1024-port study support compact evaluation as port count grows.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单用户下行链路中单射频流体天线接收机在目标中断概率下的信噪比、孔径与端口数需求，给出基于无采样残差证书的设计区间，并量化孔径与端口数的权衡。
AI.motivation: 流体天线（FAS）通过在一维/二维孔径内可重构端口位置提升接收分集，但实际系统需明确：为达到给定中断目标，需要多大的孔径、多少射频端口以及多少信噪比余量。已有分析多依赖仿真采样，缺乏对连续信噪比区间内降秩近似误差的控制，也缺少将估计不确定性转化为可用设计区间的严谨手段，因此需要一套可验证、无需采样的设计框架。
AI.method: 针对已知空间相关瑞利信道与理想端口选择，构建无采样的残差证书，用于控制降秩近似在连续信噪比区间上的中断概率误差。利用正Bessel特征支持大阵列分析，并通过有界重要性采样将证书转化为同时置信的设计区间。进一步给出构造性慢增长秩界，并进行16–1024端口的数值研究以验证端口数增长时的紧凑评估，同时采用整数端口筛选与有效信噪比变换推广到其他速率。
AI.result: 在1 bit/s/Hz、中断概率10^-5下，四波长、十端口接收机需4.40–4.55 dB；将端口数从256降至10，在联合95%概率陈述下代价为0.70–1.25 dB。3.5波长下十端口需4.90–5.05 dB。3–8 dB的整数端口筛选给出孔径与端口需求随可用信噪比的变化，有效信噪比变换可将结论推广到其他速率。所报区间在高斯协方差输入检验下包含模型与采样不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了面向流体天线接收机的无采样、可验证设计方法：以残差证书与重要性采样给出同时置信的信噪比/孔径/端口数区间，量化了孔径与端口数之间的权衡，并通过构造性秩界与大规模端口研究支持端口数增长下的紧凑评估。

title: Topologically steerable ultra-flat electro-optic combs via non-Hermitian frequency lattices
summary: Electro-optic (EO) frequency combs convert microwave signals to the optical domain with deterministic repetition rates, enabling applications in optical telecommunications, microwave photonics, and LiDAR. However, generating flat EO combs has remained a long-standing challenge due to exponential decay of the spectral envelope inherent to bidirectional frequency coupling within conventional schemes. Here we reveal the inherent correspondence between flat-comb generation and the topological energy bands of non-Hermitian nonreciprocal frequency lattices, and experimentally realize ultra-flat combs with topologically controlled spectral flow. We derive the exact analytical condition for flat-comb generation, and find that it maps precisely onto the complex energy band, thereby establishing a direct connection between comb-envelope engineering and non-Hermitian topology. Experimentally, we observe an ultra-flat comb whose frequency evolution direction is governed by the topological winding and remains robust against detuning and phase fluctuations. This scheme can be further extended to long-range coupling and multi-lattice architectures, underscoring its versatility for flat dual- and multi-comb generation. Our work establishes a topologically steerable approach for achieving ultra-flat EO combs, paving the way for chip-scale spectral engineering via non-Hermitian topology.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了平坦电光频梳生成与非厄米非互易频率晶格拓扑能带之间的内在对应关系，并实验实现了拓扑控制的超平坦频梳。
AI.motivation: 电光频梳在光通信、微波光子学和激光雷达等领域有重要应用，但传统方案中双向频率耦合导致频谱包络指数衰减，生成平坦电光频梳长期是难题。
AI.method: 建立了平坦频梳生成与非厄米非互易频率晶格拓扑能带的对应关系，推导出平坦频梳生成的精确解析条件，并将其与复能带精确映射；实验上通过拓扑绕数控制频谱演化方向。
AI.result: 实验观测到超平坦频梳，其频率演化方向由拓扑绕数决定，并对失谐和相位涨落保持鲁棒性；该方案可推广至长程耦合和多晶格结构，支持平坦双梳及多梳生成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了拓扑可调控的超平坦电光频梳实现方法，为基于非厄米拓扑的芯片级频谱工程开辟了道路。

title: Anechoic: Onsager-Corrected Parallel Annealing for Sub-0.1 ms Dense Max-Cut on an FPGA
summary: Ising machines solve combinatorial optimization problems by annealing a network of spins. On dense problems, the least expensive hardware step updates all spins at once: stochastic cellular automata (SCA) decide every spin in parallel and read couplings only for the spins that flip. Such synchronous updates create an echo: the previous state of each spin returns to it through its neighbors. On K2000, a Max-Cut benchmark on a 2,000-node complete graph, two-thirds of all flips undo the same spin's flip one step earlier. This paper presents Anechoic, an FPGA Ising machine that subtracts this echo from every decision. Dynamical mean-field theory identifies the echo as an Onsager reaction; its one-step strength is the number of spins whose flip probability is strictly between 0 and 1, divided by twice the temperature. The decision logic already flags these spins, so the correction costs one population count per step; a temperature-scaled form needs none. An RTL engine executes a dense 2,000-spin step in 18.1 cycles plus 0.14 per flip, so every saved step and flip saves time. Both forms find better K2000 cuts at every step budget than five published binary-spin algorithms at their papers' settings. Twelve engines at 250 MHz on an AMD Alveo V80 reach a cut of at least 33,000 with 99% probability in 0.05 ms, 5.2 times faster than the fastest published hardware, at 5.4 mJ per solution; with 2-bit couplings, the temperature-scaled form is also faster than uncorrected SCA on 49 of 51 G-set graphs. On an NVIDIA GH200 GPU, the same engine is 2.3 times slower and needs 8.0 times more energy per solution, though its 240 concurrent anneals give 2.3 times the throughput. As a GlobalFoundries 22 nm ASIC at 1.25 GHz, twelve engines would reach the target in about 10 microseconds, 26 times faster than the fastest published hardware. The code is available at https://github.com/skethz/anechoic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Anechoic，一种通过从每次自旋决策中减去"回声"（Onsager 反应项）来加速密集 Ising 机退火的 FPGA 实现，在 K2000 基准上以更高速度和能效超越已发表的二值自旋算法与最快的硬件实现。
AI.motivation: 密集组合优化问题中，最低成本的硬件步骤是随机元胞自动机（SCA）并行更新所有自旋。但这种同步更新会产生"回声"：每个自旋之前的状态通过邻居返回自身。在 K2000（2000 节点完全图的 Max-Cut 基准）中，三分之二的翻转在撤销同一自旋上一步的翻转，造成大量无效计算，降低了退火效率。
AI.method: 用动力学平均场理论将回声识别为 Onsager 反应项，其一步强度等于翻转概率严格介于 0 与 1 之间的自旋数目除以两倍温度。由于决策逻辑已标记这些自旋，校正仅需每步一次 population count；并给出一种温度缩放形式，无需额外计数。在 FPGA 上实现 RTL 引擎，密集 2000 自旋步骤耗时 18.1 个周期加每次翻转 0.14 个周期。
AI.result: 两种校正形式在每个步骤预算下均优于五篇已发表二值自旋算法在其论文设置下的表现。在 AMD Alveo V80 上以 250 MHz 运行 12 个引擎，0.05 ms 内以 99% 概率达到至少 33,000 的割，比最快已发表硬件快 5.2 倍，每解 5.4 mJ；在 2-bit 耦合下，温度缩放形式在 51 个 G-set 图中的 49 个上比未校正 SCA 更快。在 NVIDIA GH200 GPU 上，同引擎慢 2.3 倍、每解能耗高 8.0 倍，但 240 个并发退火带来 2.3 倍吞吐量。作为 GlobalFoundries 22 nm ASIC 在 1.25 GHz 下，12 个引擎约 10 微秒达到目标，比最快已发表硬件快 26 倍。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过从自旋决策中消除同步更新产生的回声（Onsager 反应），Anechoic 显著提升了密集 Ising 机的退火效率，在速度与能效上大幅超越现有最优硬件与算法实现，并展现出 ASIC 实现的巨大潜力。

title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models
summary: A latent recurrent language model applies a shared block of layers repeatedly, so one checkpoint can trade inference compute for accuracy by changing the loop count. At one loop, however, such models typically fall well short of a non-recurrent model of the same size, a one-loop tax that makes a separate non-recurrent model the better choice whenever latency matters. We present Elastic Latent Recurrence (ELR), a recipe for training looped language models without this tax. At one loop, an ELR model costs the same to serve as a non-recurrent model of the same size and, trained on the same data, reaches similar accuracy. Each additional loop then buys more accuracy for more inference compute. Three choices make this work: a gated state update with a learned step size, loop counts mixed within each optimizer update, and conditioning each pass on its loop index and budget. The first two preserve one-loop accuracy, and the third lowers loss at every additional loop. Mixed depths can be introduced late in pretraining to limit the added training cost, and with zero-initialized conditioning added at the switch, this late schedule reaches lower loss than mixed-depth training from scratch. In MoE models, reusing first-loop expert routes on later loops cuts mixed-depth update time by 11.7% with no measurable change in accuracy. At inference, keeping only the last loop's attention KV cache holds attention KV memory at its one-loop level while retaining most of the gain from additional loops. On 4B dense and 30B-A3B MoE hybrid models, ELR at one loop is 0.52 points below and 1.04 points above its matched baseline on a ten-task average, and four loops add 7.25 and 4.75 points. Carried through post-training, the recipe yields Koi-4B, a single checkpoint that scores an estimated 18 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at one loop, matching Qwen3.5-4B, and 29 at four loops.

AI.tldr: 提出 Elastic Latent Recurrence（ELR）训练方法，使循环（latent recurrent）语言模型在单次循环时与同等规模非循环模型精度相当，无"单循环税"，随后每次追加循环以更多推理算力换取更高精度，并在 4B dense 与 30B-A3B MoE 模型上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 隐式循环语言模型通过重复使用共享层块，使同一 checkpoint 能按循环次数调节推理算力与精度。但其单循环（one loop）时的精度通常显著低于同等规模的非循环模型，形成"单循环税"（one-loop tax），导致对延迟敏感的场景下用户仍会另选非循环模型。因此需要一种消除该税的训练方案。
AI.method: ELR 的三项关键设计：（1）带可学习步长的门控状态更新；（2）在同一次优化器更新内混合不同循环次数（mixed depths）；（3）每次前向依据循环索引与算力预算进行条件化（conditioning）。前两项用于保持单循环精度，第三项用于降低附加循环的损失。混合深度可在预训练后期引入以控制训练开销，并以零初始化条件化参数在切换点接入，效果优于从头混合深度训练。MoE 模型中复用首循环的专家路由以加速。推理时仅保留最后一循环的 attention KV cache，将 KV 显存控制在单循环水平。
AI.result: MoE 中复用首循环专家路由使混合深度更新耗时降低 11.7%，精度无可测变化；仅保留末循环 KV cache 可将 attention KV 显存维持在单循环水平，同时保留大部分附加循环收益。在 4B dense 与 30B-A3B MoE 混合模型上，ELR 单循环在十任务平均上分别低于/高于匹配基线 0.52 分与 1.04 分；四循环分别增益 7.25 与 4.75 分。经后训练得到 Koi-4B，单 checkpoint 在单循环时 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 估计得分 18，与 Qwen3.5-4B 持平，四循环得分 29。
AI.conclusion: ELR 消除了循环语言模型的单循环精度劣势，使"一个 checkpoint 按需调节推理算力"成为可行的部署范式：单循环零成本对标非循环模型，追加循环单调提升精度，且通过混合深度晚接、路由复用与末循环 KV 缓存等工程手段控制训练与推理开销，并在 dense 与 MoE 规模上验证了可扩展性。

title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
summary: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger.
