A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpireBench，一个让大语言模型完整游玩商业卡牌构筑游戏《杀戮尖塔》（最高难度）的长时程智能体基准，用于评估长程战略推理。基准测试 20 个 LLM，发现前沿模型优于启发式基线、接近普通人类玩家但远逊于专家；能力差距随游戏推进而扩大，且模型无法有效利用跨局经验记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准多为短时程、片段式任务，难以研究长时程战略推理；长任务表现也难以拆解为存储知识、推理能力与运气。作者需要一个能分离这些因素、且贴近真实商业游戏的长时程基准。
AI.method: 构建 SpireBench 测试框架，首次让模型游玩完整原版《杀戮尖塔》，在最高难度下评估 20 个 LLM。通过全程术语系统性重命名检验模型是否依赖游戏先验知识；考察模型跨局写入记忆的利用情况；并与现有测试框架进行对比。
AI.result: 在最高难度下，前沿模型超越启发式基线并达到普通人类玩家平均水平，但显著落后于专家。模型与专家的差距随游戏进程拉长而扩大：最强模型在第一幕胜率与专家相当，之后逐渐落后。强弱模型的关键差异在于单场战斗水平；所有模型在整个游戏过程中都误判风险，倾向于保留生命值而非将其投入以变强。术语重命名实验表明模型表现部分依赖游戏先验知识；模型无法从跨局记忆中获益，其记忆往往错误且过于保守。
AI.conclusion: SpireBench 提供了一个尚未饱和的长时程智能体基准，并附带可定位智能体在何处、为何失败的诊断工具，为研究长程战略推理与知识依赖提供了新平台。

title: Scaling Multi-Teacher Distillation for Digital Pathology
summary: Multi-teacher distillation allows transferring knowledge from multiple "teacher" networks to a single "student" network. This method is promising in fields such as digital pathology, where many powerful foundation models were proposed recently. However, as we show in this paper, the standard multi-teacher distillation approach reacts poorly to an increase in the number of teachers used to train a student encoder. We demonstrate that learning teacher-specific representations is a key to scaling in MTD. Importantly, different design choices, such as learnable teacher tokens, a tailored attention scheme, additional mixture-of-experts layers and a contrastive loss, are proposed to better learn such teacher-specific representations. We show that our method better scales with respect to the number of considered teachers, allowing us to train compact student encoders, up to 10x more efficient than larger teacher foundation models, while matching their performance and even outperforming them on a large set of tile-level and slide-level tasks. We conduct a thorough empirical validation, evaluating more than 10 foundation models on 39 tasks spanning tile and slide levels. As a result, we release a new collection of strong and efficient foundation models, named OMNI, trained from the knowledge of 10 state-of-the-art foundation models. We finally conduct an analysis of the learned teacher-specific representations, highlighting their complementarity and explaining why they can be easily aggregated at downstream time.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出标准多教师蒸馏（MTD）在教师数量增加时性能不佳，提出学习"教师特定表示"是扩展MTD的关键，并通过可学习教师token、定制注意力、MoE层和对比损失等设计改进方法。实验在10+基础模型、39个任务上验证，学生编码器最高比教师模型高效10倍且性能相当或更优，并发布OMNI基础模型集合。
AI.motivation: 多教师蒸馏可将多个教师网络的知识迁移至单一学生网络，在数字病理等领域很有前景（近期涌现大量强大基础模型）。然而作者发现标准MTD方法在增加教师数量时表现不佳，需要解决其扩展性问题。
AI.method: 核心思想是学习教师特定表示（teacher-specific representations）。具体设计包括：可学习的教师token、定制注意力机制、额外的混合专家（MoE）层以及对比损失，用以更好地学习教师特定表示。
AI.result: 方法随教师数量增加具备更好的扩展性，可训练紧凑学生编码器，效率最高比更大的教师基础模型高10倍，同时在大量tile级和slide级任务上性能相当甚至更优。实证验证涵盖10+基础模型、39个任务。发布OMNI基础模型集合，由10个SOTA基础模型蒸馏而来。
AI.conclusion: 学习教师特定表示是扩展MTD的关键，可提升对教师数量的扩展性并产生高效紧凑的学生编码器；对所学教师特定表示的分析表明其具有互补性，解释了其在下游任务中易于聚合的原因。

title: Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 10th IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (IEEE EI2 2026). IEEE Xplore publication pending
summary: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. At a fixed 48-hour context length, daylight mean absolute error (MAE) of the best model rises from 0.104~kW on seen households in the future test period to 0.185~kW on unseen households over the same period, and under a fixed training contract the deployment regime explains far more of the error variation than model choice. Under target-domain normalization, fine-tuning on five target-region households reduces source-model transfer error by 28\%--36\%. Long input windows help known-customer extrapolation, while their new-customer benefits vary by model. These findings suggest regime-matched error budgets, limited target supervision for model adaptation in new regions, and use-case-dependent context selection for energy data analytics.

AI.tldr: 该文通过四种部署情景系统量化了深度序列模型在光伏分解任务中的泛化难度，指出部署情景对误差的影响远大于模型选择，并提出针对新区域的少样本微调与情景匹配的上下文选择策略。
AI.motivation: 配电网需要掌握表后光伏发电情况，但居民用户通常只有净计量数据。基于深度学习的PV分解可恢复该可见性，但其实际运维价值取决于模型面向的是已知用户、新用户、未来时段还是新区域，这一部署依赖性此前缺乏系统量化。
AI.method: 基于Ausgrid智能电表数据，并跨数据集适配到Pecan Street数据；定义四种部署情景，将家庭层面迁移与时间外推分离；在固定训练协议下，对代表性深度序列架构在情景匹配评估下进行基准测试；并在目标域归一化下，用五个目标区域家庭进行微调。
AI.result: 在固定48小时上下文长度下，最佳模型的日间MAE从未来测试期已知家庭的0.104 kW上升到同期未知家庭的0.185 kW；固定训练契约下，部署情景对误差变化的解释力远强于模型选择。目标域归一化下，用五个目标区域家庭微调可将源模型迁移误差降低28%–36%。长输入窗口有利于已知用户的外推，但其对新用户的收益因模型而异。
AI.conclusion: 建议采用情景匹配的误差预算，在新区域模型适配中仅使用有限的目标域监督，并根据具体用例选择上下文长度，以实现更可靠的能源数据分析部署。

title: LLM-Assisted Hierarchical Interference Control for Satellite-Terrestrial Integrated Networks
summary: Time-varying aggregate interference from low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites challenges terrestrial-network (TN) protection, whereas conservative control degrades LEO quality of service (QoS). This letter proposes a hierarchical framework combining geometry-based interference estimation, QoS-constrained power control, adaptive energy detection, large language model (LLM)-assisted candidate ranking, stay-or-switch decisions, and target-band selection, with deterministic verification. The current band is retained only when both spectrum-hole and power-feasibility conditions hold, with periodic reevaluation. Over a 300-s horizon with 0.5-s sampling, the proposed method keeps the aggregate INR from exceeding the $-12.2$~dB threshold and achieves a time-averaged mean LEO-link rate of $320.97$~Mbps with $100\%$ QoS satisfaction. It markedly outperforms power-only and satellite-muting in jointly protecting the TN and preserving LEO QoS.

AI.tldr: 提出分层框架，融合几何干扰估计、QoS约束功控、自适应能量检测、LLM辅助候选排序、保持或切换决策及目标频段选择，并带确定性验证。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星的时变聚合干扰威胁地面网络保护，而保守控制会降低LEO的QoS，需在保护TN与保障LEO QoS间取得平衡。
AI.method: 分层框架：基于几何的干扰估计、QoS约束功率控制、自适应能量检测、LLM辅助候选排序、保持或切换决策、目标频段选择，并加入确定性验证；仅当频谱空洞与功率可行性条件同时满足时保留当前频段，并周期重评估。
AI.result: 在300 s、0.5 s采样下，聚合INR不超过-12.2 dB阈值，时间平均LEO链路速率达320.97 Mbps，QoS满足率100%，显著优于仅功控与卫星静默方案。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能在联合保护地面网络与保持LEO QoS方面显著优于对比方案。

title: Silent breakdown of the perturbative polarization expansion in the terahertz regime
summary: Nonlinear optics expands the polarization in powers of the drive and retains only the lowest-order terms. This truncation is safe at optical frequencies, where the convergence field lies far above the damage threshold. In the terahertz regime, phonon polaritons enhance the nonlinear susceptibilities by orders of magnitude, lowering the convergence field into the sub-damage range and opening a window in which the expansion fails while the crystal remains recoverable. We term this window silent breakdown. At resonance, the nearest singularities of the driven lattice mode are a complex-conjugate pair of branch points below the multistability threshold, so the response remains smooth and single-valued even though the $χ^{\left( n \right)}$ description fails. The convergence field scales as $Q^{-3/2}$, so sharpening a resonance enhances the nonlinearity but narrows the range over which the expansion applies. It follows from the mode shift $S$ alone, $E_{\mathrm{conv}}=E_{\mathrm{ref}}(3\sqrt{3}QS)^{-1/2}$, giving 2$\sim$9 MV/cm for $\mathrm{LiNbO}_{3}$. Since resonant enhancement is central to terahertz nonlinear optics, this boundary defines the field range over which susceptibility-based descriptions are quantitatively reliable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并定义了"静默击穿"（silent breakdown）窗口：在太赫兹波段，声子极化激元将非线性响应增强数个量级，使微扰展开的收敛场降至损伤阈值以下，此时χ⁽ⁿ⁾描述失效但晶体仍可恢复。收敛场仅由模移S决定，E_conv=E_ref(3√3QS)^(-1/2)，对LiNbO₃约为2~9 MV/cm。
AI.motivation: 非线性光学通常将极化强度按驱动场幂级数展开并只保留最低阶项，该截断在光频段因收敛场远高于损伤阈值而安全。然而在太赫兹波段，声子极化激元将非线性极化率增强数个量级，导致收敛场落入亚损伤区间，微扰展开失效而晶体尚未被破坏。作者旨在界定这一此前被忽视的区域，明确基于极化率的描述在何场强范围内定量可靠。
AI.method: 从被驱动的晶格模式出发进行复平面奇点分析：在共振条件下，考察驱动模式最近奇点的性质与位置，判断非线性响应是否仍平滑单值；推导收敛场与品质因子Q、模移S的标度关系，并据此估算具体材料的收敛场数值。
AI.result: 共振时被驱动晶格模式最近的奇点是一对共轭分支点（branch points），位于多稳态阈值以下，因此即使χ⁽ⁿ⁾描述失效，响应仍保持平滑且单值。收敛场随品质因子标度为Q^(-3/2)，即共振越尖锐，非线性增强越强但展开适用场范围越窄。收敛场仅由模移S决定：E_conv=E_ref(3√3QS)^(-1/2)，对LiNbO₃给出约2~9 MV/cm。
AI.conclusion: 由于共振增强是太赫兹非线性光学的核心机制，该收敛场边界界定了基于极化率（susceptibility-based）的描述在定量上可靠的场强范围；超出该边界即进入"静默击穿"窗口，需要超越微扰展开的理论框架。

title: A Hybrid and Hierarchical Ray Tracing Method for Efficient 3D Gaussian Rendering
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a powerful representation for real-time neural reconstruction and rendering. While existing 3DGS systems rely on rasterization for efficiency, recent work explores ray tracing to enable secondary lighting, highly distorted cameras, and depth-of-field effects. However, compared with rasterization, ray-traced 3DGS introduces three major challenges: (1) the highly non-uniform spatial distribution of massive numbers of Gaussian primitives creates severe load imbalance; (2) neighboring pixels often generate rays with highly similar traversal paths, leading to substantial redundant traversal overhead; and (3) supporting both Gaussian and triangle primitives yields heterogeneous intersection workloads that are not well matched to existing GPU architectures. We present H2-Ray, a hybrid and hierarchical ray tracing architecture for efficient 3D Gaussian rendering. H2-Ray introduces three techniques. Load-Balanced Spatial BVH (LB-SBVH) partitions the scene into uniform grids and uses density-aware representations to convert an imbalanced global workload into balanced local traversal units. Ray-Cluster Path Reuse (RCPR) lets a proxy ray share traversal state with neighboring rays to amortize redundant traversal. The Unified Intersection Engine (UIE) supports mixed Gaussian and triangle intersections through a mode-multiplexed datapath that shares 40% of its floating-point units across both primitive types. Across 8 scenes, H2-Ray achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 3.77x and a maximum speedup of 9.26x over RaySplats on the NVIDIA RTX A5000, combining a cycle-accurate model of the modified RT Core with measured CUDA timings.

AI.tldr: 提出 H2-Ray 混合分层光线追踪架构，针对 3DGS 光线追踪的负载不均、冗余遍历与异构求交三大瓶颈，实现相对 RaySplats 平均 3.77x、最高 9.26x 加速。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 现有系统多依赖光栅化以追求效率，但光栅化难以支持二次光照、强畸变相机与景深等效果，故近期工作转向光线追踪。然而光线追踪 3DGS 面临三个核心挑战：(1) 海量高斯基元空间分布高度不均，造成严重负载失衡；(2) 相邻像素生成的光线遍历路径高度相似，产生大量冗余遍历开销；(3) 同时支持高斯与三角面片两种图元导致异构求交负载，与现有 GPU 架构匹配不佳。
AI.method: H2-Ray 是一种混合且分层的 3D 高斯渲染光线追踪架构，包含三项技术：(1) 负载均衡空间 BVH（LB-SBVH）：将场景划分为均匀网格，采用密度感知表示，把不均衡的全局负载转化为均衡的局部遍历单元；(2) 光线簇路径复用（RCPR）：让代理光线与相邻光线共享遍历状态，以摊销冗余遍历；(3) 统一求交引擎（UIE）：通过模式复用的数据通路支持高斯与三角面片混合求交，在两类图元间共享 40% 的浮点单元。
AI.result: 在 8 个场景上，基于 NVIDIA RTX A5000，结合修改后 RT Core 的周期精确模型与实测 CUDA 时序，H2-Ray 相对 RaySplats 取得几何平均 3.77x、最高 9.26x 的加速。
AI.conclusion: H2-Ray 通过负载均衡空间 BVH、光线簇路径复用与统一求交引擎三项协同设计，有效缓解了光线追踪 3DGS 中的负载失衡、冗余遍历与异构求交问题，验证了混合分层光线追踪架构在高效 3D 高斯渲染上的可行性与显著收益。

title: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting
summary: Prompt optimization is an attractive alternative to reinforcement learning for adapting language-model agents, since it is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts. On factual tasks, however, it carries a failure mode that scalar-reward reinforcement learning does not. An optimizer that reads the training examples can write their answers into the prompt, so an in-distribution gain may be memorization rather than transferable behaviour. We apply reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to the two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent and evaluate it under a topic-disjoint split in which no topic is shared across train, validation, and test. Held-out citation reward rises by 0.079, from 0.702 to 0.781, with a bootstrap 95\% confidence interval of [0.051, 0.107], and the gain replicates across three seeds (mean 0.107). Nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, yet a controlled ablation shows this content earns no reward even on the exact training questions it encodes. The large validation-minus-held-out gap is therefore small-sample selection under a noisy judge, not memorization. Varying the verifier isolates what makes the gain transfer. Decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient, and collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative. The gain persists under an out-of-family judge and is largely reproduced by a hand-written version of the discovered recipe. Credible evaluation of prompt optimizers therefore requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablations. We release the candidate prompts, lineage diffs, figures, tables, and analysis.

AI.tldr: 将反射式提示词进化（GEPA）应用于多智能体深度研究智能体的两个系统提示词，在主题不相交划分下留出引用奖励从0.702提升至0.781（提升0.079，bootstrap 95% CI [0.051, 0.107]），三个随机种子可复现（均值0.107）。尽管获胜提示词中近一半是记忆的答案键，消融实验表明该内容即使对训练问题也不产生奖励；真正的因果要素是分解式逐维度反馈，而非标量奖励。
AI.motivation: 提示词优化相比强化学习更廉价且产出人类可读的产物，但在事实性任务上存在强化学习所没有的失败模式：优化器读取训练样本后可能将答案直接写入提示词，使分布内增益实为记忆而非可迁移行为。因此需要区分记忆与真实迁移，并厘清何种验证器设计能带来可迁移增益。
AI.method: 对多智能体深度研究智能体的两个系统提示词应用反射式提示词进化（GEPA）；采用主题不相交（topic-disjoint）划分，训练、验证、测试之间不共享任何主题；使用带bootstrap置信区间的留出引用奖励评估，并在三个随机种子上重复；进行对照消融检验记忆内容是否贡献奖励；通过改变验证器（分解式逐维度反馈 vs. 坍缩为单一标量奖励）隔离迁移增益的因果成分；并在家族外（out-of-family）评判器下复现，以及用手写版本的发现配方复现。
AI.result: 留出引用奖励提升0.079（0.702→0.781），bootstrap 95% CI [0.051, 0.107]，三个种子均值0.107且可复现；获胜提示词近半为记忆的答案键，但对照消融显示其即使在训练问题上也不获奖励，验证集与留出集的大差距源于噪声评判下的小样本选择而非记忆；分解式逐维度反馈是迁移增益的因果要素，坍缩为单一标量奖励会使留出迁移变为负；增益在家族外评判器下依然保持，并可由手写版本配方大部分复现。
AI.conclusion: 提示词优化器的可信评估需要留出主题、多种子与验证器消融。分解式逐维度反馈而非标量奖励是迁移增益的关键，说明提示词优化的可迁移性取决于验证信号的结构。作者公开发布候选提示词、谱系差异、图表、表格与分析。

title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench-Live show consistent improvements across the evaluated Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B configurations, supporting using the policy's own comparative judgments as a complementary learning signal for training software engineering agents.

AI.tldr: 提出行为自奖励(BSR)方法，利用策略自身对同一任务、同一验证结果轨迹的调试行为进行成对比较，将偏好聚合成有界辅助奖励，在保留验证器通过/失败序的同时引入奖励对比，无需新交互即可提升软件工程Agent表现。
AI.motivation: RLVR通过可执行测试为软件工程Agent提供可靠监督，但二值奖励无法区分调试质量差异显著的不同轨迹。作者希望探究当前策略能否自评判轨迹，并在不单独训练奖励模型的前提下利用这些判断提升任务表现。
AI.method: BSR（Behavioral Self-Rewarding）：复用策略对来自同一任务、具有相同验证器结果的轨迹之间的可观察调试行为进行比较；将成对偏好聚合为任务局部分数；再转换为有界辅助奖励。该方法在引入奖励对比的同时保持验证器定义的通过/失败序，仅利用已采集轨迹即可提供额外监督，无需新的环境交互。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified与SWE-bench-Live上，对Qwen3-14B和Qwen3-32B配置均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 策略自身的比较性判断可作为补充学习信号，用于训练软件工程Agent，无需额外奖励模型或环境交互。

title: Mind the Temporal Gap: Evaluating Video Models for Temporal Understanding in Driving
summary: Modern video-language models are increasingly treated as general-purpose video reasoners, yet it remains unclear whether they robustly capture temporal dynamics in safety-critical settings such as driving. We study this question through controlled ego-motion tasks that require identifying actions from driving videos. Across video-language models, we find that standard prompting, visual prompting, few-shot prompting, and chain-of-thought prompting remain unreliable and highly task- and model-dependent, with persistent class biases, although newer models show substantial task-specific few-shot gains. In contrast, lightweight LoRA finetuning and simple probes trained on intermediate visual features recover strong motion-discriminative performance, indicating that motion-relevant cues are often present inside the models but are not reliably used by the final video-to-language pathway. These results suggest that, in driving, current video-language models remain unreliable temporal reasoners and often behave more like frame-level, bias-driven recognizers than dependable temporal world models.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控自车运动任务检验视频-语言模型在驾驶场景中的时间动态推理能力，发现各类提示方法均不可靠且存在类别偏置，而LoRA微调与中间视觉特征探针能恢复强运动判别性能，表明运动线索存在于模型内部但未被视频到语言的最终通路可靠利用。
AI.motivation: 视频-语言模型日益被视作通用视频推理器，但其在驾驶等安全关键场景中能否稳健捕捉时间动态尚不明确，需通过受控实验加以验证。
AI.method: 设计需要从驾驶视频中识别动作的受控自车运动任务，比较标准提示、视觉提示、少样本提示与思维链提示的效果；同时采用轻量LoRA微调及基于中间视觉特征的简单探针进行对照。
AI.result: 各类提示方法表现不可靠，高度依赖任务与模型，并持续存在类别偏置，尽管较新模型在特定任务上少样本性能有显著提升；相比之下，LoRA微调与中间特征探针均取得强运动判别性能。
AI.conclusion: 在驾驶场景中，当前视频-语言模型仍是不不可靠的时间推理器，更像帧级、偏置驱动的识别器，而非可信赖的时间世界模型；运动相关线索常潜藏于模型内部，却未被最终的视频到语言通路有效利用。

title: GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer
summary: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. Synthetic sensor views calibrated on paired Dexcom and Libre recordings, different-day pairs and glucose-summary targets supply this supervision without clinical labels. Across twelve cross-cohort directions, dropping the Sensor band from the same frozen encoder raises mean transfer AUROC from 68.75 to 73.57, against 69.3 for GlucoFM. The gain has two parts. Into CGMacros, the one target cohort recorded with two sensor types, filtering adds 11 to 19 points, and this holds when the generator is recalibrated on half of the participants and scored on the other half. On the other eight directions filtering is neutral and the encoder itself exceeds GlucoFM by 3.5 points. The device remains linearly decodable after filtering, so the filter removes a device-related component that harms transfer rather than all measurement information. The retained bands improve window AUROC on thirteen of fourteen public task--cohort cells (Holm-adjusted p=0.031) and correlation on fourteen of fifteen clinical endpoints in an external cohort of 9,303 participants.

AI.tldr: GlucoPRISM 通过"响应契约"监督预训练，将连续血糖监测（CGM）表征解耦为与设备无关的 Trait 带、与天相关的 State 带和记录设备的 Sensor 带；部署时用固定投影丢弃 Sensor 带，在无需目标域数据的情况下提升跨队列迁移性能。
AI.motivation: CGM 基础模型将每天编码为单一向量，混合了"人是谁""当天发生了什么"以及"传感器如何测量"三类信息，导致测量差异随表征一起迁移到新队列，损害跨队列迁移。作者希望把有害于迁移的测量成分放到已知坐标（维度带）中，使部署时能用固定投影直接剔除，而无需任何目标数据。
AI.method: 以 GlucoFM 为骨干，用"响应契约"（response contracts）进行监督：规定表征各部分在只有"天"变化或只有"传感器"变化时应如何改变——64 维 Trait 带两者都不应改变，48 维 State 带仅在跨天时改变，16 维 Sensor 带应跟随设备变化。监督信号来自基于配对 Dexcom 与 Libre 记录校准的合成传感器视图、不同天配对以及血糖汇总目标，无需临床标签。部署时对同一冻结编码器用固定投影丢弃 Sensor 带。
AI.result: 在 12 个跨队列迁移方向上，从同一冻结编码器丢弃 Sensor 带使平均迁移 AUROC 从 68.75 提升至 73.57，高于 GlucoFM 的 69.3。增益有两部分：在 CGMacros（唯一用两种传感器类型记录的目标队列）上，过滤带来 11~19 个点提升，且在生成器仅用一半参与者重新校准、另一半评分时仍成立；在其余 8 个方向上过滤为中性，编码器本身已超过 GlucoFM 3.5 个点。过滤后设备仍可线性解码，说明滤除的是有害于迁移的设备相关成分而非全部测量信息。保留的两个带在 14 个公共任务—队列单元中的 13 个提升窗口 AUROC（Holm 校正 p=0.031），并在 9,303 名参与者的外部队列中于 15 个临床终点中的 14 个提升相关性。
AI.conclusion: 通过响应契约监督可将 CGM 表征中的设备/测量成分定位到明确的 Sensor 带，部署时用固定投影去除即可在无目标数据条件下显著改善跨队列迁移，且不损失设备信息之外的有效测量信号，在多个公共任务和外部临床队列上获得一致提升。

title: JEPA-kMMVAE: CSI Prediction for Time-Varying Wireless Channels
summary: This paper considers channel state information (CSI) prediction using neural networks for time-varying multi-antenna channels from noisy historical observations. The main challenge is to exploit temporal correlation while distinguishing channel evolution from observation noise. We propose JEPA-kMMVAE, which combines a joint-embedding predictive architecture with a k-memory Markov variational autoencoder to predict future CSI through temporally structured latent representations. The framework supports direct prediction and residual corrections relative to the latest latent state and noisy CSI observation. Simulation results show that the residual configuration outperforms the evaluated baselines at moderate and high input CSI signal-to-noise ratios, while sequence baselines remain more accurate under stronger noise.

AI.tldr: 提出JEPA-kMMVAE框架，结合联合嵌入预测架构与k-记忆马尔可夫变分自编码器，从含噪历史观测中预测时变多天线信道的CSI，残差配置在中高信噪比下优于基线。
AI.motivation: 时变多天线信道的CSI预测需利用时间相关性，同时将信道演化与观测噪声区分开来，这是核心难点。
AI.method: JEPA-kMMVAE将联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)与k-记忆马尔可夫变分自编码器(kMMVAE)相结合，通过时间结构化的潜表征预测未来CSI；框架支持两种模式：直接预测，以及相对于最新潜状态和含噪CSI观测的残差校正。
AI.result: 残差配置在中等和高输入CSI信噪比下优于所评估的基线；在更强噪声条件下，序列基线方法精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架在信道预测中有效，但存在信噪比适用范围：残差配置适合中高信噪比，强噪声下序列模型更优。

title: Matrix-free numerical continuation of the Ikeda map in passive Kerr resonators
summary: We introduce a matrix-free numerical continuation framework for the Ikeda map of coherently driven passive Kerr resonators. The framework traces solution branches and evaluates their linear stability without explicitly assembling the full Jacobian matrices, using a unified formulation for states that recur after one or multiple round trips. We resolve stable and unstable branches of modulation-instability patterns and temporal cavity solitons, and uncover period-doubled homogeneous states and associated multi-round-trip dynamics that are absent from the standard Lugiato-Lefever equation (LLE). For period-1 states, the Ikeda map and the LLE show close agreement in the high-finesse regime, while their branch-existence intervals increasingly deviate as the finesse decreases. These results demonstrate that direct continuation of the unaveraged round-trip map can capture nonlinear states and multi-round-trip dynamics beyond the mean-field description, providing a systematic framework for bifurcation and stability analysis of Kerr resonators without relying on the averaged LLE.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无矩阵数值延拓框架，直接对无平均的Ikeda映射进行分岔与稳定性分析，可刻画超越LLE平均场描述的多程动力学。
AI.motivation: 标准Lugiato-Lefever方程（LLE）采用平均场近似，无法捕捉Kerr谐振腔中多程往返的非平均动力学，且完整Jacobian矩阵的显式组装在延拓与稳定性分析中计算成本高。
AI.method: 面向相干驱动无源Kerr谐振腔的Ikeda映射，构建无矩阵数值延拓框架；采用统一表述处理单程或多程往返后重现的状态；在不显式组装完整Jacobian矩阵的前提下追踪解分支并评估线性稳定性。
AI.result: 求解出调制不稳定性图案与时间腔孤子的稳定及不稳定分支，发现周期倍化的均匀态及其关联的多程动力学，这些在标准LLE中不存在。对周期-1态，在高精细度区Ikeda映射与LLE高度一致，随精细度降低二者分支存在区间偏差增大。
AI.conclusion: 直接对无平均的往返映射延拓可捕捉超越平均场描述的非线性态与多程动力学，为不依赖平均LLE的Kerr谐振腔分岔与稳定性分析提供系统框架。

title: Rethinking Neural Nonlinearity as Gating
summary: Activation functions are considered an essential primitive for neural nonlinearity, i.e., they enable neural networks to serve as universal approximators. In this paper, we show that this nonlinearity can also be achieved by input-conditioned threshold gating through branches as a universal primitive. We demonstrate that standard activations -- whether piecewise-linear (ReLU, PReLU, Hardtanh) or smooth (SiLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, GELU) -- are in fact instances of a single Threshold Gating (TG) primitive. For softmax, we show that it admits an exact TG conversion via its equivalent per-element Sigmoid form. We then validate these equivalences by converting pretrained networks across CNNs, transformer-based models, and recurrent architectures, preserving model performance without requiring retraining. Threshold Gating also enables training from scratch that goes beyond replacing existing activations, enabling gains in model compression, performance, and shorter training. We also propose a 'Minimal Branch Theorem' which relates the minimum number of required branches in our primitive to the trainability of general deep neural networks. In terms of hardware implementation, TG maps to a unified implementation in the case of analog in-memory systems, addressing the bottleneck of analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog converters (ADC/DAC) that is known to significantly impact power consumption and on-chip area.

AI.tldr: 本文提出阈值门控(TG)作为一种统一的神经网络非线性原语，证明常见激活函数(ReLU、GELU、Softmax等)均为TG的特例，可实现免重训练的等价转换，并在压缩、性能、训练效率及模拟存内计算硬件上带来收益。
AI.motivation: 激活函数通常被视为实现神经网络非线性与通用逼近能力的必要原语。作者希望探究这种非线性是否可由更基础、更统一的机制（输入条件化的阈值门控分支）来实现，并借此统一现有激活、提升训练与压缩性能、缓解模拟存内计算中ADC/DAC的功耗与面积瓶颈。
AI.method: 以输入条件化的阈值门控分支作为通用原语，构建单一TG形式；将分段的ReLU、PReLU、Hardtanh与平滑的SiLU、Sigmoid、Tanh、GELU 归约为TG实例；对Softmax利用其等价的逐元素Sigmoid形式做精确TG转换。通过在CNN、Transformer和循环网络上转换预训练模型来验证等价性，并开展从零训练实验。同时提出"最小分支定理"将原语所需最小分支数与深度网络可训练性关联。
AI.result: 分段的与平滑的标准激活函数均被证明是单一TG原语的实例，Softmax亦可经逐元素Sigmoid实现精确TG转换；在CNN、Transformer及循环结构上转换预训练网络可保持模型性能且无需重训练。从零训练TG可超越替换既有激活的范畴，带来模型压缩、性能提升与更短训练时间的收益。硬件上TG在模拟存内系统中映射为统一实现，缓解ADC/DAC瓶颈。最小分支定理将最少分支数与深度网络可训练性建立联系。
AI.conclusion: 阈值门控可作为实现神经网络非线性的统一原语，涵盖主流激活函数并支持免重训练的等价网络转换；它在训练、压缩与硬件实现（尤其模拟存内计算）方面具有实用价值，并通过"最小分支定理"为深度网络可训练性提供理论视角。

title: Self-Preservation in Language Models
summary: Continual learning (CL) seeks to adapt pretrained models while preserving prior capabilities. Yet the tasks supplied for preservation cover only part of what a model knows, while forgetting can extend beyond them. Recent work shows that language models can supplement this limited evidence by generating useful replay without access to their original training data. This raises a question about self-preservation: can a model help choose preservation targets that protect its own capabilities more broadly? To study this question, we organize task descriptions and their examples into Task Banks, whose entries can be selected and combined to guide replay generation by a frozen model. Continual instruction tuning with Qwen models of varying sizes yields three findings. First, the new task and learning rate shape which prior capabilities degrade, while tracking previously correct answers reveals losses that average accuracy can conceal. Second, generated replay reduces forgetting on tasks outside the bank. Combining partial banks strengthens this protection, improving mean retention of previously correct answers over either bank alone across the tested sizes. Third, the model can also help choose replay targets: selection informed by the new task improves mean held-out retention over random selection at 4B, with similar new-task gains, although smaller models show no corresponding advantage. Under a fixed example budget, however, replacing new-task examples with replay improves preservation at the cost of smaller new-task gains. Together, these findings show that models can support broader self-preservation by generating replay data and, in some settings, choosing which tasks to replay.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"Task Banks"框架，让冻结的预训练模型生成replay数据，以在持续指令微调中保护模型自身的更广泛能力，并发现生成式replay、bank组合与任务选择均能缓解遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续学习在适应新任务时仅用有限的任务集合作为保留目标，而这些任务只覆盖模型已有知识的一部分，遗忘可能超出这些任务范围。近期研究表明语言模型无需原始训练数据即可生成有用的replay，由此引出"自我保存"问题：模型能否帮助选择保留目标，从而更广泛地保护自身能力。
AI.method: 将任务描述及其示例组织为Task Banks，条目可被选择与组合，用以引导冻结模型生成replay；在Qwen系列不同规模模型上进行持续指令微调，比较bank单独使用、部分bank组合，以及基于新任务信息的选择策略与随机选择的差异，并控制示例预算。
AI.result: 一，新任务与学习率决定哪些先前能力退化，跟踪原本正确的答案可揭示被平均准确率掩盖的损失；二，生成式replay可减少bank之外任务的遗忘，组合部分bank比单独任一bank更能提升原有正确答案的平均保留率；三，基于新任务信息的选择在4B模型上优于随机选择，且新任务收益相近，但更小模型无此优势；在固定示例预算下，用replay替换新任务示例可提升保留但牺牲新任务收益。
AI.conclusion: 模型能够通过生成replay数据，并在某些设置下选择应replay的任务，来支持更广泛的自我保存，且应关注原本正确答案的保留而非仅看平均准确率。

title: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
summary: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. These paired returns train the controller to predict clarification value and the task policy to select useful questions and act on the answers. The controller guides subsequent rollout collection, while outcomes from the updated agent provide new value labels that allow clarification guidance to adapt as the agent learns. With Qwen3-4B, CLEAT achieves the highest mean score in all ten evaluation settings across four benchmarks. Gains over the strongest baseline reach 13.2 and 6.5 percentage points on UserGym Travel and IN3 underspecification judgment accuracy, respectively. Ablations show that co-training improves the task policy even when the controller is removed at inference, while adapting clarification guidance to the evolving policy yields further gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLEAT框架，通过价值引导的智能体协同训练，让LLM智能体在交互中学习提出澄清问题并将回答转化为更优决策。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需处理用户未明确表述的目标与约束，澄清只有在智能体能将回答转化为更好决策时才有用；而训练会改变智能体处理不完整信息与利用回答的方式，使同一澄清的价值发生变化，因此需要让澄清引导随智能体学习而自适应。
AI.method: 协同训练澄清价值控制器与任务策略，共享交互结果：定义残差查询价值（相对当前策略直接行动所获得的任务效用增益），通过同一交互历史下的配对rollout估计；用配对回报训练控制器预测澄清价值、训练策略选择有用问题并依据回答行动；控制器引导后续rollout采集，更新后智能体的结果提供新价值标签，实现澄清引导的自适应。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3-4B，在四个基准的十个评测设置中均取得最高平均分；相比最强基线，在UserGym Travel上提升13.2个百分点，在IN3欠指定判断准确率上提升6.5个百分点。消融显示协同训练即使推理时移除控制器也能提升任务策略，且随策略演化自适应澄清引导带来进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 交互式意图对齐中，价值引导的澄清协同训练可有效提升智能体的澄清与决策能力，且澄清引导需随策略演化持续适配。

title: MemReg: Streaming Outdoor LiDAR Point Cloud Registration with Hybrid Memory Buffers
summary: Prior outdoor LiDAR registration works are commonly limited by the pair-wise input paradigm, which neglects temporal correlations inherent within streaming sequences. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-frame outdoor point cloud registration network for streaming LiDAR scans enhanced with pose-related memory buffers. The key observation is that long-term temporal LiDAR sequences can provide rich global contextual information to complete sparse measurements, filter outliers, and address low-overlap problems, thereby boosting registration performance. Specifically, two hybrid memory buffers are designed, including an implicit memory feature buffer and an explicit memory pose buffer, to store and dynamically update pose-related temporal features. Moreover, a novel dynamic history weighting module is developed to adaptively fuse current and history pose-related features. Extensive experiments on three outdoor datasets, including KITTI, nuScenes, and Apollo-Southbay, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of MemReg, surpassing all previous pair-wise methods and also multi-frame SLAM systems. Our method also generalizes surprisingly well to multiview indoor registration scenarios with rather competitive performance on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, and ScanNet. Code will be released at https://github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemReg，一种带有位姿相关记忆缓冲的多帧室外LiDAR点云配准网络，利用长期时序上下文突破成对输入范式，在多个数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有室外LiDAR配准工作普遍受限于成对（pair-wise）输入范式，忽略了流式序列中固有的时间相关性；而长时序LiDAR序列可提供丰富的全局上下文信息，用于补全稀疏测量、滤除离群点并缓解低重叠问题。
AI.method: 设计两种混合记忆缓冲：隐式记忆特征缓冲与显式记忆位姿缓冲，用于存储并动态更新位姿相关的时序特征；同时提出动态历史加权模块，自适应融合当前与历史位姿相关特征，构建多帧流式LiDAR扫描配准网络MemReg。
AI.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Apollo-Southbay三个室外数据集上达到SOTA，超越所有先前的成对方法及多帧SLAM系统；并良好泛化至多视图室内配准场景，在3DMatch、3DLoMatch、ScanNet上性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过记忆缓冲引入时序上下文的多帧配准范式，能有效提升室外LiDAR配准性能并具备跨场景泛化能力，为流式点云配准提供了新思路。

title: CacheScope: Exact-Compute Allocation for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Training-free feature reuse accelerates diffusion transformer inference by replacing full denoising computation at selected steps with cached approximations. Existing methods mainly improve the reconstruction of skipped features, but we find that once a stable first-order reconstructor is used, increasing reconstruction complexity brings limited gains, whereas the placement of exact-computation steps has a much larger effect on fidelity. More importantly, absolute shallow-probe variation is jointly affected by input-trajectory displacement and network response strength, and therefore does not directly reflect cache risk. We address this confounding by normalizing probe-output variation with the corresponding input displacement, yielding a directional gain per unit trajectory movement. Based on this signal, we propose CacheScope, which identifies high-risk reuse steps online and selectively falls back to full denoising computation while leaving the underlying cache reconstructor unchanged. CacheScope requires no additional training, gradients, auxiliary networks, or prompt-specific offline schedule optimization. Across FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and Open-Sora 1.2, CacheScope achieves up to 3.57x acceleration and reduces median LPIPS by up to 70.1% over the strongest probe-based baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出CacheScope：通过将探针输出变化按输入位移归一化，识别高风险复用步并在线回退到完整去噪，无需训练即可加速扩散Transformer推理。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练特征复用方法主要致力于提升被跳过特征的重建质量，但作者发现：当重建器达到稳定的一阶水平后，继续增加重建复杂度收益有限，而精确计算步的放置位置对保真度影响更大。此外，绝对浅层探针变化同时受输入轨迹位移和网络响应强度影响，无法直接反映缓存风险，存在混淆。
AI.method: 对探针输出变化以对应的输入位移进行归一化，得到单位轨迹移动的方向性增益，作为高风险信号；据此提出CacheScope，在线识别高风险复用步并选择性回退到完整去噪计算，同时保持底层缓存重建器不变，无需额外训练、梯度、辅助网络或针对提示词的离线调度优化。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B和Open-Sora 1.2上，CacheScope实现最高3.57倍加速，并将中位LPIPS相比最强探针基线最多降低70.1%。
AI.conclusion: 在稳定一阶重建器下，精确计算步的放置比提升重建复杂度更为关键；归一化探针信号可有效指示缓存风险，基于该信号的在线回退策略在多种扩散Transformer模型上兼顾显著加速与保真度提升。

title: Towards Signal Processing In Networks: Multiplierless Block Transforms in Data Plane
comment: Submitted to the 2027 ICASSP-OJSP track, 9 pages, 4 figures
summary: In this paper, we propose a signal processing concept, signal processing in networks (SPIN), that executes signal processing tasks directly on programmable switches. Traditionally, signal processing tasks, such as denoising, decomposition, and dimensionality reduction, are performed on edge or cloud servers, i.e., raw streams are transmitted from sensors. This imposes a heavy processing load on edge/cloud servers and requires substantial bandwidth. SPIN addresses this problem by performing signal processing on the forwarding path. As an initial realization of SPIN, we implement a DCT-based block transform on a programmable switch. We redesign its computation using a lifting-based lattice structure, multiplierless approximation, and pipeline partitioning across stages in a programmable switch. We verify at the compiler level that the proposed implementation satisfies the strict hardware constraints of the Intel Tofino2--specifically regarding pipeline stages, packet header vector, and ternary content-addressable memory usage--and therefore enables line-rate processing. We further quantify the per-packet latency of the ingress match-action pipeline. The SPIN-oriented preprocessing adds 46 cycles (approximately 31 ns at 1.5 GHz). The total ingress match-action unit latency is approximately 87 ns, which remains consistent with the low-latency operation targeted by SPIN. Furthermore, we implement the proposed block transform on a BMv2 switch using P4 and evaluate it as preprocessing for in-network machine learning. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves classification performance over unfiltered baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出网络内信号处理（SPIN）概念，在可编程交换机转发路径上直接执行去噪、分解、降维等信号处理任务，并以基于DCT的块变换为初步实现，验证其满足Intel Tofino2硬件约束并可线速处理。
AI.motivation: 传统信号处理（去噪、分解、降维）在边缘或云服务器执行，需将原始数据流从传感器传输上去，造成边缘/云服务器处理负载过重且占用大量带宽。本文希望将信号处理下沉到网络转发路径，以缓解该瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出SPIN概念并在可编程交换机上实现DCT块变换：采用基于提升（lifting）的格结构重新设计计算、无乘法器近似，并在可编程交换机内进行跨流水线阶段的流水划分。在编译器层面验证其满足Intel Tofino2在流水线阶段、包头向量（PHV）和TCAM使用方面的严格硬件约束，以实现线速处理；并量化入站match-action流水线的每包延迟。此外用P4在BMv2交换机上实现该变换，作为网络内机器学习的预处理进行评测。
AI.result: SPIN预处理增加46个周期（1.5 GHz下约31 ns），入站match-action单元总延迟约87 ns，与SPIN低延迟目标一致；编译层面验证满足Tofino2约束并支持线速处理。在BMv2上的实验表明，该方法相比未滤波基线提升了分类性能。
AI.conclusion: SPIN可在可编程交换机转发路径上以线速、低延迟方式完成信号处理，其DCT块变换实现兼顾硬件可行性与分类增益，验证了在网信号处理作为边缘/云卸载方案的可行性。

title: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
summary: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. Based on these findings, we propose a SERS-active system that provides strong signal enhancement (up to four orders of magnitude for a single globular object) while maintaining spectral fidelity, where PMSs act both as model analytes and as integral components of a metal-dielectric resonator.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"自下而上"的SERS策略：在被研究物体表面沉积金属，而非将分析物沉积于基底上，并以聚苯乙烯微球（PMS）为模型验证了该金属-介电谐振器系统的强增强与光谱保真性。
AI.motivation: 传统SERS通常需将分析物沉积于金属或半导体基底上，这限制了可测对象（尤其是球形或囊泡状物体）的直接检测。作者希望将SERS的构建方式反转，直接在待测物体表面沉积金属，实现对其自身的灵敏检测。
AI.method: 基于Mie理论分析介电核-壳粒子的电场增强；采用SERS、原子力显微镜（AFM）与扫描电子显微镜（SEM）的关联方法，建立灵敏SERS检测与光谱分析所需条件；以聚苯乙烯微球（PMS）作为球形与囊泡状物体的模型分析物，同时作为金属-介电谐振器的组成部分。
AI.result: 该SERS活性体系对单个球形物体可实现高达四个数量级的信号增强，同时保持光谱保真度；PMS既充当模型分析物，又作为金属-介电谐振器的集成组件。
AI.conclusion: 自下而上的金属沉积策略可行，金属-介电核壳谐振器可提供强SERS增强并维持光谱保真，为球形及囊泡状物体的直接SERS检测提供了新途径。

title: GeopoliticalQA: Benchmarking Retrieval and Generation over Intelligence Reports
summary: Geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports constitute a rich source of expert knowledge and have increasing value in the current political climate, but their heterogeneity and analytical complexity pose challenges for retrieval-augmented question answering. We introduce a benchmark for grounded question answering over 415 open-source geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, comprising 5,525 document-grounded question-answer pairs spanning factual, inferential, comparative, and risk-oriented questions. We propose a document-aware generation pipeline that profiles reports before generating questions and validate dataset quality through expert annotation and an LLM-as-judge protocol. Using the benchmark, we evaluate 15 retrieval systems and six open-weight LLMs for RAG. We find that models perform similarly on document-level retrieval, while at the harder chunk level retrieval quality is not driven by embedding-model scale: bge-m3, a mid-size open encoder matches an order of magnitude larger ones and outperforms commercial embedding APIs. In contrast, answer generation remains challenging even given the gold evidence, particularly for inferential and risk-oriented questions.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了地缘政治与战略情报报告问答基准（415份报告、5525个文档接地问答对，覆盖事实/推断/比较/风险四类问题），提出文档感知的生成流程，并系统评测了15个检索系统与6个开源LLM，发现检索层面bge-m3等中等规模模型可媲美超大规模模型，但生成层面即使给定金标准证据仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 地缘政治与战略情报报告是专家知识的重要来源且价值日益提升，但其异质性与分析复杂性给检索增强问答（RAG）带来困难，而现有领域缺乏相应的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建包含415份开源地缘政治与战略情报报告、5525个文档接地问答对的基准，覆盖事实、推断、比较与风险导向四类问题；提出先对报告进行画像（profiling）再生成问题的文档感知生成流程；通过专家标注与LLM-as-judge协议验证数据质量；基于该基准评测15个检索系统与6个开源权重LLM的RAG表现。
AI.result: 在文档级检索上各模型表现相近；在更困难的块级（chunk-level）检索中，检索质量并非由嵌入模型规模驱动——中等规模的开放编码器bge-m3可媲美大其一个数量级的模型，并优于商业嵌入API。答案生成仍然困难，即便给定金标准证据，在推断类和风险导向问题上尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与评测揭示了情报领域RAG的关键瓶颈：检索层面开放的中等规模编码器已具竞争力，商业嵌入API并无优势；而生成层面（尤其推断与风险类问题）仍是主要挑战，指示未来研究应聚焦于复杂推理与风险导向的答案生成。

title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
summary: Data-centric scaling of RLVR has focused on collecting or generating verifiable training problems. However, corpus size alone does not determine whether the dataset provides a useful learning signal for a target policy. To guide the synthesis of effective RLVR data, we experimentally characterize dataset effectiveness as a function of its problems, the target policy, and the training rollout budget. Under this characterization, we show that a large open-source math corpus pooled from widely used RLVR datasets falls almost entirely into a zero-advantage trap: for a fixed target policy and rollout budget, roughly 88% of its problems are solved in every rollout or failed in every rollout. Filtering concentrates what remains, but it can only select, discarding the hard problems. Effective synthetic problems should therefore require the reasoning operations and compositions required to solve those hard problems. Yet their difficulty must be calibrated, so that some rollouts succeed, some fail, and at least one correct solution fits within the training budget. Prompting a teacher to vary hard problems directly does not achieve this. Guided by these empirical principles, we introduce MagicBeanStalk, a top-down decomposition and bottom-up recursive data-synthesis algorithm that grows seed problems into families of substantively new, policy- and budget-calibrated training problems while preserving the seeds' reasoning blueprints. Across 8 math benchmarks, continual RLVR on MagicBeanStalk problems improves gpt-oss-120b from 61.2 to 69.8 (+8.6) and DeepSeek v4Flash from 72.4 to 77.9 (+5.4) on a 16K-token budget. Training on the full 78K source corpus improves by only +1.1 and its best filtered real data subset by +5.8. In finance, we synthesize over 14K verifiable problems from only 340 solutions and improve over base by 6.9 and 2.4 points on SecQue and FinanceBench, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出仅靠扩大可验证问题语料规模并不能保证有效的RLVR学习信号，提出以目标策略和rollout预算为条件来刻画数据有效性，并据此设计MagicBeanStalk自顶向下分解与自底向上递归合成算法，生成策略与预算校准的新问题，在多数学基准和金融任务上显著优于全量源语料与最佳筛选真实数据。
AI.motivation: 面向RLVR的数据中心化扩展目前主要聚焦于收集或生成可验证训练问题，但语料规模本身无法决定数据集是否为目标策略提供有用学习信号。作者希望通过实验刻画数据集有效性如何依赖于问题本身、目标策略以及训练rollout预算，从而指导高效RLVR数据的合成。
AI.method: 作者实验发现，在固定目标策略和rollout预算下，从常用RLVR数据集汇总的大型开源数学语料中约88%的问题落入零优势陷阱（每次rollout都成功或每次都失败）。筛选只能保留部分数据并丢弃难题。基于此，作者提出MagicBeanStalk：一种自顶向下分解与自底向上递归的数据合成算法，将种子问题扩展为大量实质新颖、且针对策略与预算校准的训练问题，同时保留种子的推理蓝图。
AI.result: 在8个数学基准上，使用MagicBeanStalk问题进行持续RLVR，使gpt-oss-120b从61.2提升至69.8（+8.6），DeepSeek v4Flash从72.4提升至77.9（+5.4），预算为16K token。训练完整78K源语料仅提升+1.1，其最佳筛选真实数据子集提升+5.8。在金融领域，仅用340个解合成超过14K个可验证问题，在SecQue和FinanceBench上分别比基线提升6.9和2.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RLVR数据有效性取决于问题、目标策略与rollout预算的联合匹配，而非语料规模。合成有效训练问题应覆盖解决难题所需的推理操作与组合，并校准难度，使部分rollout成功、部分失败且至少存在一个符合训练预算的正确解。MagicBeanStalk通过保留推理蓝图并递归生成策略与预算校准问题，显著优于全量源语料和筛选真实数据，并在金融等低资源领域展现出高效迁移能力。

title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling. However, existing methods typically allocate computation uniformly across space when generating the next video chunk, updating all patches with the same denoising schedule and number of function evaluations. This ignores the spatial heterogeneity of video content: static, simple, or recurring regions are often easier to denoise, while other regions require further refinement or additional context. A uniform budget thus leads to redundant computation on easy patches, whereas reducing the fixed step count can leave difficult patches insufficiently refined. We introduce \methodname{}, a general framework that dynamically allocates denoising steps to individual patches: easy patches stop early to improve efficiency, while difficult patches receive more refinement steps. This design accelerates generation with negligible quality degradation. Our method is compatible with most existing few-step autoregressive diffusion models, requiring only a lightweight routing module with modest training. Experiments demonstrate that \methodname{} reduces the total number of denoising steps applied across video patches by about 50\% while maintaining visual quality comparable to the four-step baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出动态分配去噪步数的框架，对简单patch提前停止、困难patch多步细化，在几乎不损失质量的前提下将总去噪步数减少约50%。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型在生成下一视频块时对空间均匀分配计算，所有patch采用相同的去噪调度和函数评估次数。这忽略了视频内容的空间异质性：静态、简单或重复区域更易去噪，而其他区域需要更多细化或额外上下文。均匀预算导致简单patch冗余计算，而统一减少步数又会使困难patch细化不足。
AI.method: 引入一种通用框架，对单个patch动态分配去噪步数：简单patch提前停止以提升效率，困难patch获得更多细化步数。该方法与多数现有少步自回归扩散模型兼容，仅需一个轻量级路由模块和适度训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在保持与四步基线相当的视觉质量的同时，将视频patch上的总去噪步数减少约50%。
AI.conclusion: 通过空间自适应的去噪步数分配，可在几乎无质量损失的情况下显著加速自回归视频扩散生成，为实时交互式视频生成与视频世界建模提供高效方案。

title: Market Impact Estimation via Causal Foundation Models
comment: In 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), November 14-17, 2026, Milan, Italy
summary: When a trader executes a large order, the relevant question is not \emph{what will the price be?} but \emph{what would the price have been had I not traded?} Market impact is thus a causal quantity, yet classical models (Almgren--Chriss, propagators) regress price on flow, which is biased whenever informed flow moves prices through information as well as trading. We present a proof-of-concept \emph{Causal Market Simulator}: a continuous-time causal prior-data fitted network (PFN) trained on a synthetic market prior in which a hidden informational flow confounds the flow--price relation by construction, with confounding strength an exact per-episode knob. On this prior, the naive estimator's bias follows a closed form we confirm empirically (up to 68\% overestimation), while the PFN tracks the unbiased true-parameter oracle at high confounding. Its \emph{do-ablated twin}, the same model with the intervention inputs removed, collapses onto the pre-window mean. Zero-shot, the model responds at the ground-truth scale to metaorders in an ABIDES limit-order book ($+0.38$ pre-onset standard deviations against seed-replay counterfactuals), and its intervention response replicates on about 2,300 detected flow bursts in BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals and 3,800 on Nasdaq equities, evidence consistent with, though not proof of, causal transfer. Off-prior the response degrades gracefully, and split-conformal recalibration repairs interval calibration. Transfer hinges on encoding the metaorder as added flow rather than a clamped price level, not on more training. A recurrent state-space variant closes the remaining shape gap: its impact accrues over execution duration where the transformer's stays flat, raising the correlation with measured metaorder impact from $+0.68$ to between $+0.92$ and $+0.96$, at the cost of weaker on-prior deconfounding that traces to the training recipe rather than to recurrence.

AI.tldr: 提出因果市场模拟器（基于连续时间因果PFN），在合成先验下验证市场冲击的因果估计，可零样本迁移至ABIDES及真实市场流。
AI.motivation: 市场冲击本质是因果量（"若非我交易，价格会是多少"），但经典模型（Almgren-Chriss、传播子模型）将价格对订单流做回归，当知情流同时通过信息与交易影响价格时会产生混杂偏误。
AI.method: 构建连续时间因果先验数据拟合网络（PFN），在合成市场先验上训练，该先验按构造让隐藏信息流混杂流-价关系，且混杂强度为每幕可控参数；设计"去干预孪生"模型（移除干预输入）作为对照；将元订单编码为"新增流"而非钳制的价格水平。
AI.result: 朴素估计器偏误符合闭式解，经验上高估达68%；PFN在高混杂下逼近无偏真参数预言机；去干预孪生坍缩至窗口前均值；零样本在ABIDES限价订单簿中对元订单以真值尺度响应（+0.38个发病前标准差），并在约2300个BTC/ETH/SOL永续合约流爆发与3800个Nasdaq股票事件上复现；偏离先验时响应优雅退化，分裂共形重校准修复区间校准；循环状态空间变体将冲击与测量元订单冲击相关性从+0.68提升至+0.92~0.96。
AI.conclusion: 迁移关键在于将元订单编码为新增流而非钳制价格，而非更多训练；循环变体缩小形状差距但先验去混杂能力较弱，且该弱点源自训练配方而非循环结构本身。

title: Scalable Quantum Clustering of Renewable Profiles via a Hybrid Qubit-efficient Strategy
summary: Large-scale renewable energy profile clustering is a computationally challenging NP-hard problem. Recent quantum computing techniques offer a potential remedy, yet their scalability is severely constrained by the limited qubit count of current quantum hardware. To address this issue, we first cast the problem into a QUBO form and then we propose a consensus-based variable reduction (CBVR) method to drastically cut qubit usage. More specifically, we tailor the one-hot constraint to eliminate assignment variables and leverage consensus analysis to convert stable clustering relations from initial anneals into equality constraints for further reduction. Experiments on real quantum hardware confirm that CBVR compresses oversized QUBO models into feasible sizes while retaining high clustering quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大规模可再生能源场景聚类这一NP-hard问题，将其转化为QUBO形式，并提出基于共识的变量约减（CBVR）方法，通过定制one-hot约束与共识分析大幅降低量子比特用量，在真实量子硬件上实现了可解规模与高聚类质量。
AI.motivation: 大规模可再生能源场景聚类是计算上困难的NP-hard问题；量子计算提供了潜在解决途径，但受限于当前量子硬件的量子比特数目，可扩展性严重不足。因此需要一种能大幅压缩量子比特需求的建模方法。
AI.method: 首先将问题建模为QUBO形式；随后提出基于共识的变量约减（CBVR）方法：一是定制one-hot约束以消去分配变量，二是利用共识分析将初始退火中稳定的聚类关系转化为等式约束，从而进一步缩减变量规模。
AI.result: 在真实量子硬件上的实验表明，CBVR能够将超规模的QUBO模型压缩至可解规模，同时保持较高的聚类质量和效率。
AI.conclusion: CBVR通过约束定制与共识分析有效缓解了量子硬件量子比特数受限的瓶颈，使QUBO形式的大规模聚类问题在现有量子硬件上变得可行，并维持了聚类质量与效率。

title: Localization Landscapes based on the Green's Matrix of Non-Hermitian Optical Scattering Systems
summary: The Filoche--Mayboroda (FM) localization landscape predicts where the spatially localized modes of a self-adjoint elliptic operator reside without diagonalizing it, but the construction fails for the complex, non-normal Green's matrix G of an open scattering array of electric dipoles. We propose three real-valued, positive landscapes built from the Feinberg--Zee hermitization of G: a regularised Gramian inverse (Gram), the diagonal Schur block that carries the Metz--Neri--Rogers spectral density (SY), and the full hermitized inverse contracted against a polarization-isotropic source pair (Herm). The three form a progression from spectrum-blind to fully hermitisation-faithful, agree in the limit $z\to 0$, and diverge where it matters: at nonzero spectral shift SY resolves modes that Gram collapses, and Herm resolves modes that SY collapses. We demonstrate the progression on random and deterministic aperiodic scattering arrays with a wide range of structural correlations, extend to the vectorial case of transverse electric polarization (TE), and provide rigorous justifications along with mathematical proofs and a complete numerical recipe in the appendices and in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 提出三种从Feinberg--Zee厄米化构造的实值正景观（Gram、SY、Herm），用于预测开放散射电偶极子阵列的局域模式，三者从盲谱到完全忠实厄米化递进。
AI.motivation: Filoche--Mayboroda局域景观可预测自伴椭圆算子的空间局域模式而无需对角化，但对开放散射电偶极子阵列的复非正规Green矩阵G失效，因此需要新构造。
AI.method: 基于G的Feinberg--Zee厄米化，构造三种实值正景观：正则化Gram逆（Gram）、携带Metz--Neri--Rogers谱密度的对角Schur块（SY）、以及极化各向同性源对缩并的完全厄米化逆（Herm）；并在随机与确定性非周期散射阵列、TE矢量情形上验证。
AI.result: 三者在z→0极限一致，但在非零谱移处分化：SY能分辨Gram塌缩的模式，Herm能分辨SY塌缩的模式。
AI.conclusion: 三种景观构成从盲谱到完全忠实厄米化的递进，适用于广泛结构关联的散射阵列并可推广至TE矢量情形，附录与补充材料给出严格证明与完整数值配方。

title: perturber: A Stateless Service for Semantics-Preserving Text Perturbations
comment: 14 pages (6 main + references and appendix), 5 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/IBM/perturber
summary: Large language model (LLM) evaluations on clean benchmarks overstate model robustness: real inputs arrive perturbed, and these meaning-preserving variants routinely move model answers. Studying this systematically requires applying perturbations one at a time, reproducibly, and identically wherever they run, yet existing tools couple them to a benchmarking stack rather than packaging them as a reusable transform layer. We present perturber, a stateless service and Python library that applies exactly one semantics-preserving perturbation per call, drawn from a first-party catalog of 68 perturbations across 11 families. It turns on a single primitive, with composition left to the caller chaining calls, so the service and the library produce identical output by construction. We evaluate the tool itself, its correctness, reproducibility, and cost, rather than any model's robustness, measuring meaning-preservation per perturbation rather than assuming it. The demonstration adds a live playground, an introspectable catalog for benchmark selection, and a one-command reproducible evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 perturber——一个无状态服务与 Python 库，每次调用施加恰好一个语义保持扰动，覆盖 11 大类共 68 种扰动；服务与库由同一原语构建，输出天然一致。工作重点在于评估工具本身的正确性、可复现性与成本，而非模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评测多基于干净基准，高估了模型鲁棒性：真实输入常带扰动，而语义保持的变体往往改变模型答案。系统研究该问题需要逐次、可复现且跨环境一致的扰动施加方式，但现有工具将扰动与评测栈耦合，未封装为可复用的变换层。
AI.method: 设计并实现 perturber：无状态服务 + Python 库，具备首方扰动目录（68 种扰动、11 个族），每次调用只施加一个语义保持扰动；以单一原语实现，组合交由调用方通过链式调用完成，从而保证服务与库输出在构造上一致；按扰动逐一度量语义保持性；并提供在线 playground、可内省的目录用于基准选择，以及一条命令即可复现的评测。
AI.result: 对工具本身进行评估，涵盖正确性、可复现性与成本；语义保持性按每个扰动分别测量而非默认假设；服务与库因共享同一原语而在输出上完全一致；附带在线演示、可内省目录与一键复现评测流程。
AI.conclusion: perturber 将扰动从评测栈中解耦为可复用的无状态变换层，通过单扰动调用、单一原语和可内省目录，提升了扰动施加的可复现性与跨环境一致性；评估对象聚焦于工具质量而非模型鲁棒性，为后续鲁棒性研究提供了标准化基础设施。

title: Faithful and Complete LLM-Assisted Automated Construction of Hierarchical Hardware Knowledge Graphs
summary:
Hardware datasheets contain engineering specifications essential for component selection, system integration, and hardware compatibility verification. However, manual inspection is tedious and error-prone because datasheets are lengthy and heterogeneous, with dense information fragmented across tables, figures, and text. Although large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, naïve one-shot processing omits relevant specifications even when the document fits within the model's context window.
  We present an automated LLM-driven pipeline that transforms hardware datasheets into general-purpose hierarchical hardware knowledge graphs through chunk-based property extraction, hierarchical routing, and iterative refinement. The framework uses LLMs for information extraction and semantic reasoning while preserving source provenance and applying graph updates through validated instructions and deterministic local execution. This staged design reduces per-query context and maintains traceable intermediate representations. The resulting knowledge graphs provide semantically organized, source-grounded hardware properties for downstream retrieval and reasoning.
  We evaluate the framework on 20 hardware datasheets spanning diverse component types and document lengths. We assess property faithfulness and introduce inter-graph completeness to measure relative semantic coverage without exhaustive ground truth. Our framework achieves 98.8% property faithfulness compared with 76.1% for the one-shot baseline, while fully covering 83.6% of faithful baseline properties; in the reverse direction, the baseline fully covers only 10.5% of ours. These improvements provide more reliable and comprehensive engineering information for downstream hardware design and verification, reducing the risk of overlooked constraints and incorrect decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM驱动的自动化流水线，将硬件数据手册转化为分层硬件知识图谱，在20份数据手册上实现98.8%的属性忠实度，显著优于一次性基线（76.1%）。
AI.motivation: 硬件数据手册冗长且异构，关键规格分散于表格、图和文本中，人工检查低效易错；而直接用LLM一次性处理即使文档在上下文窗口内也会遗漏相关规格。
AI.method: 采用分块属性抽取、分层路由与迭代精炼的自动化管线，将数据手册转化为通用分层硬件知识图谱；LLM负责信息抽取与语义推理，保留来源溯源，并通过验证指令与确定性本地执行进行图更新，降低单次查询上下文并保持可追溯的中间表示。
AI.result: 在20份覆盖多种组件类型和文档长度的数据手册上评测：属性忠实度98.8%（基线一次性方法76.1%）；本框架完全覆盖83.6%的忠实基线属性，而基线仅完全覆盖本框架属性的10.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为下游硬件设计与验证提供更可靠、全面的工程信息，降低约束遗漏与错误决策风险；并提出inter-graph completeness指标以在缺乏完备真值的情况下衡量相对语义覆盖。

title: Feature Competition and Its Representational Origins in Vision Language Models: Evidence from the Stroop Paradigm
summary: When you ask a vision-language model (VLM) a question with an image, it answers your question based on the image. But to act means to choose: saying one thing means choosing to respond not say another. This becomes an issue when the image contains multiple features that equally relate to the question at hand: how would VLMs choose to respond? This problem is precisely studied by the classical Stroop task in psychology: among a set of deliberately designed images whose text and color conflicts (e.g., \textcolor{blue}{RED}), participants are instructed to report the color. We adapt this psychological paradigm to a benchmark and prompted a range of contrastive and generative VLMs on their behavior. Across models, we observe a persistent bias toward the feature of text in Stroop images: when text and color disagree, models preferentially generate responses centered to the text rather than color. We then opened the black box and examined the source of this bias and why certain features influences the model's behavior more than others. In the embedding space, we found that textual cues are represented more strongly and separably than color cues. This representational asymmetry predicts intervention success: steering models toward text-related directions is substantially easier than steering them toward color-related directions. Using a classical psychological paradigm, we demonstrate, at both behavioral and representational levels, that distinct features within the same image can exert unequal influence on VLM behavior. Our findings suggest that VLMs assign different degrees of saliency to different features within the same image, highlighting the need to understand how cue-specific saliency shapes their performance in widely used downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 将经典心理学Stroop任务改编为基准，发现视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像文本与颜色冲突时，持续偏向文本特征；表征空间中文本书写线索比颜色线索更强、更可分，且对文本方向的可操控性更强。
AI.motivation: VLM在回答带图问题时需要在多个与问题同样相关的图像特征间做出选择，即"行动即选择"。当图像包含多个同等相关的特征时，模型如何取舍尚不清楚。作者借用心理学经典Stroop范式来系统研究这一选择偏好问题。
AI.method: 将Stroop任务改造为基准，构造文本与颜色冲突的图像（如蓝色书写的"RED"），对多种对比式与生成式VLM进行提示测试，观察其行为；随后打开黑箱，在嵌入空间分析文本线索与颜色线索的表征强度与可分性，并做方向性干预（steering）实验。
AI.result: 跨模型普遍存在对文本特征的持续偏见：文本与颜色不一致时，模型优先产生以文本为中心的响应。嵌入空间分析显示，文本线索比颜色线索表征更强、更可分；这种表征不对称可预测干预效果——将模型导向文本相关方向显著比导向颜色方向更容易。
AI.conclusion: 在行为与表征两个层面证明，同一图像内不同特征对VLM行为的影响并不均等：VLM对同一图像内的不同特征赋予不同的显著性。这提示需理解线索特异性显著性如何影响其在广泛下游应用中的表现。

title: Efficient Learning of Survival Analysis Models Under Outcome-Dependent Truncation and Censoring
summary: Modern machine learning models are typically trained on data assumed to be representative of the predictive tasks the model will face in the future, but practical datasets violate this assumption. We focus on outcome-dependent truncation in which an observation appears in the training data depending on its label. Our work connects two largely distinct literatures: efficient learning under truncation and survival analysis. Existing methods for truncated survival analysis do not characterize the optimization landscape and instead rely on iterative procedures such as expectation maximization. We address this gap and prove that Cox regression can be efficiently learned under truncated and right-censored data using first-order optimization when the baseline hazard is known (despite nonconvexity). In contrast, when the baseline hazard is learned jointly, we construct identifiable and correctly specified models whose negative log-likelihood contains strict suboptimal local minima. On experiments with four survival datasets, we show that accounting for truncation reduces the prediction bias induced by naive Cox regression and extends to neural networks. We also show orders of magnitude speedups compared to standard expectation maximization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究结果依赖型截断下的生存分析，证明当基线风险已知时，截断+右删失数据下的Cox回归可通过一阶优化高效学习（尽管非凸）；但当基线风险联合学习时，可构造出含严格次优局部极小值的可识别、正确设定模型。实验表明考虑截断可降低朴素Cox回归的预测偏差，并扩展到神经网络，相比EM算法有数量级加速。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型通常假设训练数据对未来预测任务具有代表性，但实际数据集违背该假设。本文聚焦结果依赖型截断（观测是否进入训练数据取决于其标签），并试图连接"截断下的高效学习"与"生存分析"这两个此前基本独立的研究领域。现有截断生存分析方法未刻画优化景观，且依赖EM等迭代过程。
AI.method: 理论上刻画截断+右删失数据下Cox回归的优化景观：在基线风险已知时用一阶优化学习；在基线风险联合学习时构造可识别且正确设定的模型，分析其负对数似然的局部极小值结构。实验上在四个生存数据集上比较考虑截断与否的Cox回归，并扩展到神经网络，同时与标准EM算法对比效率。
AI.result: 证明基线风险已知时，截断+右删失数据下的Cox回归可用一阶优化高效学习，尽管目标非凸；但基线风险联合学习时，负对数似然存在严格次优局部极小值。实验中，考虑截断降低了朴素Cox回归的预测偏差，结论可扩展到神经网络，且相比标准EM算法实现了数量级加速。
AI.conclusion: 截断问题在生存分析中不可忽视，正确处理可减少预测偏差；优化景观的性质依赖于基线风险是否已知，联合学习会引入次优局部极小值；一阶优化方法在效率上显著优于EM。

title: ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals
summary: Secure transmission of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains a major challenge in telecardiology. While traditional mathematical watermarking can embed patient metadata directly into ECG signals, it is highly fragile against temporal desynchronization such as circular phase shifts. In contrast, existing deep watermarking approaches for temporal signals, such as audio, typically rely on lossy quantization, which compromises the high-frequency micro-morphological details critical for clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we propose ECGWmark, a fully convolutional and quantization-free deep watermarking framework for medical time-series. ECGWmark operates in a continuous, full-resolution latent space and utilizes a localized frame-level mechanism to improve the robustness to severe desynchronization. Crucially, we introduce a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. Experiments on the benchmark MIT-BIH database show that ECGWmark maintains channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under the evaluated circular temporal shifts. Furthermore, under a rigorous inter-patient diagnostic evaluation, Class-V sensitivity changes from 71.97% to 76.50%, whereas Macro-F1 changes from 35.25% to 34.71% and Class-S sensitivity from 8.89% to 1.39%; these results indicate mixed class-level effects.

AI.tldr: 提出ECGWmark——面向医学时间序列的全卷积、无量化深度水印框架，在连续全分辨率隐空间运行，结合帧级局部机制与可微生理损失，在MIT-BIH上实现时移下>90%的比特提取精度并保持诊断语义。
AI.motivation: 远程心电（telecardiology）中ECG信号的安全传输是难题。传统数学水印虽能嵌入患者元数据，但对循环相移等时间失同步极其脆弱；而面向音频等时间信号的既有深度水印多依赖有损量化，会损害对临床诊断至关重要的高频微形态细节。因此需兼顾鲁棒性与诊断保真度的方案。
AI.method: ECGWmark为全卷积、无量化（quantization-free）的深度水印框架。其要点：在连续、全分辨率的隐空间操作；采用局部化的帧级（frame-level）机制提升对严重失同步的鲁棒性；引入由临床分类器引导的可微生理损失（Physiological Loss）以保留诊断语义。在基准MIT-BIH数据库上进行实验。
AI.result: 在所评估的循环时间偏移下，ECGWmark的通道比特提取精度保持在90%以上。严格的跨患者（inter-patient）诊断评估中，Class-V敏感度由71.97%升至76.50%；Macro-F1由35.25%变为34.71%；Class-S敏感度由8.89%降至1.39%，显示类别层面效果不一。
AI.conclusion: ECGWmark在无量化、全分辨率连续隐空间下同时兼顾了对时间失同步的鲁棒性与诊断语义保留，比特提取精度表现良好；但在跨患者诊断评估中，各类别的诊断指标变化不一致（部分提升、部分明显下降），说明其对临床诊断语义的保护仍存在类别相关的不均衡性，需进一步改进。

title: Spectral-control-assisted Kerr-lens mode-locking in a Tm:Y2O3 ceramic laser
summary: We report a soft-aperture Kerr-lens mode-locked Tm:Y2O3 ceramic laser stabilized by suppressing wavelength competition under high population-inversion conditions. The laser delivers an average output power of 0.5 W with a pulse duration of 112 fs at a repetition rate of 90 MHz and a central wavelength of 2.08 um. Further optimization for shorter pulses yields a pulse duration of 107 fs, through with a reduced output power of 0.22 W. These results demonstrate that spectral-control is an effective approach for achieving stable mode-locking in such laser with strong spectral competition.

AI.tldr: 通过抑制高粒子数反转条件下的波长竞争实现软光阑克尔透镜锁模的Tm:Y2O3陶瓷激光器，输出0.5 W、112 fs（重频90 MHz、中心波长2.08 μm）的飞秒脉冲，优化后可达107 fs/0.22 W，证明光谱调控是实现强光谱竞争激光器稳定锁模的有效途径。
AI.motivation: Tm:Y2O3陶瓷激光器在2 μm波段具有宽发射带等优势，但在高粒子数反转条件下存在强烈的波长竞争，导致多波长振荡，破坏锁模稳定性。因此需要一种有效手段实现稳定锁模。
AI.method: 采用软光阑克尔透镜锁模（KLM）结构，并通过光谱调控抑制高粒子数反转条件下的波长竞争，从而获得稳定锁模运转。
AI.result: 获得平均输出功率0.5 W、脉宽112 fs、重复频率90 MHz、中心波长2.08 μm的飞秒脉冲；进一步优化脉宽至107 fs时输出功率降至0.22 W。
AI.conclusion: 光谱调控（抑制波长竞争）是实现具有强光谱竞争特性激光器稳定锁模的有效方法，为2 μm波段超快陶瓷激光器提供了可行技术路径。

title: GeoFitBench-LLM: A Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models' Capabilities in Geospatial Data Requirements Elicitation for Geo-Analytic Tasks
comment: Presented as an Oral Presentation Paper at GeoAI 2026, Ghent, Belgium. Also available on Zenodo
summary: Large language models are becoming central to GeoAI systems, yet their evaluation rarely considers the elicitation of geospatial data requirements. This omission is critical as retrieval oriented geo-analytic tasks cannot be supported reliably without first identifying the necessary datasets and constraints. GeoFitBench-LLM is introduced as a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs can infer the datasets, the supporting resources and the constraints required by geo-analytic requests in natural language. The benchmark is structured around two reasoning dimensions, Spatio-Temporal Relational and Semantic Grounding, reflecting long-standing challenges in geospatial information retrieval and related natural language tasks. Ground truth requirements are encoded in a fixed, provider-independent schema for reproducible evaluation of resource identification and attribute-level specification. Experiments on seven models under minimal prompting indicate that identifying the necessary resources is often achievable, with GPT-5.4 Thinking achieving the best result by recovering the complete set of resources in 66.67% of benchmark requests. Results further indicate that accurate fitness-for-use specification remains more difficult as inferential demands increase.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoFitBench-LLM基准，评估大语言模型能否从自然语言地理分析请求中推断所需数据集、支撑资源与约束条件。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正成为GeoAI系统的核心，但现有评估很少关注地理空间数据需求的提取。该缺口十分关键：检索类地理分析任务若不能先识别必要数据集与约束，就无法可靠运行。因此需要专门的基准来衡量模型此方面能力。
AI.method: 构建GeoFitBench-LLM基准，围绕两个推理维度组织：时空关系推理（Spatio-Temporal Relational）与语义锚定（Semantic Grounding），对应地理信息检索及相关自然语言任务的长期挑战。基准将真值需求编码为固定的、与数据提供方无关的模式（schema），以支持资源识别与属性级规格说明的可复现评估。在最小提示（minimal prompting）条件下对七个模型进行实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，识别必要资源通常可实现，其中GPT-5.4 Thinking表现最佳，在66.67%的基准请求中恢复了完整资源集合。结果进一步显示，随着推理需求上升，准确的适用性（fitness-for-use）规格说明仍更为困难。
AI.conclusion: GeoFitBench-LLM为LLM地理空间数据需求提取提供了可复现的评估框架，揭示出资源识别与属性级适用性规格说明之间的能力差距；后者是未来提升LLM支撑地理分析任务的关键方向。

title: Representation Alignment from a Few Paired Data via Distilled Optimal Transport
summary: Aligning two independently pretrained unimodal encoders typically demands millions of paired examples. In this paper, we study the regime where only $N \sim 100$--$500$ pairs are available, while unpaired data on either side is abundant. Our method expresses every representation by its similarities to the $N$ paired anchors, which places both modalities in a common coordinate system; matches the two point clouds with a single entropic optimal transport problem solved over the entire pool, whose marginal constraints counteract the hubness that defeats nearest-neighbor matching; and distills the resulting plan into two lightweight encoders, so that the correspondence becomes inductive. We additionally put this marginal constraint in relation with the one-step hub corrections of the bilingual lexicon induction literature. Pairing is required only for the anchors: the unpaired collections may be drawn independently from the two marginals, so that no item outside the anchor set needs to have both of its modalities observed. We evaluate on image-text and molecule-text alignment, where our method outperforms existing approaches at the same anchor budget on Flickr30k, MS-COCO and ChEBI-20.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅需 100–500 对锚点即可对齐两个独立预训练单模态编码器的方法，通过在锚点相似度坐标系中表达表征，并用熵最优传输匹配两个点云，再蒸馏为轻量编码器，在图文与分子-文本对齐任务上优于同预算的现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统对齐两个独立预训练的单模态编码器通常需要数百万对配对样本；本文关注配对数据极少（N 约 100–500 对）但两侧无配对数据充足的场景，旨在降低对配对监督的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 用样本对 N 个配对锚点的相似度来表示每个表征，从而将两种模态置于统一坐标系；2) 在整个数据池上求解单一熵最优传输问题来匹配两个点云，其边缘约束可缓解导致最近邻匹配失效的 hubness 问题；3) 将得到的传输方案蒸馏为两个轻量编码器，使对应关系具有归纳性；4) 将边缘约束与双语词典归纳文献中的一步 hub 校正建立联系。
AI.result: 在图像-文本与分子-文本对齐任务上，于相同锚点预算下，本方法在 Flickr30k、MS-COCO 和 ChEBI-20 数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 仅需锚点集配对，无配对数据可分别独立地从两个边缘分布中采样，因此锚点集之外的样本无需同时观测两种模态；该方法为低配对预算下的跨模态对齐提供了有效方案。

title: WoodBR-Cross: A public wood-image dataset and individual-tree-disjoint benchmark for species identification
summary: Wood-image benchmarks can yield optimistic estimates when images from the same tree occur in both training and test sets. WoodBR-Cross contains 4,875 transverse-surface images in 38 operational taxonomic classes, linked to 303 distinct trees identified by numeric catalogue witness codes (codigos-testemunho) in the Brazilian Forest Service collection. A species-level subset comprises 3,406 images, 20 classes and 214 trees. Three tasks compare duplicate-aware image partitions for all classes (A), image partitions for the species subset (B1), and individual-tree-disjoint partitions for that subset (B2). In B2, all images from each tree are kept together, so no tree is shared across training, validation or test within a fold. ResNet-50, ConvNeXt-Tiny and ViT-B/16 were evaluated with three outer folds, internal validation and five training seeds. Handcrafted and frozen-feature baselines complement border-only and randomized-label controls. Validation-selected ConvNeXt-Tiny achieved B2 tree-level macro-F1 of 0.8621 +/- 0.0317; frozen DINOv2 features yielded 0.9000 +/- 0.0722. Values are means and standard deviations across three seed-averaged fold means. Results estimate performance on previously unseen trees from this collection.

AI.tldr: 提出WoodBR-Cross木材横切面图像基准，包含4875张图像、38个分类类群、303棵独立树木，设置A、B1、B2三类划分任务以解决同树重复导致的乐观偏差；在树级不相交的B2设置下，ConvNeXt-Tiny树级宏F1为0.8621±0.0317，冻结DINOv2特征达到0.9000±0.0722。
AI.motivation: 现有木材图像基准在训练集与测试集中可能包含同一棵树的图像，造成数据泄漏，从而给出过于乐观的性能估计，无法反映模型对未见树木的真实识别能力。
AI.method: 构建WoodBR-Cross数据集：4875张横切面图像、38个操作分类类群，关联巴西林务局收藏中以numérico catalogue见证码标识的303棵不同树木；物种级子集含3406张图像、20类、214棵树。设计三类任务对比：A为全类别的重复感知图像划分；B1为物种子集的图像划分；B2为该子集的单树不相交划分（同树全部图像保持在同一侧）。采用ResNet-50、ConvNeXt-Tiny、ViT-B/16，配合三折外层交叉、内部验证与五个训练随机种子，并辅以手工特征、冻结特征基线及仅边界与随机标签对照。
AI.result: 经验证集选择的ConvNeXt-Tiny在B2设置下树级宏F1为0.8621±0.0317；冻结DINOv2特征为0.9000±0.0722（均为三个种子平均折均值的均值与标准差）。
AI.conclusion: 树级不相交划分能抑制重复样本带来的乐观偏差，所得指标可估计模型对该收藏中未见树木的识别性能；冻结自监督特征在该任务上表现优于端到端微调模型。

title: Enriched Holomorphic Neural Networks for 2D and 3D Laplace Problems
summary: Boundary-value problems for the Laplace equation develop singular behaviour near corners, edges and junctions that smooth approximators resolve poorly. We combine holomorphic neural networks with singular functions derived from the local geometry and boundary conditions. The representation is harmonic by construction, so no interior residual is needed: the network fits the smooth remainder from boundary data alone, and the enrichment terms capture the singular behaviour. Singular exponents are trainable, so the construction also applies when the local expansion is not known in advance. We extend the approach to three dimensions using independent networks evaluated along complex null directions. The enriched model is the most accurate tested method on every problem. Its margin is several orders of magnitude where the enrichment captures the singularity exactly, and a factor of about 1.7-2.1 over the next-best method on a CdZnTe radiation detector with many singular sites, in both two and three dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将全纯神经网络与由局部几何和边界条件推导的奇异函数相结合，构造天然满足调和性的表示，仅在边界数据上拟合光滑余项，由富集项捕获角点/棱边/连接处的奇异性，并将方法扩展至三维。富集模型在所有测试问题上精度最高，能精确捕获奇异时优势达数个数量级，在含大量奇异位点的CdZnTe辐射探测器上（二维与三维）较次优方法提升约1.7-2.1倍。
AI.motivation: Laplace方程的边值问题在角点、棱边和连接处会产生奇异行为，光滑逼近器难以有效刻画这些奇异特征，导致精度受限。
AI.method: 将全纯神经网络与由局部几何及边界条件导出的奇异函数相结合：表示按构造即满足调和性，故无需内部残差；网络仅用边界数据拟合光滑余项，富集项负责捕获奇异行为；奇异指数设为可训练参数，使局部展开未知时同样适用；通过沿复零方向独立评估的网络将方法推广至三维。
AI.result: 富集模型在所有测试问题上均为最精确方法：在富集项能精确捕获奇异性的情形下领先达数个数量级；在含大量奇异位点的CdZnTe辐射探测器问题上，二维和三维均较次优方法提升约1.7-2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 将调和性先验与几何导出的奇异富集相结合，能够高效且高精度地求解含奇异性的Laplace边值问题，且无需预先知道局部展开，并可自然推广至三维。

title: Tri-Hybrid SWIPT with Reconfigurable Parasitic Antennas
summary: We propose a coupling-aware tri-hybrid precoding architecture for simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) using reconfigurable parasitic antennas. By integrating multiport network theory and information theory, we develop a third precoding layer that explicitly accounts for mutual coupling and reactive energy storage within the antenna domain. To efficiently optimize this architecture, we propose a low-complexity tri-hybrid solution comprising coordinate descent (CD) for parasitic reactive load optimization, a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based analog precoder, and a protective partial zero-forcing (PPZF) digital precoder. Numerical results demonstrate that the transmit array introduces impedance mismatch that reduces the real power accepted by the antenna array. Moreover, the proposed tri-hybrid architecture significantly outperforms hybrid precoding by constructively exploiting the coupling effects, yielding substantial gains in spectral efficiency (SE) and sum non-linear harvested energy (NLHE) at a fraction of the hardware cost.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种考虑天线互耦的三混合预编码架构，用于可重构寄生天线的SWIPT系统，通过联合优化寄生负载、模拟与数字预编码显著提升频谱效率与非线性采集能量。
AI.motivation: 传统混合预编码忽略了天线域内的互耦与无功储能效应，导致阻抗失配、实际被天线阵列接收的功率下降。作者希望在SWIPT场景中显式建模并利用耦合效应，以低硬件成本同时提升信息传输与非线性能量采集性能。
AI.method: 融合多端口网络理论与信息论，构建耦合感知的三混合预编码架构，新增第三层预编码以刻画互耦与无功储能。提出低复杂度三混合求解方案：坐标下降（CD）优化寄生电抗负载，基于奇异值分解（SVD）设计模拟预编码，采用保护型部分迫零（PPZF）数字预编码。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，发射阵列引入的阻抗失配会降低天线阵列实际接收的有功功率；所提三混合架构通过建设性利用耦合效应，在仅为混合预编码一部分硬件成本的条件下，于频谱效率（SE）与和速率非线性采集能量（NLHE）上均取得显著增益，明显优于传统混合预编码。
AI.conclusion: 将天线互耦与无功储能纳入预编码设计可有效缓解阻抗失配并建设性利用耦合，三混合架构以低复杂度、低硬件成本实现了SWIPT系统SE与NLHE的显著提升，为耦合感知预编码提供了可行方案。

title: Activating the Annotator: Operationalising Lived Experience in Data Annotation
summary: Perspectivist NLP has established that annotator positionality shapes labels for subjective tasks, but the field still lacks methods for operationalising it. Positionality is typically operationalised as a demographic form completed at recruitment: a static attribute recorded once and treated as a covariate, on the assumption that the knowledge it indexes is active when the annotator reads an item. This paper treats that assumption as a design problem and asks whether lived experience can instead be primed by the task itself. We introduce AXLE, a pre-annotation stage in which a scenario vignette anchors a short, axis-guided conversation that is synthesised into a first-person micro-narrative and returned to the annotator before labelling begins. In a 2x2 between-subjects study (104 annotators, 30 items, 1,040 annotations) on ambiguous hate speech spanning immigration, religion and gender, elicitation was associated with higher identity resonance and higher sensitivity to harm. It also increased label entropy and lowered inter-annotator agreement: the stage appears to surface plurality rather than manufacture consensus, which distinguishes it from annotator training, whose success criterion is convergence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AXLE方法，通过标注前的轴引导对话与第一人称微叙事来激活标注者的生活经验，而非依赖招募时填写的人口统计属性，从而在主观标注任务中实现"立场性"的可操作化。
AI.motivation: 视角主义NLP研究已确认标注者立场性会塑造主观任务的标注结果，但领域内缺乏将其操作化的方法。现有做法通常把立场性视为招聘时一次性采集的静态人口统计属性，并假定其对应的知识在标注者阅读条目时自动激活；本文将该假设视为一个设计问题，探讨生活经验能否由任务本身来激活。
AI.method: 提出AXLE，即一个预标注阶段：以情境短文为锚点，引导一段简短的、按轴组织的对话，并将其合成为第一人称微叙事，在标注开始前返还给标注者。在涉及移民、宗教与性别等模糊仇恨言论的2x2被试间研究中进行验证（104名标注者，30个条目，1,040条标注）。
AI.result: 引入该诱发环节后，标注者的身份共鸣与对伤害的敏感度均提高；同时标签熵上升、标注者间一致性下降。该阶段似乎是在呈现多元性而非制造共识，这使其区别于以收敛为成功标准的标注者培训。
AI.conclusion: AXLE表明立场性可以不再作为静态协变量，而由任务本身诱发；其价值在于显露多元视角，而非追求标注一致性，为主观标注任务中立场性的操作化提供了新路径。

title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated. We study a complementary axis of self-evolution: evolving those beliefs during deployment. Such beliefs can support multiple tasks, but incorrect ones can also propagate across them. We introduce EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses. Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation. Later observations and controlled experiments provide independent validation before a rule can guide predictions or plans within its supported scope. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as the environment changes. The language model remains frozen, and each rule remains linked to its evidence and the decisions it changes. Across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, EvoBelief improves task performance and reuses learned rules across tasks. On ALFWorld without actor-side transition memory, it improves success over the matched Frozen World Model by 23.9% and 31.3% with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, respectively. On MiniGrid, it revises stale rules and recovers after unannounced dynamics changes. In DiscoveryWorld's Reactor Lab, it discovers and validates quantitative laws, completing 83.3% of Normal-tier and 58.3% of Challenge-tier instances, versus 0% for each evaluated baseline. These results demonstrate self-improvement through testable, revisable environment knowledge rather than model-parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoBelief，一种自我进化的世界模型，将环境知识表示为可证伪的假设，在部署中通过意外结果触发假设生成、独立验证与反例修正来演化信念，而非更新模型参数。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化 LLM 智能体多聚焦于行动层面的改进（经验、反思、技能积累），但即使程序能力强的智能体，在环境动态信念不完整、错误或过时时仍会失败；且错误信念会在多任务间传播。因此需要研究"部署期演化环境信念"这一互补维度。
AI.method: EvoBelief 将环境知识表示为可证伪假设（规则）。意外结果与决策相关未知触发假设形成；后续观察与受控实验提供独立验证，规则方可在其支持范围内指导预测或规划；反例随环境变化收窄或淘汰规则。语言模型保持冻结，每条规则与其证据及所改变的决策保持关联。
AI.result: 在覆盖静态动态、隐藏漂移与科学发现的四个基准上提升任务表现并可跨任务复用规则。ALFWorld 无 actor 侧转移记忆时，相对 Frozen World Model 分别以 Claude Haiku 4.5 与 GPT-5.4 提升成功率 23.9% 和 31.3%；MiniGrid 中修正陈旧规则并能从无预告动态变化中恢复；DiscoveryWorld Reactor Lab 中发现并验证定量规律，Normal 层完成 83.3%、Challenge 层 58.3%，各基线均为 0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可通过可检验、可修正的环境知识实现自我改进，而非依赖模型参数更新。

title: Bridging Human and Model Attention: Explainability Analysis of CNN, Mamba, and ViT Architectures with Gaze-Based Validation
comment: Submitted to Image and Vision Computing
summary: High-risk applications of deep learning require precise characterization of model decision-making. We conduct a systematic explainability evaluation across Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Vision Mamba (ViM). Unlike predominantly qualitative studies, we quantify the alignment between model attention and human visual perception using eye-tracking ground truth. We formalize this comparison via a standardized normalization pipeline mapping post-hoc attribution maps and gaze heatmaps onto spatial probability distributions. Alignment is evaluated across fine-grained classification, medical imaging, and emotion recognition using architecture-specific XAI methods. We measure fidelity using Jensen-Shannon similarity, Chi-square similarity, and Pearson correlation, three complementary estimators capturing support overlap, mass discrepancy, and structural co-variation. Our results reveal distinct attention dynamics: CNNs tend to exhibit a more global focus, with spatially more diffuse saliency maps that correlate well with human perception in general contexts, while ViTs demonstrate fine-grained, patch-level attention, often focused on discriminative microfeatures. The Mamba architecture shows biased behavior: it achieves strong explainability in medical tasks but exhibits divergent intensity distributions in natural images; our analytical characterization of the metrics makes this dissociation explicit, since near-unit support overlap is attained simultaneously with a vanishing linear correlation. We further analyze the effect of backbone freezing and ensemble strategies on model interpretability. The results highlight how architectural and training choices influence the alignment between model saliency and human visual attention.
