On downstream benchmarks, the largest effects occur in story completion and narrative question answering, although they vary across models and languages; results on confabulation and hallucination benchmarks are mixed. These findings provide causal evidence that selected sets of narrative-associated components contribute to model behaviour, while their internal organisation, relation to narrative theory, and broader functions remain open questions.

AI.tldr: 研究在GPT-2-Small、Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.1-8B中定位与"叙事性"相关的注意力头、MLP神经元和稀疏自编码器特征，并通过消融实验提供其因果作用的证据。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型内部是否存在专门表征"叙事性"（文本呈现叙事属性的程度）的组件，即模型是否具备可识别的叙事表征机制。
AI.method: 跨三个模型识别激活与叙事性评分相关的注意力头、MLP神经元及稀疏自编码器特征；对选定的神经元与特征集进行消融，比较其对高低叙事性文本下一词预测损失的影响，并观察开放式生成中叙事性的变化，同时在多项下游基准上评估效应。
AI.result: 消融选定组件对高叙事性文本的下一词预测损失增幅大于低叙事性文本，并降低开放式生成的叙事性；下游任务中效应最大的是故事补全与叙事问答，但随模型和语言而异；在虚构与幻觉基准上结果不一致。
AI.conclusion: 提供了因果证据，表明特定叙事相关组件集合参与模型行为，但其内部组织、与叙事理论的关系及更广泛功能仍待研究。

title: SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents
summary: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas. Existing task-oriented dialogue benchmarks assume cooperative users and measure task completion; SmartSalesBench inverts this assumption, placing agents against personas programmed to resist and challenge across conversations of up to twenty turns. The benchmark includes five agent profiles, twelve buyer personas, fifteen smartphone products across six price tiers, and four controlled experiments with 3 iterations totaling 13,680 sessions. Both sales-agent and buyer persona generations are grounded through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We introduce nine evaluation metrics grouped into three tiers: primary outcome metrics (CR, BRS, RIR), secondary quality metrics (SMS, PFS, ETI), and exploratory metrics planned for future reporting (ITS, ARI, SPI). Our evaluation combines automated LLM-as-judge scoring with internal human assessment (n = 50, \k{appa} = 0.71, Pearson r = 0.81 with BRS).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SmartSalesBench，首个面向 LLM 销售代理的多轮对话基准，以心理学的抗辩型买家角色取代合作型用户假设，覆盖 13,680 场会话，并给出分层评估指标体系与自动+人工混合评分方案。
AI.motivation: 现有任务型对话基准默认用户合作、以任务完成度为指标，无法反映真实销售场景中买家会质疑、抗拒与施压的对抗性特征，因而缺乏对 LLM 销售代理说服与应变能力的有效评估手段。
AI.method: 构建 SmartSalesBench 多轮对话基准：包含 5 个代理画像、12 个买家角色、6 个价格档位的 15 款智能手机产品，以及 4 组对照实验、3 次迭代、共 13,680 场会话，单场最长 20 轮；代理与买家角色生成均基于 RAG 增强；设计三层九项指标——主要结果指标（CR、BRS、RIR）、次要质量指标（SMS、PFS、ETI）与后续探索指标（ITS、ARI、SPI）；评估采用 LLM-as-judge 自动打分与内部人工测评（n=50，κ=0.71，与 BRS 的 Pearson r=0.81）相结合。
AI.result: 基准可规模化开展对抗性多轮销售评估，人工测评与自动评分在 BRS 上呈强相关（r=0.81），评分者一致性达 κ=0.71，说明 LLM-as-judge 在该任务上与人工判断具有较好的一致性；探索性指标暂未报告结果。
AI.conclusion: SmartSalesBench 将对话评估范式从"合作型任务完成"转向"对抗型说服与抵抗博弈"，为 LLM 销售代理提供了心理学锚定、可控变量且人机校验的评测框架，并为后续探索性指标的验证留出接口。

title: BLEND: Balancing Personalization vs. Generalization in Federated Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted in Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026
summary: Federated vision-language models (FedVLMs) represent one of the emerging frontiers of machine learning, aiming to integrate federated learning within the fine-tuning pipelines of vision-language models (VLMs). In this work, we introduce BLEND, a new framework designed to jointly enhance the personalization and generalization capabilities of FedVLMs. BLEND proposes a selective VLM parameter fine-tuning and aggregation strategy that consists of (i) global vision and text adapters shared across clients, and (ii) a personalized vision projection adapter tailored to each client. BLEND further introduces a novel loss function that blends the outputs of the global and personalized adapters to achieve personalization, while simultaneously promoting generalization through a principled anchor design implemented via the projection heads of the zero-shot VLM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BLEND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting its ability to effectively balance personalization and generalization across diverse system settings. (Code is available at: https://github.com/payamsiabd/BLEND.git)

AI.tldr: BLEND 是一个联邦视觉语言模型微调框架，通过共享全局视觉/文本适配器与客户端个性化视觉投影适配器相结合，配合混合损失与零样本投影头锚定设计，同时提升个性化与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习与视觉语言模型微调的结合（FedVLMs）是新兴方向，但现有方法难以在个性化与泛化之间取得平衡，因此需要一种能同时增强二者的框架。
AI.method: 提出选择性 VLM 参数微调与聚合策略：(i) 跨客户端共享的全局视觉与文本适配器；(ii) 每个客户端专属的个性化视觉投影适配器。并设计新损失函数，通过混合全局与个性化适配器输出实现个性化，同时借助零样本 VLM 投影头构成的原则化锚点设计促进泛化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 BLEND 持续优于当前最先进的基线方法，在多种系统设置下均能有效平衡个性化与泛化。
AI.conclusion: BLEND 能有效联合提升 FedVLMs 的个性化与泛化性能，代码已开源。

title: Spatial Context or Memory? Sizing the Inputs of Neural Surrogates for Partially Observed Fields
summary: Neural surrogates that forecast a physical field from sparse, noisy sensors read a window of nearby sensors and a history of past snapshots. Practitioners choose both by comparing fitted models with each other. Such comparisons cannot tell a model's shortfall from missing information. We measure the trade-off between window and history against the Bayes-optimal error of the same readings. An exact Gaussian analysis shows that noisy or sparse observation of a field with local dynamics makes the optimal forecast read distant sensors only through spatial correlation. On a forced linear field with a known optimum, trained models that read only the window come within 1% of it. We then train such models on viscous Burgers flow and the chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, with every deciding comparison fixed before any test evaluation. In every field except KS, eight snapshots remove a smaller fraction of the one-snapshot error as the lead time, the number of steps to the forecast target, grows. In KS, for windows up to one correlation length, they remove a larger fraction. This lead-time inversion persists across sensor densities, three architectures and a two-dimensional domain. It shrinks as damping lowers the Lyapunov exponent. Damping also removes the linear instability of KS. We therefore tie the inversion to instability and leave chaos and linear amplification unseparated. For surrogate design the results give two rules. Size the window in correlation lengths of the field. Split a fixed input budget between window and history for the lead time the model will serve, because the best split moves toward wider windows as the lead time grows. In Burgers flow the split chosen at lead time one ends with 13.5 times the best error at lead time eight.

AI.tldr: 该论文用贝叶斯最优误差衡量神经代理模型中"感受野窗口"与"历史快照"之间的权衡，发现这一权衡随预测提前期增长而反转，并将反转归因于线性不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 从业者通常通过比较拟合模型的性能来选择感受野窗口和历史快照长度，但模型间比较无法区分误差来自模型缺陷还是信息缺失，因此需要一个以信息论下界为基准的绝对衡量标准。
AI.method: 对具有局部动力学的场进行精确高斯分析，推导同批读数下的贝叶斯最优误差；在已知最优解的受迫线性场上验证仅读取窗口的模型；随后在粘性Burgers流和混沌Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程上训练模型，所有决定性比较均在测试评估前固定；并跨传感器密度、三种架构和二维域验证，通过阻尼改变李雅普诺夫指数。
AI.result: 精确高斯分析表明，带噪或稀疏观测使最优预测仅通过空间相关性读取远处传感器；受迫线性场上仅用窗口的模型误差在最优解1%以内。除KS外所有场中，八个快照随提前期增大消除的单快照误差比例减小；KS中窗口达一个相关长度时该比例增大。该提前期反转在多种传感器密度、三种架构和二维域中持续存在，且随阻尼降低而减弱。Burgers流中按提前期1选定的划分在提前期8时误差为最优值的13.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 给神经代理设计提供两条规则：窗口按场的相关长度确定尺寸；固定输入预算应按模型实际服务的提前期分配给窗口与历史，因为最佳划分随提前期增大而偏向更宽的窗口。

title: What Should SFT Learn? Conditional Information Gain for Generalizable Post-Training
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) remains a widely used approach for post-training large language models, because fixed demonstrations can directly introduce desired reasoning strategies and behavioral patterns. Yet forcing a model to imitate externally provided trajectories may also interfere with behaviors already supported by pretraining, limiting generalization beyond the training distribution. Recent dynamic SFT methods mitigate this issue by reweighting token-level supervision according to model-side signals such as predictive probability, prior support, or distributional compatibility. However, model compatibility is not equivalent to learning value: a token that is weakly supported by the current model may either be an undesirable mismatch or precisely the task-specific decision that the demonstration is intended to teach. We propose CIG-SFT, an information-theoretic framework that estimates the task-conditioned information carried by each demonstrated token. Under teacher forcing, we compare the token likelihood from a frozen reference model with and without access to the task input while keeping the gold solution prefix fixed. The resulting conditional information gain quantifies how much the task itself reduces uncertainty about the demonstrated decision. We then convert this information into a KL-regularized projection of the current policy and derive an equivalent scalar-weighted SFT objective whose logit gradient exactly matches that of the projected target. Across mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, CIG-SFT consistently outperforms standard SFT and recent adaptive fine-tuning baselines, with particularly strong improvements in generalization to challenging evaluation distributions, while requiring neither additional training data nor online rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出CIG-SFT框架，用条件信息增益度量示范token的任务相关信息，并转化为KL正则投影等价于标量加权SFT目标。
AI.motivation: 固定示范的SFT虽能引入推理策略，但强制模仿外部轨迹会干扰预训练已具备的行为，限制分布外泛化；现有动态SFT仅依据模型侧信号（预测概率、先验支持、分布兼容性）重加权，但模型兼容不等于学习价值，弱支持token可能是任务特定决策。
AI.method: 在teacher forcing下，固定gold solution前缀，比较冻结参考模型在有/无任务输入时的token似然，得到条件信息增益以量化任务对示范决策不确定性的降低；再将该信息转化为当前策略的KL正则投影，导出等价标量加权SFT目标，其logit梯度与投影目标精确一致。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，CIG-SFT持续优于标准SFT和近期自适应微调基线，在困难评测分布上的泛化提升尤为显著，且无需额外训练数据或在线rollout。
AI.conclusion: 以条件信息增益衡量示范token的学习价值，可为SFT提供有理论依据的加权机制，在提升泛化性的同时保持训练成本不变。

title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Finite-Beam Reachability and Continuous-Query Generation in Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) of social media platforms commonly retrieves items by autoregressively decoding discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) with finite-width beam search. This work examines how this output interface constrains whether held-out targets enter finite returned lists, while distinguishing catalog-wide scoreability from empirical top-K support. We introduce two continuous-query paradigms: CQG-Single generates one retrieval query in a single pass, and CQG-AR autoregressively generates continuous residual updates, retaining step-wise decoding while removing the SID item-token vocabulary, code lookup, and discrete beam expansion. These designs thereby eliminate the SID-specific reachability constraint induced by finite-beam decoding and avoid the technical challenge of aligning a discrete SID vocabulary with the pretrained backbone's vector space. Both methods make every encoded item directly scoreable through dense or approximate-nearest-neighbor retrieval. Under a unified protocol with valid-prefix constrained decoding, CQG-Single exceeds the TIGER-style baseline in all seven runs while using 55.3% as many trainable parameters. CQG-AR remains comparable on ML-1M and is numerically stronger on Beauty and Sports datasets. A controlled depth ablation further shows that additional continuous refinement does not monotonically improve shallow accuracy. These findings motivate decoupling output representation, autoregressive modeling, and retrieval budget when evaluating generative recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究生成式推荐（GR）输出接口对检索可达性的限制，提出两种连续查询范式（CQG-Single 与 CQG-AR），消除离散语义ID（SID）与有限宽度束搜索带来的可达性约束，并在统一协议下取得优于TIGER基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体平台的生成式推荐通常通过自回归解码离散语义ID（SID）并结合有限宽度束搜索来检索物品。作者希望考察这种输出接口如何限制被留出的目标物品是否能够进入有限的返回列表，并在评估中区分"全目录可打分性"与"经验性Top-K支持"这两个不同概念。
AI.method: 提出两种连续查询范式：CQG-Single 单次前向生成一个检索查询；CQG-AR 自回归生成连续残差更新，保留逐步解码但去除SID物品token词表、码本查找与离散束扩展。两者均使每个编码物品可通过稠密或近似最近邻检索直接打分。同时在统一协议下采用合法前缀约束解码，并进行受控深度消融实验。
AI.result: 在统一协议下，CQG-Single 在全部七次运行中均超过TIGER风格基线，且可训练参数量仅为基线的55.3%；CQG-AR 在ML-1M上表现相当，在Beauty与Sports数据集上数值更强。受控深度消融显示，额外的连续细化并不会单调提升浅层准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明，在评估生成式推荐系统时，应将输出表示、自回归建模与检索预算三者解耦，连续查询范式可有效规避离散SID与有限束搜索导致的可达性约束。

title: What Egocentric Video Embeddings Encode and How to Combine Them with Inertial Sensors for Human Activity Recognition
comment: 31 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Solution to the 3rd WEAR Dataset Challenge @ HASCA 2026
summary: Egocentric video and body-worn inertial sensors are increasingly recorded together, and the video is usually encoded by pretrained models. What these embeddings represent when the camera sits on the head, and how they should be combined with inertial sensing, has received little attention. Across VideoMAEv2, CLIP, DINOv2 and the egocentric VC-1, the leading principal directions of the embedding are dominated by where the camera looks. Measured head orientation explains them on Ego-Exo4D for egocentric (R^2 0.49-0.70) but not exocentric cameras, and the scene layout explains them on WEAR. The part that the limbs' inertial signals predict separates activities across people. In a set-level probe, the rest separates exercise sets within a participant but not activities across people. This is consistent with separate roles: the video finds the clips of the same set, and the inertial classifier labels them. On WEAR, with temporal order removed and one random limb per one-second clip, we propagate inertial predictions over a within-participant video graph whose leading components are removed. This raises subject-wise cross-validated macro-F1 from 0.648 to 0.852. In our comparisons, propagation helps only over the video graph, and fusing the modalities in one classifier, or adding inertial edges to the graph, performs worse.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示第一人称视频嵌入的主成分主要由相机朝向（头部姿态）主导，而惯性信号预测的部分则编码跨人的活动类别；据此提出在去除主成分的参与者内视频图上传播惯性预测，将WEAR数据集被试级宏F1从0.648提升至0.852。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频与可穿戴惯性传感器常被同时采集，视频通常由预训练模型编码，但这些嵌入在相机佩戴于头部时究竟表征什么、以及应如何与惯性感知结合，尚缺乏关注。
AI.method: 在VideoMAEv2、CLIP、DINOv2与第一人称VC-1上分析嵌入主方向；用头部朝向与场景布局做回归解释；将惯性分类器预测在去除主成分的参与者内视频图上传播，并在WEAR上移除时间顺序、每个一秒片段随机取一个肢体。同时对比单分类器融合、在图谱中加入惯性边等方案。
AI.result: embedding主方向由相机朝向主导：头部朝向在Ego-Exo4D上可解释第一人称嵌入（R^2 0.49–0.70），但对第三人称不成立；场景布局可解释WEAR上的嵌入。惯性信号预测的部分可跨人区分活动；集合级探针中其余部分能在同一参与者内区分锻炼组但无法跨人区分活动。传播使被试级交叉验证宏F1从0.648提升到0.852；仅视频图上传播有效，单分类器融合或加入惯性边效果更差。
AI.conclusion: 视频嵌入与惯性信号承担不同角色：视频负责找到同一组的片段，惯性分类器负责为其打标签；在去除主成分的参与者内视频图上传播惯性预测可显著提升被试级性能，优于特征融合或引入惯性边。

title: A Categorical Atlas of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning: Cones, Orbits, and Gauges
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning has hundreds of methods, usually compared by parameter count and benchmark score. We compare them as maps. A pretrained checkpoint is a base point in weight space, and a weight-space method is a smooth map from a small parameter space that starts at that point. These maps form a slice category in which the frozen model is initial and full fine-tuning terminal. Three invariants of the map do most of the work. Its image near the base point governs expressivity, through the first-order image, the dimension, a min-cut bound on rank and whether that point is smooth or an apex. Its fibres, with the optimizer's metric, govern training dynamics. Base change moves the base point and covers splitting initialisations, quantisation, restarts and merging. We prove, for example, that zero-initialised LoRA, and Householder reflection adaptation at its default start under stated rank and parity conditions, begin at the apex of a cone; that no exact initialisation lets LoRA reach an update of rank above twice its own; that exactly orthogonal methods never change a weight's singular values in exact arithmetic, however often they are merged; that under Adam with no epsilon, weight decay or clipping and one shared schedule, LoRA+ from the standard zero initialisation follows exactly the trajectory of plain LoRA with its scale multiplied by the learning-rate ratio; that Adam with shared hyperparameters respects only the signed permutations inside LoRA's continuous symmetry group of full-rank factors; and that the activation function decides when a scaling adapter folds into preceding weights. We classify 382 methods from 138 papers by seven coordinates read off their formulas, with 403 simulation arrows and 485 obstructions. Every numbered result is proved in full, and results due to others are credited where we re-derive them.

AI.tldr: 该文将参数高效微调方法视为权重空间中的光滑映射，用切片范畴刻画其数学结构，并以像、纤维、基变换三类不变量分析表达能力、训练动力学与初始化/量化/合并等变体，进而系统分类并证明一系列关于LoRA等方法的具体结论。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法数量庞大，通常仅以参数量和基准分数比较，缺乏统一、可解释的理论框架。作者希望从权重空间的映射视角建立统一语言，用范畴论和几何不变量解释不同方法的表达能力、训练行为和等价关系。
AI.method: 将预训练检查点视为权重空间中的基点，将权重空间方法视为从低维参数空间出发、以该点为起点的光滑映射；这些映射构成以冻结模型为初始对象、全量微调为终止对象的切片范畴。使用映射在基点附近的像（一阶像、维数、秩的min-cut界、是否光滑或为锥顶点）刻画表达能力；使用带优化器度量的纤维刻画训练动力学；用基变换统一处理初始化、量化、重启和合并。读取各方法公式中的七个坐标，对138篇论文中的382种方法进行分类，给出403个模拟箭头和485个阻碍。
AI.result: 证明多项结论，例如：零初始化LoRA及在给定秩与奇偶条件下默认起点的Householder反射适配始于锥的顶点；不存在精确初始化能使LoRA达到高于自身秩两倍的更新秩；精确正交方法在精确算术下永不改变权重的奇异值，无论合并多少次；在无epsilon、无权重衰减或裁剪且共享调度时，标准零初始化的LoRA+与缩放乘以学习率比的普通LoRA轨迹完全一致；共享超参数的Adam仅尊重LoRA满秩因子连续对称群内的带符号置换；激活函数决定缩放适配器何时折叠进前置权重。分类覆盖138篇论文的382种方法、403个模拟箭头和485个阻碍，所有编号结果均完整证明，并标注他人已有结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出以映射和切片范畴为核心的参数高效微调统一理论框架，将方法比较从经验指标提升为几何与范畴不变量分析，并给出可复用的分类体系和多项严格定理，为理解、比较和设计权重空间方法提供理论基础。

title: Evaluating LLM Creativity through Long-Tail Performance
comment: 26 pages, including references and appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/YichenZW/longtail-creativity
summary: Creativity benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) vary widely in task and metric design. This raises the question of whether they capture a common notion of creativity. We propose that this shared target can be formalized as task-specific performance in the long tail of a reference input-output distribution, which describes how common input-output pairs are relative to a chosen source of text. We ground this proposition in the novelty-quality product formulation and evaluate it empirically across 15 benchmarks and 26 open-weight models, using n-gram absence from the pretraining data as a novelty proxy. Our results show that creativity benchmarks lie further in the tail regions than standard benchmarks. Moreover, on both creativity and standard benchmarks, model rankings from higher-tail subsets of each benchmark align more closely with human creativity judgments in LM-Arena. Building on these findings, we introduce q@Tail($α$), a lower-cost creativity diagnostic that measures mean task quality on the tail fraction of an existing benchmark. Applying it to creativity-promoting methods reveals substantial room to improve LLM creativity through stronger tail performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"参考输入-输出分布长尾中的任务特定表现"来统一形式化大语言模型的创造力评测目标，并以n-gram在预训练数据中的缺失作为新颖性代理，在15个基准、26个开源权重模型上实证验证，同时提出低成本诊断指标q@Tail($\alpha$)。
AI.motivation: 当前针对大语言模型的创造力基准在任务与指标设计上差异很大，学界不清楚这些基准是否在测量同一"创造力"概念，缺乏对创造力评测共同目标的统一形式化定义。
AI.method: 作者将创造力形式化为相对特定文本来源的参考输入-输出分布长尾区域上的任务特定表现，并以"新颖性-质量乘积"框架为理论基础；采用n-gram在预训练数据中的缺失作为新颖性代理，跨15个创造力与标准基准、26个开源权重模型进行实证分析，并基于长尾子集构建诊断指标q@Tail($\alpha$)，用于评估提升创造力的方法。
AI.result: 创造力基准比标准基准更位于分布尾部；在创造力与标准基准上，来自高尾子集的模型排名与LM-Arena中人类创造力判断的一致性更高；q@Tail($\alpha$)显示现有创造力促进方法仍有很大提升空间，可通过增强尾部表现来改善LLM创造力。
AI.conclusion: 创造力评测可统一理解为参考分布长尾上的任务表现，长尾表现与人类创造力判断高度相关；q@Tail($\alpha$)作为一种低成本诊断工具，能够有效识别模型创造力的改进空间，为后续方法研究提供方向。

title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
summary: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow rules from task-specific details. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework's infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation. Its 350 demonstrations are screened for completeness and task success. We then propose an agentic skill-induction method that inspects evidence on demand to produce reusable skills capturing workflow rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. When the same four execution models are equipped with skills induced by each method under shared execution settings, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates. Mean score improvements over the corresponding No Skill baseline are 4.67--10.54 points on MyPCBench Bounded Action and 3.11--7.50 points on a 286-task subset of OSWorld-Verified. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill.

AI.tldr: 提出Work2Skill框架，从人类GUI演示中记录经验并归纳可复用智能体技能，构建WorkDemo-350数据集，在MyPCBench与OSWorld-Verified子集上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体虽能完成日益复杂的GUI任务，但面对陌生软件及依赖人类领域知识的工作流仍存在困难。人类演示通过同一GUI交互空间传达流程性知识，但其复用需结合上下文解析动作、并将工作流规则与任务特定细节分离。
AI.method: 1) WorkRecorder基础设施：采集并对齐屏幕录像、鼠标键盘事件与可用的可访问性树信息；2) 基于WorkRecorder构建WorkDemo-350，首个面向可复用技能归纳与下游评估的同步多模态人类桌面GUI演示数据集，350条演示经完整性与任务成功筛选；3) 提出智能体式技能归纳方法，按需检查证据，产出捕获工作流规则、步骤依赖与完成校验的可复用技能。
AI.result: 在相同执行设置下，四种执行模型配备各方法归纳的技能时，Work2Skill取得最高分数与成功率。相较对应No Skill基线，MyPCBench Bounded Action平均提升4.67–10.54分，OSWorld-Verified的286任务子集平均提升3.11–7.50分。
AI.conclusion: Work2Skill实现了从人类GUI演示到可复用智能体技能的有效归纳，验证了技能归纳对多模型下游执行的泛化增益；代码与数据开源于 https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill。

title: UniDeblur: Unified Motion Deblurring via Fourier Convolution Learning
summary: Image deblurring is a fundamental task in computer vision, yet existing methods mainly specialize in isolated scenarios. Consequently, the deblurring performance of these models drops significantly across scenarios with different cameras and image contents. This motivates the development of a unified motion deblurring framework that can handle diverse blur patterns. To this end, we construct a multi-source dataset and develop a data pruning and quality control pipeline. Then, to restore blur images with various motion blur kernels across different scenarios, we propose a unified motion deblurring framework via Fourier Convolution Learning. Existing deblurring networks usually rely on pixel-level mappings and overlook the convolutional nature of blur. Thus, the network mostly fits the image content itself rather than learning the convolution process, making it difficult to handle multi-source blur images. Instead of relying on spatial mapping, we perform blur-adaptive global filter learning in Fourier space, which avoids the limited spatial support of kernel estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model effectively handles motion blurs across diverse sources and scenes, achieving competitive performance across both in-domain and OOD benchmarks. Code will be released at github.com/DeepMed-Lab-ECNU/Single-Image-Deblur.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于傅里叶卷积学习的统一运动去模糊框架，并构建多源数据集与数据清洗/质量控制流程，使单一模型可跨相机与内容场景处理多样模糊模式，在域内与域外基准上均取得有竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有去模糊方法主要针对孤立场景设计，当相机与图像内容发生变化时性能显著下降，缺乏能够处理多源、多样运动模糊模式的统一模型。
AI.method: 1) 构建多源去模糊数据集，并设计数据剪枝与质量控制流程；2) 提出通过傅里叶卷积学习的统一运动去模糊框架，在傅里叶空间进行模糊自适应全局滤波学习，避免传统空间像素级映射及核估计空间支撑受限的问题，从而学习模糊的卷积本质而非仅拟合图像内容。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该统一模型能有效处理来自不同来源与场景的运动模糊，在域内和域外（OOD）基准上均达到有竞争力的性能。代码将开源于 github.com/DeepMed-Lab-ECNU/Single-Image-Deblur。
AI.conclusion: 通过傅里叶空间的全局滤波学习，去模糊网络可摆脱对特定场景与像素级映射的依赖，实现跨源、跨场景的统一运动去模糊，具有较强的泛化能力。

title: Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlases for Amortized Conditional Interpretability
summary: Gradient-based attribution provides input-specific information about model parameters, but computing it via backpropagation for many samples is expensive, while static importance scores discard input dependence. We derive KPSA (Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas) from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel. It measures normalized parameter-group sensitivity, embeds those sources in an explicit query space, and uses a lightweight kernel to estimate sensitivities for unseen inputs. We derive bounds that separate finite-source from irreducible representation error and give margin-based top-$k$ recovery. This paper studies two interpretability applications. Firstly, KPSA identifies parameter groups with high susceptibility to perturbations across vision, forecasting, and protein-modeling setups. Across a fivefold range of parameter budgets ($0.02$-$0.1\%$), its selected groups attain $39$-$85\%$ of the perturbation susceptibility of a first-order backpropagation oracle. In vision and forecasting, these parameter groups form sparse sensitivity circuits that extend across depth and vary systematically with the input. Secondly, we use KPSA on an activation-attribution problem for MLP features in transformers. It retains $81\%$ of the gap between a backpropagation oracle and a constant-sensitivity baseline on vision while increasing batched query-time throughput from 551 to 2,041 images/s and reducing peak GPU memory from 4.55 to 0.44GB. On the protein-modeling task, it recovers $68\%$ of this gap. An ablation of KPSA's kernel aggregation shows that nearest-neighbor retrieval in KPSA space can remain competitive. The empirics show that compact kernel atlases can store useful input-dependent parameter sensitivity while amortizing repeated gradient attribution, a step toward scalable conditional interpretability. Code can be found at https://github.com/Axym-Labs/kpsa .

AI.tldr: 本文提出KPSA（Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas），从经验神经正切核的块分解出发，度量归一化的参数组敏感度，并将这些来源嵌入显式查询空间，用轻量核估计未见输入的敏感度，从而实现可摊销的条件可解释性。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的归因能提供与输入相关的参数信息，但对大量样本做反向传播代价高昂；而静态重要性分数又丢弃了输入依赖性。因此需要一个既保留输入依赖、又能摊销重复梯度计算开销的方法。
AI.method: KPSA由经验神经正切核的块分解推导而来，计算归一化的参数组敏感度，把敏感度来源嵌入显式查询空间，并用轻量核为未见输入估计敏感度。理论上给出区分有限来源误差与不可约表示误差的界，以及基于间隔的top-k恢复保证。应用上，其一用于识别对扰动高敏感的参数组（视觉、预测、蛋白建模）；其二用于Transformer中MLP特征的激活归因问题。
AI.result: 在参数预算0.02%-0.1%（五倍范围）下，所选参数组达到一阶反向传播oracle扰动敏感度的39%-85%；视觉与预测中这些参数组形成跨深度的稀疏敏感回路，并随输入系统性变化。激活归因方面，视觉任务上保留了反向传播oracle与常数敏感度基线之间差距的81%，批查询吞吐从551提升到2,041 images/s，峰值GPU内存从4.55GB降至0.44GB；蛋白建模任务恢复该差距的68%。核聚合消融显示KPSA空间中的最近邻检索仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，紧凑的核图谱能够存储有用的、依赖输入的参数敏感度，同时摊销重复的梯度归因，是迈向可扩展条件可解释性的一步。代码已开源于 https://github.com/Axym-Labs/kpsa 。

title: Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution
summary: Self-evolving agents are increasingly used to improve language model systems without human intervention through either weight updates or harness improvements. Existing approaches typically pursue these directions separately: some methods update model weights using self-generated experience, while others rewrite the harness that defines how an agent uses prompts, tools, context, and execution feedback. However, these approaches overlook the relationship between model weights and the agent harness. To connect these processes and ensure effective and smooth agent self-evolving, we propose Evo$^2$, a framework for weight-harness co-evolution. For harness updates, we design a unified dual-role pipeline that a single policy serves as both a Proposer, which writes harness edits, and a Reflector, which diagnoses their effects and guides revision. For weight updates, harness modifications and their execution outcomes guide the training of both the Proposer and the Reflector. We further develop EvoTIDE, a training pipeline that recovers usable trajectories through edit extraction and prefix continuation, then combines SFT with interleaved GRPO across the two roles. Extensive experiments across three coding benchmarks demonstrate that Evo$^2$ significantly outperforms existing self-evolution methods. It achieves 82.1% on Polyglot and 48.3% on SWE-bench Verified, compared with 62.6% and 41.0% for the strongest baseline, respectively. We also show that the evolved harnesses transfer to different tasks without further evolution and rank first in cross-benchmark evaluations. Our dual-role harness improvement framework is also able to extend to self-evolution with proprietary models, improving a GPT-5-mini agent's performance from 24.4% to 48.3%. These results demonstrate the applicability of the framework Evo$^2$ across domains and its broad transferability across models and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Evo$^2$，一个权重–框架协同演化（weight-harness co-evolution）框架，通过统一的双角色（Proposer/Reflector）流水线与 EvoTIDE 训练策略，将智能体框架改写与模型权重更新相互连接，在三个编码基准上显著超越现有自演化方法，并展现出跨任务、跨模型的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化智能体方法分两条独立路线推进：一类通过自生成经验更新模型权重，另一类重写定义提示、工具、上下文与执行反馈使用方式的智能体框架（harness）。二者互不关联，忽视了模型权重与框架之间的内在联系，难以实现有效且平滑的智能体自演化。
AI.method: 提出 Evo$^2$ 权重–框架协同演化框架。在框架更新方面，设计统一的双角色流水线：同一策略同时充当 Proposer（撰写框架编辑）与 Reflector（诊断编辑效果并指导修订）。在权重更新方面，利用框架修改及其执行结果指导 Proposer 与 Reflector 的训练。进一步提出 EvoTIDE 训练流水线，通过编辑抽取与前缀续写恢复可用轨迹，并在两个角色间结合 SFT 与交错式 GRPO。
AI.result: 在三个编码基准上，Evo$^2$ 显著优于现有自演化方法：Polyglot 上达 82.1%（最强基线 62.6%），SWE-bench Verified 上达 48.3%（最强基线 41.0%）。演化后的框架无需进一步演化即可迁移到不同任务，在跨基准评测中排名第一。该双角色框架改进方法还可扩展到专有模型的自演化，将 GPT-5-mini 智能体性能从 24.4% 提升至 48.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 Evo$^2$ 在跨领域适用性以及跨模型、跨任务的可迁移性方面具有广泛价值，验证了权重与框架协同演化这一思路的有效性。

title: Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification
summary: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult. This paper asks if an unsupervised representation trained on patent text can recover relevant connections that code-restricted search cannot, and if hyperbolic space helps. We trained a hyperbolic and a matched Euclidean Variational Autoencoder (VAE) on 45,000 US patents (96 runs, 6 seeds). The hyperbolic model retrieves genuinely cross-category prior art 52% more often than the Euclidean model (18.76% vs. 12.34% of top-10 results, 3,000 queries). This represents a practical gain for the motivating search problem. The hyperbolic model agrees less with official classification (NMI 0.2392 vs. 0.3206), which we explain geometrically: the two measures capture different goals, and only one aligns with prior-art search needs. In a study of 10 technology domains (50,000 more patents), we find that a domain's classification breadth--the number of distinct CPC subgroups spanned--predicts approach performance (Pearson r=-0.642, p=0.045, N=10), and that patents per subgroup is an even stronger predictor (r=0.715, p=0.020). This provides a checkable signal for practitioners to determine where the method is most valuable. We report all findings with statistical transparency and release a complete, 91-test automated implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于专利文本的无监督表示能否恢复分类代码受限检索无法发现的跨类先验技术关联，以及双曲空间是否有帮助。作者在45,000件美国专利上训练了双曲与等价的欧氏VAE（96次运行、6个种子），发现双曲模型在top-10结果中检索到真正跨类别先验技术的比例比欧氏模型高52%，并进一步分析了其与官方分类一致性的差异及可预测方法适用性的领域特征。
AI.motivation: 现有先验技术检索系统围绕分类代码组织，导致跨代码发现困难。论文旨在检验在专利文本上训练的无监督表示能否恢复代码受限检索无法捕捉的相关关联，并探究双曲空间是否能带来增益，同时为实践者提供判断该方法适用场景的可检验信号。
AI.method: 在45,000件美国专利上训练一对匹配的双曲和欧氏变分自编码器（VAE），共96次运行、6个种子。进行3,000次查询，比较两者在top-10结果中检索跨类别先验技术的比例，并比较其与官方分类的一致性（NMI）。另在10个技术领域（额外50,000件专利）中研究领域分类广度（跨越的CPC子组数量）及每子组专利数对方法性能的预测作用。
AI.result: 双曲模型检索到真正跨类别先验技术的频率比欧氏模型高52%（top-10结果的18.76% vs. 12.34%，3,000次查询）。双曲模型与官方分类的一致性较低（NMI 0.2392 vs. 0.3206），作者从几何角度解释为两者目标不同，且仅有一种与先验技术检索需求一致。在10个技术领域（50,000件额外专利）中，领域分类广度可预测方法性能（Pearson r=-0.642，p=0.045，N=10），每子组专利数是更强预测因子（r=0.715，p=0.020）。
AI.conclusion: 双曲空间的无监督专利文本表示能更有效地恢复跨代码先验技术关联，为动机中的检索问题带来实际增益。与官方分类一致性较低并不代表性能差，而是反映目标差异。领域分类广度和每子组专利数可作为可检验信号，帮助实践者判断该方法最有价值的应用场景。研究以统计透明方式报告结果，并发布完整的91项测试自动化实现。

title: In-Context Learning Can Help Vision-Language Models Overcome Training Priors
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) learn strong statistical regularities during training, which can make them fail to properly respond to visual evidence when input images violate those regularities. It is challenging to disambiguate these prior-induced errors from errors caused by the model missing the underlying visual capabilities. In this work, we use controlled visual in-context learning to encourage the model to focus on the visual evidence, and demonstrate that this alone is frequently sufficient to correct the errors -- suggesting that the models in fact do possess the relevant visual capabilities. Specifically, we show that across five vision-centric tasks, demonstrations yield large gains on prior-conflicting counterfactual examples ($+27.2\%$ for Qwen3-VL 235B and $+15.1\%$ for Qwen3-VL 32B) while leaving accuracy on prior-aligned examples nearly unchanged. These findings generalize across five VLM families with gains from $+9.7\%$ to $+30.3\%$. We analyze visual representations and find that demonstrations indeed redirect attention toward grounding cues while reducing reliance on cues that support the learned prior. Finally, we find that in-context learning is limited when the underlying visual capability is weak or absent. Together, these results show that current VLMs possess visual grounding capabilities that standard evaluations may overlook, underscoring the need for controlled evaluation design in diagnosing and improving model capability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控视觉上下文学习证明：VLM的错误多源于统计先验干扰而非缺乏视觉能力，示范可显著修正先验冲突的反事实样本错误。
AI.motivation: VLM在训练中习得强统计规律，当输入图像违反这些规律时，模型可能无法正确响应视觉证据。然而，难以区分这类先验导致的错误与模型本身缺乏视觉能力所导致的错误，这阻碍了对模型真实能力的诊断。
AI.method: 采用受控的视觉上下文学习（visual in-context learning），通过提供示范（demonstrations）引导模型关注视觉证据；在五个以视觉为中心的任务上测试先验冲突的反事实样本与先验一致样本的表现，并分析视觉表征中注意力分布的变化。实验覆盖五个VLM家族。
AI.result: 示范在先验冲突的反事实样本上带来大幅提升（Qwen3-VL 235B提升+27.2%，Qwen3-VL 32B提升+15.1%），而先验一致样本准确率几乎不变；结论在五个VLM家族上泛化，增益为+9.7%至+30.3%。表征分析显示示范将注意力重新导向接地线索、降低对支持先验线索的依赖。当底层视觉能力薄弱或缺失时，上下文学习效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM实际具备被标准评测忽视的视觉接地能力；标准评测可能低估模型能力，凸显了在诊断与改进模型能力时采用受控评测设计的必要性。

title: KITE: A Knowledge-Injected Temporal Encoder for Time-Series Event Forecasting
summary: Forecasting rare, high-cost events in multivariate time-series systems is hard because their precursors are seldom observed, so a purely data-driven model has little to learn from. The engineers who run these systems, however, hold knowledge that precedes such events, information absent from the scarce labels. We call this a semantic prior and inject it into a self-supervised event forecaster through two switchable mechanisms, a covariate mechanism and an attention-bias mechanism, each the identity at its null, so one architecture serves every prior type with no per-dataset architecture search. A prior helps when it supplies information the observed window does not already contain: in a short context an informative prior beats no prior in-domain (pooled h-AUROC over the no-prior baseline: a periodicity clock +14%, p<0.001; a conservation residual +47% at a 0.25 label fraction), and a working prior transfers out-of-domain (+53%), substituting for feature transfer, while priors the window already recovers stay inert and the attention-bias mechanism shows no measurable gain. KITE is a switchable, attributable route to contextual conditioning, and a substrate for scaling toward cross-domain, pretrained time-series foundation world models that carry their governing structure explicitly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"语义先验"概念，通过协变量与注意力偏置两种可切换机制注入自监督事件预测器（KITE），在稀缺标签、稀有高代价事件场景下显著提升域内与跨域预测性能。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列中的稀有高代价事件前兆极少被观测到，纯数据驱动模型缺乏可学习信号；而系统运维工程师掌握先于事件发生的知识，这些信息在稀缺标签中并不存在，因此需要一种方法将这类领域知识注入模型。
AI.method: 提出KITE：将工程师知识形式化为"语义先验"，通过两种在其零值处均为恒等映射的可切换机制——协变量机制与注意力偏置机制——注入自监督事件预测器。由于两种机制均为恒等零映射，单一架构即可服务所有先验类型，无需逐数据集进行架构搜索。
AI.result: 先验在有增益时需提供观测窗口尚未包含的信息：短上下文下域内优于无先验基线（h-AUROC：周期时钟+14%，p<0.001；0.25标签比例下守恒残差+47%）；有效先验可跨域迁移（+53%），并可替代特征迁移；窗口已能恢复的先验保持惰性，注意力偏置机制无可测增益。
AI.conclusion: KITE提供了可切换、可归因的上下文条件化路径，可作为向跨域、预训练时间序列基础世界模型扩展的基座，使模型显式承载其内在结构。

title: RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
summary: Recurrent-depth language models improve inference-time reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared network to refine internal representations, but the additional recurrent computation also increases inference cost. This overhead is particularly pronounced during long-context prefill, where the full input sequence is repeatedly processed across recurrent depth. Weight-and-activation quantization offers a natural way to accelerate this computation through lower-precision arithmetic, yet repeatedly applying quantized computation introduces numerical perturbations that accumulate along the recurrent trajectory. We systematically analyze how such errors propagate across recurrent depth and show that quantization errors introduced earlier are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps and therefore have a smaller effect on the final representation. Matched-budget experiments strongly support this prediction, showing that placing quantized computation earlier in recurrent depth consistently yields the best fidelity. Based on this insight, we introduce RAMP (Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision), which performs early recurrent refinement using low-precision weight-and-activation computation and restores high precision for terminal refinement. Across context lengths up to 4K, RAMP preserves near-full-precision prefill quality while achieving up to 1.16x end-to-end first-prefill speedup on an NVIDIA H100, corresponding to a 13.9% latency reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文分析循环深度语言模型中量化误差沿循环深度的传播规律，提出RAMP混合精度方法：在循环深度早期使用低精度权重与激活计算，末端恢复高精度，从而在保持预填充质量的同时加速推理。
AI.motivation: 循环深度语言模型通过反复应用共享网络提升推理能力，但增加了推理开销，尤其在长上下文预填充阶段，完整输入序列需沿循环深度反复处理。权重与激活量化可加速计算，但重复应用量化计算会引入沿循环轨迹累积的数值扰动，因此需要理解量化误差如何在循环深度中传播。
AI.method: 系统分析量化误差沿循环深度的传播机制，发现早期引入的量化误差会被更多后续循环步骤衰减，对最终表示影响更小。基于此提出RAMP（Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision）：在早期循环精炼阶段采用低精度权重与激活计算，在末端精炼阶段恢复高精度计算。
AI.result: 匹配预算实验强烈支持上述预测：将量化计算置于循环深度较早位置始终获得最佳保真度。在最长4K上下文长度下，RAMP在NVIDIA H100上保持接近全精度的预填充质量，同时实现最高1.16倍的端到端首次预填充加速，对应13.9%的延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: 量化误差在循环深度中具有衰减特性，早期量化对最终表示影响较小。利用该规律设计的RAMP方法能有效兼顾循环深度模型的预填充质量与推理效率，为循环深度模型的量化加速提供了新的设计原则。

title: Hindsight Structured Advice Distillation: Steering Executor Agents with Advisors Trained on Their Failures and Task Characteristics
summary: Language-model agents are used for specialized work such as financial research, healthcare and law. Such agents are often capable enough for a task but still miss its details. In finance, for example, these details include which filing reports a figure or how a company discloses a metric. Retraining the agent to learn these details is expensive, and often impossible when the agent is a closed or shared system. Writing the missing know-how into the agent's prompt makes the prompt long and identical for every input, although different inputs need different guidance. We propose to learn to generate this guidance instead. A small advisor model reads each input and writes structured advice, which is appended to the prompt of a frozen executor. The advisor is trained with hindsight, following work on distillation with privileged information. On a training pool with graded answers, we analyse the executor's failures, run it under several strategies to see which one worked on each input, and let a teacher that sees the grades and the traces write the advice that would have helped. The advisor then learns, by supervised fine-tuning, to write that advice from the input alone. Because the student is a separate small model rather than the executor, it is cheap to train and adds little latency. We call this approach hindsight structured advice distillation (HSAD). On FrontierFinance, a public benchmark of expert-written financial research queries, an 8B advisor raises the qualification rate of Samaya's proprietary research agent, which already leads the benchmark's leaderboard, from 52.9% to 56.6%. This is above the agent's own high-effort configuration, at 37% lower cost per query. We study the generalization of the proposed approach, and in particular show that HSAD also improves results on WebShop, BIRD text-to-SQL and ExpertLongBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSAD（后见之明结构化建议蒸馏）：用一个小型"顾问模型"读取输入并生成结构化建议，附加到冻结执行器（executor）的提示词中，从而以低成本提升语言模型智能体在专业任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 专业领域（金融、医疗、法律）的智能体往往能力足够但遗漏任务细节，如某数字出自哪份文件、公司如何披露某指标。重训执行器成本高，闭源或共享系统更无法重训；而把缺失知识写入提示词会导致提示冗长且对所有输入千篇一律，无法按输入提供差异化指导。
AI.method: 训练一个独立的小型顾问模型，为每个输入生成结构化建议并拼接至冻结执行器的提示中。顾问模型采用"特权信息蒸馏"式的后见之明训练：在有评分答案的训练池上分析执行器失败案例，让其用多种策略运行并观察哪种策略在哪个输入上有效，再由可见评分与轨迹的教师模型写出"本可奏效"的建议；顾问模型通过监督微调，学会仅凭输入生成该建议。因学生是独立小模型而非执行器本身，训练廉价且延迟增加有限。
AI.result: 在FrontierFinance（专家撰写的金融研究查询公开基准）上，8B顾问模型将已居榜首的Samaya专有研究智能体的合格率从52.9%提升至56.6%，超过该智能体自身的高投入（high-effort）配置，且单次查询成本降低37%。泛化实验显示HSAD在WebShop、BIRD text-to-SQL和ExpertLongBench上同样带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 学习"生成输入相关的指导建议"比把通用知识硬塞进提示词更有效：小型顾问模型可低成本、低延迟地增强冻结的强执行器，并在多个专业与通用基准上展现良好泛化性。

title: Video Codec-Guided Training-Free Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
summary: Video large language models (VLLMs) rely on long visual token sequences to understand complex temporal content, which makes visual token compression important for efficient inference. Existing training-free compression methods mainly reduce the number of tokens sent to the language model, but the compression process itself can still require many visual feature comparisons, especially for intra-frame token protection and inter-frame temporal token merging. This paper proposes a video codec-guided training-free token compression method for VLLMs that uses coding information already available in compressed video as a low-cost search prior. The method aligns reference-frame dependencies, motion vectors, and residuals with the visual token grid. Residual information forms compact candidate pools for token protection, while motion information is propagated along reference-frame chains to construct localized candidates for temporal token merging between sparsely sampled frames. Local visual feature similarity comparison is then used within these candidates to make the final compression decisions, without modifying the base VLLM. Experiments on three representative VLLMs and four video-understanding benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves performance comparable to the state-of-the-art training-free baseline FlashVID, and in some settings surpasses it, while substantially reducing the feature comparisons required by token protection and temporal matching. These results demonstrate that codec information can effectively improve the accuracy-complexity tradeoff of video token compression.

AI.tldr: 提出一种视频编解码器引导的免训练视觉token压缩方法，利用压缩视频中已有的编码信息（参考帧依赖、运动矢量、残差）作为低成本搜索先验，降低特征比较开销，在不修改基座VLLM的前提下实现与FlashVID相当甚至更优的性能。
AI.motivation: VLLM依赖长视觉token序列理解复杂时序内容，需进行视觉token压缩以提升推理效率。现有免训练压缩方法虽减少了送入语言模型的token数量，但压缩过程本身仍需大量视觉特征比较，尤其体现在帧内token保护和帧间时序token合并上，计算开销依然显著。
AI.method: 1) 将压缩视频中的参考帧依赖、运动矢量与残差对齐到视觉token网格；2) 利用残差信息构建紧凑的候选池用于token保护；3) 利用运动信息沿参考帧链传播，在稀疏采样帧间构建局部候选用于时序token合并；4) 在这些候选范围内进行局部视觉特征相似度比较以做出最终压缩决策，全程不修改基座VLLM。
AI.result: 在三种代表性VLLM和四个视频理解基准上，性能与当前最优免训练基线FlashVID相当，部分设置下超过基线，同时大幅减少token保护与时序匹配所需的特征比较次数。
AI.conclusion: 编解码器信息能有效改善视频token压缩的精度—复杂度权衡，为VLLM高效推理提供了一种低成本、免训练的压缩路径。

title: Neural expectation-maximization and meta-models
summary: We interpret Transformer networks as learned approximations to a hybrid probabilistic-inference procedure that combines max-product Loopy Belief Propagation (LBP) with Expectation--Maximization (EM). In this view, a Transformer performs inference in partially observed Markov Random Fields (MRFs) whose structure and parameters are not given a priori but are inferred from data. We show that self-attention implements a differentiable approximation to max-product LBP on an input-conditioned, dynamically structured MRF, with attention weights encoding learned structural affinities. We further establish an EM correspondence at the level of depth: each layer updates latent representations in an E-step-like forward pass, while the transition $θ^{(l)} \to θ^{(l+1)}$ across layers acts as an implicit M-step. Building on this interpretation, we introduce \emph{meta-models}, a design paradigm in which inputs generate instance-specific parameters, unifying mechanisms such as self-attention, mixture-of-experts, and gated units within a single framework. Empirical results support the proposed perspective.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Transformer解释为一种混合概率推断过程的近似，该过程将最大积环路信念传播（LBP）与期望最大化（EM）相结合，并基于此提出"元模型"设计范式。
AI.motivation: Transformer网络虽然经验上表现优异，但其理论机制缺乏统一、可解释的框架。作者希望从概率推断角度为Transformer提供一个原理性解释，从而揭示其内部计算与经典推断算法之间的对应关系，并借此指导新的架构设计。
AI.method: 论文从理论上建立对应关系：证明自注意力相当于在输入条件化、动态结构化的马尔可夫随机场（MRF）上对最大积LBP的可微近似，注意力权重编码了学习到的结构亲和度；同时在深度层面建立EM对应，即每层的前向传播类似E步更新隐表示，而层间参数转移θ^(l)→θ^(l+1)充当隐式M步。基于该解释，提出"元模型"设计范式，使输入生成实例特定的参数，将自注意力、混合专家（MoE）和门控单元统一在同一框架下。
AI.result: 作者从理论上给出了自注意力与最大积LBP、层间更新与EM的对应证明，并展示了元模型框架对自注意力、MoE和门控机制的统合能力；经验结果支持所提出的观点。
AI.conclusion: Transformer可被理解为对最大积LBP与EM相结合的混合推断过程的学习近似，其中结构化和参数均从数据中推断而非先验给定。元模型范式在这一视角下统一了多种常见机制，为理解和设计Transformer架构提供了新的理论框架。

title: CoBe: A Benchmark For Conversational Counterfactual Text Editing
comment: accepted to NeurIPS'26 workshops on Trustworthy AI For Good (AI4GOOD) and Trustworthy AI Evaluations (TAE)
summary: Counterfactual text editing is the ability to revise a given text in light of a hypothetical change while preserving facts not causally affected by that change. When asked what would have happened if a doctor had not recommended surgery, the model output should retain the patient's medical history and modify only the consequences of the decision. This requires causal understanding: a model must determine, without being explicitly instructed to, what events are affected by the hypothetical change and what should remain fixed. This skill is central to human reasoning, especially in safety-critical domains like healthcare or law. By contrast, the task of associational text generation merely generates text statistically associated with the altered condition. In the medical example, an associational response might make the patient's symptoms less severe because milder cases correlate with no surgery. Such responses produce a plausible scenario, but not the counterfactual version of the given one. Prior counterfactual-text datasets do not clearly separate these modes of reasoning. We introduce the Counterfactual Benchmark (CoBe), a testbed for models' zero-shot ability to counterfactually edit a given textual scenario when prompted to do so in a conversationally natural way. CoBe contains 2000 questions spanning healthcare, science and engineering, business, and everyday scenarios. We test a suite of frontier and smaller models, with frontier systems achieving an average score of $58.05\%$. Our findings indicate that models frequently default to associational generation rather than preserving the causal structure of the original scenario. Moreover, performance does not scale consistently with either model size or output token length, suggesting that the failure may reflect model training objectives rather than insufficient model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实文本编辑基准CoBe，包含2000个跨领域问题，测试模型在假设变更下保留因果未受影响事实、仅修改因果后果的零样本能力，发现前沿模型平均仅得58.05%，常退化为关联式生成。
AI.motivation: 反事实文本编辑要求模型在无显式指令下识别哪些事件受假设变更因果影响、哪些应保持不变，这对医疗、法律等安全关键领域至关重要；而现有反事实文本数据集未能清晰区分"反事实推理"与"关联式生成"两种模式，因此需要一个专门基准来评估模型的因果编辑能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了Counterfactual Benchmark（CoBe），以对话式自然提示评估模型零样本反事实编辑给定文本场景的能力。CoBe包含2000个问题，覆盖医疗健康、科学与工程、商业和日常场景，并对一系列前沿模型与较小模型进行测试，对比其反事实编辑与关联式生成的表现，并分析性能与模型规模、输出长度的关系。
AI.result: 前沿系统在CoBe上平均得分仅58.05%；模型频繁退化为关联式生成，而非保留原始场景的因果结构；性能与模型规模或输出token长度并不一致地正相关。
AI.conclusion: 模型在反事实文本编辑上存在系统性缺陷，该失败可能更多源于训练目标而非模型容量不足，提示需要改进训练方式来提升因果理解与反事实推理能力。

title: Scaling Empowered Agents
summary: Empowerment measures the capacity of an agent to actively control its environment. In this work, we explain the connection between skill learning and empowerment. While skill learning is not empowerment, we introduce a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization: empowerment corresponds to the number of executable skills from a state, so maximizing empowerment corresponds to reaching states that are good starting points for many skills. Our recipe applies to arbitrary underlying skill learning methods. Whereas most prior work on empowerment looks at tabular settings, this recipe enables us to study empowerment at a scale where we can realize theoretically-predicted but empirically-elusive properties of empowerment (e.g., gathering resources, environment modification, survival). Experiments show that empowerment maximization unlocks interesting emergent properties, such as building a house in Crafter. Website and code at \href{https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/scaling-empowerment/}{this https url}.

AI.tldr: 本文将技能学习与赋能（empowerment）联系起来，提出一种可扩展的赋能最大化方法：赋能为某状态下可执行技能的数量，最大化赋能即到达可作为众多技能起点的状态。
AI.motivation: 先前关于赋能的研究多局限于表格型（tabular）设定，难以在较大规模上验证理论上预测但经验上难以观察到的赋能特性，如资源收集、环境改造与生存。
AI.method: 提出一种简单且可扩展的赋能最大化配方，将赋能定义为从某状态可执行技能的数量，并适用于任意底层技能学习方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，赋能最大化能解锁有趣的新兴特性，例如在Crafter游戏中建造房屋。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使赋能得以在更大规模上研究，能够实现理论上预测但经验上难以观察到的赋能特性。

title: MVGraph: Benchmarking LVLMs on Evidence Composition across Multi-View Visual Graph
summary: We introduce MVGraph, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-graph reasoning where the evidence required by a query is distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views. Although such evidence commonly resides in source-specific graphs, temporal snapshots, or local observations, existing graph reasoning benchmarks remain confined to a single self-contained structure, assessing only graph perception and reasoning while leaving the alignment and composition of evidence across views underexplored. MVGraph comprises 8k instances spanning 8 \textit{graph-theoretic} tasks, abstracted from two multi-graph scenarios (partial and temporal graph views). Each problem is programmatically constructed and verified to be unsolvable from a single view. Beyond end-to-end evaluation, we decompose multi-graph reasoning into four complementary capabilities---Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning---and design 29 diagnostic tasks with 64k instances to probe each one, along with golden intermediate representations for evaluating the intermediate process. Across 15 LVLMs, we reveal the difficulty of multi-graph reasoning and identify cross-view edge alignment and relation-level composition as prominent bottlenecks through stage-oriented diagnostics. Meanwhile, temporal constraints and increasing view counts expose further capability boundaries. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AAAndy-Zhu/MVGraph.

AI.tldr: MVGraph是面向大视觉语言模型的多元图推理基准，含8k端到端实例和64k诊断实例，揭示跨视图边对齐与关系级组合是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有图推理基准局限于单一自洽结构，仅评估图感知与推理，未探索多视图间证据的对齐与组合，而现实中查询所需证据常分布于来源特定的图、时间快照或局部观测中。
AI.method: 构建MVGraph基准，含8k实例、8个图论任务，抽象自部分视图和时间视图两类多图场景；每个问题程序化生成并验证单视图不可解。将多图推理分解为感知、对齐、组合、推理四项能力，设计29个诊断任务共64k实例，并提供黄金中间表示以评估中间过程。
AI.result: 在15个LVLM上评估，揭示多图推理的难度，并通过阶段导向诊断定位跨视图边对齐和关系级组合为主要瓶颈；时间约束和视图数量增加进一步暴露能力边界。
AI.conclusion: MVGraph填补了多视图图推理评估的空白，提供端到端与诊断性双重评估体系，为LVLM多图推理能力的细粒度分析奠定基础。

title: Static Gradient Attribution Underperforms a Density-Matched Random Mask on Loss-Based Forgetting Within LoRA B-Matrix
summary: Parameter-efficient continual learning updates a restricted subset of adapter parameters to incorporate sequential tasks while limiting catastrophic forgetting. Gradient attribution is a common rule for selecting that subset, but it requires an additional backward pass over calibration data. We identify a parameter-pool confound in comparisons between initialization-time gradient masks and unrestricted random masks under standard zero-initialized LoRA ($B=0$): the gradient with respect to $A$ is identically zero ($\partial\mathcal{L}/\partial A=0$), so gradient masks select strictly from the $B$ matrix whereas unrestricted random masks draw from both $A$ and $B$. Such a comparison changes both the selection rule and the candidate parameter pool. Isolating the selection criterion by restricting both approaches to the same parameter pool, we find a negative result: a uniform random mask consistently achieves lower loss-based backward transfer than gradient attribution across seven seeds on Qwen2.5-3B. The effect is concentrated on the medical task, which contributes 80\% of the aggregate; code and math move in the same direction, and legal shows no reliable difference. This advantage is consistent with a stability--plasticity trade-off under the tested task sequence, in which random masking slightly reduces single-task fitting. On the two discrete-option tasks (Medical and Legal), the mean accuracy-BWT difference is not statistically distinguishable from zero.

AI.tldr: 该文指出零初始化LoRA下梯度掩码与随机掩码的比较存在参数池混淆（∂L/∂A=0，梯度掩码仅从B中选，随机掩码从A、B中选）；在统一参数池后，随机掩码的基于损失的BWT反而低于梯度归因，效应集中于医学任务。
AI.motivation: 参数高效持续学习常用梯度归因选择可更新参数子集，但需对校准数据额外反向传播。作者同时质疑已有比较中梯度掩码与随机掩码的公平性，希望厘清选择准则本身的作用。
AI.method: 识别零初始化LoRA（B=0）下A的梯度恒为零所导致的"参数池混淆"，将梯度掩码与均匀随机掩码限制在同一参数池内以隔离选择准则；在Qwen2.5-3B上以七个随机种子进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在统一参数池下出现负结果：均匀随机掩码的基于损失的向后迁移（BWT）一致低于梯度归因。效应集中于医学任务（占聚合的80%），代码与数学方向一致，法律任务无可靠差异；在两个离散选项任务（医学、法律）上，平均准确率-BWT差异与零无统计区分。该优势与稳定性—可塑性权衡一致，随机掩码略微降低单任务拟合。
AI.conclusion: 先前梯度掩码优于随机掩码的结论部分源于参数池混淆这一混杂因素；在控制参数池后，随机掩码在BWT上反而更优但伴随单任务拟合下降，且任务间差异不均，提示需谨慎解释掩码选择准则的收益。

title: CliQ-RRG: Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology reports are essential for diagnostic reasoning and patient care, yet their manual preparation is time-consuming and cognitively demanding. Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) offers a scalable alternative, but existing models often produce lengthy, unstructured narratives that overlook diagnostic cues and multi-view information. We present Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation (CliQ-RRG), a unified two-stage framework for interpretable and clinically grounded reporting. In Stage 1, CliQ-RRG employs a Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment module that aligns image and text representations using predicted disease embeddings, reinforced by a Prior-Guided Attention Module (PrAM) to capture multi-view dependencies across current and prior scans. In Stage 2, GraphRAG-guided retrieval augments intermediate textual representations with graph-grounded clinical evidence, and a large language model restructures them into concise, interpretable question-answer (QA) pairs with diagnostic summaries. Experiments on two public chest X-ray benchmarks demonstrate that CliQ-RRG consistently outperforms prior methods across both lexical and clinical metrics, generating accurate and clinically coherent QA-style radiology reports. Code is available at: https://github.com/chandravardhan-singh-raghaw/CliQ-RRG.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架CliQ-RRG，结合疾病感知视觉-文本对齐、先验引导注意力与GraphRAG检索，用LLM生成QA式放射报告，在两个公开胸部X光基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 放射报告撰写耗时且认知负荷高；现有自动放射报告生成（RRG）模型常生成冗长、无结构的叙述，忽视诊断线索与多视角信息，缺乏可解释性与临床依据。
AI.method: 两阶段统一框架：阶段1的Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment模块利用预测的疾病嵌入对齐图像与文本表示，并由Prior-Guided Attention Module（PrAM）捕获当前与既往扫描的多视角依赖；阶段2用GraphRAG引导检索，以图结构化的临床证据增强中间文本表示，再由大语言模型重构为简洁可解释的问答对及诊断摘要。
AI.result: 在两个公开胸部X光基准上，CliQ-RRG在词汇指标与临床指标上均持续优于既有方法，生成准确且临床连贯的QA式放射报告。
AI.conclusion: 疾病感知对齐、先验引导多视角建模与图检索增强相结合，可提升RRG的临床相关性与可解释性；代码已开源。

title: Provenance-Aware Belief Updating in Human-AI Feedback Loops
comment: Accepted Oral at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Dynamic Alignment in Human-AI Coupled Systems
summary: In repeated human-AI interaction, a single observation can be quoted, summarized, and returned to a model as multiple reports, making repetition look like independent corroboration. We study whether language models can use supplied report lineage to update according to evidence provenance rather than report count. We introduce Latent Quotient Evidence Training (LQET), a relational objective that combines sparse Bayesian supervision with constraints that encourage stable predictions when reports add no new evidence and consistent updates to the same new evidence across relay histories. On a controlled binary benchmark, LQET reduces new-evidence update RMSE by 41-44% and log-odds drift after eight relay steps by 89-91% relative to task-only training across Qwen3-4B and Phi-4-mini, with three paired training seeds per backbone. The gains extend to a closed-loop simulation in which model confidence controls how many relayed reports re-enter the model's context in later rounds. By grounding belief updates in supplied provenance, LQET offers a route toward dynamic human-AI systems in which influence follows new evidence, not the number of times the same evidence returns.

AI.tldr: 论文提出潜在商数证据训练（LQET），利用报告血缘关系让语言模型按证据来源而非报告数量更新信念，在多跳传播场景下显著降低更新误差与信念漂移。
AI.motivation: 在重复的人机交互中，同一条观察可能被引用、摘要并作为多条报告返回给模型，使重复被误判为独立佐证。论文研究语言模型能否利用所提供的报告血缘（provenance）按证据来源而非报告数量来更新信念。
AI.method: 提出LQET（Latent Quotient Evidence Training），一种关系型目标函数：结合稀疏贝叶斯监督，并施加两类约束——当报告不带来新证据时保持预测稳定，以及在跨中继历史中对同一新证据给出一致更新。
AI.result: 在受控二元基准上，相对于仅任务训练，LQET将新证据更新RMSE降低41–44%，八步中继后对数几率漂移降低89–91%（Qwen3-4B与Phi-4-mini，每个主干三个配对训练种子）。增益还可推广到闭环模拟：模型置信度决定后续轮次有多少中继报告重新进入上下文。
AI.conclusion: 通过将信念更新锚定在所提供的证据来源上，LQET为动态人机系统提供了一条路径，使影响力取决于新证据而非同一证据重复出现的次数。

title: MotionCoach: Constructing Multimodal Guidance for Video Professional Motion Editing
summary: Video editing models achieve strong performance in modifying appearance, backgrounds, styles, and motions, empowered by large-scale training data. Beyond general scenarios, professional motions are significant in performance, sports, and martial arts. This paper focuses on professional motion editing, which involves fine-grained motion technique and temporal structure. Given professional motion names but lacking detailed descriptions, existing models often fail to generate professional motions, such as incorrectly lifting the front wheel under a Stoppie instruction. To address this challenge, we introduce MotionCoach, a trained multimodal agent that uses multi-turn tools and performs self-verification, producing a grounded prompt and a reference clip as reliable and sufficient multimodal guidance to inject external professional motion knowledge into video editing models. To supply training data, we build a data pipeline to construct trajectories. We cold-start the agent on MotionCoach-SFT-10k and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on MotionCoach-RL-2k with rewards on the motion guidance prompt, the motion outcome video, and the format. For evaluation, we introduce VPMEBench, comprising 314 professional motion editing tasks with fine-grained references and annotations. Extensive experiments show that MotionCoach improves the overall score from 55.1 to 65.6 on Seedance 2.0 and from 51.2 to 64.5 on MiniMax-H3. Learning to construct multimodal guidance enables precise professional motion editing without retraining video editing models.

AI.tldr: MotionCoach：一个多模态智能体，通过多轮工具调用与自验证生成"文本提示+参考片段"的多模态引导，将外部专业动作知识注入视频编辑模型，无需重训模型即可实现细粒度专业动作编辑，并提出VPMEBench评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑模型在外观、背景、风格、运动修改上表现优异，但在专业动作（表演、体育、武术）编辑上存在明显短板：用户通常只给出专业动作名称而缺乏细粒度描述，模型无法理解其技术细节与时间结构，导致如Stoppie指令下错误抬前轮等失败。核心难点在于缺少将专业动作知识转化为可靠引导的方式。
AI.method: 提出MotionCoach——一个训练而成的多模态智能体，使用多轮工具调用并进行自验证，输出"有依据的提示（grounded prompt）+参考片段（reference clip）"作为充分且可靠的多模态引导，将外部专业动作知识注入视频编辑模型。数据方面构建了轨迹构造流水线；训练上先用MotionCoach-SFT-10k进行冷启动，再在MotionCoach-RL-2k上应用GRPO，奖励分别来自引导提示、动作结果视频与格式三个方面。
AI.result: 在Seedance 2.0上整体分数由55.1提升至65.6，在MiniMax-H3上由51.2提升至64.5（测试于新提出的VPMEBench，含314个专业动作编辑任务，配细粒度参考与标注）。
AI.conclusion: 学会构建多模态引导即可实现精确的专业动作编辑，且无需重新训练视频编辑模型；多轮工具调用+自验证的智能体范式与多奖励GRPO训练是有效路径，VPMEBench为该方向提供可评测基准。

title: NV-Tesseract-AD: Curriculum-Enhanced Conditional Diffusion for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: We propose NV-Tesseract-AD, a curriculum learning-enhanced conditional diffusion framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Our central hypothesis is that reconstruction difficulty can be explicitly structured along two complementary axes, masking severity and diffusion noise level, and that training from easier to harder tasks along both axes simultaneously stabilizes optimization and improves residual discriminability. We integrate a Transformer-based diffusion backbone with a three-stage dual curriculum over masking ratios and diffusion timesteps, retaining anomalous samples throughout training and relying on structured corruption to drive self-supervised representation learning. We evaluate NV-Tesseract-AD under two regimes: in-distribution training on the TSB-UAD-M corpus and strict zero-shot transfer to ten EasyTSAD benchmark families without per-dataset tuning. The dual-axis curriculum produces masking-invariant reconstruction, confirmed by a near-zero loss gap between complementary masking strategies within the first training stage, and yields an approximately 3.7-fold improvement in F1 and a 56 percent reduction in MSE relative to a non-curriculum baseline. Zero-shot performance reaches F1 = 0.984 on NAB and F1 = 0.948 on NormA. Weaker results on heterogeneous families are traced to unsupervised threshold calibration rather than reconstruction quality, identifying calibration as the dominant remaining detection bottleneck. Accelerated inference via DPM-Solver++ reduces sampling cost by a factor of 3.5 to 5.7 at the dataset level but couples to thresholding behavior, establishing that the sampler and threshold must be validated jointly. Together, these findings demonstrate that aligning diffusion denoising difficulty with curriculum learning principles provides a principled and practical approach for robust anomaly detection in complex multivariate time series.

AI.tldr: 提出NV-Tesseract-AD，一种课程学习增强的条件扩散多元时间序列异常检测框架，沿掩码强度与扩散噪声双轴构建三阶段课程，在TSB-UAD-M分布内与EasyTSAD零样本迁移上均验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列异常检测中，重构难度缺乏显式结构化设计，训练不稳定且异常残差判别性不足；同时零样本跨域检测与推理效率问题尚待系统验证。
AI.method: 核心假设为重构难度可沿两条互补轴显式结构化：掩码严重度与扩散噪声水平。以Transformer扩散骨干为基础，构建掩码比率与扩散时间步的三阶段双课程，全程保留异常样本，依靠结构化破坏驱动自监督表示学习。评估包含两个场景：TSB-UAD-M语料上的分布内训练，以及无需逐数据集调优、严格零样本迁移至十个EasyTSAD基准族。
AI.result: 双轴课程实现掩码不变重构，首阶段互补掩码策略间损失差近乎为零；相较无课程基线F1提升约3.7倍、MSE降低56%。零样本达NAB F1=0.984、NormA F1=0.948。异质族表现较弱源于无监督阈值校准而非重构质量。DPM-Solver++加速推理使数据集级采样成本降低3.5–5.7倍，但与阈值行为耦合。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散去噪难度与课程学习原则对齐，为复杂多元时间序列的鲁棒异常检测提供了有原则且实用的方法；阈值校准是剩余的主导瓶颈，采样器与阈值须联合验证。

title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
summary: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3.3%, resulting in lower TTFT. Even with 1 TB of cache capacity, prefix caching reaches only a 17.9% hit rate in this workload. Source code is available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose.

AI.tldr: KV-Repurpose 是一个基于 vLLM 的开源系统，用于在精确前缀之外实现分段级 KV-cache 复用，在 Zipfian RAG 负载下将 token 级命中率从 3.3% 提升至 63.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务中的 KV-cache 复用通常局限于精确的 prompt 前缀，当同一检索文档出现在不同的系统提示、对话历史或动态元数据之后时无法复用，导致缓存命中率低、TTFT 高。
AI.method: 提出 KV-Repurpose 系统，基于 vLLM 实现，包含缓存感知的分段调度、prompt 构建、容量管理、工作负载生成与运行时监控，用于开发和评估超越精确前缀的分段级 KV-cache 复用。
AI.result: 在长上下文基准上，朴素分段复用在单文档问答和摘要任务中基本保持输出质量，但在跨文档推理中表现明显不足。在 20% 请求共享固定前缀的 Zipfian RAG 负载下，30 GB 缓存容量时 token 级命中率达 63.9%，显著高于前缀缓存的 3.3%，TTFT 更低；即使缓存容量扩大到 1 TB，前缀缓存命中率也仅 17.9%。
AI.conclusion: 分段级 KV-cache 复用可显著提升非精确前缀场景下的缓存命中率并降低 TTFT，但当前朴素方案在跨文档推理任务上仍存在局限，代码以 Apache-2.0 许可开源。

title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
summary: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EmbodiedCLBench，是首个在具身仿真环境中评估自演化智能体持续学习能力的基准，以组合泛化为核心评估原则，通过大量实验揭示了当前智能体在具身持续学习上的局限与行为特征。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习研究大多局限于非具身环境，尚未扩展到具身场景，而具身环境中智能体的持续学习与技能迁移能力缺乏系统性评估手段，因此需要构建专门的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建EmbodiedCLBench具身仿真基准，以组合泛化为核心评估原则，要求智能体先从基础任务中学习，再重组已获得技能以解决复杂且未见过的高级任务；基于该基准，对多种智能体框架（agent harnesses）与学习方法进行大量实验。
AI.result: 零样本设置下高级任务几乎无法解决，但基础任务经验能带来一致的性能提升；该收益在任务复杂度增加时仍保持稳定；然而提升并不随学习样本数量增加而相应扩大，当前智能体无法从额外经验中提取有意义信息。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习是具身智能体中基础但尚未被充分探索的能力；EmbodiedCLBench为设计具身环境中有效的自演化智能体提供了有价值的数据与基准资源。

title: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
summary: Visual representations are largely developed for understanding, yet what makes them useful for generation remains unclear. We study this question in pixel diffusion transformers and uncover two key insights. First, better representation quality does not necessarily translate into greater generative utility, as externally aligned semantics can be progressively lost during pixel synthesis. Second, architectural separation with specialized pixel decoders mainly redistributes semantic and spatial modeling, without necessarily yielding representations better suited to generation. These insights suggest that a useful generative representation must be both properly formed and actively exploited. Motivated by these insights, we introduce Representation Guidance (RG), which directly forms and exploits internal representations while retaining a plain Transformer architecture. A low-dimensional bottleneck forces generation-relevant information into a compact representation, which is then explicitly used to guide decoder generation by modifying the flow-matching target according to its induced prediction offset. RG learns clearer semantic and spatial structure while scaling efficiently in both parameters and computation. On ImageNet 256x256, RG-L/16 with only 459M parameters outperforms substantially larger pixel diffusion transformers, while RG-XL/16 achieves an FID of 1.55. RG further reaches an FID of 1.74 at 512x512 and extends to text-to-image generation, achieving 0.89 on GenEval and 87.1 on DPG-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究像素扩散Transformer中"什么样的视觉表征对生成有用"，发现表征质量高不等于生成效用高，并提出 Representation Guidance（RG）方法，通过低维瓶颈与显式引导提升生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉表征多面向"理解"任务设计，其对"生成"是否有用尚不明确。作者希望厘清表征质量与生成效用之间的关系，并找到真正适合生成任务的表征构建方式。
AI.method: 作者在像素扩散Transformer上展开研究，得到两点洞见：一是外部对齐的语义信息在像素合成过程中会逐步丢失，表征质量高并不必然带来更高生成效用；二是采用专用像素解码器的架构分离主要只是重新分配语义与空间建模，未必产生更适合生成的表征。基于此提出 Representation Guidance（RG）：保留朴素Transformer架构，用低维瓶颈将生成相关信息压缩为紧凑表征，并依据该表征诱导的预测偏移修改flow-matching目标，从而显式引导解码器生成。
AI.result: RG能够学习到更清晰的语义与空间结构，并在参数量和计算量上高效扩展。在ImageNet 256×256上，仅459M参数的RG-L/16即超越体量更大的像素扩散Transformer，RG-XL/16取得1.55的FID；在512×512下FID达1.74；并扩展到文本到图像生成，在GenEval上取得0.89、在DPG-Bench上取得87.1。
AI.conclusion: 有用的生成表征必须同时被"恰当形成"与"主动利用"，RG通过在朴素架构中以低维瓶颈形成内部表征并显式用于引导生成，验证了这一思路的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
comment: perovskite solar cells, provenance-grouped protocol, state of art, benchmark
summary: Machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells are typically evaluated using random data splits, which we show systematically leak information through massive internal duplication. Because nearly two-thirds of curated devices share their exact recipe with another, random splits primarily reward the mere recall of historical data rather than testing true physical generalisation. To solve this, we mapped the institutional provenance of the Perovskite Database and established a rigorous hierarchy of grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications, and institutions. Benchmarking thirteen models establishes new state-of-the-art performance across all splits and reveals a critical regime shift: while tree ensembles dominate random splits by recognising familiar recipes, their ranking collapses on genuinely unseen institutions and future discoveries, where composition-aware neural architectures excel. Furthermore, feature importance demonstrates that the device architecture and fabrication methodology dictate final efficiency just as strongly as the absorber chemistry. This standardised protocol empowers the community to separate memorisation from true physical discovery.

AI.tldr: 该文指出钙钛矿太阳能电池机器学习模型常用随机划分数据，会通过大量内部重复样本泄漏信息，因此提出基于机构来源的分组划分协议，并重新基准测试十三种模型。
AI.motivation: 现有钙钛矿太阳能电池机器学习评估多用随机数据划分，但近三分之二器件与另一器件共享完全相同配方，导致随机划分主要奖励对历史数据的记忆，而非检验真实物理泛化能力。
AI.method: 作者梳理Perovskite Database的机构来源，建立严格的分组划分层级，逐步隔离重复器件、出版物和机构；并在所有划分上对十三种模型进行基准测试，同时分析特征重要性。
AI.result: 基准测试在各类划分上建立新的最优性能，并揭示关键机制转变：树集成模型在随机划分中因识别熟悉配方占优，但在真正未见机构和未来发现上排名崩塌，组成感知神经网络架构表现突出。特征重要性显示器件结构和制备方法与吸收层化学对最终效率的影响同样强。
AI.conclusion: 该标准化协议有助于区分记忆与真实物理发现，为钙钛矿太阳能电池机器学习评估提供更严格的泛化测试框架。

title: From 2.1M Hours of Raw Broadcast Audio to Finnish Speech SSL: Confidence Filtering and Architectural Analysis at Scale
summary: Broadcast archives offer scale and diversity for self-supervised learning (SSL) but contain substantial noisy, non-speech, and multilingual content. Prior work typically relies on voice activity detection or language identification (LID) to extract speech, ensuring presence rather than quality. Whether and how to filter unlabeled speech by quality for SSL, particularly from noisy broadcasts, remains underexplored. We present a large-scale Finnish SSL study starting from 2.1M hours of unconstrained broadcast audio. We propose automatic speech recognition (ASR) confidence as a proxy for pretraining data quality and show 3-7% relative WER improvements over LID-based filtering despite a smaller training set. We further address the lack of controlled architectural comparisons in speech SSL by evaluating Transformer, Macaron-Net, Conformer, and E-Branchformer at matched parameter budgets. Our models improve upon prior Finnish SSL baselines, particularly at Base scale and out-of-domain.

AI.tldr: 本文基于210万小时芬兰语广播音频开展大规模自监督学习研究，提出以ASR置信度作为预训练数据质量的代理指标，并系统比较四种架构。
AI.motivation: 广播档案虽规模大、多样性高，但含大量噪声、非语音及多语言内容；以往工作多依赖VAD或LID仅保证"是语音"，而非"高质量语音"。如何按质量过滤无标注语音用于SSL，尤其针对噪声广播，尚无充分探索。
AI.method: 从210万小时无约束广播音频出发，提出用ASR置信度作为预训练数据质量的代理进行过滤；并在参数量匹配条件下对Transformer、Macaron-Net、Conformer和E-Branchformer进行受控架构对比。
AI.result: ASR置信度过滤相比基于LID的过滤，在训练集更小的情况下取得3-7%的相对WER改进；模型在Base规模及域外场景下优于既有芬兰语SSL基线。
AI.conclusion: ASR置信度是噪声广播SSL数据筛选的有效质量代理，且受控架构比较为语音SSL设计提供了参考；所提模型提升了芬兰语SSL基线表现。

title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ReTRAIL 框架，允许 LLM 智能体在长时程任务中回退环境状态但保留并复用已有探索经验，通过双信号策略训练实现从死胡同轨迹中恢复。
AI.motivation: 长时程环境中早期错误会引发级联失败并将智能体困于死胡同轨迹，因此智能体需要主动从这些状态恢复，并将探索经验转化为后续决策的指导。仅添加回退原语效果有限甚至有害，说明单纯环境回退不足以解决问题，需与经验复用相结合。
AI.method: ReTRAIL 使智能体将环境回退到较早状态，同时保留有效进展并延续从被放弃探索中学到的知识，即环境状态后退而智能体知识前进。框架训练一个共享策略，使用两个互补信号：State-Anchored GRPO 从重访状态比较替代性延续以改进执行；分支推进奖励（branch-advancement reward）通过后续探索的进展引导反思。
AI.result: 在四个交互式基准 MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上的实验表明，仅添加回退原语收益有限，甚至可能降低性能；而 ReTRAIL 能让智能体从低产状态回退，并利用被放弃分支的洞见指导后续探索。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明，在长时程任务求解中，将环境回退与任务内经验复用耦合具有重要价值。代码已开源于 https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL。

title: The Evidence Anchoring Boundary: Where Visual Interventions Matter and When They Help in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual interventions provide a training-free way to reduce hallucinations in multimodal large language models. However, an intervention may have little leverage at some layers and may damage a correct answer even when it changes the output. We investigate where visual interventions retain leverage and when they improve predictions. First, we apply the same visual-residual edit at successive decoder layers, matching its RMS strength across depth. Across six checkpoints from three model families, we observe a persistent drop in intervention effect and define its operational onset for this edit as the \textbf{Evidence Anchoring Boundary (EAB)}. With boundaries fixed on calibration queries, held-out effects on disjoint evaluation queries before EAB are $13.78\times$--$26.10\times$ larger than those after it. Comparison with intermediate readouts shows that the edit can lose leverage before answer preferences stabilize. Second, we compare counterfactual subtraction across presence, attribute, and relation questions. Subtraction can correct a misleading preference, leave a decision unchanged, or remove a preference supporting the correct answer. Based on these observations, we develop calibrated selective routing, which preserves the original prediction unless calibration supports an intervention for the question type. It improves full-set attribute accuracy by $1.56$--$1.81$ percentage points across three checkpoints, while universal subtraction is neutral or harmful.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多模态大模型视觉干预的有效性问题，提出Evidence Anchoring Boundary（EAB）刻画干预效应随解码层深度的衰减，并据此设计校准式选择性路由（calibrated selective routing），仅对校准支持的题型施加干预。
AI.motivation: 视觉干预是无训练缓解多模态大模型幻觉的手段，但干预在部分层可能失去作用杠杆，且即使改变输出也可能破坏原本正确的答案。因此需要明确干预在何处仍具影响力、以及何时能真正改进预测。
AI.method: 在连续解码层施加相同的视觉残差编辑，并在深度上匹配其RMS强度，跨3个模型家族、6个检查点观测干预效应；用中间读出（intermediate readouts）对比以判断杠杆损失与答案偏好稳定的先后关系。随后在存在、属性、关系三类问题上比较反事实减法（counterfactual subtraction）的效果，并据此提出校准式选择性路由。
AI.result: 跨6个检查点观察到干预效应持续下降，定义其操作性起点为EAB；在校准查询上固定边界后，EAB之前对不相交评估查询的留出效应比之后大13.78–26.10倍。编辑可在答案偏好稳定前就失去杠杆。全集合属性准确率提升1.56–1.81个百分点（3个检查点），而通用减法为中性或有害。
AI.conclusion: 视觉干预的收益高度依赖层级与问题类型；以校准为依据的选择性路由优于无条件减法，为无训练缓解多模态幻觉提供了更可靠的干预策略。

title: REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Copyright 2026 Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL). Licensed under CC BY 4.0
summary: Unlearning in large reasoning models (LRMs) requires removing forget-set information from both the reasoning trace and the final answer. Existing approaches achieve this objective at the cost of reasoning collapse, where the model fails to produce a coherent chain-of-thought (CoT) and does not properly terminate its reasoning process. To address this challenge, we propose REDaCT (REgenerate via Detection and Corrective Tuning), an inference-time unlearning framework for LRMs. REDaCT consists of two key components: (1) a binary leak detector that identifies sentences in the reasoning trace that leak forget-set information, and (2) an embedding optimization module that learns a corrective embedding offline, such that when injected at the first detected leak during inference, it guides subsequent reasoning towards sentences that do not leak forget-set information. Experimental results show that REDaCT completely avoids reasoning collapse, substantially improving reasoning preservation compared to state-of-the-art unlearning methods while maintaining perfect answer forgetting and near-perfect CoT forgetting. Our code is available at: https://github.com/jmaccoby/redact.

AI.tldr: REDaCT：一种面向大型推理模型的推理时遗忘框架，通过泄漏检测与纠正嵌入优化，在保持答案遗忘与思维链遗忘的同时避免推理崩溃。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型的遗忘需要同时从推理轨迹和最终答案中移除遗忘集信息，但现有方法以推理崩溃为代价，模型无法生成连贯的思维链且不能正确终止推理过程。因此需要一种能兼顾遗忘效果与推理能力保持的方法。
AI.method: REDaCT 包含两个关键组件：（1）二元泄漏检测器，用于识别推理轨迹中泄漏遗忘集信息的句子；（2）嵌入优化模块，离线学习一个纠正嵌入，在推理时于首个检测到的泄漏处注入，引导后续推理转向不泄漏遗忘集信息的句子。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，REDaCT 完全避免了推理崩溃，相比最先进的遗忘方法大幅提升了推理保持能力，同时保持完美的答案遗忘和近乎完美的思维链遗忘。
AI.conclusion: REDaCT 通过推理时的检测与纠正机制，有效解决了推理模型遗忘中的推理崩溃问题，在遗忘与推理能力保持之间取得了更优平衡。

title: BenCoDiC: A Large-Scale Contextual Cyberbullying Corpus for Bengali Political News Discourse FULL VERSION
summary: Cyberbullying is a growing concern in online communities, yet existing Bengali corpora remain limited in contextual information, annotation transparency, scale, accessibility, and support for multidimensional analysis, thereby hindering robust detection and comprehensive study of harasser behaviors and networks. To address these gaps, we introduce the Bengali Contextual and Diverse Cyberbullying (\textit{BenCoDiC}) corpus, a publicly available contextual cyberbullying resource for Bengali political news discourse comprising 50,250 textual instances collected from 100 YouTube videos and their associated discussions. The corpus preserves caption--comment--reply relationships and is organized through a nine-dimensional star schema covering users, videos, textual content, context, time, engagement, political parties, target identities, and language categories. Five AI chatbots were initially evaluated for annotation but did not meet the predefined reliability criterion. Consequently, a two-tier human annotation process with expert verification was adopted, achieving Fleiss' $κ=0.86$ and Krippendorff's $α=0.86$. Statistical analyses characterize the corpus, while transformer-based experiments show that incorporating conversational context yields modest but consistent improvements over isolated-text classification. \textit{BenCoDiC} supports context-aware cyberbullying detection and perpetrator-oriented behavioral and network analysis. The corpus is available at https://github.com/bencodic/BenCoDiC-Corpus.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了面向孟加拉语政治新闻话语的上下文网络欺凌语料库BenCoDiC（50,250条），采用九维星型模式保留对话结构，经两阶段人工标注（Fleiss κ=0.86，Krippendorff α=0.86），并验证了引入对话上下文对检测性能的稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有孟加拉语网络欺凌语料库在上下文信息、标注透明度、规模、可获取性及多维分析支持方面存在不足，限制了对欺凌行为与网络的稳健检测和系统研究。
AI.method: 从100个YouTube视频及其讨论中采集50,250条文本实例，保留字幕—评论—回复关系，并以九维星型模式组织（用户、视频、文本内容、上下文、时间、互动、政党、目标身份、语言类别）。先用五个AI聊天机器人试标注，未达可靠性标准，改采两阶段人工标注加专家核验。开展统计分析，并进行基于Transformer的上下文与孤立文本分类对比实验。
