comment: Accepted in IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing. 18 pages, 9 figures, plus 5 pages of supplementary material
summary: Softmax-based multimodal emotion recognition methods often assign high confidence even when sensor data are corrupted or contradictory, for example when facial expressions suggest positive valence while vocal prosody indicates negative arousal. We present an Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion (EMT-DS) that addresses this problem through formal uncertainty quantification. EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. Under subject-independent and speaker-independent evaluation on four benchmarks, EMT-DS achieves 84.3% accuracy on IEMOCAP versus 81.7% for the best baseline (p < 0.01), 82.4% on DEAP under leave-one-subject-out evaluation versus 78.1%, and 96.8% on the highly imbalanced KEMDy20, and it improves accuracy on CMU-MOSEI by 2.4 points over the strongest evidential baseline. In controlled ablation, it reduces Expected Calibration Error from 0.153 (softmax transformer) to 0.042. It maintains 71.2% accuracy under severe Gaussian noise on audio features (sigma = 1.0), where attention baselines drop to 45.3%, and degrades gracefully when entire modalities are absent. The fusion step has O(MK^2) complexity, compared with O(M^2 d^2) for cross-modal attention. The learned conflict metric also flags likely errors: reviewing 20% of samples captures 80% of misclassifications, which supports selective prediction in clinical and safety-critical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出EMT-DS（证据多模态Transformer+DS融合），用主观意见量化认知/偶然不确定性，以Dempster组合规则显式量化模态冲突，在四个基准上显著超越基线并大幅改善校准与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 基于Softmax的多模态情感识别即使在传感器数据损坏或模态矛盾（如面部表情呈正向效价、语音韵律呈负向唤醒）时仍输出高置信度，缺乏形式化不确定性量化，易陷入无根据的共识预测。
AI.method: 将预测建模为主观意见（Dirichlet分布），分离认知不确定性（证据不足）与偶然不确定性（传感器噪声）；各模态专用Transformer编码器输出信念质量分布，用Dempster组合规则融合，以冲突系数1/(1-c)归一化联合信念质量，使矛盾证据被显式量化为冲突并产生分散的融合预测。融合复杂度O(MK²)，低于跨模态注意力的O(M²d²)。
AI.result: 主体/说话人独立评测：IEMOCAP 84.3% vs 最优基线81.7%（p<0.01）；DEAP留一被试82.4% vs 78.1%；KEMDy20（高度不平衡）96.8%；CMU-MOSEI较最强证据基线提升2.4个点。消融中ECE由0.153（softmax Transformer）降至0.042。音频特征严重高斯噪声（σ=1.0）下保持71.2%，注意力基线降至45.3%，整模态缺失时性能平缓退化。冲突度量可标记错误：审查20%样本可覆盖80%误分类。
AI.conclusion: EMT-DS通过形式化不确定性量化与冲突显式建模，在准确率、校准性、噪声鲁棒性与缺失模态容忍度上全面优于softmax与注意力基线，且冲突指标支持选择性预测，适用于临床与安全关键场景。

title: Measuring Artifact Reliance in Machine-Generated Text Detectors
comment: Accepted to DocInsights workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Detectors of machine-generated text score almost perfectly on scientific-literature benchmarks, implying we can reliably distinguish with these detectors human and machine-generated documents. We looked at ten scientific-document subsets from six popular resources, and on several of them that apparent ease is a side effect of how the documents were put together. A logistic regression using 27 superficial features reached 0.833-0.997 macro-F1, and on the three arXiv subsets it outperformed every detector we evaluate with F1-scores 0.951-0.997. The strongest cue to the detector is the PDF extraction artifact: human texts retain their original line breaks, whereas generated texts are extracted as a single block of prose. This cue, together with three other formatting features, tell the classes apart at 0.996 AUC. To distinguish benchmarks that contain such a signal from detectors that rely on one, we introduce format counterfactuals: just re-wrapping a machine-written abstract without changing a single word reverses 20-27% of a public detector's correct decisions. Normalizing formatting before training reduces the generalization gap from 0.32 to 0.22. On format-clean benchmarks, it also raises out-of-domain macro-F1 from 0.33 to 0.65 for detectors trained on artifact-containing subsets.

AI.tldr: 机器生成文本检测器在科学文献基准上近乎满分，但这种高表现很大程度上源于数据构造中的格式伪影（尤其是PDF抽取产生的换行差异），而非真正的文本生成特征。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器在科学文献基准上得分极高，给人以可可靠区分人写与机器生成文档的印象；作者怀疑这种"表面的容易"是文档拼装方式带来的副作用，即基准本身含有捷径信号。
AI.method: 考察六个常用资源中的十个科学文档子集；用27个浅层特征训练逻辑回归；分析PDF抽取伪影及格式特征；引入"格式反事实"（format counterfactuals），即在不改动任何词的前提下重新换行机器生成的摘要；并在训练前做格式归一化。
AI.result: 逻辑回归达到0.833–0.997 macro-F1，在三个arXiv子集上以0.951–0.997 F1超过所有评测检测器；PDF抽取伪影（人类文本保留原始换行、生成文本被抽成整块散文）加另外三个格式特征可达0.996 AUC；重新换行可逆转公开检测器20–27%的正确判定；格式归一化把泛化差距从0.32降至0.22，并把在含伪影子集上训练的检测器的域外macro-F1从0.33提升到0.65。
AI.conclusion: 科学文献基准中普遍存在格式伪影，检测器的高分部分是捷径所致；需通过格式反事实诊断与格式归一化处理，才能评估并提升检测器的真实泛化能力。

title: AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards
summary: The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts. Over long horizons, it requires recovery and coordination across extended action sequences. Demonstrations, task decomposition, and dense progress rewards have enabled research advances by providing guidance on how to assemble. But how much of the strategy must be specified? The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero showed that RL at scale can discover superhuman strategies without prescribing how to win. AlphaNIST asks whether a sparse binary task reward and task diversity admitted by this task-agnostic reward can similarly let a robot discover how to assemble. In simulation, we train a single policy from scratch across all 20 assembly tasks on the NIST Assembly Task Board #1, reaching 98.2% overall training success without demonstrations, progress shaping, scripted primitives, or per-task tuning. The framework also trains policies to complete ten assembly pairs in a single episode without a prescribed order, with task success rewarded only when all ten pairs are simultaneously complete. The learned policies discover dexterous and planning-like behaviors: choosing grasps for later assembly, using surrounding geometry to reorient parts, and preparing one part, assembling another, then returning to finish the first without an explicit planner. For videos, see our website: https://alpha-nist.github.io/

AI.tldr: AlphaNIST 探索仅用稀疏二值任务奖励与任务多样性，能否让机器人在无演示、无进度奖励、无脚本基元、无逐任务调参的情况下从零学会 NIST Assembly Task Board #1 的全部装配任务。
AI.motivation: NIST Assembly Task Board #1 是学习型机器人操作方法的挑战性基准：短期需精确、富接触地操作小型紧配合零件，长期需跨长动作序列的恢复与协调。既有进展多依赖演示、任务分解与稠密进度奖励，但这些本质上都在预先规定"如何装配"，因此值得追问：究竟多少策略必须被人工指定？受 AlphaGo 到 AlphaGo Zero 的启发，本文希望验证任务无关的稀疏奖励与任务多样性是否足以让机器人自行发现装配策略。
AI.method: 在仿真中采用稀疏二值任务奖励，跨 NIST Assembly Task Board #1 的全部 20 个装配任务，从零训练单一策略；不使用演示、进度塑形奖励、脚本化基元或逐任务调参。此外，还训练策略在单回合内完成十组装配对，不规定顺序，仅当十组全部同时完成时才给予任务成功奖励。
AI.result: 单一策略达到 98.2% 的整体训练成功率。学到的策略展现出灵巧操作与类规划行为：为后续装配选择合适的抓取、利用周围几何结构重新定向零件，以及先准备一个零件、装配另一个零件、再返回完成第一个零件，且无需显式规划器。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，稀疏二值奖励结合任务多样性可使机器人从零发现长时程装配策略，大部分"如何装配"的技艺并非必须人工指定，为任务无关的机器人装配学习提供了可行路径。

title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.

AI.tldr: CompactSplat：一种前馈框架，通过内容感知的高斯分配实现稀疏视图3D重建，在更少图元下取得更优几何与纹理效果。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图、无逐场景优化的3D重建仍具挑战，尤其在准确几何与精细纹理恢复上。现有前馈方法基于可泛化3DGS，通常为每像素分配一个或多个高斯，导致均匀分配：在均质区域浪费图元造成高度冗余，且未利用平面表面的几何先验，结构建模次优。
AI.method: 提出CompactSplat前馈框架，实现内容感知的3D高斯分配。结合纹理引导的空间划分与分层采样，自适应分布图元：在复杂区域集中密集高斯，在平坦区域以扩展的、尺度调制的高斯进行平铺。框架天然支持推理时动态稀疏度控制，无需重训练即可在渲染保真度与内存占用间权衡。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV和ScanNet上，CompactSplat在标准指标和高分辨率渲染一致性上均持续优于先前方法，以显著更少的图元实现高保真重建。
AI.conclusion: CompactSplat通过内容感知的高斯分配与动态稀疏控制，有效缓解冗余与结构建模不足问题，在稀疏视图3D重建中兼顾保真度与效率。

title: Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence
summary: Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Yet the dominant approach, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), relies on a geometrically degenerate clipping proxy that cannot adapt its resistance to policy shifts, leading to premature clipping and degraded exploration. Subsequent variants alleviate these issues through fragmented and heuristic modifications. We propose Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization (GPPO), a principled and unified framework for understanding and designing LLM RL algorithms through the lens of divergence. We establish a generalized $f$-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic performance improvement guarantee, and show that different $f$-divergences induce distinct geometries and policy update dynamics. We further introduce novel estimator topologies that provide more faithful divergence estimates than the conventional single-sample Monte Carlo estimation. Under this framework, PPO and recent variants such as DAPO, DPPO, and RIPO emerge as special cases, establishing a principled two-dimensional design space of {Divergence $\times$ Estimator}. Extensive experiments on eight competition-level math and coding benchmarks show that both dimensions are critical. The best-performing GPPO instantiation surpasses standard GRPO by up to 50% and 14% on math and coding, delivering SOTA performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出广义近端策略优化（GPPO），从散度视角统一理解与设计LLM强化学习算法，构建广义f散度信赖域理论与单调性能提升保证，并引入更精确的散度估计器拓扑，形成“散度×估计器”二维设计空间，在数学与代码基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理强化学习主流方法PPO依赖几何退化的裁剪代理，无法自适应调节对策略偏移的抵抗，导致过早裁剪与探索退化；后续变体多为碎片化、启发式修补，缺乏统一理论框架。
AI.method: 提出GPPO统一框架：建立广义f散度信赖域理论并给出单调性能提升保证，揭示不同f散度诱导的几何与策略更新动态；引入新的估计器拓扑，比传统单样本蒙特卡洛估计更忠实地估计散度；证明PPO及DAPO、DPPO、RIPO等为特例，形成{散度×估计器}二维设计空间。
AI.result: 在八个竞赛级数学与代码基准上验证两个设计维度均关键；最佳GPPO实例在数学与代码任务上分别较标准GRPO提升最高50%和14%，达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: GPPO为LLM强化学习算法提供了原则化、统一的理论与设计范式，将既有方法纳入同一框架，并通过散度与估计器的协同设计显著提升推理能力。

title: zip2zip++: Towards Inference-Time Token Compression with Minimal Quality Loss
summary: Dynamic vocabularies built on-the-fly via Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) compression let a language model represent the same text in fewer tokens, but prior work shows that this efficiency comes at a cost to reasoning and perplexity. We show that this quality gap is not a fundamental price of compression but can be substantially closed through targeted improvements to the compression layer and LZW codec, without modifying the underlying pretrained language model. Our analysis reveals four key issues: (1) LZW's compression algorithm creates an implicit conflict between the input embedding and the output embedding, a tension that a single shared embedding cannot resolve; (2) naively applying RoPE to LZW-compressed sequences ignores that merged tokens can span multiple tokens; (3) merging certain tokens (notably digits) disproportionately hurts downstream accuracy; and (4) dynamic vocabularies introduce an inherent segmentation ambiguity that confounds standard evaluation. We address these through decoupled input/output dynamic embedding layer, size-aware RoPE positioning, and a modified LZW codec supporting selective merges and multi-view segmentations. Across four models, our recipe improves perplexity on every corpus we evaluated as well as mathematical reasoning accuracy, closing roughly half the quality gap between zip2zip and the uncompressed baseline at a similar compression ratio on general text. This represents a significant step toward lossless adaptive-vocabulary compression for language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析动态词表（LZW压缩）带来的质量损失并非压缩的必然代价，通过改进压缩层与LZW编解码器，可在不改动预训练模型的前提下大幅缩小与未压缩基线的差距。
AI.motivation: 动态词表（基于LZW的on-the-fly压缩）能用更少token表示同样文本，但此前工作表明这种效率以推理能力下降和困惑度升高为代价。作者希望验证这一质量差距是否可通过针对性改进来弥补。
AI.method: 论文识别出四个关键问题：(1) LZW算法造成输入嵌入与输出嵌入之间的隐式冲突，共享嵌入难以解决；(2) 直接将RoPE应用于LZW压缩序列，忽略了合并token可能跨多个原始token；(3) 合并特定token（尤其数字）会不成比例地损害下游精度；(4) 动态词表引入固有的分词歧义，干扰标准评估。对应提出三项改进：解耦的输入/输出动态嵌入层、尺寸感知的RoPE定位（size-aware RoPE positioning）、支持选择性合并与多视图分词的改进LZW编解码器。
AI.result: 在四个模型上，该方案在所评估的每个语料上都改善了困惑度，并提升了数学推理准确率；在通用文本上以相近压缩比将zip2zip与未压缩基线之间的质量差距缩小了约一半。
AI.conclusion: 动态词表压缩带来的质量损失并非压缩的根本代价，通过改进压缩层与LZW编解码器可显著缩小差距，这是迈向语言模型无损自适应词表压缩的重要一步。

title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
summary: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. We introduce SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and its execution trajectory, the learned verifier predicts the completion label and generates a natural-language analysis that explains its judgment. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) and trains a series of 30B models on trajectories from CodeForge-Preview. On a held-out test set, SWE-Critix improves classification accuracy from 57% for the base Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning model to 66% after SFT and 78% after RL. We release our models, datasets, and training code to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SWE-Critix，一个通过后训练流水线（SFT+RL）训练代码智能体轨迹通用验证器的方案，能在无现成评估器时判断任务完成情况并生成自然语言分析，将分类准确率从基线的57%提升至66%（SFT）和78%（RL）。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体被越来越多地用于端到端软件工程任务，但往往缺乏定义成功标准的现成oracle评估器，因此需要能够可靠判断并解释智能体行为的验证机制。然而验证并不简单：智能体的执行轨迹可能极长，包含与代码仓库和外部工具的数百次迭代交互；现有验证器要么依赖未经专门训练的通用LLM，要么训练只输出标量奖励的专用critic，基于训练的通用验证器探索相对不足。
AI.method: 提出 SWE-Critix 后训练流水线，用于训练代码智能体轨迹的通用验证器。给定任务及其执行轨迹，验证器预测完成标签并生成解释性自然语言分析。流水线结合监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL），基于 CodeForge-Preview 的轨迹训练一系列30B规模模型。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上，SWE-Critix 将分类准确率从基础 Qwen3-30B-A3B 推理模型的57%提升至SFT后的66%以及RL后的78%。作者开源了模型、数据集和训练代码。
AI.conclusion: SWE-Critix 表明结合SFT与RL的后训练流水线可有效训练代码智能体轨迹的通用验证器，显著提升判断准确率并具备可解释性，为后续研究提供了模型、数据和代码支持。

title: High-Throughput Generative Video Super-Resolution on a Single Consumer GPU
summary:
Generative video super-resolution (VSR) can recover visually compelling high-frequency detail by leveraging diffusion priors, but iterative sampling and heavy spatio-temporal coupling make practical deployments difficult. We study a different operating point: practical HD generative VSR on a single high-end consumer GPU without end-to-end retraining. To this end, we present a zero-shot framework built entirely from pretrained components.
  The proposed system decouples spatial enhancement from temporal stabilization. A time-distilled one-step diffusion backbone handles spatial upscaling, while temporal coherence is promoted by a lightweight pretrained flow-based interpolator that synthesizes intermediate frames between super-resolved keyframes. To further improve scalability, we introduce a resolution-aware hybrid attention scheme that, in a zero-shot manner, replaces selected high-resolution global-attention layers with neighborhood attention while preserving global attention in semantically critical low-resolution layers, while also improving temporal consistency.
  Experiments show that the proposed framework reaches up to ~32 FPS at 720p resolution under interleaved inference on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090. At 4K, the proposed attention substitution can yield up to a 44% speedup over the original attention implementation. Across standard VSR benchmarks, the method consistently shifts the speed-quality trade-off decisively toward runtime efficiency, trading reconstruction fidelity for strong no-reference perceptual quality, while remaining reasonably competitive against generative approaches in temporal consistency. It also exposes clear limitations in handling more challenging motion, which a simple motion gate partially mitigates. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种零样本、免端到端重训练的实用高清生成式视频超分框架，由预训练组件解耦空间增强与时间稳定，单张RTX 4090上720p可达约32 FPS，4K注意力替换可提速44%。
AI.motivation: 生成式VSR借助扩散先验能恢复视觉上引人注目的高频细节，但迭代采样与沉重的时空耦合使其难以实际部署。作者希望探索一个新的工作点：在单张高端消费级GPU上实现实用的高清生成式VSR，且无需端到端重训练。
AI.method: 构建完全由预训练组件组成的零样本框架，解耦空间增强与时间稳定：用时间蒸馏的一步扩散骨干负责空间上采样；用轻量级预训练流式插帧器在超分关键帧之间合成中间帧以提升时间一致性。此外提出分辨率感知的混合注意力方案，以零样本方式将部分高分辨率全局注意力层替换为邻域注意力，在语义关键的低分辨率层保留全局注意力，同时改善时间一致性。
AI.result: 在单张NVIDIA RTX 4090上交错推理时，720p分辨率可达约32 FPS；4K下所提注意力替换相较原始注意力实现最高44%加速。在标准VSR基准上，该方法将速度—质量权衡显著推向运行时效率，以重建保真度换取较强的无参考感知质量，在时间一致性上与生成式方法相比仍具一定竞争力。同时暴露出在更复杂运动上的明显局限，简单的运动门控可部分缓解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过零样本组合预训练组件并解耦空间与时间处理、辅以分辨率感知注意力替换，可以在消费级单卡上实现高效的高清生成式VSR，但复杂运动场景仍是待改进的瓶颈。

title: Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. Yet long-horizon autoregressive rollouts introduce a fundamental limitation: local policy mismatch can compound into severe state distribution shift over trajectories. Existing LLM RL methods, such as GRPO and GSPO, control policy mismatch at the token or sequence level, but overlook this trajectory-induced shift, causing training instability and eventual collapse as the horizon grows. To close the state distribution gap, we propose Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a principled framework that theoretically derives the state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and incorporates it into the RL objective. TAPO further employs a geometric-mean estimator for variance reduction, together with a length-aware dynamic clipping that prevents overly deviated updates across the trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across eight competition-level benchmarks, achieving up to 48% and 12% improvement over GRPO on mathematical reasoning and algorithmic coding, with substantially enhanced training stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TAPO，一种从离策略策略梯度中理论上推导状态分布校正项的轨迹感知策略优化框架，配合几何平均估计器降方差与长度感知动态裁剪，显著提升 LLM 推理训练的稳定性与性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已成为增强 LLM 推理能力的主流范式，但长时程自回归 rollout 存在根本性缺陷：局部策略不匹配会在轨迹上累积为严重的状态分布偏移。现有方法（GRPO、GSPO）仅在 token 或序列层面控制策略不匹配，忽视了这种轨迹诱导的偏移，导致训练不稳定，并随时长增长最终崩溃。
AI.method: 提出 Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO)：从离策略策略梯度中理论推导出状态分布校正项，并将其纳入 RL 目标函数；采用几何平均估计器进行方差缩减；设计长度感知的动态裁剪，防止整条轨迹上出现过大的更新偏移。
AI.result: 在八个竞赛级基准上，TAPO 显著超越现有 LLM RL 算法：数学推理较 GRPO 提升最高 48%，算法编码提升最高 12%，同时训练稳定性大幅增强。
AI.conclusion: TAPO 通过显式校正轨迹引起的状态分布偏移，弥补了 token/序列级方法的不足，在多个竞赛级任务上取得领先性能并改善训练稳定性，为长时程 LLM 强化学习提供了更具理论依据的优化方案。

title: BLiMPPI: Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Polarity Items
summary: Negative polarity items (NPIs), such as "anymore" and "ever", are grammatical only in select environments, predominantly in the context of negation. Because their grammaticality depends on both syntax and semantics, they have a rich, multilingual literature in theoretical linguistics, yet work on NPIs in language models is almost entirely confined to English. We introduce BLiMPPI, a multilingual evaluation suite of over 12,000 NPI minimal pairs in 33 languages, built by a pipeline that discovers NPIs in Universal Dependencies (UD) treebanks, labels their licensing environments, and perturbs these into minimal pairs. Evaluating 12 multilingual and 2 monolingual models alongside n-gram baselines, we find that multilingual models struggle most with lower-resource languages and with pairs that are not n-gram solvable. We further examine the effects of NPI typology, language family, licensing variability, and NPI-licenser distance. Data: https://github.com/arzuburcuguven/blimppi-data

AI.tldr: 介绍 BLiMPPI：一个覆盖 33 种语言、超 12,000 个 NPI 最小对的多语言评测集，用于评估语言模型对否定极性项（NPIs）的句法-语义知识，并揭示多语言模型在低资源语言及非 n-gram 可解样本上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: NPI（如 "anymore"、"ever"）的合法性依赖句法与语义环境，主要以否定语境为准，在理论语言学中已有多语言研究，但语言模型对 NPI 的评测几乎局限于英语。为填补多语言评测空白，需构建跨语言的、基于最小对的可控评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 BLiMPPI 流水线：在 Universal Dependencies（UD）树库中发现 NPI，标注其允准（licensing）环境，并通过扰动生成最小对；共覆盖 33 种语言、12,000+ 个最小对。评测 12 个多语言模型与 2 个单语模型，并以 n-gram 基线作对照；分析 NPI 类型学、语系、允准变异性与 NPI-允准语距离等因素的影响。
AI.result: 多语言模型在低资源语言以及非 n-gram 可解的最小对上表现最差；NPI 类型学、语系、允准变异性和 NPI-允准语距离均对模型表现产生影响。
AI.conclusion: BLiMPPI 为多语言 NPI 知识提供可复现的评测资源，表明当前多语言模型对句法-语义约束的掌握仍不均衡，尤其在低资源语言和需超越局部 n-gram 线索的样本上存在明显短板；数据已公开。

title: RegulaTutor: A Theory-Informed Framework for Long-Term Personalized Learning
summary: Long-term personalized tutoring requires language models to translate a learner's evolving history into appropriate instructional support. Existing LLM-based tutoring systems use memory and retrieval to personalize responses, but the pedagogical rationale linking historical evidence to teaching strategies is not always explicit. We introduce RegulaTutor, a theory-informed framework for long-term personalized tutoring that connects historical evidence, learner interpretation, and learner-facing instruction. Guided by self-regulated learning (SRL) research, its tutoring harness operationalizes a cognitive, affective, metacognitive, and motivational (CAMM) framework for deriving evidence-supported learner interpretations and teaching policies. The resulting policies retain links to their supporting evidence and are updated as new observations arrive. This staged workflow also supports systematic refinement through PairRoute, an offline procedure that uses intermediate execution records to distinguish harness, model, and mixed failures. PairRoute proposes and evaluates targeted harness revisions, then constructs reviewed stage-level supervision for confirmed model failures remaining under the selected harness. We focus this refinement on historical evidence acquisition, which underpins personalized instruction and allows outputs to be checked against learning records and reference answers. RegulaTutor improves historical-evidence accuracy, learner diagnosis, and judged teaching quality on average across evaluated model configurations. PairRoute results show an endpoint improvement in standalone-model historical-evidence accuracy over the refinement trajectory. Together, these results highlight RegulaTutor's potential to support lifelong personalized education through instructional policies that evolve with learner histories and targeted improvements to the tutoring system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RegulaTutor，一个理论驱动的长期个性化辅导框架，将历史证据、学习者解读与面向学习者的教学指令显式连接，并配以离线优化流程PairRoute，在历史证据准确性、学习者诊断与教学质量上取得平均提升。
AI.motivation: 长期个性化辅导要求语言模型将学习者不断演进的历史转化为恰当的教学支持。现有基于LLM的辅导系统虽用记忆与检索实现个性化，但历史证据与教学策略之间的教学论依据往往不显式，缺乏可解释、可追溯的推理链条。
AI.method: 以自我调节学习（SRL）研究为指导，构建辅导harness，将认知、情感、元认知与动机（CAMM）框架操作化，用于推导有证据支持的学习者解读与教学策略；策略保留与其支持证据的链接，并随新观察更新。配套PairRoute离线流程，利用中间执行记录区分harness失败、模型失败与混合失败，提出并评估有针对性的harness修订，并为所选harness下仍存在的模型失败构建经审核的阶段级监督；优化重点放在历史证据获取环节。
AI.result: 在所评估的多种模型配置上，RegulaTutor平均提升了历史证据准确性、学习者诊断水平与教学质量的评判结果。PairRoute结果显示，在优化轨迹上，独立模型的历史证据准确性获得终态提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，RegulaTutor有望通过随学习者历史演进的教学策略与对辅导系统的针对性改进，支持终身个性化教育。

title: MixTok: Adaptive Visual Tokenization with Global 1D Tokens and Sparse 2D Refinement
summary: Efficient visual tokenization requires balancing representation compactness with the preservation of fine-grained image content. Conventional grid-based tokenizers allocate tokens uniformly across spatial locations despite non-uniform visual complexity, whereas compact 1D tokenizers aggregate global information but can struggle to preserve local details. We introduce MixTok, a hybrid visual tokenizer that combines a compact 1D global representation with sparse 2D tokens for local refinement. A content-adaptive router ranks candidate locations by refinement priority and determines the number of 2D tokens for each image under a target average token budget. At the highest-scoring locations, 2D token features replace the spatial features recovered from the 1D representation, and a shared decoder reconstructs the image from the resulting mixed features. On ImageNet 256 x 256, MixTok achieves highly competitive reconstruction and generation performance, with an rFID of 1.195 and a gFID of 1.95 at respective average budgets of approximately 128 and 131 content tokens per image.

AI.tldr: MixTok是一种混合视觉tokenizer，用紧凑的1D全局表示结合稀疏2D局部token，通过内容自适应路由器分配token，在ImageNet 256×256上以约128个token实现rFID 1.195、gFID 1.95。
AI.motivation: 传统网格型tokenizer均匀分配token，忽视视觉复杂度的空间非均匀性；而紧凑1D tokenizer虽能聚合全局信息，却难以保留局部细节。二者难以兼顾表示紧凑性与细粒度内容保留。
AI.method: 提出混合视觉tokenizer MixTok：1D全局表示+稀疏2D token局部精修。内容自适应路由器对候选位置按精修优先级排序，并在目标平均token预算下确定每张图像的2D token数量；在得分最高位置用2D token特征替换由1D表示恢复的空间特征，再由共享解码器从混合特征重建图像。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，MixTok在平均约128个内容token时rFID为1.195、约131个token时gFID为1.95，重建与生成性能均具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 混合1D全局与自适应稀疏2D的token化策略可在有限token预算下兼顾紧凑性与局部细节，重建与生成表现优异。

title: Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning
summary: Neural operators that learn physical laws from data should generalize beyond their training distribution and expose the learned law in closed form. The Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator achieves both for position-dependent dynamics by learning a dense pseudo-differential symbol over all positions and frequencies, at a cost that grows with the square of the resolution and with closed forms that must be read out by hand. This dense symbol is unnecessary: a finite-order variable-coefficient differential operator has a symbol whose separation rank is bounded by the number of its coefficient functions, independently of the resolution, and the symbols that this network learns on its own benchmarks have rank two. We introduce the Kolmogorov-Arnold flow (KAFlow), which learns the generator of a physical operator as a low-rank symbol built from univariate Kolmogorov-Arnold functions, fixes the gauge of these functions so that every term has a unique place, integrates the dynamics with exact exponential integrators, and distills its closed form automatically. On the synthetic benchmarks of the Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator, KAFlow lowers the out-of-distribution loss by 3.4 to 11 times and recovers every coefficient to within 10^-4 without symbolic templates, reaching the precision floor of the data. On long-horizon quantum dynamics, it lowers the state infidelity by up to 6 orders of magnitude, and by 30 times when trained only on position and momentum measurements. KAFlow also learns a variable-order fractional operator 15 times more accurately than existing operator networks and discovers nonlocal, fractional and non-polynomial dispersion relations on which sparse regression fails.

AI.tldr: KAFlow 将物理算子生成元表示为低秩符号，用单变量 Kolmogorov-Arnold 函数构建、固定规范、配指数积分器并自动蒸馏闭式表达式；在 OOD 泛化、量子长时演化、变阶分数算子与色散关系发现上显著优于 Kolmogorov-Arnold 神经算子。
AI.motivation: 神经算子应从数据中学习物理规律，并具备两项能力：一是泛化到训练分布之外，二是以闭式形式显式给出所学规律。Kolmogorov-Arnold 神经算子虽能同时满足这两点，但其在所有位置与频率上学习稠密伪微分符号，代价随分辨率平方增长，且闭式表达式需人工读取，稠密符号并不必要。
AI.method: 提出 Kolmogorov-Arnold flow（KAFlow）：利用有限阶变系数微分算子的符号分离秩由系数函数个数界定、且与分辨率无关这一性质，将物理算子生成元学习为由单变量 Kolmogorov-Arnold 函数构成的低秩符号；固定这些函数的规范以保证每一项位置唯一；用精确指数积分器积分动力学；并自动蒸馏其闭式表达式。
AI.result: 在该神经算子的合成基准上，KAFlow 将 OOD 损失降低 3.4 至 11 倍，无需符号模板即把每个系数恢复到 10^-4 以内，达到数据精度下限；在长时量子动力学上，状态不保真度最多降低 6 个数量级，仅用位置与动量测量训练时降低 30 倍；学习变阶分数算子比现有算子网络准确 15 倍，并能发现稀疏回归失败的近邻非局域、分数与非多项式色散关系。
AI.conclusion: 低秩符号假设使 KAFlow 在保持闭式可解释性的同时，以与分辨率无关的代价显著提升 OOD 泛化与长时预测精度，并扩展到分数与非多项式非局域算子，优于稠密符号的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 神经算子及稀疏回归方法。

title: Training User Simulators with Latent Intrinsic Feedback
summary: User simulators are gaining attention as environments to train LLM assistants that can better cope with the nuances of multi-turn conversations with real users. Prior work on user simulation has emphasized generating realistic user utterances, leaving unexplored their potential as a source of direct feedback on the assistant's responses. Such evaluation signals may not be explicitly communicated in language, but can instead reside in the latent reasoning of users. In this work, we introduce user simulators with intrinsic feedback, namely, models equipped with latent evaluation states: internal thoughts, reactions, and scalar ratings that evaluate the assistant from a first-person user perspective at each conversation turn. We train LLM-based simulators using interaction logs between real users and assistants and demonstrate that intrinsic feedback improves simulation realism and critiquing behaviors versus prompted simulator baselines, while also providing turn-level evaluations that existing fine-tuned simulators lack. Further, evaluations generated by our trained simulators correlate better with human judgments than those of prompted simulators of the same size. Lastly, our experiments reveal that simulators with intrinsic feedback provide effective reward signals for multi-turn RL training, matching setups that rely on external judge LLMs for rewards while cutting RL compute by more than half.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出"内在反馈用户模拟器"(intrinsic feedback user simulators)，即带有潜在评估状态（内心想法、反应、标量评分）的模型，可逐轮从第一人称用户视角评估助手回复，并证明其提升模拟真实性与批评能力，且能作为高效的多轮RL奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 现有用户模拟研究主要聚焦于生成真实的用户话语，忽视了模拟器作为"对助手回复的直接反馈来源"的潜力。这类评估信号往往不通过语言显式表达，而是潜藏于用户的潜在推理中，因此尚未被开发利用。
AI.method: 1) 提出带有内在反馈的用户模拟器：模型携带潜在评估状态，包括内心想法、反应和标量评分，在每轮对话中从第一人称用户视角评估助手；2) 使用真实用户与助手的交互日志训练基于LLM的模拟器（而非仅依赖提示）。
AI.result: 1) 内在反馈提升了模拟真实性与批评行为，优于提示式模拟器基线；2) 提供现有微调模拟器所缺乏的逐轮评估；3) 生成评估与人类判断的相关性优于同规模提示式模拟器；4) 作为多轮RL奖励信号，效果可匹配依赖外部评判LLM的方案，同时将RL计算量削减一半以上。
AI.conclusion: 用户模拟器不应仅被视为生成真实话语的环境，其潜在评估状态可作为直接、逐轮的反馈来源。这种内在反馈既提升模拟质量，又提供高效的多轮强化学习奖励信号，为训练更擅长多轮对话的LLM助手提供了新途径。

title: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\$hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Web$hell，用统一接口 WebContract/WebCompiler/WebCache 将实时网页编译为可寻址的信息与动作对象，并配合共享操作，为 LLM 智能体提供一致、可操作、可持久化的网页访问，在搜索、导航与深度研究基准上以更低成本取得强性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正直接使用开放网络，面对长时程、端到端任务，需要在单条轨迹中兼顾广泛信息收集、浏览器操作与已获取证据的回访。现有搜索增强型、浏览器型与文件系统型访问模型多只支持信息收集或浏览器交互之一，组合使用会带来显著成本或性能折衷，难以满足上述需求。
AI.method: 提出 Web$hell 统一访问接口：以 WebContract 定义共同模式（schema）；WebCompiler 将实时网页编译为可寻址的信息对象与动作对象；这些对象由 WebCache 维护，并通过一组共享操作进行调用，从而为智能体提供一致、可操作且可持久化的网页访问。
AI.result: 在网页搜索、网页导航与深度研究等多类基准上开展大量实验，Web$hell 在取得较强任务性能的同时成本更低；结果也表明接口设计对有效网页访问具有重要作用。
AI.conclusion: Web$hell 通过统一接口设计为 LLM 智能体在开放网络上的有效访问提供了新路径，有望支持更强能力与更高效率的网页智能体。

title: Destination-Conditioned Adaptation with Semantic-Geometric Alignment for Generative Inbetweening
summary: Generative inbetweening aims to synthesize temporally coherent intermediate frames between a start frame and a target frame. Although pretrained image-to-video diffusion models provide strong priors for large-motion inbetweening, they are not explicitly designed to reach a specified target frame. They may therefore generate realistic individual frames while drifting from the target or producing unstable motion under large displacements and non-rigid dynamics. We propose DSG-GI, a framework that adapts pretrained latent video diffusion models through \textbf{D}estination-Conditioned Adaptation and \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{G}eometric Alignment. Destination-Conditioned Adaptation treats the target frame as the destination of the sequence and provides temporally progressive guidance along the generated trajectory. Semantic-Geometric Alignment aligns the token-wise spatio-temporal relational geometry of backbone features with that of a frozen video foundation encoder and applies a flow-matching-aware latent flow constraint to samples near the data endpoint of the probability path. Together, these components strengthen destination guidance and preserve coherent semantic-geometric motion structure. Extensive experiments on standard and large-motion inbetweening benchmarks demonstrate improvements in temporal stability, target-frame faithfulness, and perceptual quality. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 DSG-GI 框架，通过目标条件适配与语义-几何对齐改进预训练潜视频扩散模型，提升大运动插帧的时序稳定性、目标帧保真度与感知质量。
AI.motivation: 生成式插帧需在首帧与目标帧之间合成时序连贯的中间帧。预训练图像到视频扩散模型虽提供强先验，但未显式以到达指定目标帧为设计目标，因而在大位移和非刚性动态下易偏离目标、运动不稳定。
AI.method: DSG-GI 包含两部分：(1) Destination-Conditioned Adaptation：将目标帧视为序列终点，沿生成轨迹提供时序渐进式引导；(2) Semantic-Geometric Alignment：将主干特征的逐 token 时空关系几何与冻结视频基础编码器对齐，并对接近概率路径数据端点的样本施加 flow-matching 感知的潜流约束。
AI.result: 在标准及大运动插帧基准上的大量实验表明，方法在时序稳定性、目标帧保真度和感知质量方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过目标条件适配与语义-几何对齐相结合，可有效增强目标引导并保持语义-几何运动结构的一致性；代码将公开。

title: Target-Constrained Pooling for Trajectory Extrapolation
summary: Trajectory extrapolation from a partial target trajectory is underdetermined, but completed related trajectories provide information about the unresolved continuation. We propose target-constrained pooling (TCP), which separates the finite-horizon endpoint from continuation shape and estimates that endpoint from two complementary source signals. Uniform pooling captures final response levels, while matched-increment pooling captures the remaining change after aligning source and target states. TCP selects representative sources, projects both endpoint estimates onto a target-consistent region, converts them into corrections of the free forecast, and controls their influence through strength calibration and degradation-aware weighting. Across 25,245 targets from five domains and both forecasting directions, TCP reduces mean RMSE by 35.8% to 42.1% for all ten target-only forecasters and improves all 100 forecaster, dataset, and direction comparisons. The two endpoint signals consistently outperform either alone, while representative selection remains within 0.64% to 1.02% of the full donor pool using 12.7x fewer donor inputs and 138.8x fewer matching distance computations.

AI.tldr: 提出目标约束池化(TCP)方法，利用相关完整轨迹辅助部分轨迹外推，在五大领域25245个目标上使RMSE降低35.8%–42.1%。
AI.motivation: 从部分目标轨迹进行轨迹外推本质上是欠定的，但相关的完整轨迹可提供未解析延续部分的信息，因此需要一种方法有效利用这些相关轨迹来补全目标轨迹。
AI.method: TCP将有限时域端点与延续形状分离，从两个互补源信号估计该端点：均匀池化捕获最终响应水平，匹配增量池化在对齐源与目标状态后捕获剩余变化；随后选取代表性源，将两个端点估计投影到目标一致区域，转化为对自由预测的修正，并通过强度校准与退化感知加权控制其影响。
AI.result: 在五个领域、双向预测共25245个目标上，TCP使全部10种仅目标预测器的平均RMSE降低35.8%–42.1%，并在全部100组预测器、数据集与方向比较中均有提升；两种端点信号持续优于单独使用任一信号，代表性选择在仅用1/12.7的供体输入和1/138.8的匹配距离计算下，性能仍保持在完整供体池的0.64%–1.02%范围内。
AI.conclusion: TCP通过端点与形状分离、双信号互补估计及投影修正机制，显著提升轨迹外推精度，同时以极低的计算与输入成本保持接近完整供体池的性能。

title: AMLworld-Compact: Importance-Weighted Downsampling for Cost-Effective LLM Evaluation and Error Diagnosis
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on AMLworld's smallest test splits is costly because each of over a million targets requires a separate graph prompt. Sampling reduces this cost, but small balanced subsets change unweighted precision and F1. We introduce AMLworld-Compact, an evaluation set that retains every illicit test transaction and samples benign transactions from supervised-score strata. Its HT-Coreset protocol reduces evaluation targets by 271x and 611x on HI-Small and LI-Small. Horvitz-Thompson weights give unbiased full-test confusion-count estimates for fixed predictions; recall is exact, while precision and F1 are ratio estimates. In a held-out study using Graph Feature Preprocessor (GFP) features, one boosted-tree family defines strata for evaluating the other over 500 draws per configuration. At the released sizes, F1 RMSE is 0.00-2.58 percentage points versus 4.44-7.41 for uniform sampling with HT weights; conservative intervals remain broad. Under the evaluated graph prompts, seven open-weight LLMs have weighted precision near the predict-all-illicit baseline. In an outcome-stratified audit of 1,000 HI-Small few-shot outputs from one run per model, lexical checks pass for 84.5% of correct and 56.2% of incorrect binary verdicts, so these markers do not establish correctness. We release the evaluation sets, construction code, and audit tools at https://huggingface.co/datasets/typhoon-ai/AMLworldCompactEval and https://github.com/nat-nischw/AMLworld-Compact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AMLworld-Compact 评估集，通过保留全部非法交易并按监督分数分层采样合法交易，将评估目标减少 271x/611x，结合 Horvitz-Thompson 加权实现无偏混淆计数估计。
AI.motivation: 在 AMLworld 最小测试集上评估大语言模型成本极高（超百万目标各需独立图提示）；采样可降本，但小规模平衡子集会改变未加权精确率与 F1，因此需要一种既能大幅降本又能保持估计无偏的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建 AMLworld-Compact：保留全部非法测试交易，按监督分数分层采样合法交易；引入 HT-Coreset 协议，在 HI-Small 与 LI-Small 上分别减少 271x 与 611x 评估目标；用 Horvitz-Thompson 权重对固定预测给出无偏全测试混淆计数估计（召回率精确，精确率与 F1 为比率估计）。在留出研究中用 GFP 特征，由一个提升树族定义分层以评估另一族，每配置 500 次抽样。
AI.result: 在发布规模下，F1 的 RMSE 为 0.00–2.58 个百分点，而均匀采样加 HT 权重为 4.44–7.41；保守区间仍较宽。在评估的图提示下，七个开源权重 LLM 的加权精确率接近“全部预测为非法”基线。对 1000 条 HI-Small few-shot 输出的分层审计显示，词汇检查在 84.5% 正确和 56.2% 错误二分类判定中通过，无法据此确立正确性。
AI.conclusion: AMLworld-Compact 可在保持无偏混淆计数估计的同时显著降低评估成本，但保守置信区间仍宽；词汇标记不能作为正确性判据。评估集、构建代码与审计工具已在 Hugging Face 与 GitHub 公开。

title: Local Diagnostics of Learned Event Representations for Anomaly Detection at the HL-LHC
summary: Anomaly detection, the identification of collision events that deviate from Standard Model expectations, is one of the most promising model-agnostic strategies for new-physics searches at the Large Hadron Collider. Searching for rare events in learned low-dimensional representations removes the need to commit to hand-crafted observables a priori, but sacrifices the immediate physical interpretation those observables provide. For anomaly detection to enter a discovery pipeline, flagged events must therefore be diagnosed locally, both to distinguish potential new physics from mismodeling or detector effects and to identify observables for targeted follow-up searches. We evaluate supervised and self-supervised neural embedding strategies on COLLIDE-2V, a 750-million-event dataset simulated under realistic High-Luminosity LHC conditions, using the reconstruction error of an autoencoder trained in the learned latent space as the anomaly score. Across the configurations and benchmark signals considered, supervised objectives, which exploit simulation process labels during training, generally outperform their self-supervised counterparts and, in their best configurations, improve on an autoencoder trained directly on kinematic features, raising the signal efficiency at 10% background acceptance on all held-out processes. We further introduce a local diagnostic pipeline that fits a Gaussian Mixture Model to the SM latent space, profiles each component through high-level observables without process labels, localizes the flagged events, and ranks observables by their local discriminating power. The ranking recovers the defining kinematics of the held-out processes, while correlating the anomaly score with the same observables quantifies how closely the score tracks them, revealing cases where the most discriminating observable is not the one the score follows most closely.

AI.tldr: 本文在高亮度LHC模拟数据COLLIDE-2V上比较监督与自监督神经嵌入策略，并引入基于高斯混合模型的局部诊断流程，用于定位异常事件并按局部判别力排序高维观测量。
AI.motivation: 异常检测是LHC上不依赖具体模型的寻找新物理策略，但低维表示中的罕见事件缺乏直接物理解释，需对标记事件做局部诊断，以区分新物理与模拟误差/探测器效应，并为后续定向搜索确定观测量。
AI.method: 在750百万事件的COLLIDE-2V数据集上，以潜空间中自编码器重构误差为异常分数，评估监督与自监督嵌入策略；并构建局部诊断流程：对SM潜空间拟合GMM、在无过程标签下用高维观测量刻画各分量、定位被标记事件并按局部判别力排序观测量。
AI.result: 在所用配置与基准信号下，利用模拟过程标签的监督目标通常优于自监督方法；最佳配置在全部留出过程上于10%背景接受率下提升信号效率，并优于直接在运动学特征上训练的自编码器。诊断排序可恢复留出过程的定义性运动学，且异常分数与同一批观测量的相关性揭示了最具判别力的观测量并非分数最紧密追踪的观测量。
AI.conclusion: 监督神经嵌入结合局部GMM诊断流程，可提升异常检测信号效率并提供可解释的事件定位与观测量排序，为异常检测进入发现管线提供支持。

title: Golden Anchor for Video Generation
comment: 22 pages (including references and appendices), 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Video generation supports digital content creation, with applications in virtual avatars, AI-driven filmmaking, interactive game engines, and world models. State-of-the-art systems achieve controllability primarily through image-to-video (I2V) generation, in which an injected anchor image determines the identity, composition, and style of the resulting video. In modern pipelines, this anchor is synthesized by a text-to-image (T2I) generator. This raises a largely overlooked question: Are images obtained directly from the T2I model truly suitable for current video models? Our analysis shows that anchor aesthetic and quality scores are weakly correlated with downstream video quality. The structure-and-texture score is negatively correlated with I2V video quality in both the visual and motion dimensions. Fine-tuning the T2I model on an image reward accordingly yields anchors with visibly denser structural and character detail: they score higher on image metrics, yet lower the video reward on every I2V model we test and change downstream motion unpredictably. We therefore introduce Golden Anchor Learning (GAL), to our knowledge the first framework for learning golden anchors by optimizing a T2I generator with downstream video feedback. GAL evaluates candidate anchors through the videos they induce under a frozen I2V model and converts video rewards into image-level preferences for DPO fine-tuning of the T2I generator. On all four I2V models, GAL raises the VBench average by $2.97\%$--$8.46\%$ over the untuned generator. The rendered clips also score higher under VideoReward-Overall, and their extracted frames under HPSv3 and UniPercept. GAL yields consistent motion gains across all four I2V models, as measured by a $5.62\%$--$38.24\%$ increase in VBench dynamic degree. Although GAL is trained only on HunyuanVideo-1.5 renders, these gains extend to the other three I2V models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Golden Anchor Learning (GAL)，首个用下游视频反馈优化 T2I 生成器以学习"黄金锚点"的框架：通过冻结 I2V 模型生成视频、将视频奖励转为图像级偏好进行 DPO 微调，在四个 I2V 模型上普遍提升视频质量与运动表现。
AI.motivation: 当前可控视频生成依赖 I2V 范式，锚点图像由 T2I 模型生成，决定视频的身份、构图与风格。但"直接来自 T2I 模型的图像是否真正适合视频模型"这一问题被长期忽视。作者发现锚点的美学与质量分数与下游视频质量弱相关，结构-纹理分数甚至与 I2V 视频质量负相关，说明以图像指标为导向的 T2I 优化并不能保证视频质量。
AI.method: 提出 GAL 框架：在冻结的 I2V 模型下，用候选锚点诱导生成的视频来评估锚点质量；将视频奖励转换为图像级偏好对，用于对 T2I 生成器进行 DPO 微调。对比实验包括在图像奖励上微调 T2I（产生结构/角色细节更密集、图像指标更高但视频奖励更低的锚点）。
AI.result: 在全部四个 I2V 模型上，GAL 使 VBench 平均提升 2.97%–8.46%（相对未微调生成器）；生成片段在 VideoReward-Overall 上得分更高，抽帧在 HPSv3 与 UniPercept 上得分更高；四个 I2V 模型的 VBench dynamic degree 提升 5.62%–38.24%，运动增益一致。虽仅在 HunyuanVideo-1.5 的渲染上训练，增益可迁移至其余三个 I2V 模型。
AI.conclusion: 锚点图像的图像级指标并非视频质量的有效代理，应以下游视频反馈作为优化信号。GAL 证明通过视频反馈优化 T2I 生成器可获得更优锚点，且具有良好的跨 I2V 模型泛化性。

title: Towards Easier-to-Tune Training Algorithms: New Results from AlgoPerf
summary: Evaluating deep learning optimizer is challenging because confounding factors such as hyperparameter tuning and optimizer-model co-design often obscure true algorithmic performance. We present results of the updated AlgoPerf V1 benchmark, in which we evaluate a new set of training algorithms on wall-clock time-to-target across nine workloads on fixed hardware. This report focuses on the results of the benchmark's self-tuning ruleset, which requires submissions to use a single configuration across all workloads. Out of the 13 submissions in PyTorch and JAX, Schedule-Free AdamW ranked first. In addition to the wall-clock scores, we also analyze the trade-offs between step efficiency and wall-clock execution, revealing that matrix-preconditioned and two-loop methods achieve good sample efficiency but require more aggressive computational optimizations to be competitive in runtime. Finally, our hyperparameter saliency and retention analyses show that the learning rate and momentum are highly sensitive across domains and algorithms, highlighting the need for methods that are more robust against hyperparameter tuning and can generalize well to new tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了更新版 AlgoPerf V1 基准测试结果，对 13 个 PyTorch 与 JAX 训练算法在九类负载、固定硬件下以墙钟时间达标时间进行评估；在自调参规则集下，Schedule-Free AdamW 排名第一，并分析了步数效率与运行时效率的权衡，以及学习率和动量的高敏感性。
AI.motivation: 评估深度学习优化器具有挑战性，因为超参数调优、优化器与模型协同设计等混杂因素会掩盖算法本身的真实性能，因此需要一个受控、公平的基准来比较训练算法。
AI.method: 采用更新版 AlgoPerf V1 基准，在固定硬件上针对九类工作负载，以墙钟时间达标时间（wall-clock time-to-target）评估一组新训练算法；重点关注自调参规则集（要求所有工作负载使用单一配置）；在 PyTorch 和 JAX 上共评估 13 个提交；并开展超参数显著性与保留性分析，以及步数效率与墙钟执行效率的权衡分析。
AI.result: 在 13 个 PyTorch 和 JAX 提交中，Schedule-Free AdamW 排名第一。分析显示，矩阵预条件方法和双循环方法具有良好的样本效率，但在运行时竞争力方面需要更激进的算力优化；超参数显著性与保留性分析表明，学习率和动量在不同领域与算法间高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 当前优化器在墙钟时间上表现最佳的并非样本效率最高的方法；学习率和动量的高度敏感性凸显了对超参数调优更鲁棒、且能更好泛化到新任务的方法的需求。

title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals
summary: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of $1.58\times$ over the standard residual baseline, compared with $1.35\times$ for AttnRes and $1.30\times$ for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR)，将AttnRes沿深度轴的注意力残差扩展为多头深度注意力，通过多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文获取流多样性，并以轻量自适应混合生成单流层输入，在18B/28B MoE规模下优于多种残差变体，实现1.58倍等损失计算加速。
AI.motivation: AttnRes实现了沿网络深度的内容相关检索，可视为沿深度轴的单流softmax注意力。受序列轴上多头注意力成功的启发，作者希望将该机制推广至多头深度注意力，在不显著增加开销的前提下获得性能增益。
AI.method: MSAR通过多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文中获取流多样性，使不同头以不同上下文视角检索历史表示，同时保持隐藏表示的完整性；检索到的多流通过轻量自适应混合（adaptive mixing）组合为单流层输入。该方法保留单流来源并按需扩展，无需持久的多流存储或通信。
AI.result: 在18B和28B MoE规模的全部12个下游基准上，MSAR一致优于标准残差连接、流形约束Hyper-Connections (mHC) 和AttnRes。缩放律实验中，MSAR相对标准残差基线实现1.58倍等损失计算加速，而AttnRes为1.35倍、mHC为1.30倍。
AI.conclusion: MSAR是一种面向大规模预训练的有前景的残差架构，在保持低开销的同时通过多头深度注意力显著提升性能与计算效率。

title: Rollout-Time Intervention: Unlocking Agentic Reinforcement Learning Beyond Policy Limits
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents, enabling stronger reasoning, planning, and tool-use in interactive environments. However, existing agent RL methods remain fundamentally constrained by an on-policy reasoning bottleneck: when tasks exceed the model's current capability boundary, effective trajectories become extremely sparse and training often collapses. We introduce Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI), a technique designed to elicit successful trajectories beyond the policy's intrinsic exploration capacity. RTI operates by leveraging reward-side evidence (i.e., evaluation rubrics) during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks that the policy rarely solves on its own. Although intervention trajectories are inherently off-policy, we find that they can effectively guide policy optimization when trajectories with excessive distributional shifts are filtered out. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that RTI consistently outperforms RL baselines, enabling the post-trained policy to approach the performance of substantially stronger contemporary LLMs and, more importantly, transcend its original capability boundary. The code is available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rollout-Time Intervention（RTI），通过在 rollout 阶段借助奖励侧证据（评估 rubric）将错误轨迹转化为成功轨迹，突破策略自身探索能力的限制，缓解 agent RL 的 on-policy 推理瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 的强化学习方法受限于 on-policy 推理瓶颈：当任务超出模型当前能力边界时，有效轨迹极为稀疏，训练容易崩溃。因此需要一种机制在策略固有探索能力之外诱导出成功轨迹。
AI.method: RTI 在 rollout 过程中利用奖励侧证据（即评估 rubric）对轨迹进行干预，将错误轨迹转化为成功轨迹，从而为策略自身难以解决的任务提供有效学习信号。由于干预轨迹本质上属于 off-policy，作者通过过滤分布偏移过大的轨迹来保证其能有效指导策略优化。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，RTI 一致优于 RL 基线，使后训练策略的性能接近显著更强的当代 LLM，并且超越其原有能力边界。
AI.conclusion: RTI 通过 rollout 阶段的奖励侧干预有效缓解了 agent RL 的 on-policy 推理瓶颈，为超越策略原始能力边界的训练提供了可行路径。代码已开源。

title: Complexity-Calibrated Reconstruction Discrepancy for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment
summary: The discrepancy induced by surface reconstruction in a distorted point cloud is jointly influenced by its intrinsic structural complexity and signal degradation. This observation motivates a referencefree point cloud quality assessment (PCQA) strategy that estimates and compensates for the complexity-induced component. We implement this strategy through successive reconstruction. Specifically, reconstructing the distorted point cloud produces an input-toreconstruction discrepancy that combines the effects of signal degradation and content complexity. Reapplying the reconstruction operator with stronger smoothing produces a discrepancy between successive reconstructions, which serves as a proxy for the complexityinduced component. This proxy is then used to calibrate the inputto-reconstruction discrepancy. We apply the same strategy to 3D geometry patches and their aligned 2D regions, enabling local comparison of the resulting discrepancies. The calibrated geometric and projected-view discrepancies are then fused into a final degradation score. For both branches, the discrepancies are measured using frozen pretrained perceptual representations. Our method does not require PCQA-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on three public databases show that the proposed method consistently outperforms most generic baselines and achieves performance comparable to several full-reference metrics.The code is available at https://github.com/HC-W-whc/CCRD-NR-PCQA.git.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需参考的点云质量评估方法，通过对失真点云进行连续重建来估计并补偿由内容复杂度引起的差异分量，融合几何与投影视图的校准差异得到质量分数。
AI.motivation: 失真点云中表面重建引起的差异同时受到内在结构复杂度和信号退化的影响，二者混淆使得无参考质量评估难以准确反映真实退化程度，因此需要显式估计并补偿复杂度引起的分量。
AI.method: 采用连续重建策略：对失真点云重建得到输入到重建的差异（含退化与复杂度效应）；再用更强平滑的重建算子得到连续重建间差异，作为复杂度分量的代理，用于校准前者。该策略同时应用于3D几何块及其对齐的2D区域，实现局部差异比较；校准后的几何与投影视图差异融合为最终退化分数。差异均使用冻结的预训练感知表征度量，无需PCQA专门的训练或微调。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据库上的实验表明，该方法一致优于大多数通用基线，并达到与若干全参考指标相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过连续重建解耦并补偿复杂度引起的差异，所提无参考PCQA方法在无需PCQA特定训练的情况下取得了接近全参考指标的性能，验证了该策略的有效性。

title: CB-Orchestrator: Adaptive Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents via Contextual Bandits
comment: Presented at ICML 2026 Workshop on Compositional Learning: Safety, Interpretability, and Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. In the second stage, we formulate workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, which enables sample-efficient learning by balancing exploration and exploitation, thereby significantly reducing the feedback required for training. During inference, the model adaptively selects the optimal workflow tailored to each query. Evaluations across five diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CB-Orchestrator consistently outperforms all baselines. Notably, on the MATH dataset, CB-Orchestrator achieves better performance than strong recent baselines while reducing training-phase API token overhead by no less than 40.55% and total end-to-end training (including workflow pool generation) token overhead by no less than 29.73%.

AI.tldr: 提出 CB-Orchestrator，将工作流生成与选择解耦：先用进化搜索构建候选工作流池，再用上下文赌博机进行样本高效选择，实现按查询自适应复用工作流，在降本的同时提升性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体通过 agentic workflow 处理复杂任务表现优异，但人工设计工作流成本高、缺乏对多样查询的适应性；自动化优化方法在训练阶段收集反馈时 API 开销昂贵，且无法自适应复用高质量工作流，成为性能与成本效益的瓶颈。
AI.method: CB-Orchestrator 将工作流生成与选择解耦，分两阶段：第一阶段通过进化搜索构建多样化的候选工作流池；第二阶段将工作流选择建模为 Contextual Bandit 问题，通过探索-利用权衡实现样本高效学习，显著减少训练所需反馈。推理时针对每个查询自适应选择最优工作流。
AI.result: 在五个多样化基准上，CB-Orchestrator 一致优于所有基线。在 MATH 数据集上，其性能优于近期强基线，同时训练阶段 API token 开销降低不低于 40.55%，端到端训练（含工作流池生成）总 token 开销降低不低于 29.73%。
AI.conclusion: 将工作流生成与选择解耦、并用上下文赌博机做选择，可同时提升性能与成本效益，为 LLM 智能体工作流的自动化优化提供了一条样本高效、可自适应复用的可行路径。

title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
summary: Large language models struggle to reliably identify and correct errors in their own reasoning. Unlike prior training-based approaches that fine-tune an LLM to generate revisions or feedback, we learn where to intervene in failed rollouts and determine how to redirect them. To choose where to intervene, we train a 130K-parameter MLP head on a frozen encoder using only final-answer correctness. For redirection, we find that under a fixed generation budget, the tested inline injections fail to reliably redirect reasoning, whereas presenting the same instruction in a new user turn changes the model's course. The resulting correction framework, UPTURN (User-Prompt TURN injection at a learned position), requires no LLM fine-tuning: it retains a selected prefix, injects an instruction as a new user turn, and regenerates the suffix. Across four reasoners and six math benchmarks, UPTURN improves average accuracy in every setting over a 32-rollout baseline. It outperforms self-correction and reflection-token injection baselines under matched correction budgets, transfers across reasoners and to GPQA-Diamond without retraining, and complements GRPO and self-correction methods.

AI.tldr: 提出UPTURN框架：通过少量参数的学习式探测定位失败推理中的干预位置，并以新用户回合形式注入纠正指令重新生成后缀，在无需微调LLM的情况下提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型难以可靠识别并纠正自身推理错误。既有方法多依赖对LLM进行微调以生成修订或反馈，成本高且泛化性受限。本文转而研究：在失败的推理轨迹中"在哪里干预"以及"如何重定向"，无需微调模型即可实现纠正。
AI.method: 1）干预位置选择：在冻结编码器上训练一个仅13万参数的MLP头，仅使用最终答案正确性作为监督信号，预测合适的干预位置。2）重定向方式：在固定生成预算下对比发现，内联注入（inline injection）无法可靠地改变推理走向，而将相同指令放入新的用户回合（new user turn）能有效改变模型方向。3）框架UPTURN：保留选定前缀，将纠正指令作为新用户回合注入，再重新生成后缀，全程不微调LLM。
AI.result: 在4种推理模型与6个数学基准上，UPTURN在全部设置下相较32次采样基线均提升平均准确率；在相同纠正预算下优于自纠正与反思令牌注入基线；无需重训练即可跨推理模型迁移，并迁移至GPQA-Diamond；可与GRPO及自纠正方法互补。
AI.conclusion: 有效纠正LLM推理错误的关键在于干预位置的选择与指令呈现形式，而非微调模型本身。以用户回合形式在学得位置注入指令，可在零微调条件下实现稳定、可迁移且可与其他方法叠加的推理纠正。

title: Agentic Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have taken the world by storm. Their ability to communicate with us in our own language, and to reason about our world, has made them a favorite tool for writing, answering questions, and much more. Their answers already influence our decisions and our actions. What would happen if LLMs themselves could act in the world directly? What would happen if LLMs could interact with each other? Agentic LLMs combine the power of large language models with the ability to act in the real world. In this book we will discuss how agentic LLMs work, how they act, how they interact, and what this means for us, as users.

AI.tldr: 本文（书籍介绍）聚焦"智能体化大语言模型"（Agentic LLMs），探讨其运作机理、行动方式、交互模式及对用户的影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已深度影响人类决策与行动，但现有LLM主要用于辅助（写作、问答）。作者由此提出关键问题：若LLM能够直接在世界中行动、并与其他LLM交互，将会怎样？这一设想驱动了对智能体化LLM的系统探讨。
AI.method: 以书籍形式进行概念性论述与综述，围绕三条主线展开：智能体化LLM的工作机制（how they work）、行动方式（how they act）、交互方式（how they interact），并延伸讨论其对用户的意义。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或定量数据，属于观点提出与框架构建型内容。
AI.conclusion: 智能体化LLM将LLM的推理语言能力与在真实世界中行动的能力相结合，是LLM发展的重要方向；本书旨在阐明其原理、行为与交互，并分析其对用户的影响。

title: Multi-Modal Graph Neural Network-Inspired Vessel Identification and Tracking for UAV-Based Maritime Surveillance
summary: The unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based maritime surveillance is becoming an important part of maritime Internet of Things (IoT) and intelligent transportation systems. It provides a flexible and cost-effective way to large-scale maritime traffic monitoring. However, achieving robust situational awareness remains challenging in practical maritime environments. The main challenges arise from heterogeneous sensing modalities, adverse imaging conditions, and spatial misalignment caused by UAV motion. To address these problems, this paper proposes an airborne multi-modal graph learning-driven framework, termed AMGT, for vessel identification and tracking in UAV-assisted maritime IoT. Specifically, visible and infrared images are first aligned and fused through a multi-parameter perspective transformation model. This improves visual perception under low visibility and complex illumination conditions. Automatic identification system (AIS) messages are then temporally synchronized using interpolation and linear prediction. To detect small and oriented vessels, we develop a mixed-modality MAir-YOLOv8-OBB detector, followed by the MAir-SORT algorithm for stable vessel tracking. We further design a graph learning-driven association network to model temporal dynamics and spatial dependencies among vessels and between vessels and UAVs. A motion-aware coordinate unification (MCU) strategy is also introduced to reduce nonlinear misalignment caused by UAV motion. Experiments on the MAP-M2UAV50 dataset show that AMGT achieves high accuracy and efficiency. The results demonstrate its potential for UAV-assisted maritime IoT applications, including vessel monitoring, traffic situational awareness, and intelligent maritime transportation services. The dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/MAPGroup/AMGT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AMGT框架，面向无人机辅助海上物联网中的船舶识别与跟踪，通过多模态对齐融合、AIS时序同步、图学习关联网络与运动感知坐标统一策略，在MAP-M2UAV50数据集上实现高精度高效的态势感知。
AI.motivation: 无人机海上监视是海上物联网与智能交通系统的重要组成部分，可灵活、低成本地实现大规模海上交通监测。但实际海上环境中，异质传感模态、恶劣成像条件以及无人机运动导致的时空错位，使鲁棒的态势感知难以实现。
AI.method: 1) 通过多参数透视变换模型对可见光与红外图像进行对齐与融合，提升低能见度和复杂光照下的视觉感知；2) 利用插值与线性预测对AIS消息进行时间同步；3) 提出混合模态MAir-YOLOv8-OBB检测器检测小型有向船舶，配合MAir-SORT算法实现稳定跟踪；4) 设计图学习驱动的关联网络建模船舶之间及船舶与无人机之间的时序动态与空间依赖；5) 引入运动感知坐标统一（MCU）策略，降低无人机运动引起的非线性错位。
AI.result: 在MAP-M2UAV50数据集上的实验表明，AMGT在准确率和效率方面均取得较高表现，验证了其在无人机辅助海上物联网应用中的潜力，涵盖船舶监测、交通态势感知与智能海上运输服务。数据集与代码将开源于https://github.com/MAPGroup/AMGT。
AI.conclusion: AMGT通过多模态融合、AIS时序同步、有向小目标检测跟踪、图学习关联与运动感知坐标统一，有效应对海上无人机监视中的异质传感、恶劣成像与运动错位挑战，为无人机辅助海上物联网的态势感知提供了可行方案。

title: Double-Take: Improving Capacity, Binding, and Selectivity In Long-Context Within Bidirectional Memory
summary: Processing a long sequence does not guarantee that distant information remains usable. As context grows, a fixed-size memory must retain many associations, connect information across positions, and preserve relevant structure without being overwhelmed by everything it observes. These are distinct requirements: a memory may store more information without representing the relationships needed for retrieval, and it may transport those relationships without preserving the ones that matter. Thus, the challenge is not simply extending context length, but constructing a memory that remains usable as context grows. We study this problem in large-chunk test-time training (TTT) and identify two basic failures: single-step writes accumulate interference, limiting capacity, while self-associative writes cannot form cross-position bindings. We introduce Double-Take (DT), which repairs these failures with multi-step unpinned updates and cross-position mixing, and adds bidirectional change-sensitive writes for selective retention. Capacity alone leaves end-to-end recall at the $0.10$ chance floor; adding binding raises it to $0.92$. Trained only on $32\,\mathrm{kb}$ genomic contexts, DT reaches $0.927$ AUROC at $131\,\mathrm{kb}$ and $0.856$ near $1\,\mathrm{Mb}$, while transferring zero-shot from human to mouse. Together, these results identify capacity, binding, and selectivity as three requirements for usable long-range memory.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大块test-time training（TTT）中的长程记忆可用性问题，指出固定大小记忆需同时满足容量、绑定与选择性三项要求，并提出Double-Take（DT）方法修复单步写入与自联想写入的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 长序列处理并不保证远距离信息可用。随着上下文增长，固定大小记忆必须在众多关联中保留信息、跨位置连接信息并保持相关结构，而容量、绑定与选择性是相互独立的需求：记忆可能存储更多信息却无法表达检索所需关系，也可能传递关系却丢失关键结构。因此核心挑战不是单纯延长上下文长度，而是构建随上下文增长仍可用的记忆。
AI.method: 作者在大块test-time training（TTT）框架下定位两个基本失败：单步写入会累积干扰、限制容量；自联想写入无法形成跨位置绑定。为此提出Double-Take（DT），采用多步无固定（unpinned）更新与跨位置混合来修复上述问题，并加入双向变化敏感写入以实现选择性保留。
AI.result: 仅提升容量时，端到端召回率仍停留在0.10的随机水平；加入绑定后提升至0.92。仅在32 kb基因组上下文上训练的DT，在131 kb达到0.927 AUROC，在接近1 Mb时达到0.856，并实现从人类到小鼠的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 容量、绑定与选择性是可用的长程记忆的三项基本要求；DT通过多步无固定更新、跨位置混合与变化敏感写入同时满足这三项要求，显著提升长上下文召回与跨物种零样本迁移能力。

title: Retractions Revisited: A Replication, Extension, and Mechanistic Evaluation of Linguistic Obfuscation Effects in Fraudulent Science
summary: Prior work suggests fraudulent scientists write their articles with higher rates of linguistic obfuscation than genuine scientists, with a possible mechanism suggesting obfuscation makes research more costly for a reader to analyze. This result has not undergone additional empirical scrutiny in the open science era, nor have other psychological mechanisms been evaluated. The current replication and extension addressed this opportunity by comparing 800 fraudulent and 800 genuine control papers (2013-2025). The results supported the linguistic obfuscation hypothesis, suggesting fraudulent papers were more obfuscated than genuine ones. A parallel mediation model evaluated three competing mechanisms, finding that reality monitoring, as measured through decreased rates of adjectives, best explained the link between fraudulent science and linguistic obfuscation. Cross-validated detection accuracy using obfuscation features (60.7%) and an elastic net of over 100 language dimensions (71.6%) were significantly greater than chance. Implications for scientific fraud and psychology of language research are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过复制与扩展比较800篇学术造假论文与800篇真实对照论文（2013-2025），支持"语言遮蔽"假说：造假论文语言更晦涩；现实监控机制（形容词使用率降低）最能解释该关联，语言特征交叉验证检测准确率为60.7%，弹性网络模型达71.6%。
AI.motivation: 已有研究提示造假科学家比真实科学家使用更高比率的语言遮蔽（linguistic obfuscation），可能的机制是遮蔽使读者分析研究信息的成本上升。但该结论在开放科学时代未获进一步实证检验，其他心理机制也未被评估，因此需要复制与扩展研究。
AI.method: 比较800篇学术造假论文与800篇真实对照论文（2013-2025年）；检验语言遮蔽假说；采用平行中介模型评估三种竞争机制，其中现实监控（reality monitoring）以形容词使用率降低作为测量指标；使用语言遮蔽特征进行交叉验证检测，并构建包含100多个语言维度的弹性网络（elastic net）模型。
AI.result: 结果支持语言遮蔽假说，造假论文比真实论文更为遮蔽。平行中介模型显示，现实监控机制（形容词使用率下降）最能解释学术造假与语言遮蔽之间的联系。基于语言遮蔽特征的交叉验证检测准确率为60.7%，基于100多个语言维度的弹性网络模型准确率为71.6%，均显著高于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 研究在开放科学时代复制并扩展了造假论文语言遮蔽效应，并首次将现实监控确立为更具解释力的心理机制；语言特征具备显著优于随机的检测能力。文中讨论了对学术造假研究与语言心理学研究的启示。

title: SqueezeBench: Saturation-Resilient Evaluation of Mathematical Capability
summary: AI systems are making rapid progress in mathematics, but this progress is hard to measure. Benchmarks of solved problems saturate, and in benchmarks of open problems each problem can be resolved for the first time only once. We present SqueezeBench, a benchmark that is resilient to saturation: a success raises the bar instead of removing the problem. Each problem fixes an integer function $f(n)$ whose values are known only for small $n$, and the benchmark keeps a lower and an upper record on it. A record is a computable Lean function with a machine-checked proof that it bounds $f$. A submission proposes a new function and proves that it bounds $f$, that it is no worse than the current record at any $n$, and that it is strictly better at some $n$. Once accepted, it becomes the record that the next submission has to beat. The system thus chooses the bound as well as its proof, and it may improve the record at a single $n$ or its growth rate. At every $n$, the gap between the two records shows how far the certified bounds are from determining $f(n)$. Every proof is checked by two independent Lean kernels, so no referee needs to check the mathematics. The checks also reject a function that computes $f$ by exhaustive search at small $n$, and a maintainer only reads the submitter's report and looks for such a search at larger $n$. We release ten problems from extremal combinatorics with twenty proved initial records and the admission tools. As a baseline, agents based on a frontier language model, with at most one hour per record, had 82 submissions accepted and improved every record, without going beyond the published literature. Agents based on two newer models then started from these records, had 60 more submissions accepted and improved 19 of the 20 records again. For eight of the ten problems, at least one record is still asymptotically behind the best published bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SqueezeBench，一种抗饱和的数学基准，通过维护整数函数上下界的 Lean 机检记录，让每次成功提交抬高门槛而非移除问题。
AI.motivation: AI 在数学上的进展难以度量：已解题基准会饱和，而开放问题基准中每个问题只能被首次解决一次，缺乏可持续评测信号。
AI.method: 每个问题固定一个整数函数 f(n)，仅已知小 n 的值，基准对其维护上下界记录。记录是一个可计算 Lean 函数，并附有机检证明其界定 f。提交需给出新函数并证明其界定 f、不比当前记录差、且在某 n 处严格更优；被接受后成为下一提交需超越的记录。系统同时选择界与证明，可改进单个 n 或增长率。每份证明由两个独立 Lean 内核验证，无需人工检查数学。检查还拒绝通过小 n 穷举搜索计算 f 的函数，维护者仅读报告并检查更大 n 的此类搜索。作者发布来自极值组合学的十个问题、二十个已证初始记录与准入工具。
AI.result: 基线：基于前沿语言模型的智能体（每个记录最多一小时）有 82 份提交被接受，改进所有记录，且未超出已发表文献范围。基于两个更新模型的智能体从这些记录出发，又有 60 份提交被接受，并再次改进 20 个记录中的 19 个。十个问题中有八个，至少一个记录仍渐近落后于最佳已发表界。
AI.conclusion: SqueezeBench 通过记录机制实现抗饱和评测，两个独立 Lean 内核保证正确性并自动拒绝穷举搜索作弊；实验显示智能体能持续改进记录，但仍存在与已发表最佳界的差距，表明基准可持续提供评测信号。

title: Automated Detection and Encoding of Cartographic Signs in Historical Maps
summary: Symbols and icons in archival maps represent an expansive source of evidence for historical geography. In this paper, we present a two-stage framework for (1) detecting cartographic signs in historical maps and (2) generating interpretable sign embeddings that capture both semantics and stylistic variations. We also introduce CaSiDD, an open benchmark dataset spanning multiple sign categories and diverse cartographic styles, designed for generic sign detection. Using YOLOv10-X, we demonstrate the practicality of automated sign detection on historical maps. We then present strategies for creating contrasted, informative embeddings of cartographic signs. We approach embedding design systematically, maximizing expressiveness while suppressing digitization or background material confounders. Our final method, based on an adapted RADIOv4 backbone, effectively encodes both sign form and semantics, while producing interpretable representations. This work lays a foundation for scalable evidence extraction for the comparative study of map signs within cartographic culture and geohistorical research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，用于历史地图中的制图符号检测与可解释符号嵌入生成，并发布基准数据集CaSiDD，为地图符号的规模化证据提取奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 历史档案地图中的符号与图标是历史地理研究的重要证据来源，但人工提取效率低，缺乏面向多样符号类别与制图风格的通用检测与表征方法，制约了地图符号的比较研究与地理历史研究。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用YOLOv10-X进行自动化制图符号检测；第二阶段系统性地设计嵌入方案，通过对比学习获得兼具信息量的符号嵌入，在最大化表达力的同时抑制数字化伪影与背景材料的混淆因素，最终方法基于改进的RADIOv4骨干网络。同时构建开放基准数据集CaSiDD，涵盖多符号类别与多样制图风格。
AI.result: 在CaSiDD上验证了基于YOLOv10-X的自动符号检测的实用性；最终嵌入方法能有效编码符号形态与语义，并生成可解释的表征，优于易受混淆因素干扰的嵌入设计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为制图文化内地图符号比较研究与地理历史研究提供了可扩展的证据提取基础。

title: Human and LLM Facilitation in Collaborative Design Meetings: A Computational Behavioral Comparison
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored as facilitators of group discussion and collaborative work, but the behavioral differences between LLM-generated and human facilitation remain insufficiently characterized. We compare human Project Manager facilitation turns from scenario-based collaborative design meetings with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct responses across 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus. The analysis covers five confirmatory dimensions: contextual semantic distance, a lexical elaboration proxy, empathyand-hedge lexical density, topic divergence, and phase-vocabulary alignment. An exploratory directiveness measure failed domain validation and is not interpreted. The sampled human Project Manager turns were higher on contextual semantic distance (r = 0.644) and on empathyand-hedge lexical density (r = 0.203). The second contrast is carried mainly by hedge terms, so we read it as lexical hedging rather than psychological empathy. Llama-generated facilitation was higher on topic divergence (r = 0.703), the lexical elaboration proxy (r = 0.288; lengthconfounded), and instruction-conditioned phase-vocabulary alignment (r = 0.382). A secondary no-phase check left the Llama-higher phase contrast in place. The system prompt still requested a facilitation move, so that check is not evidence of spontaneous phase awareness. These differences should not be interpreted as a ranking of facilitation quality. The resulting behavioral profile provides a reference point for later comparisons of LLM facilitators, human facilitators, prompts, models, and collaborative settings.

AI.tldr: 对比人类项目经理与Llama 3.1 8B在协作设计会议中的引导行为，发现人类在语境语义距离与模糊限制语密度上更高，模型在话题发散度、词汇铺展（受长度混淆）及阶段词汇对齐上更高，差异不构成质量排序。
AI.motivation: LLM正被用于促进群体讨论与协作，但LLM引导与人类引导的行为差异尚缺乏系统刻画，需要一个可比的行为剖面作为后续比较的参照基准。
AI.method: 从AMI会议语料抽取199对配对的引导轮次，比较人类项目经理与Llama 3.1 8B Instruct的输出；分析五个验证性维度：语境语义距离、词汇铺展代理指标、共情与模糊限制语词汇密度、话题发散度、阶段词汇对齐；另设一个探索性指令性指标因未通过领域效度检验而不作解读；并做无阶段信息的二次检验。
AI.result: 人类项目经理轮次在语境语义距离（r = 0.644）和共情—模糊限制语密度（r = 0.203）上更高，后者主要由模糊限制词驱动，故解读为词汇层面的模糊化而非心理共情。Llama引导在话题发散度（r = 0.703）、词汇铺展代理（r = 0.288，受长度混淆）和受指令条件约束的阶段词汇对齐（r = 0.382）上更高；无阶段信息的二次检验中，模型阶段对比仍成立，但因系统提示仍要求引导动作，不能视为自发的阶段意识证据。
AI.conclusion: 两类引导者呈现可区分的行为特征，但差异不应被解读为引导质量的优劣排序；该行为剖面可作为后续比较LLM引导者、人类引导者、提示、模型与协作情境的参照点。

title: Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph
comment: Accepted at the RAGE-KG 2026 Workshop, co-located with ISWC 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures
summary: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对德国法律代码场景下RAG检索准确性问题，提出基于结构驱动解析构建知识图谱（KG）的方法，并比较多种KG-informed分块与检索策略对引用检索准确率的影响。
AI.motivation: 医学、法律等可靠性关键领域的自动化必须透明可验证，但基于LLM的系统因黑箱特性难以满足要求。RAG通过将生成过程锚定于可解释文档来降低幻觉风险并支持验证，然而随着检索源数量和规模增加，朴素检索性能下降，会忽略关键上下文元素。
AI.method: 在德国法律代码语境下，采用结构驱动解析（structure-driven parsing）构建知识图谱用于源文档导航与检索，并对比多种KG-informed的分块（chunking）与检索策略。
AI.result: 评估了各策略对检索引用（citations）准确率的影响（原文未给出具体数值结果）。
AI.conclusion: 利用结构信息构建知识图谱并据此设计分块与检索策略，可望改善规模化检索中的上下文遗漏问题并提升引用检索准确性。

title: A Local Agentic AI Framework to Generate Edge Case Scenarios for Safety Assurance
summary: Generating edge case scenarios is crucial for training, testing and safety assuring autonomous systems. This identifies hazardous failures to increase system reliability and robustness, ensures the system can still function safely on the boundaries of its operational design domain and learns the expected system behaviour for these edge cases. The rapid advancement in the generation and analysis capabilities of language models (LMs) has expanded their applicability and recent work has investigated LM scenario generation. However, many recent approaches rely on human-in-the-loop or rule-based strategies. This restricts the LM's ability to generate diverse and edge case scenarios; the long tail of the distribution. Our work uses local LMs in a laptop-based agentic AI framework for adaptive scenario generation. This is cheap, fully-controlled, ensures data privacy and security. It uses think, act, observe, update, and continue loops with lightweight JSON encoding to generate scenarios. We use the system requirements, system description and environment description as knowledge bases in contextual prompts for an LM to ensure scenario realism. A second, independent LM critiques each scenario using domain specific criteria so it can be refined. The refined scenarios are run in simulation and evaluation metrics collected. These metric scores are analysed and similar scenarios are created for edge cases (exploitation) or novel scenarios are generated to explore the scenario space. Post-hoc clustering using metric scores and thematic-type analysis of the rich-text scenario descriptions produced by the LM pinpoints functional gaps and their triggering conditions. This creates traceable evidence for the safety assurance case. Our work highlights the potential of a flexible and adaptive local agentic AI framework for automating edge case generation and producing traceable safety assurance evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于本地语言模型的智能体AI框架，通过"思考-行动-观察-更新-继续"循环与轻量JSON编码自适应生成边缘案例场景，并借助独立LM评审、仿真评估与事后聚类，实现自动化场景生成与可追溯的安全保障证据构建。
AI.motivation: 边缘案例场景生成对自动驾驶等自主系统的训练、测试与安全保障至关重要，可识别危险失效、提升可靠性与鲁棒性。现有LM场景生成方法多依赖人在回路或规则化策略，限制了生成多样性与长尾边缘案例的能力，因此需要更灵活、可控且保护隐私的自动化方案。
AI.method: 采用基于笔记本电脑的本地LM智能体AI框架，使用"思考、行动、观察、更新、继续"循环及轻量JSON编码生成场景；以系统需求、系统描述和环境描述作为知识库构建上下文提示以保证真实性；由第二个独立LM依据领域特定标准进行评审与细化；细化场景经仿真运行并采集评估指标，分析指标后按利用（生成相似边缘案例）与探索（生成新场景）策略迭代；最后通过基于指标的聚类与主题类型分析定位功能缺口及其触发条件。
AI.result: 该框架能够自适应生成边缘案例场景，仿真评估指标驱动的利用与探索策略可同时深化边缘案例与拓展场景空间；事后聚类与主题类型分析识别出功能缺口及其触发条件，并形成可追溯的安全保障证据。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，灵活且自适应的本地智能体AI框架在自动化边缘案例生成与生成可追溯安全保障证据方面具有潜力，兼具低成本、完全可控、保障数据隐私与安全的优势。

title: FPD-Drive: Future Policy Distillation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving models are typically trained on real-world driving logs, which record only the trajectory actually executed in each scene. This provides limited supervision for learning alternative valid behaviors. Multi-target supervision can mitigate this limitation, but broader trajectory coverage makes safe candidate selection more challenging. We propose FPD-Drive, an end-to-end planner that distills privileged future knowledge into a visual driving policy to improve both multi-trajectory supervision and safety selection. Specifically, we introduce Future-Privileged Multi-Target Distillation to transfer diverse, high-quality trajectory targets from a teacher with access to recorded future observations to the student. These targets extend supervision beyond the single recorded human trajectory. For candidate selection, we further introduce Safety-Aware Score Correction to correct ranking errors between nearby safe and unsafe candidates and raise underestimated safety scores of safe candidates. At deployment, the student requires neither future observations nor teacher inference. Our base model achieves 94.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest and 55.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navhard. The scaled FPD-Drive-Pro improves these scores to 95.5 PDMS and 58.1 EPDMS, respectively, achieving SOTA performance among the compared methods on both benchmarks. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further yields an HD-Score of 45.1 and RC of 55.3.

AI.tldr: 提出FPD-Drive端到端规划器，通过蒸馏"特权未来知识"改进多轨迹监督与安全选择：教师利用未来观测生成多样化轨迹目标，学生仅用视觉输入即可在部署时达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 真实驾驶日志只记录实际执行的单条轨迹，对"其他可行行为"缺乏监督信号。多目标监督可缓解该问题，但轨迹覆盖越广，安全候选选择越困难，二者存在矛盾。
AI.method: 两大模块：(1) Future-Privileged Multi-Target Distillation——由可访问记录未来观测的教师向学生迁移多样且高质量的轨迹目标，将监督扩展到单条人类轨迹之外；(2) Safety-Aware Score Correction——修正邻近安全/非安全候选之间的排序错误，并提升被低估的安全候选分数。部署时学生不需未来观测，也不需教师推理。
AI.result: 基础模型：NAVSIM v1 navtest 94.9 PDMS，v2 navhard 55.9 EPDMS；FPD-Drive-Pro：95.5 PDMS、58.1 EPDMS，两基准均达对比方法中的SOTA。HUGSIM 零样本闭环：HD-Score 45.1，RC 55.3。
AI.conclusion: 将特权未来知识蒸馏进视觉驾驶策略，可同时提升多轨迹监督质量与安全候选选择能力，且在部署阶段保持纯视觉、无教师依赖的推理成本。

title: Can Failed Trajectories Reveal Where Agents Go Wrong? Agentic Failure Attribution Without Step-Level Labels
summary: Failure attribution for LLM agents aims to identify decisive steps responsible for task failure, which is critical for debugging and improving agentic systems. Existing methods rely on costly LLM prompting, step-level error annotations, or verified successful trajectories that lack failure signals for assistance. In this paper, we study failure attribution from step-unlabeled failure trajectories, where each trajectory is known to have failed but its decisive step is unknown. We propose SOAP (Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation), an effective framework requiring neither step-level training labels nor a separate success-only reference set. SOAP first constructs a spectral reference space from LLM representations and assigns each step a base error score according to its projection behavior. Importantly, later steps may exhibit stronger failure signals because they inherit an earlier mistake, causing independent scorers to favor downstream consequences over the decisive error. To address this downstream contamination, SOAP derives soft step dependencies from attention patterns and propagates downstream error evidence toward its likely upstream sources.
