Extensive experiments show that SOAP consistently improves attribution performance over competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SOAP框架，在仅有失败轨迹而无步骤级标签、也无成功参考集的条件下，通过谱参考空间打分并借助注意力引导的传播机制将下游错误证据回溯至上游根因，实现LLM智能体的失败归因。
AI.motivation: 失败归因对LLM智能体的调试与改进至关重要，但现有方法依赖昂贵的LLM提示、步骤级错误标注或已验证的成功轨迹；而成功轨迹缺乏失败信号，无法提供有效辅助。本文因此研究"步骤无标注失败轨迹"这一更现实的设定。
AI.method: SOAP（Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation）：1）基于LLM表征构建谱参考空间，根据每步的投影行为赋予基础错误分数；2）针对"下游污染"问题——后续步骤因继承早期错误而呈现更强失败信号，导致独立打分偏向下游结果而非决定性错误——从注意力模式中提取软步骤依赖关系；3）沿依赖关系将下游错误证据向上游可能来源传播，从而定位决定性步骤。方法无需步骤级训练标签，也无需单独的成功参考集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SOAP在归因性能上持续优于具有竞争力的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SOAP为步骤无标注的失败归因提供了一种无需额外标注与成功参考集的框架，并通过注意力引导的上游传播有效缓解下游污染，提升了归因准确性。

title: Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training
comment: Accepted at the NLLP 2026 Workshop, co-located with EMNLP 2026. 9 pages, 5 figures
summary: Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.

AI.tldr: 提出面向德国交通法规（StVO）的多任务预训练方法，融合NSP、知识图谱引导聚类与KG感知段落分类，将结构化法律知识编码进模型权重，实现零样本法律推理，在九个编码器、324次实验中显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 法律语言理解需对半结构化法规文档进行推理，但现有法律语言模型仅依赖掩码语言建模，将法条文本视为扁平token序列，忽略其层级约束，缺乏对结构能力的显式预训练目标。
AI.method: 提出三目标互补的多任务预训练方案：下一句预测（NSP）、知识图谱引导聚类（CLU）、知识图谱感知段落分类（CLS），将结构化法律知识直接编码进模型权重，从而在推理阶段支持零样本法律推理，无需离散图遍历。
AI.result: 在九个Transformer编码器上共进行324次实验。合成StVO问答任务上相对基线提升10.3%–155.0%；相较LexGLUE基线（Chalkidis等，2022），在7个法律基准中的4个上取得更优结果；在奥地利驾驶法规上获得3.4%–15.8%的一致零样本迁移增益。
AI.conclusion: 多任务结构化预训练能有效注入法规层级知识，提升法律推理性能，并可跨法域泛化，成功迁移至初始训练领域之外的法律场景。

title: Branching On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. We propose BranchOPD (Branching On-Policy Distillation), which selects informative decision points using student uncertainty and teacher-student disagreement, resamples student-policy continuations from shared prefixes, and applies token-level teacher supervision to both main trajectories and branches. BranchOPD operates at token-level decisions in mathematics and within-turn decisions in agent tasks. Shared-prefix reuse reduces student-generated token costs by approximately 19% on ALFWorld and 31% on WebShop relative to seven independent trajectories. We also introduce protocol-boundary repair (PBR), which uses targeted supervision under protocol constraints to mitigate repetition and wasted generation. BranchOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD and Multi-Rollout OPD (n=7) across all evaluated benchmarks, with gains over Vanilla OPD of 18.55 percentage points in mean mathematics accuracy over 16 sampled answers (avg@16) and 13.8 points in mean ALFWorld ID/OOD success. Mechanistic analyses and selection ablations show that branching at uncertain decisions expands subsequent behavior coverage and outperforms random selection and turn-initial branching.

AI.tldr: BranchOPD 通过在不确定性高和师生分歧大的决策点进行分支重采样，共享前缀复用降低生成成本，并优于 Vanilla/Multi-Rollout OPD。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation 中单条轨迹在每个决策点只实现一种延续，有限采样预算下监督覆盖不足；同时存在重复生成与协议边界浪费问题。
AI.method: 基于学生不确定性与师生分歧选择信息量高的决策点；从共享前缀重采样学生策略延续（分支）；对主轨迹与分支均施加 token 级教师监督；数学任务作用于 token 级决策，agent 任务作用于回合内决策；并提出 protocol-boundary repair（PBR），在协议约束下做定向监督以缓解重复与无效生成。
AI.result: 相对七条独立轨迹，共享前缀复用降低学生生成 token 成本约 19%（ALFWorld）与 31%（WebShop）；所有评测基准上优于 Vanilla OPD 与 Multi-Rollout OPD (n=7)；较 Vanilla OPD 提升：数学 avg@16 平均准确率 +18.55 个百分点，ALFWorld ID/OOD 平均成功率 +13.8 点。机制分析与选择消融显示，在不确定决策处分支可扩展后续行为覆盖，且优于随机选择与回合初始分支。
AI.conclusion: 在不确定决策点进行共享前缀分支重采样与 token 级教师监督，可在有限预算下提升 OPD 的监督覆盖、样本效率与多任务性能；PBR 进一步修复协议边界问题。

title: Jag: Direct Box Prediction for Efficient Visual Grounding
summary: Visual grounding combines image--language understanding with geometric prediction, yet autoregressive multimodal models often express a box as a coordinate sequence. Sequential decoding adds computation to the multimodal processing needed for localization. Adapting these representations to box geometry offers a route to direct prediction. We present Jag, which adapts a compact pretrained multimodal model for direct continuous box prediction. A lightweight regression head reads the last valid input-token state, conditioned on the image and referring expression, and predicts all four box coordinates together. Geometric supervision jointly adapts the language backbone, visual merger, and regression head, allowing localization losses to shape both the multimodal representations and the coordinate mapping. Inference retains image--language processing and returns the box in one forward pass, without coordinate generation or text parsing. Across benchmarks, Jag consistently improves grounding accuracy over its base model across the observed target sizes and expression groups. Component ablation show that jointly adapting the representations and head substantially improves accuracy over training the head alone. Against existing specialized grounding models, it achieves competitive accuracy with lower single-request latency and GPU memory use. These results show how supervision tailored to the geometric answer can specialize a compact pretrained multimodal model for accurate grounding and efficient direct prediction. Project page: https://xyzzzh.github.io/Jag/

AI.tldr: 提出 Jag，将紧凑预训练多模态模型适配为直接连续框预测，用轻量回归头一次前向输出四个坐标，免去坐标序列生成与文本解析，在精度、时延和显存上均具优势。
AI.motivation: 自回归多模态模型通常将边界框表示为一串坐标 token，需顺序解码，为定位额外增加计算量，拖慢推理。作者希望把框表示适配到几何本质，从而实现直接预测，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.method: 在紧凑预训练多模态模型上增加轻量回归头，读取最后一个有效输入 token 的状态，以图像与指代表达为条件，一次性回归四个框坐标。用几何监督联合适配语言主干、视觉 merger 与回归头，使定位损失同时塑造多模态表示和坐标映射。推理仅保留图像—语言处理，单次前向直接返回框，无需坐标生成或文本解析。
AI.result: 在各基准上，Jag 在观察到的目标尺寸和表达分组中均稳定优于基座模型；组件消融显示联合适配表示与回归头显著优于仅训练回归头；与专用定位模型相比，取得有竞争力的精度，同时单次请求时延与 GPU 显存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 针对几何答案定制的监督可将紧凑预训练多模态模型特化为高精度定位与高效直接预测，表明表示适配加轻量回归头是替代坐标序列解码的可行路线。

title: Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement
summary: Biological function in RNA is encoded across scales, from local sequence motifs to long-range structural dependencies. Conventional RNA foundation models couple parameter capacity and inference depth within a fixed architecture, prescribing a fixed computation graph for each inference. Here we present Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that makes inference depth adjustable through learned iterative refinement. Its shared, input-conditioned Transformer core refines sequence representations through repeated application. The iteration count is selected after training and controls effective depth at fixed model parameters. We train across recurrent depths with masked reconstruction, state regularization, and a one-sided loss that anchors deeper reconstruction to a shallow reference. On the 70-assay RNAGym fitness benchmark, increasing refinement from one to four iterations raises aggregate absolute Spearman correlation from 0.242 to 0.286, with the gain retained through eight iterations. At four iterations, Eco-RNA surpasses the current SOTA Evo 2 40B on all three aggregate fitness metrics despite 500x fewer parameters. Its iteration configurations advance the compute-performance Pareto frontier among the evaluated models. It also outperforms the evaluated baselines in non-coding RNA family classification, RNA secondary-structure prediction, and chemical probing profile prediction. These results establish internal inference computation as an effective scaling dimension for RNA foundation models.

AI.tldr: Eco-RNA是一个80M参数的RNA基础模型，通过训练后可调的迭代精炼实现推理深度可调，在RNAGym适应度基准上用500倍更少参数超越Evo 2 40B。
AI.motivation: RNA的生物功能编码于多尺度：从局部序列模体到长程结构依赖。传统RNA基础模型将参数容量与推理深度耦合在固定架构中，为每次推理预设固定的计算图，无法灵活调整推理时的有效计算量。
AI.method: 提出Eco-RNA，采用共享的、输入条件化的Transformer核心，通过重复应用对序列表示进行迭代精炼。迭代次数在训练后选择，在固定参数下控制有效深度。训练策略包含循环深度训练、掩码重建、状态正则化，以及一个将深层重建锚定到浅层参考的单侧损失。
AI.result: 在70个实验的RNAGym适应度基准上，精炼从1次增至4次使聚合绝对Spearman相关从0.242提升至0.286，该增益保持至8次迭代。在4次迭代下，Eco-RNA在三个聚合适应度指标上均超越当前SOTA Evo 2 40B，且参数少500倍。其迭代配置推动了所评估模型间计算-性能帕累托前沿。在非编码RNA家族分类、RNA二级结构预测和化学探测谱预测上也优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 内部推理计算是RNA基础模型的有效缩放维度，推理深度可作为独立于参数容量的可调缩放轴。

title: Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models
summary: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过行为与机制分析发现，LLM对"just"和"only"等话语小品词敏感，指令微调增强敏感性，且模型内部的小品词表征部分按语义组织，二者重叠呈现不对称性。
AI.motivation: 话语小品词（如just、only）虽高频出现，却因语义效果微妙而长期缺乏研究；作者希望探究LLM对其敏感度及其内部表征机制。
AI.method: 开展行为与机制分析：比较LLM与人类对粒子的偏好；在有无粒子条件下采样生成并评估模型对生成可能性的评分；定位LLM中粒子敏感单元并检验just与only的迁移性。
AI.result: LLM与人类都偏好粒子存在且更敏感于just；模型对含粒子生成赋予更高可能性；指令微调提升敏感性；仅only单元选择性迁移到排他性just，而just单元无论语义均可迁移到only，重叠不对称。
AI.conclusion: LLM话语小品词的词汇级表征部分按语义组织，且对粒子具有可测量的敏感性；指令微调强化该能力；资源已开源。

title: Humanize MLE Agents: Multi-Agent Session Alternation Beyond Single-Agent Limits
summary: Existing LLM-based agent approaches for long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) often use context engineering, implemented through custom harnesses that manage tools, skills, and accumulated experience. However, we find that as single-session execution lengthens, the agent's reasoning intensity declines alongside slowing progress, summarized as long-horizon deceleration, and the benefits of these custom harnesses vanish as the underlying model improves, summarized as harness staleness. These findings suggest that their benefits may not persist across versions, which motivates a workflow-level approach in which agents build on one another's work across sessions. We model these alternating agent sessions as a context-reset semi-Markov decision process (CR-SMDP) and establish sufficient conditions for alternation to exceed single-agent reference limits, derive an explicit experiment-budget bound, and characterize when session caps preserve this advantage. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Humanize MLE Agents (HMA), which alternates two agents on a shared workspace, limits each session to at most k experiments and resets the context between sessions, without additional task-specific harness or prior knowledge supplements. Across 75 Kaggle tasks in MLE-bench, HMA reaches a state-of-the-art any-medal rate of 78.2%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 8.0 points with a quarter of its time budget. Moreover, among six configurations spanning five heterogeneous agent pairs, HMA improves any-medal rate over the constituent baselines by 6.4 points on average, demonstrating cross-pair generality. A supplementary case on kernel optimization reaches 878 cycles, within 1.6% of the community leaderboard leader, demonstrating applicability beyond MLE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出跨会话交替智能体的工作流级方法HMA，并通过CR-SMDP理论分析证明其优于单会话长程执行的充分条件，在MLE-bench上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的长程机器学习工程代理依赖上下文工程，通过定制化harness管理工具、技能与经验。但作者发现两个问题：一是单会话执行变长时，推理强度下降、进度放缓（长程减速）；二是模型升级后定制harness的收益消失（harness过时）。这表明单会话harness的收益难以跨版本持续，因而需要转向工作流层面的方法，让智能体跨会话相互接续工作。
AI.method: 作者将交替的智能体会话建模为上下文重置半马尔可夫决策过程（CR-SMDP），建立交替优于单智能体参考上限的充分条件，推导显式实验预算界，并刻画会话上限何时能保持这一优势。据此提出HMA（Humanize MLE Agents）：在共享工作区上交替运行两个智能体，每个会话限制最多k次实验，并在会话间重置上下文，不依赖额外的任务特定harness或先验知识补充。
AI.result: 在MLE-bench的75个Kaggle任务上，HMA达到78.2%的any-medal率（SOTA），比最强开源基线高8.0个百分点，且仅用其四分之一时间预算。在覆盖五组异构智能体配对的六种配置中，HMA相对各组成基线平均提升6.4个百分点，体现跨配对通用性。在kernel优化的补充案例中达到878 cycles，距社区排行榜榜首仅1.6%，表明方法可推广至MLE之外。
AI.conclusion: 单会话定制harness的收益随模型迭代而衰减，工作流层面的跨会话交替是可扩展的替代范式。HMA以简单的交替+上下文重置+实验次数上限机制，无需任务特定harness即实现跨配对 generality 与跨领域适用性。

title: Deep Learning Approach for RealTime Contraction Detection in Laboring Dairy Cattle
summary: Currently, the animal production sector is undergoing rapid development of techniques that allow automatic monitoring of animal behaviour and health. This paper presents a computer vision-based approach for the automatic recognition of labor contractions in cows. During the course of the study, videos depicting 100 cow births were collected. From the obtained videos, 8500 cow contraction actions and about 25 000 non-contraction sequences were extracted which constituted the dataset. Leveraging image processing techniques and deep learning algorithms like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs), our methodology extracts relevant features from video frames to detect and classify contractions. Our study demonstrates a high accuracy rate of over 95% in detecting labor contractions. This automated system has the potential to enhance productivity and animal welfare in the dairy industry by providing real-time monitoring and facilitating timely intervention during difficult calvings. The video demonstration of the system can be found at the following URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8fTSG5D7dZ0

AI.tldr: 提出基于计算机视觉的奶牛分娩宫缩自动识别方法，利用CNN与ViT从视频帧提取特征进行检测分类，准确率超95%。
AI.motivation: 畜牧生产领域正快速发展动物行为与健康的自动监测技术；对奶牛分娩宫缩进行自动识别，可实现实时监测并在难产时及时干预，从而提升乳业生产效率与动物福利。
AI.method: 采集100头奶牛分娩视频，提取8500个宫缩动作样本与约25000个非宫缩序列构成数据集；结合图像处理技术与深度学习算法（卷积神经网络CNN、视觉Transformer ViT）从视频帧中提取特征，用于宫缩的检测与分类。
AI.result: 宫缩检测准确率超过95%；系统提供实时监测功能，并附有演示视频链接。
AI.conclusion: 该自动识别系统具备在乳业中提升生产效率与动物福利的潜力，可通过实时监测支持难产时的及时干预。

title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
summary: Continual post-training faces a dual challenge of acquisition and retention: models must learn new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge. While Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) mitigates this using self-supervision with in-context demonstrations, it relies on strong in-context learning and instruction-following abilities. Consequently, SDFT fails on smaller models critical for low-latency, on-device use. To enable continual learning at smaller scales, we first identify the root cause of failure. We show that poor acquisition and forgetting correlate linearly with the post-trained model's distribution shift, revealing the necessity of in-distribution learning. We thus introduce Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), imitating SDFT's in-distribution rewrite by outsourcing the task to a minimally larger, same-family aligner. Coupled with off-policy supervision and rejection sampling, this provides the high-quality supervision small models require without breaking their original distribution. Evaluations spanning 4 acquisition datasets (including a mixture) and 14 retention benchmarks show SynthSelf consistently outperforms 6 methods (including off- and on-policy distillation) across 3 small model scales. Extensive further analyses confirm SynthSelf paves the way toward effective small-model continual learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SynthSelf（Synthetic Self-Distillation），通过将 SDFT 的分布内重写任务外包给同族略大的对齐模型，并结合离策略监督与拒绝采样，解决了小模型在持续后训练中无法有效进行自蒸馏的问题。
AI.motivation: 持续后训练面临"习得新能力"与"保留旧知识"的双重挑战。Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning（SDFT）借助上下文演示与自监督缓解该问题，但其依赖强上下文学习与指令跟随能力，因此在低延迟、端侧部署所需的小模型上失效。作者旨在让小模型也能实现持续学习。
AI.method: 首先定位失败根因：实验表明习得效果差与遗忘程度均与后训练模型的分布偏移呈线性相关，说明分布内学习是必要条件。基于此提出 SynthSelf：将 SDFT 的分布内重写任务外包给同族、规模略大的对齐模型（aligner）来完成，从而在保持原始分布不被破坏的前提下，为小模型提供高质量监督；同时结合离策略监督（off-policy supervision）与拒绝采样。
AI.result: 在 4 个习得数据集（含一个混合数据集）与 14 个保留基准上进行评测，SynthSelf 在 3 种小模型规模上一致优于 6 种方法（包括离策略与在策略蒸馏）。
AI.conclusion: 大量进一步分析证实，SynthSelf 为小模型持续学习提供了有效路径。

title: REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment, Emotion, Politeness, and Formality
summary: Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer's self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). The resulting role-aware representations are fused with contextual embeddings through a learned gate that adaptively weights how much role information each input contributes, rather than appending semantic roles as an auxiliary feature vector. Across four benchmark datasets, the framework yields statistically reliable gains over strong BERT-based baselines for emotion, politeness, and formality, with gains concentrated in theoretically predicted cases such as low-frequency, complex emotions and highly polite expressions; sentiment improvements are marginal and non-significant, suggesting that sentiment is conveyed more through lexical choice than participant-role structure. Additional evaluation on real-world data demonstrates that the framework improves both predictive performance and model traceability. These results demonstrate that linguistically grounded modifications to transformer self-attention improve the detection of communicative meaning, generalize beyond benchmark datasets to real-world mental-health data, and yield traceable, role-grounded explanations that extend beyond predictive performance to interpretability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种角色感知的Transformer架构，将情感、情绪、礼貌、正式性四个维度映射到语义角色标注配置并融入自注意力机制，在多个基准及真实数据上提升了交际意义检测性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 对话中交际意义（情感、情绪、礼貌、正式性）的表达不仅依赖词汇内容，还依赖参与者角色结构，但现有方法依赖上下文语言表示，将语义角色视为隐式信息，未显式建模。
AI.method: 设计角色感知Transformer：将四个SEPF维度映射为理论支撑的SRL配置并直接注入自注意力；用非方向性角色感知注意力建模内部状态（情感、情绪），用方向性角色感知注意力建模发起者到接受者的外部线索（礼貌、正式性）；通过可学习门控将角色感知表示与上下文嵌入自适应融合，而非将角色作为辅助特征向量拼接。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上，情绪、礼貌、正式性相对强BERT基线取得统计显著增益，且增益集中于理论预测情形（低频复杂情绪、高礼貌表达）；情感提升边缘且不显著，说明情感更多由词汇选择而非角色结构传递；真实世界数据评估显示预测性能与模型可追溯性均提升。
AI.conclusion: 语言学驱动的自注意力修改能提升交际意义检测，可泛化至真实心理健康数据，并提供超越预测性能的角色化可追溯解释。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Language Model with Heterogeneous Evidence Integration for Clinical Prognosis
summary: Clinical prognosis requires integrating structured measurements, physiological waveforms, longitudinal history, and population context. We introduce PRISM (Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis), a multimodal language model that combines per-feature numerical tokenization, recency-weighted aggregation of longitudinal ECGs, and a dual-modality population memory bank. Retrieval operates in representation space: the model receives mean-pooled embeddings of similar training-cohort encounters, while no individual retrieved record enters the prompt. On the 1,443-task MDS-ED benchmark, PRISM achieves AUROCs of 86.2% for diagnosis, 93.1% for deterioration, 91.8% for ICU admission, and 92.8% for mortality. These results use a 96-hour pre-arrival window unavailable to reported baselines. With benchmark-window inputs only, PRISM reaches 0.8895 AUROC, compared with 0.8937 for UniPACT and 0.8889 for MDS-ED. A matched-input compact fusion model using the same five evidence streams and frozen encoders reaches 0.7652 AUROC, versus 0.9092 for PRISM. Replacing numerical EHR encoding with text serialization reduces AUROC by 3.66 points; removing pre-arrival history reduces it by 1.97 points; and zeroing retrieval reduces it by 0.99 points. Genuine retrieval outperforms random-neighbor retrieval by 0.97 macro-average points, although a paired task-level sign test does not establish a uniform advantage (p=0.067). On the external MC-MED cohort, supervised fine-tuning reaches 0.8611 AUROC, compared with 0.8227 for locally trained gradient boosting and 0.7841 for source-only PRISM. These results support structure-aware multimodal integration and supervised external adaptation.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一种多模态语言模型，通过逐特征数值化、纵向ECG近因加权聚合和双模态人群记忆库检索，整合结构化测量、生理波形、纵向病史与人群上下文，在MDS-ED与MC-MED基准上取得领先的临床预后性能。
AI.motivation: 临床预后需要同时整合结构化测量、生理波形、纵向病史与人群背景等多源异构信息，现有方法在跨模态融合与人群先验利用上存在不足，且基线通常缺乏到达前（pre-arrival）窗口信息。
AI.method: 提出PRISM多模态语言模型，包含三项核心设计：逐特征数值分词（numerical tokenization）；纵向ECG的近因加权聚合（recency-weighted aggregation）；双模态人群记忆库（dual-modality population memory bank）。检索在表示空间进行，模型仅接收相似训练队列就诊记录的均值池化嵌入，原始个体记录不进入提示词。
AI.result: 在1,443任务的MDS-ED基准上，诊断AUROC 86.2%、恶化93.1%、ICU入住91.8%、死亡92.8%（使用96小时到达前窗口）。仅用基准窗口输入时为0.8895 AUROC，对比UniPACT 0.8937、MDS-ED 0.8889。相同五路证据流与冻结编码器的紧凑融合模型为0.7652，PRISM为0.9092。消融显示：文本序列化替代数值EHR编码降3.66点，移除到达前病史降1.97点，检索置零降0.99点；真实检索较随机邻居检索高0.97宏观平均点，但配对任务级符号检验未证实一致优势（p=0.067）。在外部MC-MED队列上，监督微调达0.8611 AUROC，优于本地训练的梯度提升0.8227和仅源域PRISM 0.7841。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持结构感知的多模态整合与监督式外部适配策略，数值化编码、纵向病史与表示空间检索均为性能关键因素。

title: Vision Transformers Learn Word Meaning from Images Alone
summary: Can a vision model learn what words mean from pixels alone? We show that the two largest DINOv3 vision transformers organize words rendered in images by word meaning, despite being pretrained using self-supervision on images only, without paired captions, class labels, or other language supervision. We derive word representations from embedding differences between word images and matched controls, then test whether semantically related words are neighbors within each model's embedding space, while controlling for spelling similarity. We find that brand names in the same industry group together, as do nouns from the same semantic domain. Country-capital pairs exhibit consistent vector offsets, similarly to word embeddings trained on text. These word representations also align with the representations of the visual object categories they name. DINOv3-H and DINOv3-7B are, to our knowledge, the first self-supervised vision models to show substantial semantic structure for rendered words. Comparisons with text and speech encoders reveal shared structure among representations of the same words. Contrastive alignment with either encoder further strengthened DINOv3-H's word-level semantic structure, while leaving the other finetuned vision models largely unchanged. Image-only training can therefore teach vision models not just what words look like, but also how their meanings relate.

AI.tldr: DINOv3视觉Transformer仅凭自监督图像预训练，就能在嵌入空间中按语义组织渲染单词，展现出文本式语义结构。
AI.motivation: 探究纯视觉自监督模型能否仅从像素中习得词义，即是否存在无需语言监督的词义语义结构。
AI.method: 以DINOv3-H与DINOv3-7B为对象，用"单词图像减配对控制图像"的嵌入差提取词表示；在控制拼写相似度后检验语义邻近性、同域聚类、国家—首都向量偏移，并对比文本/语音编码器，再做对比对齐微调。
AI.result: 同行业品牌名、同语义域名词彼此邻近；国家—首都呈一致向量偏移；词表示与其所指视觉类别的表示对齐；与文本/语音编码器存在共享结构；对比对齐增强DINOv3-H词级语义结构，其他微调模型基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 纯图像训练可让视觉模型不只学会词的"形"，还学到词义间的关联，是首批展现渲染单词显著语义结构的自监督视觉模型。

title: WaSA: Wavelet Scattering Autoencoders for Unsupervised Offline Detection of Malicious Clients in Federated Learning
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Omni-Layer Intelligent Systems (COINS) 2026, Bologna, Italy; September 7-9, 2026
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without exposing raw data, yet remains vulnerable to malicious clients injecting poisoned datasets. Existing defenses are typically reactive (operating during training) or supervised (requiring prior knowledge of attack types) - assumptions that rarely hold in open-ended IoT deployments. We propose WaSA, a fully unsupervised, offline framework for malicious client detection. Before training, each client transmits a single, privacy-preserving spectral summary of its data to the server. A denoising autoencoder, trained solely on clean auxiliary data, scores clients based on their deviation from the learned benign manifold, identifying corruptions regardless of the attack type. WaSA requires no attack labels, generalizes to unseen anomalies, and introduces a Boltzmann sampling strategy for client selection that smoothly interpolates between hard exclusion and standard aggregation. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under diverse attack scenarios (up to 90 % malicious clients) demonstrate consistent improvements over supervised baselines and robust aggregation methods, with negligible communication overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/alelicciardi99/wavelet_autoencoders_malicious.

AI.tldr: 提出WaSA：一种全无监督、离线的恶意客户端检测框架。训练前各客户端上传隐私保护的谱摘要，服务器用以纯辅助干净数据训练的降噪自编码器依据偏离良性流形的程度打分，实现与攻击类型无关的检测，并以Boltzmann采样在硬排除与标准聚合间平滑插值。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽不暴露原始数据，但仍易受恶意客户端投毒攻击；现有防御多为训练中进行的反应式方法或需预先知道攻击类型的监督式方法，在开放式IoT部署中难以满足。
AI.method: 该方法包含三部分：1）客户端在训练前仅发送单份隐私保护的谱摘要（spectral summary）；2）服务器使用仅在干净辅助数据上训练的降噪自编码器（denoising autoencoder），按客户端偏离学习到的良性流形程度进行打分，从而在无需攻击标签条件下识别任意类型的污染；3）引入Boltzmann采样策略进行客户端选择，在硬排除与标准聚合之间平滑插值。
AI.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100上，在多种攻击场景（恶意客户端比例高达90%）下，相比监督式基线和鲁棒聚合方法取得一致提升，且通信开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: WaSA验证了全无监督、离线的谱摘要加降噪自编码器方案在极端恶意比例下仍具鲁棒性，能够泛化到未见异常并保持低通信开销，为开放式部署中的投毒防御提供了可行路径。

title: Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR
summary: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37--38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.

AI.tldr: 该论文在四种低资源语言和英语的五个数据规模上，交叉比较了音频层面（速度扰动、SpecAugment）与文本层面（转录修改并合成音频）的数据增强方法，并在音素层面分析错误。研究发现两类方法因互补原因而有效：SpecAugment 聚合提升最可靠但增加声调与腭化错误，文本方法引入辅音插入错误，二者结合可相互抵消各自引入的错误。这种互补性可预测：声调与腭化各由单一声学属性标识且在训练中出现最少，文本方法压平词频使其频率提高37–38%，从而逆转这些错误。组合方法的提升超过各自单独提升之和（超加性），但该效应在100小时后消失，将互补性限制在低资源范围。建议在关注特定错误类型时，依据训练暴露度与声学属性选择增强方法，二者均可在训练前测量。
AI.motivation: 低资源自动语音识别中数据增强虽属标准做法，但其收益几乎总是以总体错误率报告，无法解释某方法为何以及在何时有效。论文旨在揭示增强方法起作用的机制与适用条件，特别是错误类型的层面。
AI.method: 在四种低资源语言及英语、五种数据规模下，交叉组合两类增强：修改现有音频的方法（速度扰动、SpecAugment）与修改文本转录并据此合成音频的方法。对识别结果进行音素级错误分析，并考察训练暴露度、声学属性与词频变化对特定错误类型的影响。
AI.result: SpecAugment 的总体改进最稳定，但会增加声调与腭化错误；文本类方法则引入辅音插入错误。两者结合时各自减少对方引入的错误。声调与腭化各由单一声学属性标识，且在训练中暴露度最低；压平词频的文本方法将其出现频率提高37–38%，从而逆转这些错误并进一步改善总体错误。组合方法的改进超过各方法单独改进之和，表现出超加性，但该效应在100小时数据量时消失。
AI.conclusion: 音频类与文本类增强通过互补机制提升低资源 ASR，其互补性可由训练暴露度和声学属性预测，且仅在低资源区间（约100小时以下）成立。在关注特定错误类型时，应依据训练前即可测量的暴露度与声学属性来选择增强方法。

title: Causal Effect Identifiability in Causal Abstractions: A Strict Hierarchy of Criteria
summary: Identifying causal effects from observational data typically requires a fully specified causal graph, an assumption that is often unrealistic in complex or high-dimensional settings. Causal abstractions address this limitation by retaining only partial causal information, thereby defining equivalence classes of compatible causal graphs. In this paper, we study causal effect identifiability directly at the level of these graph collections, rather than at the level of individual causal diagrams. We formalize several notions of identifiability in this setting and organize them into a hierarchy that clarifies their relationships and differences. In particular, we establish that a causal effect may be identified over a collection of graphs without admitting a single causal derivation that holds uniformly across all compatible graphs. These results help reveal gaps and clarify ambiguities in the existing literature.

AI.tldr: 本文将因果效应可识别性问题从单个因果图层面提升到因果抽象（图集合）层面，形式化了若干可识别性概念并组织成层级结构，揭示出效应可在图集合上被识别而无需存在对所有兼容图一致成立的单一因果推导。
AI.motivation: 传统因果效应识别要求完整指定的因果图，在复杂或高维场景下该假设往往不现实。因果抽象通过仅保留部分因果信息、定义兼容因果图的等价类来缓解该问题，但现有文献对"在图集合层面如何定义与理解可识别性"尚不清晰，存在空白与歧义。
AI.method: 作者直接在因果抽象所定义的图集合层面（而非单个因果图层面）研究因果效应可识别性：形式化该设定下的若干可识别性概念，并将其组织为一个层级结构以厘清各概念之间的关系与差异。
AI.result: 建立了可识别性概念的层级关系；特别证明了因果效应可以在一个图集合上被识别，却不存在对所有兼容图一致成立的单一因果推导，即"集合层面的可识别性"弱于/不同于"存在统一推导"。
AI.conclusion: 在因果抽象层面研究可识别性有助于揭示现有文献中的空白并澄清其模糊之处，为部分因果信息下的效应识别提供了更一般的分析框架。

title: Beyond a Single Crop: Contextualized Embeddings for Player Re-Identification
summary:
Person re-identification is typically addressed by learning identity-discriminative embeddings from individual person crops. However, player re-identification in broadcast sports videos presents a unique challenge: players from the same team often share similar appearances, while video sequences provide repeated observations of the same players under different viewpoints and surrounding contexts. Existing crop-based approaches largely ignore this contextual information, which can be critical for resolving visually similar identities.
  Here, we propose ContextReID, a contextualized embedding framework that represents a player by jointly considering other players in the same frame and observations from different frames of the broadcast sequence. By incorporating both co-occurring players and cross-frame observations, the model learns identity features relative to the surrounding visual context rather than relying only on isolated appearance cues. We implement this framework with a vision-language model that takes sets of player crops as input and generates context-aware embeddings for individual players. A combined contextual learning and retrieval objective encourages the model to capture cross-frame identity relationships while maintaining discriminative embeddings for player matching.
  Experiments across three multi-object tracking benchmarks show that ContextReID improves player retrieval over conventional single-crop embedding approaches in both Rank-1 and mAP. These results highlight the utility of spatial and temporal context for reliable player identification in broadcast sports videos.

AI.tldr: 提出ContextReID框架，通过联合建模同帧其他球员与跨帧观测的时空上下文，为体育转播视频中的球员学习上下文感知嵌入，在三个MOT基准上提升检索Rank-1与mAP。
AI.motivation: 传统行人重识别依赖单人裁剪图的身份判别性嵌入，但广播体育视频中同队球员外观高度相似，单裁剪方法忽略了对区分相似身份至关重要的上下文信息。
AI.method: ContextReID以视觉-语言模型为骨干，输入球员裁剪图集合，联合同帧共现球员与跨帧观测生成上下文感知嵌入；采用上下文学习与检索相结合的联合目标，在保持判别性的同时捕捉跨帧身份关系。
AI.result: 在三个多目标跟踪基准上，ContextReID相较传统单裁剪嵌入方法在Rank-1和mAP上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 空间与时间上下文对广播体育视频中可靠的球员身份识别具有重要价值。

title: Does Learning Recurrent Networks Matter in Partially Observable RL?
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) under partial observability typically re- lies on recurrent networks to encode temporal information, with the recurrent module trained jointly with the policy or value function. This raises a natural question: is learning the recurrent network actually necessary? In this paper, we investigate whether a frozen recurrent network can provide sufficient memory for solving par- tially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). Motivated by the theoretical foundations of Reservoir Computing (RC) and Generalized Reservoir Computing (GRC), we study a simple archi- tecture that combines a fixed recurrent network with a trainable nonlinear output module. We evaluate this approach across tasks with varying memory demands, observation modalities, and action spaces. Surprisingly, frozen recurrent networks support recall over hundreds of steps and achieve competitive control performance across diverse POMDPs, while using less than half the number of trainable parameters required by their fully trainable counterparts. These results suggest that learning the recurrent memory module is not always necessary for solving POMDPs. Frozen recurrent networks therefore provide a simple, parameter-efficient, and sur- prisingly strong baseline for partially observable RL. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Aphlios/FRN-POMDP

AI.tldr: 该文探究部分可观测强化学习(POMDP)中循环网络是否必须训练，发现冻结的循环网络配合可训练非线性输出模块即可提供足够记忆，在多个任务上达到有竞争力的控制性能，且可训练参数不足全训练版本的一半。
AI.motivation: 现有POMDP强化学习方法通常依赖循环网络编码时序信息，并与策略或价值函数联合训练。作者提出疑问：循环网络的学习是否真的必要？期望验证冻结循环网络能否作为足够的记忆模块。
AI.method: 受储层计算(Reservoir Computing, RC)与广义储层计算(GRC)理论启发，构建一种简单架构：固定的循环网络 + 可训练的非线性输出模块。在具有不同记忆需求、观测模态与动作空间的任务上进行评估，并与全可训练基线对比参数量与性能。
AI.result: 冻结的循环网络可支持上百步的回忆能力，在多种POMDP上取得有竞争力的控制性能，同时可训练参数量不到全训练对应方法的一半。
AI.conclusion: 学习循环记忆模块并非解决POMDP的必要条件。冻结循环网络为部分可观测强化学习提供了一个简单、参数高效且性能出乎意料的强基线；源代码已开源。

title: Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection
summary: A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say "I don't know." Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model's calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the TriviaQA finding. Our results support learning to select answers in this setting while showing that reliable abstention across datasets remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 在Qwen3-14B的事实性问答上比较"训练模型自身"与"训练独立答案选择器"两种改进弃答决策的途径；学习式答案选择器在TriviaQA上以覆盖率与错误率指标优于原模型校准置信度过滤，但RL方法未取得一致增益，且跨数据集可靠弃答仍未解决。
AI.motivation: 语言模型应知道何时作答、何时说"我不知道"。作者想验证：改进这一弃答决策，是靠训练模型本身，还是训练一个独立组件来核查其答案更有效。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3-14B，针对事实性问题，采用同时奖励正确答案、惩罚错误、允许弃答的评分函数。在3个训练随机种子与2个留出置信度阈值下，比较学习式答案选择器与原始模型校准置信度过滤；并测试了若干强化学习改动。指标为阈值平均效用、覆盖率、评分答案池化错误率（精确匹配评分），并在NQ-Open上做对照，另进行部分人工复核审计。
AI.result: TriviaQA上，学习式答案选择器在阈值平均效用上优于原模型置信度过滤：平均覆盖率由20.2%升至30.9%，评分答案池化错误率由23.0%降至14.5%。强化学习改动未显示一致增益。NQ-Open上，选择器优于过滤器但仍差于"始终弃答"。部分人工复核审计支持TriviaQA结论。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定下支持"学习选择答案"的做法，但跨数据集实现可靠弃答仍是未解决问题。

title: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) by routing domain-specific data to specialized teachers, integrating their capabilities through dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, domain routing only distinguishes the supervision sources for different domains; updates from all domains still act on shared parameters. When teachers differ substantially in response style and domain expertise, supervision that is effective in isolation may still lead to persistent gradient conflicts and capability degradation during joint optimization. To address this challenge, we propose Cross-Teacher Guarding for MOPD (Road MOPD), which introduces non-routed teachers as auxiliary cross-domain critics on the same student trajectories and coordinates multi-teacher supervision through token-level credit assignment and gradient updates. Specifically, cross-teacher-guided credit assignment uses teacher agreement to strengthen token-level corrections jointly supported by the teachers and attenuate conflicting signals; preventive multi-teacher gradient projection uses auxiliary gradients from the same trajectories to constrain potentially conflicting updates and adaptively controls projection strength to retain target-domain learning signals. In experiments, Road MOPD mitigates degradation in the disadvantaged domain, gains over 5 percentage points under high conflict, and improves overall performance in low-conflict and three-domain settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Road MOPD，通过引入非路由教师作为跨域批评者，利用令牌级信用分配与多教师梯度投影缓解 MOPD 中的梯度冲突与能力退化问题。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）虽按域路由专门教师，但所有域的更新仍作用于共享参数；当教师响应风格与领域专长差异显著时，各域独立有效的监督在联合优化中会引发持续的梯度冲突，导致能力退化，尤其在弱势域上。
AI.method: 提出 Cross-Teacher Guarding for MOPD（Road MOPD）：将非路由教师作为同一学生轨迹上的跨域辅助批评者，并通过令牌级信用分配与梯度更新协调多教师监督。具体包括：(1) 跨教师引导的信用分配，利用教师间一致性增强被共同支持令牌的校正、衰减冲突信号；(2) 预防性多教师梯度投影，利用同轨迹的辅助梯度约束潜在冲突更新，并自适应控制投影强度以保留目标域学习信号。
AI.result: 实验表明 Road MOPD 缓解了弱势域的退化，在高冲突场景下提升超过 5 个百分点，并在低冲突及三域设置中改善整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨域教师作为辅助批评者并对多教师监督进行令牌级信用分配与梯度投影协调，可有效缓解 MOPD 的梯度冲突，实现多域能力的稳定联合优化。

title: SheafPrune: Sheaf-Guided Graph Propagation for Visual Token Pruning
summary: Multimodal large language models process the complete visual token sequence, increasing prefill cost even when many tokens are irrelevant to the instruction. Token-wise saliency captures limited inter-token dependence; graph-based selection instead depends on how relations govern importance propagation and ranking. We study support-constrained propagation with node-degree correction. Inspired by sheaf geometry, SheafPrune uses modality-specific maps and a sparse text--visual graph to transfer relevance, then propagates scores on a separate visual graph and corrects them for degree. It retains a hard top-$k$ subset once before the frozen language model. The selector has about $4.5$M parameters and is trained end-to-end through the frozen LLaVA-NeXT-8B backbone using only the language-modeling objective. Explicit retention-ratio conditioning lets one checkpoint serve every budget. Across four backbones, ten benchmarks and seven pruning ratios, with all baselines re-implemented under one protocol, SheafPrune achieves the best retention at $22$ of $28$ backbone--budget settings, with monotonically growing margins in the moderate-to-aggressive regime. On LLaVA-NeXT, retaining $10\%$ of visual tokens yields a $5.15\times$ net prefill speedup and an $84.0\%$ end-to-end FLOPs reduction. Together with component ablations, these results support graph-constrained importance propagation and degree correction as a design for visual token selection across the evaluated backbones and tokenization schemes, improving the trade-off between accuracy retention and inference cost. code:https://github.com/Bob0817912/SheafPrune_ICLR_2027

AI.tldr: SheafPrune 提出基于层（sheaf）几何启发的图约束重要性传播与度数校正，用于多模态大模型视觉 token 剪枝，仅用一个约 4.5M 参数的选择器即可在多种骨干与预算下取得最佳精度保留与显著加速。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型需处理完整视觉 token 序列，即便大量 token 与指令无关，prefill 成本依然高昂。现有 token 级显著性方法只能捕捉有限的 token 间依赖，而基于图的筛选效果取决于关系如何支配重要性的传播与排序，因此需要研究在关系约束下进行重要性传播的剪枝设计。
AI.method: 受 sheaf 几何启发，SheafPrune 使用模态特定的映射（modality-specific maps）与稀疏的文本-视觉图来传递相关性；随后在独立的视觉图上传播分数，并依据节点度数进行校正。该方法在冻结语言模型前只保留一次硬 top-k 子集。选择器约 4.5M 参数，通过冻结的 LLaVA-NeXT-8B 骨干以纯语言建模目标端到端训练；显式的保留率条件（retention-ratio conditioning）使单一 checkpoint 可服务任意预算。
AI.result: 在四个骨干、十个 benchmark、七种剪枝比例下，所有基线在同一协议下重新实现，SheafPrune 在 28 个骨干-预算设置中 22 个取得最佳保留率，且在中度至激进区间优势单调增长。在 LLaVA-NeXT 上，仅保留 10% 视觉 token 即获得 5.15 倍净 prefill 加速与 84.0% 端到端 FLOPs 降低。组件消融进一步验证了各设计的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将图约束的重要性传播与度数校正作为视觉 token 选择的设计范式，在所评估的骨干与 tokenization 方案中均能改善精度保留与推理成本之间的权衡。

title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
summary: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.

AI.tldr: 提出S$^3$R方法，用稀疏注意力起草、全注意力验证的推测式采样加速长上下文RLVR的rollout生成，在保持稠密策略响应分布的同时实现约1.35--1.39倍端到端训练吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文RLVR的rollout生成受限于KV-cache流量，而注意力占自回归解码核时间的72--76%。稀疏注意力虽能减少读取，但直接从稀疏策略采样会改变用于策略优化的响应分组；在组相对优化下，即使进行精确的响应级重加权也无法恢复预期的稠密策略更新，因为每个响应的优势依赖于同组其他响应的奖励。
AI.method: S$^3$R（Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts）：利用稀疏注意力提出token，再通过全注意力验证与精确推测采样生成响应；起草与验证共享同一策略参数，无需训练或更新独立drafter。同时刻画加速条件与起草、验证开销，并设计KV感知调度器以限制KV-cache的反复卸载与恢复，同时维持rollout并行度。
AI.result: 在激进稀疏起草预算的匹配消融中，S$^3$R保持训练稳定，而带训练侧校正的直接稀疏采样变得不稳定。在长上下文数学推理任务上，S$^3$R在Qwen3模型上达到自回归rollout端到端训练吞吐的1.39×~1.35×，任务性能相当。
AI.conclusion: S$^3$R通过自稀疏推测式rollout在不改变用于策略优化的响应分布的前提下加速长上下文RLVR训练，兼顾稳定性与吞吐，并揭示稠密验证仍需完整历史KV-cache，需配合KV感知调度。

title: Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models
summary: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.

AI.tldr: 研究发现任务上下文会改变共享注意力头所响应的图事实及其对后续计算的影响，网络视角有助于解释模型如何用共享参数完成不同计算。
AI.motivation: 大模型在不同任务间复用相同的注意力头，但仅识别这些共享头无法解释它们在各任务中功能上究竟有何不同。
AI.method: 借鉴共享脑区间的任务依赖交互，采用网络视角，用相同的图事实比较跨任务固定组件；测量干预对注意力头及后续层激活状态的影响（influence）和对答案的影响（importance）；对Gemma-2-9B和Qwen3-14B构造激活编辑前后两个线性响应图，用早期头的测量变化预测后续头的响应。
AI.result: 任务变化会重新分配影响，涉及4个模型家族的5个开放权重模型（1.5–14B）。在Gemma-2-9B和Qwen3-14B中，激活编辑可改变早期内部激活向量，在书面指令不变的情况下切换模型读取的事实，同一批头随后对不同图事实产生响应并不同地影响后续组件。对另一独立事实干预，对应条件的响应图相较两图平均将预测均方误差降低53.6%（Gemma）和5.0%（Qwen）。
AI.conclusion: 任务上下文同时改变共享组件响应的图事实及其输出对后续计算的影响；网络式解释有助于理解模型如何用共享参数执行不同计算，任务依赖影响的测量也可指导在改变某一行为时保留其他行为的干预。

title: MAGMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Embodied Agents under Dynamic Tasks and Execution Failures
summary: Long-horizon embodied agents must maintain task-relevant information, coordinate heterogeneous robots, and adapt their decisions as execution unfolds. Existing benchmarks investigate dynamic task execution and embodied multi-agent coordination, but provide limited evaluation of their intersection. We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark for persistent task reasoning in dynamic multi-robot environments. MAGMA-Bench evaluates agents across increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations, including execution failures, task interruptions, and mission updates, with scenarios requiring coordination across robots with heterogeneous capabilities. It uses a structured skill-level interface to separate task-level reasoning from perception and low-level control. We evaluate locally deployable open-weight planners, multi-agent state-tracking strategies, and frontier models. Even the strongest evaluated models fail on a substantial fraction of clean episodes, and their success rates decrease further under online perturbations. Supervised adaptation greatly improves a small model, but performance remains substantially lower on longer and multi-robot missions. We release the benchmark, 261,646 task-level training examples, and an architecture-agnostic expert-trace generation pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出 MAGMA-Bench，一个架构无关的基准，用于动态多机器人环境中的持久任务推理，评估长时程协调与在线扰动下的表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程具身智能体需维护任务相关信息、协调异构机器人并随执行过程调整决策。现有基准分别研究动态任务执行与具身多智能体协调，但对其交叉领域评估不足，因此需要一个同时覆盖两者的基准。
AI.method: MAGMA-Bench 通过递增任务长度与受控在线扰动（执行失败、任务中断、任务更新）来评估智能体，场景要求异构能力机器人间协调。采用结构化技能级接口，将任务级推理与感知、底层控制解耦。评估对象包括本地可部署的开源权重规划器、多智能体状态跟踪策略以及前沿模型。
AI.result: 即使最强模型在无扰动（clean）回合中仍有相当比例失败，在线扰动下成功率进一步下降。监督式适配可显著提升小模型表现，但在更长任务和多机器人任务上性能仍明显偏低。
AI.conclusion: MAGMA-Bench 填补了动态任务执行与多机器人协调交叉评估的空白，揭示当前模型在持久任务推理上的不足。发布基准、261,646 条任务级训练样本及架构无关的专家轨迹生成流水线。

title: CV-OPD: Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, contrastive learning for on-policy distillation of VLMs. Computer Vision. Post-training. VLM. LLM
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reveals versatility and convenience during VLM post-training, providing dense supervision for student from teacher. However, we observed an anomaly that the distilled VLM could still answer the questions accurately even when the related visual regions were masked or replaced with noise. Building on this observation, our quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that OPD, which uses the answer as a hint, has failed to teach students to genuinely seek out and rely on visual evidence. Our theoretical analysis suggests that this failure arises from a shortcut enabled by the lack of visual constraints during distillation. To address the issue, we introduce Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation (CV-OPD), which compares teacher distributions induced by positive and negative crops while conditioning on the same student prefix and augments optimization with a margin-based contrastive constraint, which is modulated with discrepancy gating across token and sample level. Specifically, CV-OPD first introduces a negative teacher unrelated to the answer and designs a Contrastive Divergence Loss (CDL) that constrains the feature distribution of student by contrasting the positive and negative teachers, correcting how the student exploits visual regions. The CV-OPD introduces a Discrepancy Aware Gate (DAG) that uses token-level and sample-level discrepancies to select visually relevant tokens for optimization, directing the student's attention toward visual content. Extensive experiments across a broad range of fine-grained visual benchmarks demonstrate that CV-OPD substantially alleviates shortcut and consistently improves the visual reasoning capabilities of existing VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现on-policy distillation (OPD)在VLM后训练中存在“视觉捷径”问题——学生模型即使在关键视觉区域被遮蔽或替换为噪声时仍能正确作答，说明其未真正依赖视觉证据。作者提出对比视觉on-policy蒸馏（CV-OPD），通过对比正/负教师分布并引入边际对比约束与差异门控，缓解捷径并提升视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: OPD在VLM后训练中提供了来自教师的密集监督，便利且通用，但作者观察到异常现象：蒸馏后的VLM在相关视觉区域被遮蔽或加噪时仍能准确作答。定量与定性实验表明，以答案为提示的OPD未能教会学生真正寻找并依赖视觉证据；理论分析指出该失败源于蒸馏过程中缺乏视觉约束所导致的捷径。
AI.method: 提出Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation (CV-OPD)：在相同学生前缀条件下，比较由正、负裁剪诱导的教师分布，并以边际对比约束增强优化，且通过token级与样本级的差异门控进行调制。具体包括：(1) 引入与答案无关的负教师，设计Contrastive Divergence Loss (CDL)，通过对比正负教师约束学生特征分布，纠正学生对视觉区域的利用方式；(2) 引入Discrepancy Aware Gate (DAG)，利用token级与样本级差异筛选视觉相关token进行优化，引导学生注意力转向视觉内容。
AI.result: 在广泛的细粒度视觉基准上开展的大量实验表明，CV-OPD显著缓解了捷径问题，并持续提升现有VLM的视觉推理能力。
AI.conclusion: CV-OPD通过对比正负教师分布与差异门控机制，有效纠正了OPD中的视觉捷径，使蒸馏后的VLM真正依赖视觉证据，从而在细粒度视觉任务上稳定提升视觉推理性能。

title: Rethinking Relative Policy Differences Transfer of On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target. Recent work relaxes this requirement by transferring the relative policy difference between an expert and a reference policy rather than the expert's absolute distribution. Yet it remains unclear which differences provide useful supervision and which targets can benefit from them. We develop a unified view in which the log-probability ratio between a proxy expert and a proxy reference defines an implicit reward for KL-regularized policy optimization. This formulation induces an on-policy update for the target, recovers conventional OPD as a special case, and enables any-to-any transfer across models that differ in scale, training stage or generation. Our systematic experiments yield three findings. First, a stronger expert is not necessarily a better source of supervision: differences induced by task-specific training, including reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning, transfer consistently, whereas those arising from model scale alone transfer weakly or not at all. Second, the expert and reference serve complementary roles: the expert provides the capability to be transferred, while the reference filters out shared behavior and isolates the relevant residual. Third, even a useful difference does not transfer to every target: success requires the induced update to move the target toward the expert and generalize beyond sampled rollouts. Raw policy distance does not predict transferability, whereas an appropriate reference can rescue otherwise unsuccessful transfer. These results characterize when relative policy differences provide effective supervision for OPD.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一视角：用代理专家与代理参考策略的对数概率比定义KL正则策略优化的隐式奖励，将传统on-policy蒸馏（OPD）作为特例，并实现任意模型间的差异迁移。系统实验表明：任务特定训练（RL/SFT）产生的差异可稳定迁移，而单纯模型规模差异迁移效果弱；专家提供待迁移能力，参考策略过滤共同行为；迁移成功需更新推动目标靠近专家并泛化到采样之外，原始策略距离无法预测可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 传统OPD依赖教师显著强于目标策略，虽已有工作通过迁移专家与参考策略的相对策略差异放宽此限制，但仍不清楚哪些差异是有用监督、哪些目标能从中受益。作者旨在系统刻画相对策略差异何时构成有效监督。
AI.method: 提出统一理论框架：将代理专家与代理参考策略间的对数概率比解释为KL正则策略优化的隐式奖励，由此导出目标策略的on-policy更新，将传统OPD恢复为特例，并支持跨规模、训练阶段、生成方式的任意迁移。基于该框架开展系统实验分析差异来源、专家-参考角色及目标特性对迁移的影响。
AI.result: 三项发现：（1）更强的专家未必是更好的监督来源——任务特定训练（含强化学习与监督微调）产生的差异可稳定迁移，单纯模型规模差异迁移弱甚至不迁移；（2）专家与参考互补——专家提供待迁移能力，参考过滤共同行为、分离相关残差；（3）有用差异并非对每个目标都可迁移——需更新推动目标靠近专家且泛化超出采样rollout；原始策略距离无法预测可迁移性，而合适的参考可挽救原本失败的迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了相对策略差异何时能为OPD提供有效监督，给出统一理论解释与可迁移性条件，指出专家强度非决定因素、参考策略的关键过滤作用，并强调迁移需兼顾靠近专家与泛化能力。

title: Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing
summary: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model's preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens. Under tight length limits, it improves Smatch++ over local masking by 5.1 and 2.4 points on DRS and by 6.4 and 3.2 points on AMR, comparable to rollback under the same limit, which retracts tokens. For post hoc processing, invalid outputs concentrate on the same inputs: eight unconstrained samples yield no valid output for 10.2% of inputs with limited training data, compared with 0.4% with full data, where filtering comes within 0.2 Smatch++ points of APD. For training, penalizing automaton-rejected tokens improves development Smatch++ by 3.6-11.0 points after 10% of training, but this advantage diminishes as cross-entropy alone reduces the probability assigned to rejected tokens from 14% to below 2% within the first sixth of training with limited data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出接受路径解码（APD），在解码、后处理与训练三阶段引入结构化自动机约束，保证DRS/AMR语义解析在固定长度下生成合法输出，并系统分析各阶段有效性。
AI.motivation: 神经语义解析逐token生成，良构性依赖生成过程中的引用、作用域与图关系。局部约束解码只能排除局部非法token，无法保证合法前缀能在固定输出长度内被完成，因此需要研究结构化自动机在解码、后处理与训练各阶段的作用。
AI.method: 在DRS解析的解码、事后处理与训练三阶段引入结构化自动机，并在AMR上评估解码。解码阶段提出接受路径解码（APD）：在剩余长度限制内维持一个已验证的可完成路径，优先采用模型偏好的token，只要该token仍可被完成；APD无需回退token即可保证被接受的输出。事后处理分析非法输出与输入的对应关系。训练阶段对自动机拒绝的token施加惩罚。
AI.result: 严格长度限制下，APD相对局部掩码在DRS上Smatch++提升5.1与2.4分，在AMR上提升6.4与3.2分，与同限制下需回退token的rollback相当。事后处理中非法输出集中于相同输入：训练数据有限时，八个无约束样本对10.2%的输入无有效输出，数据充足时仅0.4%，此时过滤仅比APD低0.2个Smatch++。训练中惩罚自动机拒绝token在训练10%后使开发集Smatch++提升3.6–11.0分，但随交叉熵单独将拒绝token概率在前六分之一训练内由14%降至2%以下，该优势逐渐消失。
AI.conclusion: 结构化自动机约束在各阶段均有价值：APD在不回退token的前提下保证合法输出并显著提升严格长度下的性能；事后过滤在数据充足时接近APD，说明非法输出与输入高度相关；训练期惩罚在早期有效，但交叉熵本身会迅速降低拒绝token概率，使该优势随训练减弱。

title: Constructing Pareto Frontiers of Optimal Reasoning Termination Methods for Overthinking in Reasoning Models
summary: Reasoning models can benefit from test-time scaling, but continued reasoning may become ineffective or harmful, a phenomenon termed overthinking. Evaluations against full thinking compare accuracy and token usage but lack references for overthinking severity and strategies' theoretical mitigation potential. To characterize overthinking at the model-task level, we first introduce Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP), repeatedly generating answers from multiple retained prefixes along each fixed sampled reasoning trajectory. Using each trajectory's earliest measured position attaining maximum empirical accuracy as a reference, we define Overthinking Ratio and Accuracy Degradation as the fraction of thinking tokens generated afterward and the accuracy decrease from this reference to full thinking, respectively. Secondly, we then formulate dynamic routing, fixed budgets, and dynamic early exit within a unified framework to quantify the theoretical mitigation potential of different termination strategies. Based on this unified framework, we use the complete STP measurements to construct a token-accuracy Pareto frontier for each strategy under a common normalized thinking-token budget. We further develop OTBench, a reusable benchmark built from the STP process, which produced 70.5B reasoning tokens and the corresponding probing measurements across six models and four benchmark groups.

AI.tldr: 该文研究推理模型的“过度思考”现象，提出逐步截断探测(STP)方法量化其严重程度，并统一框架评估终止策略的理论缓解潜力，同时发布了OTBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有对“过度思考”的评估仅对比完整思考与基线间的准确率和token消耗，缺乏对过度思考严重程度的参照标准，也无法衡量不同终止策略在理论上的缓解潜力。
AI.method: 1) 提出Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP)：沿固定采样的推理轨迹，对多个保留前缀重复生成答案；以每条轨迹中最早达到最高经验准确率的位置为参照，定义Overthinking Ratio(此后生成的思考token占比)与Accuracy Degradation(从参照到完整思考的准确率下降)。2) 将动态路由、固定预算、动态提前退出统一到一个框架，量化各终止策略的理论缓解潜力，并基于完整STP测量构建在统一归一化思考token预算下的token-准确率Pareto前沿。3) 构建可复用基准OTBench。
AI.result: OTBench基于STP流程产生70.5B推理token及相应的探测测量数据，覆盖6个模型和4个基准组。
AI.conclusion: STP在模型-任务层面刻画了过度思考，所提统一框架可量化不同终止策略的理论缓解潜力，OTBench为后续研究提供了可复用的评测资源。

title: ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, including references and appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick
summary: GUI grounding, the task of locating the interface element specified by a user instruction, is a fundamental capability of GUI agents. However, existing grounding models remain error-prone, often causing downstream task failures. We systematically evaluate 10 grounding models across five datasets and identify a major error pattern: most incorrect clicks hit non-target interface elements rather than the background, with different models repeatedly selecting the same distractors. Motivated by these findings, we propose ConClick, a contrastive learning framework that teaches models to distinguish the target element from plausible distractors. We construct ConClick-Data, a dataset containing 4,292 challenging target-distractor pairs, and train the model using complementary listwise ranking and pairwise margin objectives. ConClick improves the grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B from 54.71% to 66.03% on ScreenSpot-Pro, from 83.72% to 86.28% on MMBench-GUI L2, and from 63.33% to 70.20% on OSWorld-G, outperforming prior methods built on the same or similarly sized backbones. We further introduce ReClick, an inference-time strategy that revisits promising regions and compares predictions across competing candidates, yielding an additional 2.96 percentage-point improvement in average accuracy across the three benchmarks. Together, our analysis, dataset, and methods provide both empirical insights and practical tools for building more reliable GUI agents. Data and code are available at https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对GUI grounding模型的错误模式，提出对比学习框架ConClick及推理时策略ReClick，显著提升多个基准上的定位精度。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding是GUI智能体的基础能力，但现有模型错误率高，常导致下游任务失败。作者系统评估10个模型、5个数据集后发现：多数错误点击落在非目标界面元素而非背景，且不同模型反复选中相同的干扰项，说明区分目标与相似干扰项是关键难点。
AI.method: 提出ConClick对比学习框架，让模型学会区分目标元素与合理干扰项。构建ConClick-Data数据集（4,292个挑战性目标-干扰对），并采用互补的listwise排序与pairwise margin目标进行训练。另提出推理时策略ReClick，重新审视潜在区域并在竞争候选间比较预测。
AI.result: ConClick将Qwen3-VL-8B的定位精度从ScreenSpot-Pro的54.71%提升至66.03%，MMBench-GUI L2从83.72%提升至86.28%，OSWorld-G从63.33%提升至70.20%，优于同规模或相近规模骨干网络的前沿方法。ReClick在三个基准上平均再提升2.96个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过错误模式分析、数据集与方法的结合，该工作为构建更可靠的GUI智能体提供了实证洞察与实用工具，数据与代码已开源。

title: How Much Computation Does Every Forecast Need? Structured Block Skipping in Two Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: Time-series foundation models use the same network depth for every input, although forecasting windows differ in structure and difficulty. We test whether whole Transformer blocks can be removed at inference time in two pretrained models: Chronos-Bolt and TimesFM 2.5. Our bypasses avoid the original block computation and preserve the dense model exactly when all blocks are enabled. Masks are selected only on calibration windows and evaluated on 1,088 held-out windows from ETTh1, Traffic, Weather, and Exchange. At moderate sparsity, Chronos-Bolt with 7/11 candidate blocks and TimesFM with 16/20 blocks show little change in mean relative forecasting quality across datasets while reducing median A100 batch-1 latency by 11.2% and 13.4%. More aggressive TimesFM skipping accelerates inference further but substantially harms Traffic and Weather. Across both models, different equal-budget masks win on different windows, and a retrospective oracle significantly improves over the best static mask on every dataset. However, dataset-specific masks transfer inconsistently, and Chronos representations do not support reliable unseen-domain routing. These results establish cross-architecture structured redundancy and input-dependent opportunity, but not a deployable dynamic inference method.

AI.tldr: 在 Chronos-Bolt 与 TimesFM 2.5 上验证推理期整块跳过（bypass）的可行性：中等稀疏度下可保持预测质量并降低延迟，但输入依赖的动态路由尚不可靠。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型对所有输入使用相同网络深度，但不同预测窗口在结构与难度上存在差异，因此是否存在可按输入调节的有效冗余尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 在两个预训练模型上于推理阶段移除整个 Transformer 块；bypass 跳过原块计算，且当所有块启用时严格等价于稠密模型。掩码仅在校准窗口上选择，在 ETTh1、Traffic、Weather、Exchange 的 1,088 个留出窗口上评估，并统计 A100 batch-1 中位延迟。
AI.result: 中等稀疏度下 Chronos-Bolt（7/11 块）与 TimesFM（16/20 块）在各数据集上平均相对预测质量变化很小，A100 batch-1 中位延迟分别降低 11.2% 与 13.4%；更激进的 TimesFM 跳块可进一步加速，但显著损害 Traffic 与 Weather。等预算掩码的优胜窗口因窗口而异，回溯式 oracle 在各数据集上均显著优于最优静态掩码；然而数据集特定掩码迁移不稳定，Chronos 表示也无法支持可靠的未见域路由。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了跨架构的块级结构化冗余与输入依赖的跳块机会，但尚不构成可部署的动态推理方法。

title: When VLMs Destroy What They Know: Spatial Representations Fall Below Lexical Priors
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly analyze and reason about images, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode the structured relations required for such reasoning. We introduce EICS (Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability), a metric for testing whether representations consistently encode concepts under controlled one-concept interventions, and CASP-VL (Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models), a benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations derived from Visual Genome scene graphs. Across multiple VLM architectures, we find that spatial relations are represented substantially less faithfully than lexical information, even when the same models score well above chance on compositional benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the relation is identifiable at the predicate's own tokens but is lost when the sentence is aggregated into a global representation, whether through the (EOS) token or by mean pooling. These findings reveal a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation: VLMs do not preserve, in the representation used downstream, relational information that is present in their own input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EICS指标与CASP-VL基准，检验VLM内部表示是否忠实编码受控单概念干预下的结构化关系，发现空间关系表示忠实度显著低于词汇信息。
AI.motivation: VLM在图像分析与推理上表现日益增强，但其内部表示是否忠实编码此类推理所需的结构化关系尚不明确；且现有基于输出的评测可能掩盖表示层面的系统性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出EICS（Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability）指标，在受控的单概念干预下测试表示的稳定性与一致性；构建CASP-VL基准，基于Visual Genome场景图生成因果控制的空间扰动样本；在多种VLM架构上进行表示层分析，并对比谓词自身token与全局聚合表示（EOS token、平均池化）。
AI.result: 空间关系的表示忠实度显著低于词汇信息，尽管同一批模型在组合式基准上明显高于随机水平；关系信息在谓词对应token上可识别，但经EOS token或平均池化聚合为全局表示后丢失。
AI.conclusion: VLM存在一种输出层评测无法发现的系统性失效：模型在下游所用表示中并未保留其自身输入中已存在的关系信息。

title: MENTOR: Learning from Failure with On-Policy Pedagogical Intervention
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key driver for Large Reasoning Models, but it is vulnerable to "zero-reward collapse", a training failure where a sudden increase in task difficulty causes the learning signal to vanish. We argue that the conventional approach of discarding these failed trajectories is wasteful, as they contain valuable diagnostic information about the model's cognitive gaps, a bright side that can be leveraged for recovery. Existing solutions, however, often regress to static, "off-policy-style" interventions like pre-defined hint libraries or perform post-hoc refinement, failing to provide the adaptive, forward-looking guidance needed to escape the collapse. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift towards on-policy pedagogical intervention and introduce MENTOR, a multi-agent framework that acts as a live mentor. MENTOR diagnoses the root cause of failure in real-time and dynamically generates targeted, instructional prompts to guide the learning agent's next attempt. As a plug-and-play module, MENTOR integrates seamlessly into existing policy optimization pipelines like GRPO without modifying the training infrastructure. Extensive experiments on math and code generation show that MENTOR effectively mitigates zero-reward collapse, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, it achieves massive average relative gains of up to 78.3% on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct over its base model.

AI.tldr: 提出 MENTOR 多智能体框架，将零奖励崩溃产生的失败轨迹作为诊断信息，通过在线教学式干预实现 RLVR 训练恢复，在数学与代码任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: RLVR 是大型推理模型的关键训练驱动力，但存在"零奖励崩溃"问题：任务难度骤增导致学习信号消失、训练失败。作者认为失败的轨迹蕴含模型认知缺口的诊断价值，直接丢弃是浪费；而现有方案多为静态的"离策略式"干预（如预定义提示库）或事后精修，缺乏自适应、前瞻性的引导，无法有效摆脱崩溃。
AI.method: 提出向在线教学式干预（on-policy pedagogical intervention）的范式转变，并设计 MENTOR 多智能体框架，充当实时导师：实时诊断失败的根因，动态生成针对性的教学提示以引导学习智能体的下一次尝试。作为即插即用模块，MENTOR 可无缝集成到 GRPO 等现有策略优化流程中，无需修改训练基础设施。
AI.result: 在数学与代码生成任务上的大量实验表明，MENTOR 有效缓解零奖励崩溃，优于当前最先进的基线方法；在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上相对基模型取得最高达 78.3% 的平均相对增益。
AI.conclusion: MENTOR 将失败轨迹从"废弃信号"转化为诊断资源，以在线教学式干预替代静态离策略方案，为 RLVR 中的零奖励崩溃提供了一种自适应、易集成的解决路径，并在推理类任务上验证了有效性。

title: OWLET: On-Policy Weighted Learning via Evidence Transfer for Video Large Language Model Post-Training
summary: Post-training has become a key stage for eliciting reasoning capabilities in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs). Existing post-training methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, they do not fully exploit visual evidence for effective training. RL supervises the policy with a single trajectory-level reward, which is too coarse-grained for video reasoning: the same response-level advantage is applied to every generated token, disregarding that the tokens of a video response are grounded in the visual stream to very different degrees. OPD provides token-level supervision through output-distribution matching, but lacks direct supervision of the spatiotemporal representations that produce those outputs. We observe across extensive experiments that the same model reasons more accurately when its video view combines global temporal context with question-relevant details. Comparing the same student-generated response under this view and uniform sampling reveals changes in token likelihoods and internal representations, providing a training signal for evidence use. Building on this observation, we propose OWLET, an evidence-privileged RL method that derives training signals from a richer teacher view. This view couples uniform global context with question-conditioned local windows, providing visual evidence without requiring a larger model. To better exploit this privileged visual evidence, OWLET introduces (i) \textbf{evidence-aware credit redistribution}, which compares token likelihoods across the two views and redistributes positive response-level advantages according to their relative evidence support; and (ii) \textbf{spatiotemporal state alignment}, which aligns the two views' hidden states on verifier-accepted responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OWLET，一种基于证据特权视角的强化学习方法，通过结合全局时序上下文与问题相关局部窗口的教师视角，导出更细粒度的训练信号，以提升Video-LLM的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频大模型后训练方法（RL与OPD）未能充分利用视觉证据：RL仅用轨迹级单一奖励，粒度太粗，对每个token施加相同的响应级优势，忽视了视频响应中不同token与视觉流的关联程度差异；OPD虽提供token级监督，却缺乏对产生输出的时空表征的直接监督。实验观察到，当视频视角融合全局时序上下文与问题相关细节时，同一模型推理更准确，这为利用证据提供了训练信号。
AI.method: 提出OWLET——证据特权RL方法。教师视角耦合同一模型的均匀全局上下文与问题条件化的局部窗口，无需更大模型即可提供视觉证据。方法包含两部分：(i) 证据感知信用再分配，比较两种视角下的token似然，依据相对证据支持度重新分配正向响应级优势；(ii) 时空状态对齐，在验证器接受的响应上对齐两种视角的隐状态。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但指出大量实验观察到融合全局时序上下文与问题相关细节的视角可使同一模型推理更准确，且比较同一学生生成响应在该视角与均匀采样下的表现，揭示了token似然与内部表征的变化。
AI.conclusion: OWLET通过引入证据特权视角，为视频推理提供更细粒度的训练信号，弥补了RL奖励粒度粗与OPD缺乏时空表征直接监督的不足，从而更有效地利用视觉证据提升Video-LLM推理能力。

title: Monarch-MoE: Structured Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Learning new tasks in multimodal continual instruction tuning can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge. Although multi-expert LoRA distributes learning across experts, updates to a dense low-rank expert can still affect many output features. We introduce Monarch-MoE, which replaces the dense factors in LoRA experts with block-diagonal factors connected by a fixed permutation. This structure provides blockwise gradient isolation: individual block-pair updates affect only one output block, while connections between all input and output blocks are maintained. To make these compact experts practical on memory-limited hardware, we combine batched computation, fused forward operators, and an optimized backward pass. Across three continual-learning methods evaluated on MLLM-DCL and UCIT with LLaVA-1.5-7B, Monarch-MoE improves first-task retention while reducing adapter parameters by approximately 75% and 50%, respectively. In the main comparison, first-task forgetting is as low as 0.52 percentage points on MLLM-DCL and 0.10 on UCIT, with method-dependent trade-offs in final performance. Our implementation supports fine-tuning and inference on a single 24 GB RTX 4090, with lower measured memory use and competitive runtime in the evaluated settings. Together, these algorithmic and systems improvements make structured experts a practical option for continual adaptation on memory-limited hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出Monarch-MoE，用块对角因子（固定置换连接）替换LoRA专家的稠密低秩因子，实现块级梯度隔离，在多模态持续指令微调中缓解灾难性遗忘，参数减少约50%-75%。
AI.motivation: 多模态持续指令微调中学习新任务会导致对旧知识的灾难性遗忘。多专家LoRA虽将学习分散到各专家，但对稠密低秩专家的更新仍会影响大量输出特征，难以充分隔离梯度、保护旧知识。
AI.method: Monarch-MoE将LoRA专家中的稠密低秩因子替换为由固定置换连接的块对角因子（即Monarch结构）。该结构实现块级梯度隔离：单个块对更新仅影响一个输出块，同时保持所有输入块与输出块之间的连接。为适配显存受限硬件，结合批量化计算、融合前向算子与优化反向传播。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上以三种持续学习方法于MLLM-DCL与UCIT评估：首任务遗忘最低降至MLLM-DCL的0.52个百分点、UCIT的0.10，首任务保持能力提升，适配器参数分别减少约75%与50%；最终性能存在依方法而定的权衡。可在单张24 GB RTX 4090上完成微调与推理，实测显存更低、运行时间具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过算法与系统层面的协同改进，结构化专家（Monarch-MoE）成为显存受限硬件上进行持续适应的实用方案。

title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

AI.tldr: RSI-Anything 是一个基于 JEPA-Anything 的领域通用递归自我改进框架，利用预测式世界模型指导动作与学习数据选择，并通过组件与兼容性校验保留更新后的策略-模型对，在代码修复、GUI、实验室规划、反应优化及免疫科学等任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在将交互经验转化为持久改进，但外部反馈成本高昂，且随着策略演化，世界模型预测可能变得不可靠。因此需要一种能降低对外部反馈依赖、并持续维护可靠预测能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出 RSI-Anything，一个基于 JEPA-Anything 构建的领域通用框架。它使用预测式世界模型来指导动作选择与学习数据选择；观测反馈用于驱动策略或工作流改进，并进行条件式世界模型自适应；同时通过组件检查与兼容性检查来管控更新后策略-模型对的保留。
AI.result: 在代码修复中，固定 coder 时，成功率从静态验证器的 26.3% 提升到预测选择的 29.2%，世界模型自适应后达 31.2%，测试用量相当。GUI 评估任务完成率更高，平均动作数减少 39.4%。连续五个策略版本中，实验室规划得分从 21.80% 提升到 46.01%，翻倍以上。反应优化在相同 40 次实验预算下，平均最佳观测产率达 96.15%，优于贝叶斯优化的 82.16%。端到端免疫科学应用进一步将工作流演化与预测建模连接到治疗假设生成。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，预测式世界模型与保留的系统更新能够在多样环境中实现递归改进，验证了 RSI-Anything 作为领域通用递归自我改进框架的有效性。

title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erdős Conjectures database. Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: early errors can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and apparent success can mask a misinterpretation or weakening of the original task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent), an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer evaluates each candidate and provides actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model pretraining. Third, a verifier checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA achieves perfect scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026, near-full marks on the IChO 2026 problem set, and solves all 672 problems (100%) on PutnamBench. On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks first, solving 251 of 304 problems (82.6%). We further evaluate HOA with open models. Using Kimi-K3, HOA achieves full scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI, and a gold-level score of 97.1% on the IChO. These results closely match the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline on the IMO and IPhO, while exceeding it on the IChO and IOI, demonstrating that systematic feedback can help bridge substantial differences in base-model capability.

AI.tldr: HOA是一个开放的流级多智能体框架，通过评审、结构化wiki与Lean验证器三条反馈通道协调多个会话，在GPT-5.6 Sol上于IMO/IPhO/IOI 2026满分、PutnamBench 672题全解，Lean-Eval登顶；用开源Kimi-K3也能取得IMO/IPhO/IOI满分与IChO 97.1%的金牌成绩。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在长时程科学与奥赛任务上进步迅速，但已有出色系统（如Lean形式化解决Navier-Stokes、自主解答Erdős猜想数据库问题）均未同时公开底层模型与完整推理栈。更普遍地，单会话智能体在难题上脆弱：早期错误会传播、缺失领域知识会阻塞进展、表面成功可能掩盖对原任务的误解或弱化。因此需要一种开放、可复现且具鲁棒性的多会话协调框架。
AI.method: 提出HOA（Humanize Olympiads Agent），一个开放的流级（flow-level）框架，通过三条互补反馈通道协调多个智能体会话：1）独立评审者评估每个候选解并给出可执行反馈；2）结构化wiki提供预训练中可能缺失或不可靠的任务专属知识；3）验证器将生成的Lean证明与可信赛题陈述进行校验。
AI.result: 搭配GPT-5.6 Sol，HOA在IMO、IPhO、IOI 2026取得满分，IChO 2026接近满分，PutnamBench全部672题（100%）解决；Lean-Eval排行榜第一，304题中解决251题（82.6%）。使用开源模型Kimi-K3时，HOA在IMO、IPhO、IOI取得满分，IChO获97.1%的金牌级成绩。在IMO与IPhO上接近闭源GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal基线，在IChO与IOI上则超过该基线。
AI.conclusion: 系统化反馈机制能够有效弥补基座模型能力上的显著差距，且HOA以开放形式提供模型与完整推理栈，为长时程高难任务的可复现智能体研究提供了参考。

title: QCLR: A Plug-in Robustification Module via Quantization for Contrastive Learning in Self-Supervised Skeleton-Based Human Action Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based human action recognition has gained increasing attention due to the stability of skeleton data across diverse environments and advances in motion capture technologies. Following the success of supervised learning approaches, self-supervised learning approaches, particularly contrastive learning ones, have achieved impressive performance. However, they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. In this work, we propose a plug-in robustification module via quantization for contrastive learning in self-supervised skeleton-based human action recognition (QCLR), which enhances the robustness of representations against adversarial attacks while preserving their representational capability. Specifically, we employ a dual-level quantization scheme across the encoding pipeline, which breaks the gradient propagation and absorbs small adversarial perturbations within the quantization bins. To mitigate the impact of inevitable quantization error, we further design an attention-guided multi-faceted quantization strategy to maintain the representation quality. Experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that integrating QCLR into a progressive lineage of mainstream contrastive learning models substantially improves robustness against both gradient-based white-box and gradient-free black-box adversarial attacks, while preserving highly competitive classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的量化鲁棒化模块QCLR，用于自监督骨架动作识别中的对比学习，在保持分类精度的同时显著提升对白盒与黑盒对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 基于骨架的人体动作识别因骨架数据的环境稳定性和动作捕捉技术进步而受到关注，自监督对比学习方法虽性能优异，但仍易受对抗攻击影响，亟需在保持表征能力的前提下提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的量化鲁棒化模块QCLR：在编码流程中采用双层级量化方案，打断梯度传播并将微小对抗扰动吸收到量化区间内；同时设计注意力引导的多方位量化策略以缓解不可避免的量化误差、维持表征质量。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，将QCLR集成到一系列主流对比学习模型中，显著提升了对基于梯度的白盒攻击和无梯度的黑盒攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持了极具竞争力的分类精度。
AI.conclusion: QCLR作为一种通用即插即用模块，可有效增强自监督骨架动作识别对比学习的对抗鲁棒性，并兼顾表征质量与分类性能。

title: Tensor-based Fusion of Multi-modal Data for Predicting Cancer Risk Levels
summary: Cancer diagnosis and treatment increasingly rely on multi-modal diagnostic technologies that generate high-dimensional datasets. Although these datasets are rich in pathological information, they pose considerable challenges in interpretation, dimensionality reduction, and clinical applicability. Conventional machine learning approaches often fail to extract meaningful cross-modal features, thereby limiting predictive accuracy in patient risk stratification. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an unsupervised machine learning framework that integrates feature extraction, tensor decomposition, and clustering to improve cancer risk prediction. The framework employs tensor decomposition to fuse heterogeneous genomic and clinical data, enabling the extraction of latent, biologically meaningful features that outperform unimodal feature sets. Multiple feature extraction strategies are investigated, and the resulting features are subsequently clustered using a range of clustering algorithms. Comparative evaluations based on internal and external metrics are then used to identify the most effective configurations. The framework is validated on LinkedOmics data comprising 11,158 patients across 32 cancer types.
