For patient risk stratification, clinically relevant attributes such as tumor purity, pathological stage, and survival outcomes serve as ground-truth indicators. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of tSVD+GMM, which consistently outperforms other configurations across clinical benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督机器学习框架，融合特征提取、张量分解与聚类以提升癌症风险预测；在LinkedOmics的11,158例、32种癌症数据上验证，tSVD+GMM组合在临床指标上表现最优。
AI.motivation: 多模态诊断技术产生高维数据集，虽蕴含丰富病理信息，但在解释、降维与临床适用性上存在挑战；传统机器学习难以提取跨模态特征，导致患者风险分层的预测精度受限。
AI.method: 构建无监督学习框架：利用张量分解融合异构的基因组与临床数据，提取优于单模态的潜在生物特征；比较多种特征提取策略，并采用多种聚类算法对所得特征聚类，结合内部与外部指标进行对比评估以筛选最优配置。
AI.result: 在LinkedOmics含11,158名患者、覆盖32种癌症类型的数据上验证；以肿瘤纯度、病理分期与生存结局作为临床基准，tSVD+GMM配置在各临床基准上持续优于其他组合。
AI.conclusion: 张量分解驱动的无监督多模态融合可有效提取跨模态特征，tSVD与GMM的组合是患者风险分层中最有效的配置，为临床风险预测提供了可行方案。

title: Learning Size Independent Constraint Models from Input Data and Positive and Negative Example Solutions
summary: In this paper we describe a Constraint Acquisition Tool that generates size independent constraint programs from input data and positive and negative example solutions of multiple problem instances. The system finds size specific models based on typical constraint patterns over global and binary constraints, then generalizes the models to a size independent model that can be run on unseen input data. The system produces MiniZinc code as well as a textual description of the model. We evaluate the tool on the example problems of the PTHG21 Challenge and show the feasibility of the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种约束获取工具，能从多个问题实例的输入数据及正、负例解中生成与规模无关的约束程序，并在PTHG21 Challenge实例上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 约束建模通常依赖人工，且模型常与问题规模绑定，难以复用到未见数据；作者希望自动从实例与示例解中学习可泛化的约束模型。
AI.method: 工具先从输入数据与正、负例解中，基于全局约束与二元约束的典型约束模式，为每个实例学习规模相关的模型；随后将这些模型泛化为规模无关的模型，并输出MiniZinc代码及模型的文本描述。
AI.result: 在PTHG21 Challenge的示例问题上进行了评估，结果表明该方法可行。
AI.conclusion: 基于约束模式的“先学规模相关模型、再泛化为规模无关模型”的约束获取流程可行，能自动产出可运行于未见数据的MiniZinc模型。

title: Decoding Register Tokens Preserves Global Scene Details
summary: Pretrained vision transformers learn structured image representations spanning spatial patch tokens and non-spatial tokens. Recent analyses suggest that non-spatial register tokens encode global scene properties such as illumination, blur, and style. Yet patch-based image decoders discard these outputs, leaving the decoder to recover image appearance from patches alone. We investigate whether retaining register features improves decoding when the complete spatial patch representation is already available. We study this question using representation autoencoders (RAEs) with frozen register-equipped encoders. Our decoder processes four register tokens together with all patch tokens through joint self-attention. Appearance probes, paired reconstruction-error analysis, and fixed-decoder register substitutions examine which global image properties are accessible from registers and how their values affect reconstructed pixels. For generation, we train a multi-head attention pooling (MHAP) predictor to recover register features from sampled patches, keeping the pretrained diffusion model and its samples unchanged. On ImageNet-1K, our ViT-B decoders achieve mean reconstruction FIDs of 0.472 with DINOv2 and 0.442 with DINOv3, reductions of 9.5% and 5.2% relative to their respective patch-only baselines. The corresponding PSNRs are 19.73 and 20.54 dB. For generation, our DINOv2 models achieve a mean FID of 1.641, 9.8% below the patch-only baseline on identical sampled patches.

AI.tldr: 研究在解码器已获得完整patch表示时，保留register token是否仍能提升图像重建与生成质量，基于冻结register编码器的RAE验证。
AI.motivation: 现有基于patch的图像解码器丢弃register token输出，仅靠patch恢复图像外观，忽略其编码的全局场景属性（如光照、模糊、风格）。作者探究在完整空间patch表示已具备时，register特征是否仍有增益价值。
AI.method: 采用RAE，编码器为冻结的register-equipped ViT；解码器通过联合自注意力同时处理4个register token与全部patch token。通过外观探针、成对重建误差分析、固定解码器register替换实验，分析register可及的全局属性及其对重建像素的影响。生成阶段训练MHAP预测器从采样patch恢复register特征，保持预训练扩散模型及其采样不变。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K上，ViT-B解码器平均重建FID：DINOv2为0.472，DINOv3为0.442，相对各自patch-only基线分别降低9.5%与5.2%；PSNR分别为19.73 dB和20.54 dB。生成上，DINOv2模型在相同采样patch下平均FID为1.641，较patch-only基线低9.8%。
AI.conclusion: 即便完整空间patch表示已可用，保留register特征仍能显著提升重建与生成质量，表明register token携带patch难以恢复的全局外观信息。

title: ReSFlow: Rectifying Categorical Flows on Statistical Manifolds for One-Step Generation
summary: Generative modeling for discrete data has been significantly advanced by learning continuous vector fields on the statistical manifolds to transport simple priors to target discrete distributions. However, because these continuous-time flows are not constrained to follow geodesics on the statistical manifold, thereby requiring multi-step numerical integration for simulation and leading to substantial computational costs during inference. In this work, drawing inspiration from the "straight and fast" properties of Rectified Flow in continuous Euclidean space, we propose the Rectified Statistical Flow (ReSFlow) model, which enables one-step categorical generation on statistical manifolds by explicitly learning geodesic trajectories that adhere to the intrinsic Riemannian geometry. By rectifying the flow on the statistical manifold, we theoretically guarantee that trajectories between prior and target distributions approximate geodesics. This rectification significantly reduces the transport cost by aligning the learned trajectories directly along geodesics on the statistical manifold, allowing the model to map pure noise to target discrete data in a single step. Through extensive experiments on diverse real-world generative tasks, ranging from image and text to biological domains, we demonstrate ReSFlow's superior one-step generation quality, which truly embodies geodesically optimal and rapid categorical generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaohuanjia/ReSFlow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rectified Statistical Flow (ReSFlow)，通过在统计流形上显式学习测地线轨迹，实现离散数据的一步生成。
AI.motivation: 现有离散数据生成方法在统计流形上学习连续向量场以传输先验到目标分布，但这些连续时间流未约束为沿测地线，导致需要多步数值积分，推理计算成本高。
AI.method: 受欧氏空间中Rectified Flow的"直线快速"特性启发，提出ReSFlow模型，显式学习遵循内在黎曼几何的测地线轨迹，在统计流形上对流动进行整流，理论上保证先验与目标分布间的轨迹逼近测地线。
AI.result: 在图像、文本及生物等多个真实世界生成任务上的大量实验表明，ReSFlow具有优越的一步生成质量。
AI.conclusion: ReSFlow通过测地线整流显著降低传输成本，实现真正意义上的测地最优快速离散生成。代码已开源。

title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
summary: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks---spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equations---the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一个多智能体LLM框架（analyst、coder、recorder三角色，含实验日志与沙箱执行），在保持整体网络结构不变的前提下，仅对用户指定的关键组件自动生成代码并调优，跨两类任务验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法多为两层结构：先由专家选定方法类别，类别内的关键组件选择仍依赖人工且至关重要。作者希望实现这些组件的自动调优，并构建一个可跨不同性质模型迁移的通用框架。
AI.method: 框架由analyst、coder、recorder三个LLM角色组成，配有实验日志和沙箱执行环境。与优化整段ML脚本或离散空间搜索架构的方法不同，它工作在开放但语义狭窄的空间：智能体只为指定组件生成代码，不改动整体网络结构。在两个方向验证：调优带相关学习规则（correlation learning）的分类脉冲神经网络；求解高阶微分方程的物理信息神经网络（PINN）。共五个任务：MNIST与Digits脉冲分类，以及广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）和Kuramoto–Sivashinsky（KS）方程的边值问题。
AI.result: 分类精度在MNIST上提升13个百分点、Digits上提升6个百分点；相对解析单孤子解的误差降低约2491倍；所选GNLSE运行（高斯扰动）的不变量保持误差下降约325倍，多次随机初始化平均下降超100倍；KS问题（高斯扰动）的质量漂移下降14倍。均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能在不改变内部结构的情况下，对性质迥异任务中的关键组件实现自动调优，验证了其跨模型的可迁移性。

title: Sonic-AMG: Streaming Human Motion Generation from Spatial Audio
summary: Modeling human reactions to spatial audio requires understanding both what is heard and where it comes from. Prior work generates motion offline from complete acoustic and spatial input sequences. Humans, however, react to sounds without knowing what they will hear next. We present Sonic-AMG, to our knowledge the first framework for streaming human motion generation from spatial audio. The model encodes acoustic content and body-relative source geometry as separate tokens. Conditioned on these tokens, a causal transformer with a flow head generates continuous motion latents, from which a causal decoder reconstructs motion segments. Standard teacher-forced training derives motion histories and body-relative source locations from ground-truth motion, whereas streaming inference relies on generated motion for both, resulting in a training-inference mismatch. To reduce this history discrepancy, we introduce rehearsal training, which combines full-sequence teacher-forced supervision with supervised prediction along short autoregressive self-rollouts. To keep spatial conditioning consistent with generated motion, we propose spatial feedback, which recomputes body-relative source locations from generated root poses during both rehearsal training and inference. On SAM, Sonic-AMG achieves state-of-the-art FID and R-precision. It further supports real-time online generation of coherent reactions across sound events and source locations. Project page: https://jingchengni.com/sonic-amg/.

AI.tldr: Sonic-AMG是首个从空间音频流式生成人体动作的框架，通过分离的声学内容与体相对源几何token、因果Transformer加flow head，以及rehearsal training与spatial feedback缓解训练-推理失配，在SAM数据集上取得SOTA FID与R-precision，并支持实时在线生成。
AI.motivation: 建模人类对空间音频的反应需同时理解"听到什么"与"来自哪里"。已有工作从完整的声学与空间输入序列离线生成动作，而真实人类是在不知道后续声音的情况下作出反应，因此需要流式（在线）动作生成能力。
AI.method: 提出Sonic-AMG：将声学内容与体相对源几何编码为独立token；以这些token为条件，用带flow head的因果Transformer生成连续动作隐变量，再由因果解码器重建动作片段。针对teacher-forcing训练与流式推理之间的失配，引入rehearsal training（全序列teacher-forced监督结合短自回归自rollout的监督预测）以缓解动作历史差异；并提出spatial feedback，在rehearsal训练与推理中均从生成根姿态重新计算体相对源位置，保持空间条件与生成动作一致。
AI.result: 在SAM数据集上，Sonic-AMG取得state-of-the-art的FID与R-precision；并支持跨声音事件与声源位置的连贯反应的实时在线生成。
AI.conclusion: Sonic-AMG首次实现从空间音频流式生成人体动作，通过rehearsal training与spatial feedback有效缓解训练-推理失配，兼顾生成质量与实时在线可用性。

title: Learning Schwarzschild Geodesic Motion with Lagrangian Neural Networks
summary: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn dynamics from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving accelerations through the Euler--Lagrange equation, providing a variational inductive bias that improves physical consistency over purely data-driven models. LNNs have recently been extended to general relativistic settings, leaving Schwarzschild geodesics as an open challenge. Training on complex relativistic systems is hindered by the diversity of the dynamics, as well as numerical instabilities and the difficulty of adequately sampling physically relevant, diverse orbital regimes. We introduce two coordinated improvements: a decoupled position--velocity normalization scheme that independently rescales each coordinate and its time derivatives, reweighting acceleration targets to balance contributions across all channels; and an energy-constrained log-uniformly sampled dataset generation strategy informed by the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) structure. With these improvements, our model accurately reproduces perihelion precession and relativistic time dilation, conserves energy and angular momentum to within a few percent even after completing multiple orbits around the central mass and predicts orbital trajectories across eight orbital scenarios in close, medium, and far-field regimes. These results establish that LNNs, augmented with physically motivated normalization and sampling, can reliably learn geodesic dynamics in curved spacetime. Our work also represents the first successful training of LNNs on Schwarzschild geodesics and offers a promising direction for data-driven modeling of complex relativistic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出两项协同改进（解耦的位置-速度归一化与基于ISCO的能量约束对数均匀采样），首次成功将拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）训练于史瓦西测地线，准确复现近日点进动与相对论时间膨胀，并在多轨道场景下保持能量与角动量守恒。
AI.motivation: LNN通过参数化标量拉格朗日量并借助欧拉-拉格朗日方程导出加速度，具有变分归纳偏置，物理一致性优于纯数据驱动模型。近期LNN已扩展至广义相对论场景，但史瓦西测地线仍是未解难题。其训练受制于动力学多样性、数值不稳定性以及难以充分采样物理相关且多样的轨道区域。
AI.method: 提出两项协同改进：(1) 解耦的位置-速度归一化方案，独立重缩放每个坐标及其时间导数，并对加速度目标重加权，以平衡所有通道的贡献；(2) 基于最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）结构的能量约束对数均匀采样数据生成策略。
AI.result: 模型准确复现近日点进动与相对论时间膨胀；在完成多圈绕中心质量轨道后，能量与角动量守恒误差在百分之几以内；可预测近场、中场与远场三类区域共八种轨道场景下的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，辅以物理驱动的归一化与采样策略，LNN能够可靠学习弯曲时空中的测地线动力学。该工作是首次成功在史瓦西测地线上训练LNN，为复杂相对论系统的数据驱动建模提供了有前景的方向。

title: A Step Harder, Not a Step Too Far: The Benefits and Limits of Curriculum Difficulty Progression in GRPO
summary: Curriculum learning typically organizes training samples from easy to hard. In GRPO, medium-difficulty samples are attractive for online selection because they are more likely to yield informative group-relative learning signals, and prioritizing them can improve training efficiency. However, it remains unclear whether persistently selecting such samples also leads to the strongest final model performance, or whether training can benefit from progressing toward harder samples. Meanwhile, sample difficulty changes as the policy evolves, so fixed difficulty estimates can become misaligned with the current policy. We therefore re-estimate sample difficulty under the current policy and, inspired by the easy-to-hard principle of curriculum learning, design and evaluate a staged curriculum that progressively shifts the active difficulty band toward harder samples. Experiments on GSM8K show that persistent medium-difficulty selection does not achieve the strongest observed performance. Across three random seeds, progressing to a moderately harder difficulty band improves test accuracy to $0.6591 \pm 0.0077$, compared with $0.6449 \pm 0.0024$ for the fixed-medium curriculum. However, further progression to a harder difficulty band reduces accuracy to $0.6405 \pm 0.0053$. These results show that staged difficulty progression can outperform persistent medium-difficulty selection, but its benefit is non-monotonic. Effective GRPO curricula can therefore benefit from progressing beyond medium difficulty, while avoiding excessive progression toward overly difficult samples.}

AI.tldr: 在GRPO中，样本难度随策略演化而被重新估计，并按易到难设计分阶段课程；实验表明推进到中等偏难区间优于固定中等难度，但过度推进反而下降。
AI.motivation: GRPO在线训练中，中等难度样本更易产生有信息量的组内相对学习信号，因此常被优先选择以提高训练效率。但持续选择此类样本是否能带来最优的最终模型性能尚不清楚，且样本难度随策略变化而漂移，固定难度估计会与当前策略失配。
AI.method: 在当前策略下重新估计样本难度；借鉴课程学习的由易到难原则，设计并评估一种分阶段课程，使活跃难度带逐步向更难样本移动；在GSM8K上与固定中等难度课程进行对比，并采用三个随机种子评估。
AI.result: 持续选择中等难度样本并未取得最强性能。推进到中等偏难难度带时测试准确率达0.6591±0.0077，高于固定中等课程的0.6449±0.0024；但进一步推进到更难难度带时准确率降至0.6405±0.0053。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段难度推进可优于持续中等难度选择，但其收益是非单调的。有效的GRPO课程应推进到超出中等难度，同时避免过度推进至过于困难的样本。

title: PAGE: Parts-Aware Guidance for Co-Speech Gesture Portrait Video Generation
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT) 2026. Project page: https://aigc-explorer.github.io/PAGE/
summary: Co-speech gesture video generation aims to synthesize realistic, audio-driven portrait videos from a single reference image and a speech signal. Despite advances in visual quality, diffusion-based approaches still suffer from degraded local details and imperfect audio-visual alignment. We present PAGE (Parts-Aware GuidancE), a general, backbone-agnostic optimization framework for diffusion-based generation that enhances local spatial fidelity and global audio-visual consistency at both the training-objective and denoising-trajectory levels. During training, we propose Parts-Specific Reweighting (PSR), which adaptively increases supervision in semantically important regions such as lips, eyes, and hands, improving visual fidelity in perceptually critical areas. During inference, we introduce Consistency Classifier Guidance (CCG), an audio-conditioned latent classifier that identifies and corrects audio-visual inconsistencies in the generated video. We further design Differential Guidance (DG), an efficient inference strategy that refines facial and body motion separately while avoiding cross-region interference. To enable large-scale evaluation, we construct the Chinese Announcer Speech (CAS) dataset, the first comprehensive Chinese benchmark for co-speech gesture portrait video generation. Compared with the widely used PATS dataset, CAS includes substantially more identities, video clips, and scene diversity. Extensive experiments on both PATS and CAS demonstrate that PAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in perceptual quality, gesture diversity, and audio-visual alignment. Project page: https://aigc-explorer.github.io/PAGE/.

AI.tldr: PAGE是一个骨干无关的扩散生成优化框架，通过训练阶段的部件特定重加权与推理阶段的一致性分类器引导、差分引导，提升说话手势视频生成的局部细节与音画一致性，并构建了大规模中文基准CAS。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的说话手势视频生成方法虽在视觉质量上有进展，但仍存在局部细节退化（如嘴唇、眼睛、手部）以及音画对齐不理想的问题，且缺乏大规模中文评测基准。
AI.method: 提出PAGE通用优化框架，从训练目标和去噪轨迹两个层面优化：训练时采用部件特定重加权（PSR），在语义重要区域自适应增强监督；推理时引入一致性分类器引导（CCG），用音频条件潜变量分类器识别并纠正不一致；并提出差分引导（DG），分别精化面部与身体运动以避免跨区域干扰。同时构建了中文播音员语音（CAS）数据集。
AI.result: 在PATS与CAS数据集上，PAGE在感知质量、手势多样性和音画对齐方面均达到最先进性能。CAS相比PATS拥有更多身份、视频片段和场景多样性。
AI.conclusion: PAGE是一种通用、骨干无关的优化框架，可有效提升扩散式说话手势视频生成的局部空间保真度和全局音画一致性，并提供了首个全面的中文基准CAS以支持大规模评估。

title: State-OPD: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring reasoning capabilities from frontier models to smaller models, while extending its success to multi-turn agentic environments remains challenging. We study agentic OPD through interaction states, distinguishing the objective task and executed action-observation record from the internal semantic trajectory of student reasoning. Through this lens, we identify two roles of student reasoning in multi-turn OPD: prior reasoning distorts teacher supervision, while current reasoning shapes the action alternatives sampled at the same state. Specifically, at matched interaction states, removing prior student reasoning improves teacher continuation success and changes the teacher's token-level targets, with larger continuation gains at later turns. Meanwhile, resampling complete reasoning-action responses yields greater action diversity at the same state than resampling actions under a fixed reasoning trace. We introduce State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation, a framework that grounds teacher supervision in interaction states and reallocates the sampling budget to generate multiple complete reasoning-action responses at states with high response entropy, while retaining full-history student generation. Comprehensive evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop demonstrate that State-OPD achieves the highest macro-average success rate among the evaluated methods for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students. Notably, for Qwen3-4B, State-OPD raises macro-average success from 26.07\% with the strongest baseline to 31.74\% and surpasses its Qwen3-32B teacher on ALFWorld Seen. Further analyses reveal that State-OPD achieves higher task success with fewer supervised turn responses and substantially reduces persistent failed-action repetition; qualitative traces illustrate decision revision based on interaction feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多轮智能体环境下的On-Policy Distillation（OPD），从"交互状态"视角区分客观任务与动作-观测记录和学生内部推理轨迹，指出学生先验推理会扭曲教师监督、当前推理影响动作采样多样性，并提出State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation（State-OPD）框架。
AI.motivation: 将OPD从单轮推理任务扩展到多轮智能体环境面临挑战：学生推理在多轮交互中的角色尚不清晰，教师监督易被学生先验推理污染，且采样预算分配未考虑状态下响应熵的差异，导致蒸馏效率与成功率受限。
AI.method: 通过交互状态视角分析学生推理的两重作用（先验推理扭曲教师监督、当前推理塑造同状态动作候选）；提出State-OPD：将教师监督锚定在交互状态上，在高响应熵状态重新分配采样预算以生成多个完整"推理-动作"响应，并保留全历史学生生成。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop上，State-OPD对Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B学生均取得最高宏观平均成功率；Qwen3-4B上宏观平均成功率由最强基线的26.07%提升至31.74%，并在ALFWorld Seen上超过其Qwen3-32B教师。此外，以更少监督轮次响应实现更高成功率，显著减少持续性失败动作重复。
AI.conclusion: 将教师监督锚定于交互状态并聚焦高熵状态采样的State-OPD，能有效提升多轮智能体蒸馏的任务成功率与采样效率，缓解失败动作循环，并展现出基于交互反馈的决策修正能力。

title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
summary: The fast pace in which protocols, frameworks, and technologies are being proposed for LLM-based agents results in a complex scenario for anyone aiming to create state-of-the-art AI solutions. Without an assessment on how different protocols, frameworks, and libraries work together to compose an Agentic Web solution, developers and organizations face different challenges (e.g., skilling, governance, infrastructure) even before becoming part of the Agentic Web ecosystem. In this context, we propose a system for performing Agentic Web evaluations called MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) and present a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technologies, including 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks, against 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks. Results suggest that selecting a task-specific technology stack may result in gains of task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability scores; and reductions in verbosity and time to complete tasks. With the presented results, we expect to present a baseline in terms of metrics and results for this complex and fast evolving scenario for those aiming at designing, assessing, and developing multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体系统测试框架MASTIF，对Agentic Web技术栈（3个LLM、3种协议、4个智能体框架）在300个Mind2Web任务上进行基线评估。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体相关协议、框架与技术层出不穷，缺乏对它们如何协同构成Agentic Web方案的系统评估；开发者与组织在融入生态前即面临技能、治理、基础设施等挑战。
AI.method: 构建MASTIF（Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework）评估系统，针对3个LLM、3种协议、4个智能体实现框架的组合，在300个Mind2Web基准任务上进行基线测评。
AI.result: 结果表明，选择任务特定的技术栈可提升任务完成率、效率得分与社会价值稳定性得分，并降低冗长程度与任务完成时间。
AI.conclusion: 为这一复杂且快速演进的场景提供指标与结果的基线，助力多智能体系统的设计、评估与开发。

title: NovaSplat: Model-Free 6D Object Pose Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting Onboarding and Refinement
summary: 6D pose estimation of novel objects without CAD models remains an open challenge: model-free methods must build the object representation from scratch during onboarding and have long trailed their model-based counterparts. We present NovaSplat, a model-free pipeline that closes this gap. From a short smartphone video captured at onboarding, we train a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model that serves both as a template source for detection and coarse pose estimation and as a differentiable backbone for pose refinement. Our refiner optimizes the object-to-camera pose with combined photometric and geometric losses under a continuous rotation parametrization free of gradient singularities. On a household-object benchmark, NovaSplat surpasses all model-based methods. On a challenging industrial benchmark with textureless and specular surfaces, it outperforms all model-free competitors while substantially narrowing the gap to model-based ones. We further introduce NovaSplat-Lite, an inference variant that is $3.1\times$ faster at negligible accuracy cost. Code will be made available at \href{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}.

AI.tldr: NovaSplat是一个无需CAD模型的6D位姿估计流水线，利用智能手机短视频训练3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)模型，同时作为检测/粗位姿估计的模板来源和位姿精化的可微骨干，在无梯度奇异的连续旋转参数化下联合优化光度与几何损失，在家庭物品基准上超越所有基于模型方法，在工业基准上超越所有无模型方法，并推出推理加速3.1倍的NovaSplat-Lite。
AI.motivation: 新物体的6D位姿估计在缺乏CAD模型时仍是开放难题：无模型方法需在引导(onboarding)阶段从零构建物体表示，性能长期落后于基于模型的方法。本文旨在缩小甚至弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 从引导阶段用智能手机拍摄的短视频训练3DGS模型，该模型既作为检测与粗位姿估计的模板来源，又作为位姿精化的可微骨干；精化器在无梯度奇异的连续旋转参数化下，结合光度损失与几何损失优化物体到相机的位姿。
AI.result: 在家庭物品基准上超越所有基于模型的方法；在具有无纹理和镜面表面的高难度工业基准上超越所有无模型竞争者，并显著缩小与基于模型方法的差距；NovaSplat-Lite推理速度提升3.1倍且精度损失可忽略。
AI.conclusion: NovaSplat表明，借助3DGS与可微精化，无模型6D位姿估计可达到甚至超过基于模型方法的水准，为无CAD模型场景提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Effectively Shallow
summary: In-context-learning Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are uniquely suited to scenarios with limited resources or privacy constraints, as they solve new tasks without additional training. However, their architecture consists of multiple transformer blocks, resulting in high computational and memory footprints. Meanwhile, traditional alternatives like Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) remain highly competitive and run efficiently on CPUs, suggesting that tabular tasks may not inherently require deep architectures. This contrast raises a fundamental question: can TFMs be simplified by removing architectural redundancies without sacrificing performance? To answer this, we introduce a closed-form, label-free affine translator that replaces a contiguous window of up to 96% of the blocks, leaving the rest unchanged. Evaluating eight frontier TFMs on 171 classification datasets, we reveal that tabular transformers are vastly overparameterized: replacing half of a model's blocks costs at most $0.002$ median AUROC across all architectures, with the half-depth TabFM still outperforming every other full-depth TFMs and tuned GBDTs. Furthermore, different model families are overparameterized in different ways: TabPFN-3 relies on its encoders, maintaining performance regardless of which single block is retained. Other single-axis models spread computation thinly, needing only their first block, while dual-axis models concentrate it in one critical block. Ultimately, removing depth saves up to 1.5B parameters, speeds up GPU inference by up to $6\times$ at a median cost of $0.03$ AUROC, while a single-block TabPFN-3 serves cached queries $2.4\times$ faster using $6\times$ less memory at negligible cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需标签的闭式仿射转换器，可替换TFM中最多96%的连续block，揭示表格transformer存在严重过参数化，半深度模型性能损失极小且仍优于全深度模型与GBDT。
AI.motivation: TFM基于多transformer block，计算与内存开销大；而传统GBDT在CPU上高效且竞争力强，暗示表格任务未必需要深层架构。核心问题是：能否在不损失性能的前提下移除TFM的架构冗余？
AI.method: 引入闭式、无需标签的仿射转换器，替换模型中一段连续block（最多占96%），其余保持不变；在8个前沿TFM、171个分类数据集上评估，并分析不同模型家族的过参数化模式。
AI.result: 替换一半block在各架构上中位AUROC损失至多0.002，半深度TabFM仍优于所有全深度TFM和调优GBDT；TabPFN-3依赖编码器，保留任意单block均可维持性能；单轴模型仅需首个block，双轴模型将计算集中于某一关键block。移除深度可减少最多1.5B参数，GPU推理加速最高6倍（中位AUROC代价0.03）；单block TabPFN-3缓存查询快2.4倍、内存少6倍且代价可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 表格transformer显著过参数化，深度可被大幅压缩而不牺牲性能，且不同模型家族冗余结构各异，为TFM的高效部署与架构精简提供了依据。

title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
summary: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

AI.tldr: 提出 Adaptive DHiSparse，在分层稀疏 KV 存储上支持推测解码，并按负载自适应调整 KV 驻留，显著提升长上下文服务的吞吐与并发能力。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV 显存先于硬件算力成为瓶颈。已有 HiSparse 将历史 KV 存于主机内存并仅取回选中条目，但其缓存预算固定不变，且不支持 DSpark、DFlash2 等草稿模型推测解码，难以适配变化的负载与解码策略。
AI.method: 在分层稀疏 KV 上实现推测解码并自适应驻留：保护必需工作集，显存空闲时保留额外历史，其余通过精确融合检索回取。保留 DSpark 与 DFlash2 的提议与接受规则；查询之间共享缺失行检索，草稿 KV 采用窗口受限的环形缓冲，验证阶段在层组之间复用 staging。
AI.result: 100K 上下文、并发 128 时，GLM-5.3 配 DFlash2 达到每解码 GPU 793 输出 tokens/s，为 HiSparse 的 1.45 倍、非推测自适应服务的 1.27 倍；在与 HiSparse 相同延迟约束下，并发可达其 4 倍，输出为其 2.3–3.7 倍。DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 500K 上下文、并发 512 时，配 DSpark 输出为常驻服务的 1.85 倍。负载步进测试中，可选驻留把主机取回从选中行的 14.2% 降至 1.4%，并在压力下释放显存。
AI.conclusion: 通过负载自适应驻留与面向推测解码的层次化稀疏 KV 管理，Adaptive DHiSparse 在保持原有提议/接受规则的前提下，同时提升长上下文服务的吞吐、并发上限与显存弹性。

title: ThinkDrag: Semantic Drag-Based Image Editing with Visual Reasoning
summary: Drag-based image editing provides an intuitive interface for spatially controlled image manipulation by allowing users to specify handle and target points. Existing methods have made substantial progress through optimization-based, one-step, and feed-forward formulations, but they often interpret drag instructions as geometric displacements. This limits their effectiveness when the desired edit depends on interpreting image content and inferring a plausible semantic transformation from sparse point constraints. We introduce ThinkDrag, a unified multimodal framework for drag-based image editing with visual reasoning. ThinkDrag is trained to associate point constraints with meaningful object- and scene-level transformations, and can optionally produce an explicit reasoning trace that interprets the intended edit before image generation. This reasoning trace improves interpretability, particularly for ambiguous drags. Drag Endpoint Markers, motivated by an analysis of cross-image attention, provide an explicit correspondence signal that grounds each drag in image space. To support this framework, we construct a supervised dataset of semantic drag transformations paired with reasoning traces and introduce DragBench++, a benchmark targeting challenging drag-based editing scenarios with reference edit solutions. Experiments show that ThinkDrag achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving generation quality and plausibility while maintaining competitive point-following precision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ThinkDrag，一个带视觉推理的统一多模态拖拽式图像编辑框架，将点约束与对象/场景级语义变换关联，并可输出显式推理轨迹以提升可解释性；同时构建监督数据集与DragBench++基准，实验达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有拖拽式图像编辑方法（基于优化、一步式、前馈式）多将拖拽指令视为几何位移，当编辑需依赖图像内容理解、需从稀疏点约束推断合理语义变换时效果受限。
AI.method: ThinkDrag统一多模态框架：训练使点约束与对象级、场景级语义变换关联，可选在生成前产出显式推理轨迹以解释编辑意图；提出Drag Endpoint Markers，基于跨图像注意力分析，提供显式对应信号将拖拽锚定在图像空间。构建配对推理轨迹的语义拖拽变换监督数据集，并提出DragBench++基准，聚焦具参考编辑方案的困难拖拽编辑场景。
AI.result: 实验表明ThinkDrag取得SOTA性能，在提升生成质量与合理性的同时保持具竞争力的点跟随精度。
AI.conclusion: 将拖拽编辑从几何位移范式扩展为语义推理驱动的多模态编辑，显式推理轨迹提升可解释性（尤其对歧义拖拽），配合新数据集与基准推动该方向评测。

title: CAST: Credit Alignment for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
summary: Cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) requires aligning teacher and student sequences before their scores can be compared. Decoded-text alignment provides such correspondence at the chunk level, but leaves a distinct problem unresolved: credit alignment. A chunk-level signal specifies how much a span should change, but not how that signal should be distributed across student tokens, while tokens without teacher correspondence remain unconstrained. We propose CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring), a shift-or-stay framework that addresses both issues. For aligned chunks, CAST redistributes each chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness, emphasizing learning opportunities supported by locally consistent teacher feedback while preserving the chunk's total advantage. The resulting weights exactly solve a KL-regularized credit-allocation problem. For unaligned positions, CAST selectively anchors the student to its initial policy through a KL penalty, limiting drift where teacher supervision is unavailable. Because credit assignment is separated from chunk construction, CAST also applies to punctuation-defined or fixed-length chunks under shared tokenization. Across six mathematics, science, and code benchmarks, CAST improves the average over the strongest evaluated baseline by $2.45$ and $1.32$ points for cross-tokenizer transfer from Qwen3-8B to Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively, and by $2.10$ points for shared-tokenizer transfer to Qwen3-1.7B.

AI.tldr: CAST是一个面向跨分词器在线策略蒸馏的框架，通过分块级信用分配与选择性token锚定，解决"信用对齐"问题，在数学、科学、代码基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 跨分词器OPD中，解码文本对齐只能在chunk级别建立师生序列对应关系，但未解决信用对齐问题：chunk级信号只说明某段应改变多少，却不说明如何在学生token间分配该信号；同时无教师对应的token缺乏约束。
AI.method: 提出CAST（Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring）"移位或停留"框架。对已对齐chunk，利用预测不确定性与局部教师信号平滑度将chunk优势重新分配到学生token上，突出有局部一致教师反馈支持的学习机会，同时保持chunk总优势不变，所得权重恰好求解一个KL正则化信用分配问题；对未对齐位置，通过KL惩罚选择性地将学生锚定到初始策略，限制无教师监督处的漂移。信用分配与chunk构造解耦，故也适用于共享分词下的标点定义或固定长度chunk。
AI.result: 在六个数学、科学与代码基准上，跨分词器迁移（Qwen3-8B→Mistral-7B和Llama-3.1-8B）分别比最强评估基线平均提升2.45和1.32分；共享分词器迁移到Qwen3-1.7B提升2.10分。
AI.conclusion: CAST通过将信用分配与chunk构建分离，同时解决跨分词器蒸馏中的信用分配与未对齐token约束问题，在多种迁移设定下均取得一致且显著的性能提升。

title: A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
comment: Accepted as an oral at the FLLMPT workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: On-policy self-distillation promises to replace the sparse outcome signal of verifiable-reward RL with dense token-level credit: a teacher conditioned on the reference solution scores the student's own rollout, and the resulting distributional shift is distilled back into the policy. We investigate whether this scoring signal actually contains corrective credit. Using gold error spans in student rollouts, we test the two signals consumed by self-distillation objectives, the full-distribution KL and the token log-ratio, for two properties: whether they localize errors and whether they push probability away from erroneous student tokens. They exhibit neither of these properties nor can they reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts within the same problem. We argue that this failure is structural: locating an error in a reasoning trace is itself a search problem, while a scoring teacher is never explicitly asked to perform that search. The same model, with the same privileged information, localizes errors substantially better when allowed to generate a critique. This forms the motivation for \emph{critique-conditioned self-distillation}: first generate a critique of the current rollout, then condition the scoring teacher on that critique. The resulting signal localizes errors, is corrective within error spans, and shifts probability toward tokens that initiate backtracking such as ``Wait'', ``But'', and ``Actually''. We further show that the critique is useful both at test time, where resuming a wrong rollout with the critique in context converts math problems the model cannot solve by sampling, and in cold-start GRPO, where it provides an advantage signal on prompts for which verifiable rewards alone provide none.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑on-policy自蒸馏中"评分教师"提供的token级credit是否真正具有纠错性，发现KL与token log-ratio既不能定位错误也不能在错误片段内纠正概率，并据此提出"批判条件自蒸馏"（先生成critique，再让教师基于critique打分）。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的RL仅提供稀疏的结果信号，on-policy自蒸馏被寄望以密集的token级credit替代它。但作者怀疑这类评分信号是否真的包含纠错credit，因此需要实证检验其两大被消费信号（全分布KL与token log-ratio）是否具备定位错误和纠错的能力。
AI.method: 利用学生rollout中的gold error spans作为标注，检验两类信号是否(1)能定位错误、(2)能把概率推离错误的student tokens，并测试其能否可靠区分同一问题下的正确与错误rollout。作者将失败归因于结构性原因：定位推理链中的错误本身是一个搜索问题，而评分教师从未被显式要求执行该搜索。据此提出critique-conditioned self-distillation：先生成对当前rollout的critique，再让评分教师以该critique为条件进行打分。
AI.result: 原信号既不定位错误也不纠错，且无法可靠区分同一问题下的对错rollout。而同一模型在同样特权信息下，被允许生成critique时定位错误的能力显著提升。critique条件的自蒸馏信号能够定位错误、在错误片段内具有纠正性，并把概率推向"Wait""But""Actually"等触发回溯的token。该方法在测试时（带critique续写错误rollout）可解出采样无法解决的数学题，并在cold-start GRPO中为可验证奖励无法提供优势的prompt提供advantage信号。
AI.conclusion: 评分教师的token级信号不具备结构性纠错能力，因为它未被要求执行错误定位这一搜索过程；显式生成critique可使同一模型获得定位与纠错能力，从而支撑critique-conditioned self-distillation在测试时与cold-start GRPO中的有效性。

title: CoVA: Composing VAE Representations for Generative Learning
summary: Representation alignment with pretrained visual encoders improves diffusion transformer training but requires auxiliary encoders and extra training overhead. Recent approaches instead exploit representations from the generative model's own variational autoencoder (VAE). However, reconstruction-oriented VAE features are not optimized for the semantic discrimination and spatial structure needed for generative learning. We introduce \textbf{CoVA} (\textbf{Co}mposed \textbf{VA}E Representations), a lightweight framework that composes VAE features online into stage-wise guidance for flow-matching training. A small latent composer is jointly trained with class supervision, masked latent reconstruction, and horizontal-flip consistency, yielding semantically discriminative, spatially structured dense features and sample-dependent class posteriors. CoVA aligns intermediate SiT features with the composed representations early in training, then removes the increasingly detrimental alignment and reuses detached composer posteriors for sample-dependent soft label conditioning. We further uncover a hidden confound in soft label conditioning: averaging class embeddings attenuates their magnitude, coupling semantic interpolation with conditioning strength. This attenuation alone can substantially improve FID while degrading Recall, revealing a non-semantic source of the apparent gain. CoVA corrects this confound by restoring the hard-label magnitude, isolating posterior-dependent directional semantics. CoVA adds only 8.5M training-only auxiliary parameters (1.3\% of SiT-XL/2) and introduces no inference-time overhead. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, CoVA reduces SiT-XL/2 FID from 17.2 to 7.4 (\textbf{57\%}) in 400K steps. With classifier-free guidance, it achieves an FID of \textbf{2.03} in only 400 epochs, versus 2.06 after 1,400 epochs for vanilla SiT-XL/2.

AI.tldr: CoVA是一个轻量框架，在线将VAE特征组合为分阶段引导，用于流匹配训练，在SiT-XL/2上以极少额外参数显著降低FID。
AI.motivation: 利用预训练视觉编码器进行表示对齐虽能改善扩散Transformer训练，但需辅助编码器和额外训练开销；而直接用生成模型自身的VAE表示又因面向重建、缺乏语义判别性和空间结构而不理想。
AI.method: 提出CoVA，用小型latent composer在线组合VAE特征，联合类监督、掩码latent重建与水平翻转一致性训练，产生语义判别、空间结构化的密集特征和样本相关类后验；早期将SiT中间特征与组合表示对齐，后期移除对齐并复用分离的composer后验做样本相关软标签条件；并纠正软标签条件中的幅度衰减混杂。
AI.result: 仅增加8.5M训练期辅助参数（SiT-XL/2的1.3%），无推理开销；ImageNet 256×256上400K步将FID从17.2降至7.4（57%）；结合无分类器引导，400轮达到FID 2.03，而vanilla SiT-XL/2需1400轮才达2.06。
AI.conclusion: CoVA通过在线组合VAE表示实现高效表示对齐与软标签条件，揭示并纠正软标签幅度衰减混杂，以极低开销显著提升扩散Transformer生成质量。

title: Neural Surrogate Modeling of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Media
summary: Neural surrogates provide computationally efficient auto-regressive modeling of wave propagation, enabling e.g. fast inverse solutions. Despite recent progress, the current surrogates are not yet sufficient for the needs of ultrasonic sensing, characterized by high frequency and heterogeneous propagation media. We show how methods building on Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) fail to capture essential signal features, such as reflections, whereas U-Net -based methods learn the wave fields well but lack the ability to transfer information across different spatial scales. We then propose a new surrogate that captures the best of the two worlds, by integrating FNOs and local-integral resampling into a U-Net architecture. We show it can be trained on limited data, and that the predictions are robust to input noise and work across spatial scales.

AI.tldr: 提出融合FNO与局部积分重采样的U-Net神经代理模型，用于超声波动仿真，兼具多尺度信息传递与信号特征（反射）捕捉能力，且数据需求低、抗噪、跨空间尺度可用。
AI.motivation: 超声传感场景具有高频、介质异质的特点，现有自动回归神经代理模型难以满足需求：基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的方法无法捕捉反射等关键信号特征，而U-Net类方法虽能较好学习波场，却缺乏跨空间尺度的信息传递能力。
AI.method: 将FNO与局部积分重采样（local-integral resampling）整合进U-Net架构，构建新的波动传播神经代理模型。
AI.result: 该模型可在有限数据上完成训练；预测结果对输入噪声具有鲁棒性，并能跨不同空间尺度工作。
AI.conclusion: 融合FNO与U-Net的混合代理模型有效结合两者优势，弥补各自在信号特征捕捉与多尺度信息传递上的缺陷，适用于高频异质介质下的超声波动建模与快速反演。

title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
summary: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究乌克兰网络迷因中的说服技术检测，构建了乌克兰战时迷因数据集UkrMeme和乌克兰语Propaganda950子集PTM-UA，零样本评估视觉语言模型在图像、文本和多模态输入下的表现，并比较LRP与模型生成token归因的解释方法。
AI.motivation: 迷因在现代在线交流、尤其是政治冲突语境中具有重要说服作用，视觉与文本线索结合传递说服信息；但乌克兰语迷因的说服技术检测资源与方法尚不充分，且VLM在此类任务上的表现与解释性有待探究。
AI.method: 构建200条有机产生的乌克兰战时迷因数据集UkrMeme，并标注说服技术；构建PTM-UA，即Propaganda 950基准子集的乌克兰语翻译，保留原始视觉内容、翻译迷因文本；在零样本提示设置下，以图像、文本和多模态输入评估视觉语言模型，采用层次化F1指标；比较LRP与模型生成的token归因，分析各解释方法强调的证据语义类别。
AI.result: 评估VLM在零样本、图像/文本/多模态输入下的说服技术检测性能，使用层次化F1度量；对LRP与模型生成token归因进行对比，并分析两种解释方法所强调证据的语义类别差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为乌克兰语迷因说服技术检测提供了数据集与基准，揭示VLM在多模态说服检测中的零样本能力，并通过解释方法对比加深对模型证据关注模式的理解。

title: LETHE: Defending against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation via Value Diversity Collapse
summary: Image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single reference image into high-quality, subject-consistent videos, posing threats of misuse as anyone can turn personal photos into fabricated videos without consent. A promising solution is to proactively add an adversarial perturbation to the image before release, such that videos generated from it would be unfaithful or visually corrupted. However, due to an insufficient understanding of what governs how subsequent frames read the reference image in modern I2V models, existing protections struggle to offer strong protection under common perturbation budgets. In this paper, we approach the problem by exploring this underlying reading mechanism. Through a convex geometric analysis, we theoretically identify the spread of the reference value vectors as a key factor governing this reading process, and empirically find that even a mild contraction of this spread can severely degrade the generated video, making it an efficient lever for protection. Guided by this insight, we propose LETHE, a novel protection method that directly disrupts this reading process. LETHE pairs two complementary objectives, where a value collapse objective drives the reference value vectors toward uniformity, while an attention attraction objective draws subsequent frames toward these collapsed tokens to amplify corruption. We further construct two human-centric I2V protection benchmarks and conduct extensive experiments with multiple modern I2V models, which demonstrate the state-of-the-art protection performance and versatility of LETHE.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示I2V扩散模型读取参考图的机制在于参考值向量分布的"离散度（spread）"，据此提出LETHE保护方法，通过"值崩溃"与"注意力吸引"两个目标主动破坏该读取过程，在人本I2V保护基准上取得SOTA防护效果。
AI.motivation: I2V扩散模型能将单张参考图动画化为高质量、主体一致的视频，带来未经同意伪造个人视频的滥用风险。现有主动防御（在发布前向图像添加对抗扰动）因对现代I2V模型中后续帧如何"读取"参考图的机制理解不足，在常规扰动预算下防护效果有限，亟需厘清该底层读取机理。
AI.method: 1) 通过凸几何分析，理论上识别出参考值向量（reference value vectors）的"离散度/spread"是支配该读取过程的关键因素；2) 实证发现即使轻微压缩该离散度也会严重劣化生成视频，证明其是高效的保护杠杆；3) 据此提出LETHE，直接破坏读取过程，包含两个互补目标：值崩溃目标（value collapse）驱使参考值向量趋于一致，注意力吸引目标（attention attraction）将后续帧的注意力拉向这些已崩溃的token以放大破坏；4) 构建两个以人为中心的I2V保护基准，并在多种现代I2V模型上做大量实验。
AI.result: 在多个现代I2V模型与两个新建的人本I2V保护基准上，LETHE展现出最先进（state-of-the-art）的防护性能，并具备良好的通用性（versatility）。
AI.conclusion: 参考值向量离散度是决定I2V模型读取参考图的关键因素，可作为高效防护抓手；LETHE通过值崩溃与注意力吸引协同破坏该读取机制，在常规扰动预算下实现了强防护与跨模型通用性。

title: Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Metric Learning for Cross-Head Attention in Transformers
summary: In this paper, we propose Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Cross-Head Attention (DAMCHA), a simple and effective attention mechanism that generalizes Multi-Head Attention (MHA) through the lens of metric learning. Standard MHA implicitly learns a static, head-wise Euclidean similarity corresponding to the diagonal blocks of a unified cross-head metric matrix, discarding all off-diagonal interactions across heads. DAMCHA addresses this limitation via two key innovations. First, it learns the full cross-head metric matrix, inducing a Mahalanobis-like similarity that explicitly captures inter-head interactions beyond the restricted block-diagonal structure of MHA. Second, it parameterizes the metric matrix as an input-dependent function, enabling the attention geometry to dynamically adapt to the intrinsic manifold structure of the data rather than remaining fixed after training. We further introduce principled regularization strategies, most notably stack-wise parameter sharing, to ensure computational efficiency and stable optimization. DAMCHA serves as a drop-in replacement for MHA and its variants in various Transformer architectures, delivering superior expressive power and learning performance with comparable or reduced computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAMCHA-based Transformers consistently outperform competing baselines across a range of benchmark tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/erwinmsmith/DAMCHA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAMCHA，一种从度量学习视角泛化多头注意力的简单有效机制，通过学习完整跨头度量矩阵并使其输入依赖，实现动态注意力几何，性能优于基线且计算开销相当或更低。
AI.motivation: 标准多头注意力（MHA）隐式学习的是静态的、逐头的欧氏相似度，仅对应统一跨头度量矩阵的对角块，丢弃了头间的非对角交互，且训练后注意力几何固定，难以适应数据的内在流形结构。
AI.method: DAMCHA包含两项关键创新：一是学习完整的跨头度量矩阵，诱导类马氏距离相似度，显式捕获头间交互，超越MHA的块对角限制；二是将度量矩阵参数化为输入依赖的函数，使注意力几何能随数据内在流形结构动态适应。此外引入有原则的正则化策略，尤其是堆叠式参数共享，以保证计算效率和优化稳定性。DAMCHA可作为MHA及其变体的即插即用替代。
AI.result: DAMCHA在多种Transformer架构中提供更强的表达能力和学习性能，计算开销相当或更低。大量实验表明，基于DAMCHA的Transformer在多种基准任务上持续优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: DAMCHA从度量学习视角统一并推广了多头注意力，通过跨头度量与输入依赖参数化实现动态注意力几何，并借助参数共享等正则化保持效率，是一种可即插即用、表达力更强的注意力机制。代码已开源。

title: Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga
summary: Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938--1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page's visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAGE框架，将人工智能（含生成模型）作为漫画研究的工具，对扫描页进行分格、文本与书目解析、按编码手册进行视觉-语言标注、以人工标注校准，并在控制出版商与体裁后解释档案变迁；在3,929册美国漫画与87卷日本漫画上开展三项研究验证其能力。
AI.motivation: 漫画是20世纪重要的视觉记录，但既有漫画研究多逐本进行，缺乏对整批档案的系统性分析，亟需能整体处理大规模漫画档案的研究方法。
AI.method: PAGE框架：将每页扫描解析为分格、文本和书目记录；用遵循书面编码手册的视觉-语言模型逐页标注（模拟人工编码者）；将部分模型判读以人工标注进行校验；在估计中控制出版商与体裁等变量，以解释档案层面的变化。
AI.result: 在3,929册美国漫画（1938–1956）和87卷日本漫画上开展三项研究：一是结合文本检索与视觉阅读，还原大众媒介对政治权力的呈现；二是跨行业测量页面视觉形式，辨识个别画家的手法；三是追踪两种漫画传统中的言说主体，并与人工标注核对。
AI.conclusion: 除研究用途外，该方法可使档案按图像内容检索，为盲人与低视力读者开放漫画，帮助保存脆弱藏品并为未署名画家厘清归属；作者提出以AI强化漫画研究、保存与传播的研究议程。

title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
summary: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究文生图Transformer中的注意力汇聚现象：在双向扩散模型与因果自回归模型中均存在，但模式不同，且具架构、推理阶段与组件依赖性，并提供机制分析与注意力设计的依据。
AI.motivation: 注意力汇聚在LLM中已有广泛研究，但在文生图Transformer中的行为与功能相关性尚属空白，需理解其如何分配与路由注意力。
AI.method: 对双向扩散模型与因果自回归模型进行系统注意力分析，考察汇聚是否存在、出现位置及功能影响；采用针对性扰动（汇聚相关头与token位置）与register token重分配实验。
AI.result: 两类模型均出现注意力汇聚但模式不同：自回归模型集中于首个与全局尺度token；双向模型汇聚出现在模态边界、文本区域内与空间角落，并随生成阶段变化、局限于稀疏的层与头。扰动汇聚排序头带来更大平均变化，而部分汇聚位置扰动对双向模型分数影响有限；register token重分配后若干配置保持或小幅提升生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 注意力汇聚是架构、推理阶段与组件依赖的现象，为文生图Transformer的机制分析与原则化注意力设计提供了基础。

title: CopRoute: Dependence-Aware Conformal Routing for Language Models
comment: 41 pages, 6 figures, 20 tables, accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI 2026)
summary: Set-based language model routing aims to increase the coverage of the event where at least one model answers a query correctly while controlling the number of inference calls made. Existing risk-controlled routing policies bound the all-miss risk (the probability that every model in the selected set fails) by calibrating a single conformal threshold and applying it to a nested family of model sets. Because each model is scored in isolation, these policies ignore the dependence structure of model failures. Models that share training data or architecture tend to fail on the same queries, so two individually strong models can be jointly redundant while a weaker but complementary model covers the queries that the others miss. To account for this dependence, which existing risk-controlled policies ignore, we propose CopRoute, which orders models by how many new queries each one answers correctly beyond those already selected, decides per query how far down that order to go, and then picks the smallest cutoff that still meets the target risk. We show that CopRoute's ordering attains, on the design data, the best guarantee any efficient fixed-ordering algorithm can give for the average number of calls to the first correct model, and that a separate calibration step certifies the all-miss risk of the deployed sets. On RouterBench and RouterEval, CopRoute attains the fewest certified calls on nine of ten datasets at a target risk of 0.05 and on eight of ten at 0.10, making up to 79 percent fewer calls (median 24 percent) than the state-of-the-art risk-controlled policy at the same certified all-miss risk.

AI.tldr: 提出 CopRoute，一种基于集合的语言模型路由方法，通过按模型对新增正确查询的覆盖量排序并逐查询选择最小截断，实现对全失风险的校准控制，并在多个基准上显著减少推理调用数。
AI.motivation: 现有风险可控路由策略通过单一保形阈值控制全失风险，但独立打分每个模型，忽略了模型失效之间的依赖结构；共享训练数据或架构的模型倾向于在同一批查询上失败，导致两个单独强模型可能联合冗余，而一个较弱但互补的模型能覆盖他人遗漏的查询。因此需要一种考虑依赖关系的路由方法。
AI.method: CopRoute 按每个模型在已选模型之外新正确回答的查询数量对模型排序，并逐查询决定在该排序中向下走到哪一步，随后选择仍满足目标风险的最小截断。该方法在排序上给出了设计数据上任何高效固定排序算法可达到的最优保证（针对第一个正确模型的平均调用次数），并通过单独的校准步骤认证所部署集合的全失风险。
AI.result: 在 RouterBench 和 RouterEval 上，目标风险 0.05 时 CopRoute 在十个数据集中的九个取得最少的认证调用数，0.10 时在八个中取得最少；在相同的认证全失风险下，相比最先进的风险可控策略最多减少 79% 的调用（中位数 24%）。
AI.conclusion: CopRoute 通过考虑模型失效的依赖结构并在设计数据上优化排序，实现了对全失风险的有效校准，同时显著降低了达到目标风险所需的推理调用数，在多数基准数据集上优于现有风险可控路由策略。

title: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems
summary: Personal agents increasingly connect to services across the web and applications by using tools. As the effects of their actions accumulate and interact across services, unintended or harmful outcomes can arise when agents fulfill benign user requests. Proactively identifying these compositional failures requires systematically exploring diverse cross-service paths. Existing red-teaming methods often simply prompt LLMs to identify potentially harmful paths from task and environment descriptions or decompose harmful objectives specified by humans or LLMs into seemingly benign action combinations. However, generation is biased toward patterns learned during training, potentially favoring familiar tool combinations and leaving novel cross-service interactions underexplored. To address this, we propose X-AgentRed, a self-evolving red-teaming framework that discovers harmful tool call paths through a graph of tool dependencies and expands and refines them using execution feedback. By analyzing each tool's effects, potential harms, and preconditions for execution, the red-teaming agent constructs a directed graph that captures how one tool's effects can satisfy another's execution preconditions. Recipes sampled from this graph are instantiated as realistic scenarios in which agents can produce harmful outcomes. Execution feedback enables self-improvement by diversifying paths that produce harm through tool substitution and refining preconditions at blocked steps in unsuccessful paths to enable further execution. Across four frontier agentic models, X-AgentRed achieves $1.77\times$ the harmful path rate of STAC and explores a more diverse set of tools, yielding $2.99\times$ the tool coverage on average.

AI.tldr: 提出X-AgentRed，一种自进化红队测试框架，通过工具依赖图发现有害工具调用路径，并利用执行反馈扩展与优化，在四个前沿智能体模型上平均达到STAC的1.77倍有害路径率和2.99倍工具覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 个人智能体通过工具连接跨Web与应用的服务，其行为效果跨服务累积与交互，可能在使用者提出良性请求时引发非预期或有害后果。此类组合性失效需要系统探索多样的跨服务路径。现有红队方法多依赖提示LLM从任务与环境描述中识别潜在有害路径，或将人类/LLM指定的有害目标分解为看似良性的动作组合，但生成偏向训练中习得的模式，倾向于熟悉的工具组合，导致新颖的跨服务交互探索不足。
AI.method: X-AgentRed构建工具依赖有向图：分析每个工具的效果、潜在危害与执行前置条件，刻画一个工具的效果如何满足另一工具的执行前置条件。从图中采样"配方"（recipes），实例化为现实场景，使智能体可产生有害结果。利用执行反馈进行自我改进：通过工具替换（tool substitution）多样化产生危害的路径，并对失败路径中被阻断步骤的前置条件进行细化，以支持进一步执行。
AI.result: 在四个前沿智能体模型上，X-AgentRed达到STAC的1.77倍有害路径率，并探索了更多样的工具集合，平均工具覆盖率为STAC的2.99倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于工具依赖图与执行反馈的自进化红队测试，可有效突破训练偏好导致的路径单一化，发现更多样、更新颖的跨服务有害工具调用路径，显著提升有害路径发现率与工具覆盖度。

title: VideoAWR: Reinforcing Video Flow Models with Decoupled-Timestep Advantage-Weighted Rectification
summary: Regression-based RL for flow models mandates sampling \emph{without} classifier-free guidance (CFG) to align the rectification target with the reference marginal velocity. Extending Advantage-Weighted Rectification (AWR), which dynamically scales this regression target based on reward, to video generation encounters a cold-start pathology: unguided rollouts collapse into low-fidelity regions where intra-group reward gaps remain wide but no longer track perceptual quality, rendering the optimization target arbitrary. Conversely, utilizing guided rollouts to restore fidelity, while keeping the regression target tied to the guided sampling distribution, provably triggers a geometric guidance blow-up under exponential-moving-average (EMA) updates. We propose \textbf{VideoAWR}, which resolves this tension by untying sampling from the optimization anchor. An EMA reference policy generates \emph{guided} rollouts to restore reward separability, while the trainable policy is rectified against the \emph{unguided} conditional anchor. We prove this decoupled objective is mathematically exact: the centered advantage cancels the anchor in expectation, filtering out the reward-neutral guidance offset and retaining only the reward-correlated covariance increment. Consequently, inference runs single-branch and CFG-free, yet inference-time CFG preserves its original semantics. Furthermore, we introduce \emph{Decoupled Timestep Rectification}, supervising each rollout at an independently sampled timestep without bias to improve sample efficiency. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B and 14B demonstrate stable optimization and superior visual and motion quality in \emph{both} CFG-free and CFG-enabled regimes. Code is available at \pdfstartlink attr{/Border [0 0 0]} user{/Subtype /Link /A << /S /URI /URI (https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR) >>}% \textcolor{pearDark}{VideoAWR}\pdfendlink.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoAWR，通过将采样过程与优化锚点解耦，解决视频流模型强化学习中的冷启动与引导爆炸问题，实现无 CFG 推理下的稳定优化与优质生成。
AI.motivation: 基于回归的流模型强化学习要求采样时不用无分类器引导（CFG），以对齐整流目标与参考边缘速度。将 AWR 扩展到视频生成时出现冷启动病理：无引导 rollout 塌缩到低保真区域，组内奖励差虽大但不再反映感知质量，导致优化目标任意。而用引导 rollout 恢复保真度、同时把回归目标绑定到引导分布，会在 EMA 更新下引发几何引导爆炸。
AI.method: VideoAWR 将采样与优化锚点解耦：用 EMA 参考策略生成带引导的 rollout 以恢复奖励可分性，而可训练策略则针对无引导的条件锚点进行整流。理论上证明该解耦目标精确：中心化优势在期望上抵消锚点，滤除奖励中性的引导偏移，仅保留与奖励相关的协方差增量。此外引入解耦时间步整流，对每次 rollout 在独立采样的时间步上监督以提升样本效率。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1-1.3B 与 14B 上实验表明优化稳定，并在无 CFG 与启用 CFG 两种模式下均获得更优的视觉与运动质量。
AI.conclusion: VideoAWR 通过解耦引导采样与无引导整流锚点，兼顾奖励可分性与理论正确性，实现单分支、无 CFG 推理，同时保留推理时 CFG 的原始语义，为视频流模型强化学习提供了稳定有效的方案。

title: MHR-Router: Multimodal Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing for VLM Inference
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit complementary capabilities, yet selecting the most suitable expert for a given image-question query remains challenging due to heterogeneous multimodal inputs and varying expert strengths. Existing routing approaches rely on text-based cues or static model profiles, failing to capture fine-grained visual evidence and expert-specific failure patterns. To address this, we propose MHR-Router, a multimodal heterogeneous retrieval-enhanced adaptive routing framework for VLM inference. It accurately dispatches each multimodal query to the most suitable VLM expert via local retrieval evidence. MHR-Router consists of two stages: (1) Multimodal Routing Representation, which fuses frozen multimodal features into a comprehensive query representation; and (2) Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing, which retrieves expert-specific success and failure memories as local evidence and employs a shared scorer to adaptively select the optimal expert. Experiments show that MHR-Router effectively achieves heterogeneous modality routing and consistently improves accuracy over traditional baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 MHR-Router，一种基于多模态异构检索增强的自适应路由框架，用于为每个图文查询分派最合适的视觉语言模型专家，并在实验中持续提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型能力互补，但因多模态输入异构、各专家优势不同，为给定图文查询选择最优专家仍具挑战。现有路由方法依赖文本线索或静态模型画像，无法捕捉细粒度视觉证据与专家特定的失败模式。
AI.method: MHR-Router 分两阶段：(1) 多模态路由表示，融合冻结的多模态特征形成综合查询表示；(2) 异构检索增强自适应路由，检索专家特定成功与失败记忆作为局部证据，并用共享打分器自适应选择最优专家。
AI.result: 实验表明，MHR-Router 有效实现异构模态路由，并在准确率上持续优于传统基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入局部检索证据与专家成败记忆，MHR-Router 突破了文本线索与静态画像的局限，为 VLM 推理提供更精准的专家选择方案。

title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
summary: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RATED，一个结合鲁棒语义匹配与动态可靠性适配的工具检索框架，并构建 EcoAgent 基准，在真实查询上大幅提升 MRR 并显著降低故障选择率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具检索方法主要优化语义相关性，却忽略了执行阶段工具的实际可用性，导致在运行时工具故障时仍可能检索到不可用工具，影响 AI 智能体的可靠性。
AI.method: RATED 采用冻结双编码器结合对比微调进行语义匹配，并引入轻量级上下文赌博机模块，依据实时执行反馈对候选工具进行重排序，从而无需昂贵重训练即可快速适应运行时工具故障。同时构建 EcoAgent 基准，包含 5,172 个真实工具与超过 210,000 个查询-工具对。
AI.result: 在真实查询上，RATED 相比 ToolLLM API 检索器取得 52.2% 的相对 MRR 提升；在 30% 失败率的严重 API 中断场景下，将故障选择率从 86.2% 降至 2.9%，且相较仅编码推理的额外延迟低于 1 ms。
AI.conclusion: 将语义匹配与执行动态下的可靠性适配相结合，可有效提升工具检索在真实运行环境中的鲁棒性，且以极小延迟代价实现动态故障适应；EcoAgent 为离线检索与动态可靠性评估提供了基准。

title: Why DiT Models Underperform as Representation Learners without Long Skip Connections
summary: Diffusion feature, i.e., intermediate activations extracted from diffusion model backbones, has emerged as a promising approach for unifying generation and vision understanding (discrimination). Despite the advancement of diffusion backbones into Diffusion Transformers (DiT), it has been found in previous literature that DiT models tend to yield weaker features despite their stronger generation capability. This poses a threat to good generation-understanding unification. In this work, we show via controlled from-scratch training that long skip connections (LSCs) affect feature quality: a DiT with LSCs can produce better features. Furthermore, through detailed diagnosis, we reveal the mechanism causing this effect. Specifically, the input to a diffusion backbone contains both the latent image and the diffusion noise, where the diffusion noise, though appearing in the form of noises, actually reflects the information of the diffusion trajectory. To make the final prediction of a noisy variable ($v$ or $ε$), the diffusion backbone needs both signals. However, carrying both signals through the main backbone effectively "pollutes" the image signal with noises, leading to poor feature quality. In comparison, LSCs can shortcut diffusion noises directly to where they are needed, leaving much weaker noise signals in the main backbone, thus improving feature quality. To name the broader impact, this reveals that LSCs are not a mere trick but closely related to the diffusion objective. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-lsc.

AI.tldr: 本文通过从头训练的控制实验发现，DiT中的长跳连接（LSC）能提升扩散特征质量，并揭示其机制：LSC将扩散噪声捷径传递到需要处，避免主骨干中图像信号被噪声污染。
AI.motivation: 扩散特征（从扩散模型骨干提取的中间激活）有望统一生成与视觉理解，但已有文献发现更强的DiT模型反而产生更弱特征，威胁生成-理解统一，因此需探究提升DiT特征质量的方法与机理。
AI.method: 采用从头训练的可控实验，对比有无长跳连接（LSC）的DiT特征质量；并通过细致诊断分析骨干输入（潜图像与扩散噪声）及两类信号在主干中的传播方式。
AI.result: 带LSC的DiT能产生更好特征；机制在于扩散噪声虽表现为噪声，实则反映扩散轨迹信息，主干同时携带图像与噪声信号会用噪声"污染"图像信号，而LSC可将噪声直接捷径传递到所需位置，使主干中噪声信号大幅减弱，从而提升特征质量。
AI.conclusion: LSC并非单纯技巧，而与扩散目标紧密相关，这为生成-理解统一提供了新视角。代码已开源。

title: Recovering Irreducible Three-Body Interactions with Lagrangian Neural Networks
summary: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn mechanical systems from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving the dynamics through the Euler-Lagrange equations, biasing the model toward motion that respects the variational structure of mechanics. The interactions studied so far have been pairwise-additive, leaving open whether LNNs can recover an irreducible many-body interaction from motion alone. We address this using the Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole interaction, the leading three-body dispersion term, whose dependence on the collective geometry of three particles cannot be represented by any sum of pairwise terms. We prescribe the kinetic energy exactly and learn only the potential, as a function of interparticle distances and angles. Combined with a signal-aware sampling strategy that concentrates training data where the three-body signal is strongest while preserving broad coverage of configuration space, this recovers the interaction from accelerations alone. The learned potential reproduces the radial scaling, angular dependence, and characteristic sign reversal of the Axilrod-Teller interaction, and generates stable trajectories. Embedding it within a pairwise Lennard-Jones potential lets us examine its observability: the three-body term is recovered once its dynamical signature exceeds the residual modeling error, which it does cleanly at amplified coupling but not at the coupling of a real noble gas, bracketing the transition between the two. Finally, symbolic regression on the trained potential, with no assumed functional form, returns the Axilrod-Teller expression with angular numerator, radial law, and coupling constant intact. An LNN with domain-specific structure can thus recover an irreducible three-body interaction from trajectories as a closed-form law, pointing toward learning interaction laws whose structure is not known a priori.

AI.tldr: 本文研究拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）能否仅从轨迹数据中恢复不可约的三体相互作用，以Axilrod-Teller三偶极相互作用为对象（无法分解为任何两体项之和），精确给定动能、仅以粒子间距离和角度为变量学习势能，并结合信号感知采样策略。结果显示：所学势能复现了Axilrod-Teller的径向标度、角度依赖与符号反转，可生成稳定轨迹；在嵌入Lennard-Jones两体势后，三体项在动力学信号超过残差建模误差时可被恢复（放大耦合下清晰恢复，真实惰性气体耦合下则不能），界定了可观测性转变区间；对训练势做符号回归能在不假设函数形式的情况下返回完整Axilrod-Teller表达式。结论：具有领域结构的LNN可从轨迹中以闭式定律形式恢复不可约三体相互作用。
AI.motivation: 拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）通过参数化标量拉格朗日量并经欧拉-拉格朗日方程导出动力学，使模型偏向符合力学变分结构的运动；但已有研究中的相互作用均为成对可加形式，LNN能否仅凭运动数据恢复不可约的多体相互作用仍属未解问题。本文据此选取Axilrod-Teller三偶极相互作用（主导三体色散项，其依赖于三粒子集体几何，无法用任何两体项之和表示）作为检验对象。
AI.method: 精确给定动能，仅以粒子间距离和角度为函数学习势能；采用信号感知的采样策略，将训练数据集中在三体信号最强处，同时保持对构型空间的广泛覆盖。进一步把学到的三体势嵌入成对Lennard-Jones势中，通过调节耦合并比较动力学信号与残差建模误差来检验可观测性；最后对训练好的势做符号回归，不预设函数形式。
AI.result: 仅凭加速度数据即可恢复该相互作用。所学势能复现了Axilrod-Teller相互作用的径向标度、角度依赖及特征性符号反转，并能生成稳定轨迹。嵌入Lennard-Jones势后，三体项在其动力学特征超过残差建模误差时被恢复：放大耦合下可清晰恢复，真实惰性气体耦合下则不能，从而界定了两者间的转变区间。符号回归在无假设函数形式下返回了Axilrod-Teller表达式，角度分子项、径向律与耦合常数均保持完整。
AI.conclusion: 具有领域特定结构的LNN能够仅从轨迹中以闭式定律的形式恢复不可约三体相互作用，为学习结构先验未知的相互作用定律提供了方向。

title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
comment: 64 pages (14-page main text, references and 16 appendices), 17 figures, 10 tables
summary: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.

AI.tldr: 该研究用"维基百科游戏"（仅通过文章链接到达目标文章）作为信息检索类比任务，在五种维基百科语言和五个学术文献数据集上比较句子嵌入模型与大语言模型的导航能力，并基于OpenAlex构建超大规模本地图以避免依赖第三方API。结果显示：没有任何模型显著超越人类，但GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B和DeepSeek-R1:70B等最佳模型表现与人类相当。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益被用于从过大而无法建立索引的文档集合中检索信息，当任务需要专业语言学或科学知识时尤为困难。然而，现有评估往往依赖第三方API，缺乏跨语言、跨领域且可与人类直接对比的稳健基准，因此作者需要一个可控、可复现的任务来系统考察语言模型的导航能力。
AI.method: 以"维基百科游戏"（Wikipedia Game）作为信息检索的类比任务，要求模型仅通过文章链接到达目标文章。研究使用OpenAlex数据构建了极大的维基本地页面图和论文引用图，并提供构建与导航代码，从而在不依赖第三方API的情况下研究语言模型导航能力。比较对象包括句子嵌入模型与LLM，覆盖五种维基百科语言和五个学术文献数据集，并设置人类与TF-IDF基准。
AI.result: 没有任何模型显著优于人类；但最佳模型（GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B、DeepSeek-R1:70B）取得了与人类相当的成功率。模型性能与排名随语言和主题不同而变化。维基百科游戏形式支持跨技术、语言与领域的稳健比较。
AI.conclusion: 维基百科游戏可作为评估语言模型信息检索与导航能力的稳健、可复现基准，且无需依赖第三方API。由于没有模型显著超越人类且表现因语言与主题而异，实践者在应用这些技术时需谨慎考虑任务的语言与领域特征。

title: TextVBench: Evaluating Text Rendering and Preservation in Video Generation
summary: Modern video generators can synthesize convincing scenes while rendering a few characters incorrectly, omitting requested text, or changing it across frames. Measuring these failures is harder than applying OCR independently to each frame: when a scene contains multiple text targets and multiple noisy OCR regions, the evaluator must first determine which observation belongs to which intended text. We introduce TextVBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework that formulates visual-text evaluation as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem. TextVBench contains two complementary tracks: TextVBench-T2V measures the creation and maintenance of prompt-specified text, while TextVBench-Ref2V measures preservation of text from reference images. Both tracks use target-conditioned candidate selection rather than unconstrained VLM transcription, support one target mapping to multiple OCR regions, and separate frame-level spatial fidelity from cross-frame temporal fidelity. A length-weighted harmonic score summarizes these factors, while extra-text diagnostics expose failure modes hidden by a single OCR score. The benchmark is organized around controlled text, layout, carrier, and motion attributes so that aggregate scores can be traced back to specific capability limits. Across the evaluated model runs, MiniMax-H3 reaches a T2V TextVScore of 68.32, while the strongest Ref2V score is 56.51; attribute slices reveal a pronounced drop as the number of simultaneous reference text regions increases.

AI.tldr: 提出 TextVBench 基准与评估框架，将视频中视觉文本评估建模为多目标、多实例的时空对应问题，包含 T2V 与 Ref2V 两条轨道，并给出长度加权调和分数与额外文本诊断。
AI.motivation: 现代视频生成模型能生成逼真场景，但在文本渲染上常出错：角色渲染错误、遗漏指定文本或跨帧改变文本。逐帧独立 OCR 难以衡量这类失败，因为当场景含多个文本目标和多个带噪声的 OCR 区域时，评估者需先确定哪个观测对应哪个预期文本。
AI.method: TextVBench 含两条互补轨道：TextVBench-T2V 衡量提示词指定文本的生成与维持，TextVBench-Ref2V 衡量参考图像文本的保持。两条轨道均采用目标条件化的候选选择而非无约束 VLM 转写，支持一个目标映射到多个 OCR 区域，并将帧级空间保真度与跨帧时间保真度分离。使用长度加权调和分数汇总各因素，辅以额外文本诊断揭示单一 OCR 分数掩盖的失败模式；基准围绕受控的文本、布局、载体与运动属性组织。
AI.result: 在评估的模型运行中，MiniMax-H3 的 T2V TextVScore 达 68.32，Ref2V 最高分为 56.51；属性切片显示，随着同时出现的参考文本区域数量增加，性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将视觉文本评估形式化为时空对应问题，通过双轨道设计、目标条件化候选选择及空间/时间保真度分离，提供了可追溯到具体能力上限的细粒度评估，弥补了单帧 OCR 评估的不足。

title: DAG Structure Learning with Node-Varying Heavy-Tailed Disturbances
summary: DAG structures can be learned from observations by incorporating acyclicity via smooth constraints, such as DAGMA's log-determinant function. Typically, observations and the underlying DAG are related through linear structural equation models, with Gaussianity assumption on the disturbances at each node. Extending DAG learning methods that account for scale and tail behavior of disturbances that vary across nodes remains a challenge. We propose a node-varying Student-$t$ DAGMA that jointly estimates the graph structure, node-specific disturbance scales, and the degrees-of-freedom parameter. A Gaussian scale-mixture representation yields an iteratively reweighted formulation that down-weights large standardized residuals. Building on existing results, we also establish identifiability of the graph and disturbance parameters. Synthetic experiments demonstrate improved structural recovery under heterogeneous heavy-tailed disturbances, and experiments on real finance data show that the proposed method yields lower test negative log-likelihood than the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出节点变动的Student-t DAGMA方法，联合估计DAG结构、各节点扰动尺度与自由度参数，在异质重尾扰动下提升结构恢复效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于平滑约束（如DAGMA的对数行列式函数）的DAG学习通常假设线性结构方程模型且各节点扰动服从高斯分布，难以应对节点间扰动尺度与尾部行为不一致的情形，扩展此类方法仍是挑战。
AI.method: 提出节点变动的Student-t DAGMA，通过高斯尺度混合表示导出迭代重加权形式，对大标准化残差降权，从而联合估计图结构、节点特定扰动尺度及自由度参数；并在既有结果基础上建立图与扰动参数的可识别性。
AI.result: 合成实验显示在异质重尾扰动下结构恢复性能提升；真实金融数据实验表明所提方法的测试负对数似然低于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入节点变动的Student-t扰动建模，可在异质重尾噪声下更稳健地学习DAG结构，并取得更优的密度拟合表现。

title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

AI.tldr: IG-VLA 是一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）推理框架，通过潜在时空推理在视觉表征空间想象未来场景演化，并利用场景要点记忆将推理所得关联内化为紧凑的 Scene Gist Token，从而在保持未来推理收益的同时大幅降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型虽引入中间推理以提升机器人操作能力，但主要针对已观测状态进行推理，缺乏对未来场景演化的显式预判；而若在每步推理中显式展开未来 rollout，又会带来巨大的计算开销，因此需要兼顾未来推理能力与部署效率。
AI.method: 提出 IG-VLA 框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning（潜在时空推理），直接在视觉表征空间学习想象与任务相关的未来场景演化，无需昂贵的像素级视频生成即可指导动作预测；(2) Scene Gist Memory（场景要点记忆），将推理得到场景-行为关联内化为紧凑的 Scene Gist Token，在推理阶段绕过显式未来想象。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 VLABench 上的实验验证了有效性与高效性。在 LIBERO-Plus Language 套件上，reasoning 与 gist 策略均比最强基线提升近 6% 成功率；gist 策略相较基线最高加速 6.38 倍，单张 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上单动作块的推理延迟从 1081ms 降至 169.5ms。
AI.conclusion: 未来时空推理可以被有效内化，从而实现高效 VLA 部署；该方法在保持甚至提升操作成功率的同时显著降低推理延迟。

title: SADL: A Size-Adaptive Decision Layer for Chronic Stroke Lesion Segmentation in ISLES 2026
summary: Chronic ischemic stroke lesions are difficult to segment on T1-weighted MRI. Their appearance overlaps with healthy tissue, and their volumes span four orders of magnitude, so voxel-level and lesion level metrics often disagree. We build an eleven-member nnU-Net ensemble that covers five design axes: a baseline dice + top-K loss, heavy augmentation, per-lesion volume loss re-weighting, stochastic weight averaging, and a sampling-and-architecture block that pairs cohort-balanced sampling with a residual-encoder backbone. Weighted soft-map fusion of the members feeds a tuned decision layer, SADL, that estimates lesion volume, applies an adaptive per-lesion-size threshold, prunes components by voxel count and peak probability, and adds a never-empty rescue. All fusion weights and per-bucket parameters are fitted on out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, so tuning never touches the held-out test set. On a site-disjoint 91-case holdout, SADL reaches Dice 0.7322, lesion-F1 0.7461 and PR-AUC 0.8430 when scored online with the challenge's released evaluation code. A paired non-parametric bootstrap against a reference single ensemble member confirms the lesion-F1 gain at p=0.024, and the gain is largest in the small-lesion regime, where the rescue step recovers cases that a fixed threshold would silently discard.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建十一成员nnU-Net集成并配合SADL决策层，在站点分离91例测试集上实现Dice 0.7322、lesion-F1 0.7461、PR-AUC 0.8430，小病灶场景增益最大。
AI.motivation: 慢性缺血性脑卒中病灶在T1加权MRI上难以分割：其外观与健康组织重叠，且体积跨越四个数量级，导致体素级指标与病灶级指标常不一致，单一模型与固定阈值难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建覆盖五个设计轴的十一成员nnU-Net集成：基线dice+top-K损失、强增强、按病灶体积加权重加权、随机权重平均（SWA），以及"采样-架构块"（队列平衡采样+残差编码器骨干）。成员输出经加权软图融合后输入调优决策层SADL：估计病灶体积、施加自适应病灶尺寸阈值、按体素数与峰值概率剪枝组件，并加入"永不空"救援步骤。所有融合权重与分桶参数均在折外（OOF）预测上拟合，不接触测试集。
AI.result: 在站点分离的91例留出集上，使用官方评估代码在线打分：Dice 0.7322、lesion-F1 0.7461、PR-AUC 0.8430。与单一参考集成成员配对非参数bootstrap检验，lesion-F1提升显著（p=0.024）；增益在小病灶区间最大，救援步骤挽回了固定阈值会静默丢弃的病例。
AI.conclusion: 多轴集成结合OOF调优的自适应决策层能有效缓解体素级与病灶级指标不一致问题，尤其改善小病灶分割的病灶级检出性能，且调优过程严格避免测试集泄漏。

title: MORAD: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Objective Rewards for RNA Inverse Design
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Jixin Tang and Ji Guo contributed equally. Project page: https://gabrile166.github.io/MORAD/
summary: We introduce MORAD, an online reinforcement learning framework for backbone-conditioned RNA diffusion models that trains a single shared policy across diverse target backbones. Structure-conditioned RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences compatible with a target three-dimensional backbone, yet existing reinforcement learning approaches either optimize a separate policy for each target backbone or rely on offline preference optimization, leaving online post-training of a reusable backbone-conditioned model largely unexplored. MORAD combines backbone-conditioned group sampling, group-relative reward normalization, and a forward-process diffusion objective. Beyond existing RL rewards that primarily target tertiary structural quality, MORAD jointly optimizes six measurements spanning tertiary geometry, base pairing, ensemble behavior, and sequence composition. To aggregate these heterogeneous objectives despite differences in scale and optimization direction, MORAD maps each measurement to a bounded desirability score and combines them with a weighted geometric mean. Compared with a tertiary-structure-only reward, this multi-objective formulation improves 10 of the 11 evaluation metrics that have a preferred direction. Applied to pretrained RIDE, MORAD improves GDT-TS by 16.0% (from 0.3300 to 0.3827) and pairing MCC by 19.4% (from 0.6110 to 0.7295), while reducing normalized ensemble defect by 27.5% (from 0.3906 to 0.2830). On the test set, MORAD outperforms RiboDiffusion, gRNAde, and RDesign across tertiary structural accuracy, secondary-structure pairing, and thermodynamic quality, establishing a new state of the art in structure-conditioned RNA inverse design.

AI.tldr: MORAD是一个面向骨干条件RNA扩散模型的在线强化学习框架，通过单一共享策略与多目标奖励联合优化，在结构条件RNA逆设计中取得新的SOTA性能。
