AI.motivation: 结构条件RNA逆设计旨在为给定三维骨干生成兼容的核苷酸序列，但现有强化学习方法要么为每个目标骨干单独优化策略，要么依赖离线偏好优化，缺乏对可复用骨干条件模型的在线后训练探索。
AI.method: MORAD融合骨干条件组采样、组相对奖励归一化与前向过程扩散目标；同时优化涵盖三级几何、碱基配对、系综行为与序列组成的六项指标，将各指标映射为有界满意度分数并以加权几何平均聚合异质目标。
AI.result: 相比仅用三级结构奖励，该多目标形式在11项有偏好方向的指标中改进10项；应用于RIDE后，GDT-TS提升16.0%（0.3300→0.3827），配对MCC提升19.4%（0.6110→0.7295），归一化系综缺陷降低27.5%（0.3906→0.2830）；在测试集上于三级结构精度、二级配对与热力学质量方面超越RiboDiffusion、gRNAde和RDesign。
AI.conclusion: MORAD证明了在线强化学习配合多目标奖励可有效后训练可复用的骨干条件RNA扩散模型，确立了结构条件RNA逆设计的新技术水准。

title: When MLLMs miss what humans read: diagnosing and learning to read squint text
summary: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"需眯眼才能辨认的粗结构文字"定义为 Squint Text，构建了 SquintBench 与 SquintCtrl 数据集，诊断出空间选择是主要瓶颈，并提出 Squint OPSD 蒸馏方法显著提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在读取嵌入图像粗结构中的文字（人类通过眯眼即可恢复）时会失败并声称图中无文字，此类案例来自实际内容审核流水线，作者将其作为识别缺陷加以研究。
AI.method: 构建 SquintBench（1076 张来自生产环境的审核图像）与 SquintCtrl（受控合成套件）用于机制诊断；通过冻结权重分析定位瓶颈；提出 Squint OPSD：冻结教师模型接收降采样视图与真实转写作为特权上下文，其 token 级分布沿在线策略轨迹监督学生模型，推理时学生仅读取原始图像。
AI.result: Squint OPSD 在 SquintBench 上达到 88.61 ANLS，而未适配骨干为 26.50，最佳通用模型在原始视图上为 24.44，现成模型在降采样视图下最高为 68.60。
AI.conclusion: 通过抑制高频内容与正确的空间区域供给可改善读取，空间选择为主要瓶颈；Squint OPSD 在不依赖推理时辅助视图的情况下大幅缩小了可用视觉证据与生成读出之间的差距。

title: Structure-Aware Numerical Stabilization for Half-Precision Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: Local online training on resource-constrained platforms requires low computational and training-state overhead. We study the numerical stability and computational efficiency of half-precision proximal policy optimization (PPO) on commodity GPUs. Directly converting PPO training to FP16 is unreliable because numerical errors feed back through policy updates and subsequent data collection, while PPO repeatedly compares a current policy with a fixed behavior policy. We propose PPO-FP16 with three structure-aware modules. Global scalar protection stabilizes statistics shared across a minibatch or parameter update. Policy-change residual protection extracts and preserves small differences between the current and behavior policies. Efficient persistent-update protection stabilizes optimizer state and parameter writeback while reducing state storage. These changes preserve the PPO objective, hyperparameters, and training budget. Across six continuous-control tasks and five seeds, PPO-FP16 achieves the lowest mean return-AUC rank (1.90) among the four methods and ranks first in 17 of 30 environment-seed comparisons. Eight of nine performance configurations yield PPO update speedups ranging from 1.16 to 2.03 times. Relative to Full FP32 Adam, optimizer-state memory is reduced by 71.7 to 74.9 percent, and peak allocated GPU memory is reduced by up to 44.5 percent. The results show that protecting a small set of structurally important quantities can deliver stable, efficient FP16 PPO without retuning.

AI.tldr: 提出PPO-FP16，通过三个结构感知保护模块实现商品GPU上稳定高效的半精度PPO训练，无需重调超参。
AI.motivation: 资源受限平台上的本地在线训练需要低计算与低训练状态开销。直接将PPO转为FP16不可靠：数值误差会通过策略更新和后续数据采集反馈放大，且PPO需反复比较当前策略与固定行为策略，对数值误差敏感。
AI.method: PPO-FP16包含三个结构感知模块：(1) 全局标量保护，稳定跨minibatch或参数更新的共享统计量；(2) 策略变化残差保护，提取并保留当前策略与行为策略间的小差异；(3) 高效持久更新保护，稳定优化器状态与参数回写并降低状态存储。这些改动保持PPO目标、超参与训练预算不变。
AI.result: 在6个连续控制任务、5个随机种子上，PPO-FP16取得最低平均return-AUC排名(1.90)，在30个环境-种子对比中17次排名第一；9种性能配置中8种获得1.16–2.03倍PPO更新加速；相比Full FP32 Adam，优化器状态内存降低71.7%–74.9%，峰值GPU显存降低最多44.5%。
AI.conclusion: 保护少量结构性关键量即可实现稳定高效的FP16 PPO训练，无需重新调参，适用于资源受限平台上的本地在线训练。

title: A Real-World CAD Segmentation Benchmark: Comparing Rule-Based and Learning-Based Approaches through Hole Detection
summary: CAD segmentation datasets are predominantly synthetic or automatically labelled, leaving it unclear how well existing methods transfer to real-world engineering tasks. Fastener-relevant hole detection represents one such task, requiring human annotation and exhibiting greater geometric complexity than commonly used benchmarks. We address this gap through three main contributions. First, we develop two task-specific rule-based methods, one graph-wire-search and one multi-view based, and complement them with a human-annotated benchmark dataset derived from engineering CAD data that also enables training of UV-Net and AAGNet, representative learning-based approaches for B-Rep segmentation. Second, we conduct an extensive experimental study including parameter optimisation, evaluation on our benchmark dataset, cross-domain generalisation on a synthetic dataset, and an assessment of the feasibility of the approaches at varying dataset sizes and IoU thresholds. Third, we provide evidence-based insights into the strengths and limitations of different approaches: rule-based methods generalise well without training data, with the graph-wire-search method favouring recall and the multi-view method favouring precision, whereas learning-based methods achieve strong performance with sufficient annotations but exhibit reduced robustness under domain shift. These findings highlight trade-offs between data requirements, and robustness, and provide guidance not only for hole detection, but more broadly for real-world CAD segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对CAD分割数据集多为合成或自动标注、真实工程任务迁移性不明的现状，本文以紧固件相关孔检测为任务，提出两种规则方法并发布人工标注基准数据集，系统评估了规则方法与学习型方法（UV-Net、AAGNet）在精度、跨域泛化和数据需求上的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD分割数据集以合成或自动标注为主，难以判断现有方法向真实工程任务迁移的效果。孔检测这类任务需人工标注、几何复杂度高于常用基准，且存在研究空白。
AI.method: 开发两种任务特定规则方法（图线搜索法、多视角法）；构建源自工程CAD数据的人工标注基准数据集，并用于训练UV-Net和AAGNet等代表性B-Rep分割学习方法；开展包含参数优化、基准数据集评估、合成数据集跨域泛化、不同数据集规模与IoU阈值可行性的实验研究。
AI.result: 规则方法无需训练数据即可良好泛化，其中图线搜索法偏向召回率、多视角法偏向精确率；学习方法在标注充足时性能强，但域偏移下鲁棒性下降。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了数据需求与鲁棒性之间的权衡，为孔检测乃至更广泛的真实世界CAD分割任务提供指导。

title: Sustainable Cloud-Fog-Edge Systems for Smart Buildings: Algorithmic Adaptation under Memory Constraints and Dynamic Orchestration Strategies
summary: The escalating environmental footprint of the Information and Communication Technol- ogy (ICT) sectorwith global Data Center electric- ity usage potentially reaching 3% by 2030 and the imperative for real-time responsiveness in smart buildings demand a foundational shift towards Edge Computing. This article proposes a holis- tic architectural and algorithmic approach for cre- ating autonomous, resilient, and privacy-preserving learning systems within smart buildings, advancing the core concept of the building itself as the data center. Our contributions, demonstrating originality compared to conventional centralized systems, are structured around three main pillars: 1) Validation of resilient data acquisition chains using the af- fordable Arduino ecosystem (Uno R4 WiFi/BME280) and secure persistence solutions including centralized archiving (Node-RED/MySQL) and secure remote transfer (Python/rsync/SSH). 2). The proposal of a lightweight, KOptim orchestration framework, inter- operable with the FIWARE standard, for the dynamic management of Service Level Agreements (SLA). 3) The adaptation and experimental valida- tion of the Generalized Hebbian Algorithm (GHA) for Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on low- power microcontrollers,We introduce and compare an iterative learning strategy using data buffers, featuring sorting and explicit preservation of extreme samples to maintain diversity. Experimental results on the high-dimensional Tour Perret sensor data confirm that this novel method, despite introducing a necessary temporal complexity of O(W log W ) due to sorting, achieves convergence and final result quality that is visually equivalent to processing the entire dataset in full memory, reliably identifying two distinct operational states.

AI.tldr: 提出面向智能建筑的自主、弹性、隐私保护边缘学习架构（"建筑即数据中心"），围绕数据采集链验证、KOptim轻量级SLA编排（兼容FIWARE）与微控制器上GHA-PCA的自适应三方面展开，并在Tour Perret高维数据上验证了缓冲区迭代学习方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: ICT行业环境足迹持续扩大（预计2030年数据中心用电占比达3%），而智能建筑又要求实时响应能力，二者共同要求向边缘计算发生根本性转变；同时集中式系统在弹性、隐私保护与自主性上存在不足，需要以建筑自身为数据中心的整体方案。
AI.method: 1）基于低成本Arduino生态（Uno R4 WiFi/BME280）与安全持久化方案（Node-RED/MySQL集中归档、Python/rsync/SSH远程安全传输）验证弹性数据采集链；2）提出轻量级KOptim编排框架，与FIWARE标准互操作，实现服务等级协议（SLA）的动态管理；3）将广义Hebbian算法（GHA）用于主成分分析（PCA）并适配到低功耗微控制器，提出基于数据缓冲区的迭代学习策略，通过排序与显式保留极端样本来维持样本多样性。
AI.result: 在Tour Perret高维传感器数据上的实验表明，该新方法虽因排序引入O(W log W)的额外时间复杂性，但其收敛性与最终结果质量在视觉上等同于将全量数据集载入内存处理的方案，并能可靠识别出两种不同的运行状态。
AI.conclusion: 所提架构与算法在低成本硬件上实现了自主、弹性、隐私保护的智能建筑边缘学习，验证了"建筑即数据中心"概念的可行性；缓冲区迭代GHA-PCA在微控制器上可替代全内存处理，兼顾资源受限与结果质量。

title: GraftOOD: Grafting Out-of-Distribution Exemplars into Advantage-Weighted Rectification for Video Reward Optimization
summary: Video reward optimization can increase proxy rewards while reducing video dynamics, a mismatch we identify as \emph{motion collapse}, including under a video-level motion-quality reward. We propose \textbf{GraftOOD}, which replaces part of the online rollouts in selected prompt groups with out-of-distribution video exemplars. A shared velocity-regression objective combines group-relative reward rectification with sequence-level exemplar supervision, requiring neither exemplar generation trajectories nor an additional supervised-loss coefficient. We characterize its pointwise optimal field as a source-posterior-weighted combination of the two source-specific target fields. We construct \textbf{GraftSet-Video}, containing 9,588 format-matched exemplars for 2,397 prompts, to supply external supervision. On Wan2.1-1.3B, GraftOOD raises Dynamic Degree from 4.86 to 44.41 relative to reward-only FlowAWR, while HPSv3 decreases from 8.10 to 7.32 and VisionReward remains close. At the main setting, GraftOOD leads nine of ten metrics among three exemplar-augmented methods. Ablations of exemplar frequency and within-group count reveal dynamics--reward trade-offs rather than uniform gains from increasing exemplar usage. These results support external exemplar supervision as a complement to scalar reward feedback, without equating higher measured dynamics with coherent, visually plausible motion in the generated videos. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR}{GraftOOD}.

AI.tldr: 提出GraftOOD，通过在部分prompt组的在线rollout中引入分布外视频样例，缓解视频奖励优化中的"运动坍缩"问题，并构建GraftSet-Video数据集；在Wan2.1-1.3B上大幅提升Dynamic Degree，且在多指标评测中优于三种样例增强方法。
AI.motivation: 视频奖励优化在提升代理奖励的同时会削弱视频动态性，即"运动坍缩"（motion collapse），即使采用视频级运动质量奖励也存在该问题。作者希望以外部样例监督作为标量奖励反馈的补充来缓解这一不匹配。
AI.method: GraftOOD将选定prompt组中的部分在线rollout替换为分布外（OOD）视频样例；使用共享的速度回归目标，将组相对奖励校正与序列级样例监督结合，无需样例生成轨迹，也无需额外的监督损失系数。理论上刻画其逐点最优场为两个来源特定目标场按来源后验加权的组合。同时构建GraftSet-Video，含2,397个prompt的9,588个格式匹配样例。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-1.3B上，相对仅用奖励的FlowAWR，GraftOOD将Dynamic Degree从4.86提升至44.41，HPSv3由8.10降至7.32，VisionReward基本持平；在主设置下，GraftOOD在十项指标中九项领先另外两种样例增强方法。样例频率与组内数量的消融显示动态性与奖励之间存在权衡，而非样例使用越多收益越均匀。
AI.conclusion: 外部样例监督可作为标量奖励反馈的补充，但更高的动态性度量并不等同于生成视频中连贯、视觉合理的运动。代码已开源。

title: SBNO : Schrödinger Bridge Neural Operator for the Forward and Inverse Problems under Missing Information
summary: Partial differential equation (PDE) surrogate modeling often relies on either dense observations or access to governing equations/physics constraints. In practice, observations can be sparse and partial, and the underlying physics may be partially specified or unavailable. We introduce SBNO, an equation-free paired-data diffusion bridge matching framework that learns conditional operators for both forward and inverse PDE problems under partial observations. SBNO uses diffusion Schrödinger bridge matching to learn a pair of time-dependent drifts from a mask-aware endpoint coupling that preserves empirical input-solution pairing during training and supports both PDE-task directions within a single framework. At inference time, SBNO produces a deterministic point reconstruction by integrating the probability-flow ODE constructed from the learned drift pair, without inference-time observation or PDE guidance-weight tuning. On five PDE benchmarks with 5% observations, SBNO achieves superior or comparable accuracy to baselines while demonstrating lower test-instance error dispersion. Furthermore, SBNO is at least $9.7 \times$ faster and reduces GPU memory by at least $4.3 \times$ compared to guided-diffusion baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SBNO，一种无需方程的成对数据扩散桥匹配框架，可在部分观测下同时学习正向与逆向PDE的条件算子，实现高效、稳定的求解。
AI.motivation: 现有PDE代理建模通常依赖稠密观测或已知的物理约束（控制方程）。实际中观测往往稀疏且不完整，物理规律也可能仅部分已知或完全缺失，因此亟需一种不依赖方程、能在部分观测条件下同时处理正向与逆向PDE问题的方法。
AI.method: SBNO采用扩散Schrödinger桥匹配（diffusion Schrödinger bridge matching），从掩码感知的端点耦合（mask-aware endpoint coupling）中学习一对时间相关的漂移项，从而在训练中保持经验性的输入-解配对关系，并在单一框架内支持两个方向的PDE任务。推理阶段通过积分由学习漂移对构建的概率流ODE（probability-flow ODE）得到确定性的点重构，无需在推理时进行观测或PDE引导权重调参。
AI.result: 在五个PDE基准上，仅使用5%观测时，SBNO的精度优于或与基线相当，且测试样本间的误差离散度更低。相比引导扩散（guided-diffusion）基线，SBNO速度至少快9.7倍，GPU内存占用至少降低4.3倍。
AI.conclusion: SBNO证明了无需方程、基于成对数据的扩散桥匹配可以有效解决部分观测下的正向与逆向PDE问题，在精度、稳定性和计算效率上均具优势，为稀疏观测场景下的PDE代理建模提供了新思路。

title: Stride: Scale-Aware Multi-Agent Evolutionary Refinement for Infographic Generation
summary: Infographic generation challenges text-to-image models because a single image must satisfy numerous visual, textual, and semantic constraints. Iterative agentic refinement with a multimodal verifier is a natural remedy, but existing methods face a scale mismatch: local edits cannot correct global composition errors, while full regeneration may destroy already-correct regions. We introduce Stride, a constraint-grounded multi-agent framework that treats refinement over any frozen generator as a history-aware evolution strategy. Stride separates constraint evaluation - whether each requirement is satisfied - from visual grounding - where and how it is violated. It then routes global revisions to a composer subagent and local corrections to a retoucher subagent. Each subagent conducts internal planning and generates multiple candidates, while Stride accepts a candidate only when it improves the verifier score, reducing regression across iterations. Because stochastic generators and imperfect verifiers make any single step unreliable, it is this combination of scale-aware routing, per-step redundancy, and monotonic acceptance that yields stable improvement across iterations. With fully open-weight generator-verifier systems, Stride outperforms proprietary systems including Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro on BizGenEval, matches GPT-Image-2.0 and surpasses Seedream-5.0-Pro on IGenBench, and achieves a new state-of-the-art score on WISE, while substantially outperforming existing agentic methods across all evaluated benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Stride是一个约束驱动的多智能体框架，将信息图生成中的迭代精修建模为面向冻结生成器的历史感知进化策略，通过尺度感知路由、每步冗余与单调接受机制实现稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 信息图生成要求单张图像同时满足大量视觉、文本与语义约束，迭代式智能体精修配合多模态验证器是自然的解决方案。但现有方法存在尺度错配：局部编辑无法纠正全局布局错误，而整体重生成又会破坏已正确的区域，因此难以稳定收敛。
AI.method: Stride将约束评估（每个需求是否被满足）与视觉定位（违规何处、如何违规）解耦；随后按问题尺度进行路由，将全局修订交给composer子智能体，将局部修正交给retoucher子智能体。每个子智能体内部先做规划并生成多个候选；仅当候选提升验证器分数时才被接受，从而抑制迭代回归。
AI.result: 在完全开源权重的生成器—验证器组合下，Stride在BizGenEval上超越Nano-Banana-2.0与Seedream-5.0-Pro等专有系统，在IGenBench上追平GPT-Image-2.0并超过Seedream-5.0-Pro，在WISE上取得新的最先进分数，并在所有评测基准上大幅优于现有智能体方法。
AI.conclusion: 尺度感知路由、逐步冗余生成与单调接受三者的结合，是应对随机生成器与不完美验证器、实现跨迭代稳定提升的关键；该框架可作为通用精修层接入任意冻结生成器。

title: DuoRate: Two-Rate Per-Expert Precision Allocation for Mixture-of-Experts Serving
summary: Serving a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model pays for expert precision twice: the resident footprint pays for every expert the router can reach, while each batch-one decode step pays only for the experts it selects. These are two different rate functionals over the same per-expert widths, yet published per-expert MoE allocators constrain only the first. We call the difference the store-read gap; in the released BitsMoE checkpoint, 2.54 bits per weight (bpw) of storage become 7.50 bpw of decode traffic. We propose DuoRate, which stores once and reads per workload. Offline, it stores one uniform tier of a prefix-readable weight stream and bakes a distortion tensor. Online, it profiles a workload's own prefill without labels and solves a Lagrangian rate-distortion allocation under the decode functional; routing frequency provably cancels from every per-expert decision, and the solve costs one dot product per expert and a bisection. A deployment therefore keeps a single artifact that prefill reads at the stored rate and decode reads at the workload's own rate. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, DuoRate reading 2.3 bpw exceeds every 2-bit-class baseline by 6.3 to 47.0 points of average accuracy, and at 2.9 bpw it matches 4-bit formats that read 1.4-1.6 bpw more. The advantage is largest under long decoding: on GSM8K, DuoRate at 2.9 bpw matches or exceeds every 4-bit format and trails BF16 by only 0.25 points, and at 2.6 bpw it still matches or exceeds the 4.5-bit NF4 and FP4. Against controls in its own format, the allocation alone is worth 0.07-0.11 bpw of read rate. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: MoE推理中存储与解码读取是两种不同的率函数；DuoRate通过离线统一存储、在线按工作负载求解拉格朗日率失真分配，实现"存一次、按需读取"，在Qwen3-30B-A3B上以2.3–2.9 bpw读取率超越或匹敌更高比特基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE逐专家分配器只约束常驻存储的率函数（每个路由可达专家都要付出存储代价），而batch-one解码步只按选中的专家付出读取代价，二者的差异（store-read gap）未被建模。在已发布的BitsMoE检查点中，2.54 bpw存储会变成7.50 bpw解码流量，说明仅优化存储会显著低估实际解码开销。
AI.method: 提出DuoRate：离线只存储一个统一层级的、可前缀读取的权重流，并烘焙一个失真张量；在线对工作负载自身的prefill进行无标签剖析，在解码率函数下求解拉格朗日率失真分配。路由频率在每个逐专家决策中可证明地被消去，求解代价为每专家一次点积加一次二分。部署时保持单一产物：prefill按存储率读取，decode按该工作负载自身的率读取。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，DuoRate以2.3 bpw读取率比所有2-bit级基线平均准确率高6.3–47.0个百分点；2.9 bpw时可匹配读取率高1.4–1.6 bpw的4-bit格式。长解码场景优势最明显：GSM8K上2.9 bpw匹配或超过所有4-bit格式、仅落后BF16 0.25个百分点；2.6 bpw仍匹配或超过4.5-bit NF4与FP4。在自身格式的控制实验中，仅分配策略即价值0.07–0.11 bpw的读取率。
AI.conclusion: MoE服务应区分存储率与解码读取率两类函数；DuoRate通过"存一次、按工作负载读取"的统一产物与在线率失真分配，在不增加存储的前提下大幅降低解码读取开销并提升精度，尤其适合长解码工作负载。代码将在发表后释放。

title: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027 (main paper 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables; appendix included)
summary: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.

AI.tldr: SplatQ提出一种组合式3D高斯剪枝算法，通过区域预算分配与联合高斯选择的协同优化，在固定预算下提升重建质量与空间均衡性。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS剪枝方法基于独立重要性分数的全局Top-K选择，缺乏区域预算控制且忽略联合删除效应，无法保证场景内重建质量的均衡。
AI.method: 按空间邻近性与外观相似性将高斯划分为大小受限的块，将全局选择分解为固定规模子问题；对基于重要性的块保留配额进行平滑处理以防预算过度集中；利用代表性像素颜色对高斯不透明度变化的响应构建联合删除效应的二次近似，将个体响应、成对交互与配额惩罚纳入QUBO目标，采用模拟退火（SA）或相干伊辛机（CIM）求解以实现联合选择。
AI.result: 在5个基准测试上，SplatQ在总体重建质量、空间质量均衡性与渲染速度方面均优于当前最优剪枝方法；消融实验证实预算平滑改善局部细节重建，交互建模提升固定预算下的高斯选择质量。
AI.conclusion: SplatQ通过区域预算协调与联合删除建模的组合优化框架，有效解决了全局Top-K剪枝的质量不均衡问题，并可借助量子退火类硬件加速求解。

title: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
summary: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we explore in-context prediction of PDE solution fields using approximate pre-training data. In addition, inspired by the posterior predictive mean-based inference mechanism of the in-context learning in prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), we propose PDE-PFN, a prior-data fitted neural solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning. PDE-PFN builds on a PFN architecture with self- and cross-attention mechanisms of Transformer and is pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions generated by physics-informed neural networks, serving as diverse but not necessarily exact priors. Through experiments on a range of two-dimensional PDEs, we demonstrate that PDE-PFN achieves empirical generalization across heterogeneous equations, robustness under noisy priors, and zero-gradient-update in-context inference capability. PDE-PFN achieves competitive or improved predictive accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines while supporting flexible context and query representations.

AI.tldr: 提出PDE-PFN，一种基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）的神经偏微分方程求解器，通过上下文学习近似PDE解的后验预测均值，在含噪近似数据上预训练，实现跨异构方程的泛化、对噪声先验的鲁棒性以及无需梯度更新的上下文推理。
AI.motivation: 受大语言模型在广泛泛化性及对噪声、不可靠预训练数据鲁棒性方面成功的启发，作者希望探索使用近似预训练数据进行PDE解场的上下文预测；同时借鉴PFN中基于后验预测均值的上下文学习推理机制。
AI.method: 构建PDE-PFN，采用具备自注意力与交叉注意力机制的Transformer架构，并在由物理信息神经网络（PINN）生成的含噪近似解上进行预训练，这些解作为多样但不必精确的先验；通过上下文学习近似PDE解的后验预测均值。
AI.result: 在一系列二维PDE实验中，PDE-PFN在异构方程上实现经验泛化，对含噪先验具有鲁棒性，并具备零梯度更新的上下文推理能力；预测精度与所评估基线相比具有竞争力或更优，同时支持灵活的上下文与查询表示。
AI.conclusion: PDE-PFN验证了将PFN的上下文学习范式迁移至PDE求解的可行性，展示出跨方程泛化、噪声先验鲁棒性和免梯度微调推理等优势。

title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. Internal reasoning transforms it for changing viewpoints. Verbal responses selectively access it, evidenced by causal interventions that alter spatial judgments while largely preserving non-spatial responses. Case studies further show that S-Space assigns locations to unseen entities and the observer, and connects physical directions with abstract linguistic meanings, suggesting both the capabilities and limitations of large-scale language training. Finally, we use S-Space as a diagnostic tool for spatial reasoning failures. Direction-word readouts reveal systematic coupling between cardinal and image-relative reference frames. More importantly, a perception-computation decomposition exposes a key bottleneck: MLLMs can form capable spatial representations, yet fall short in the spatial transformations required to reason reliably across viewpoint changes.

AI.tldr: 论文发现多模态大模型（MLLM）中存在一个内在的线性子空间 S-Space，用于编码物体在水平、垂直与距离轴上的连续坐标，并证明其作为内部空间工作空间支撑空间推理。
AI.motivation: MLLM 展现出有前景的空间推理能力，但其内部支撑机制尚不清楚。作者旨在揭示空间推理的内部表征结构，并据此诊断空间推理失败的原因。
AI.method: 通过对物体 token 激活求空间答案分数的微分来识别水平、垂直、距离三个坐标轴；开展因果干预实验以检验 S-Space 对空间判断的因果作用；并进行案例研究（对未见实体与观察者的位置分配、物理方向与抽象语义的联结）以及方向词读出分析。
AI.result: S-Space 是模型内在的线性表征子空间，而非由特定数据或提示诱导，即使在非空间问题下仍可读出；感知将物体位置编码进该空间，内部推理可对其做视角变换，语言输出选择性地读取该空间，因果干预可改变空间判断而基本不影响非空间回答。诊断显示基数与图像相对参考系之间存在系统性耦合，且瓶颈在于空间变换而非空间表征形成。
AI.conclusion: S-Space 可作为 MLLM 的内部空间工作空间与空间推理失败的诊断工具；MLLM 能形成有能力的空间表征，但在跨视角变化推理所需的空间变换上存在不足。

title: AgentTune: A Unified Training Lifecycle for Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using agents increasingly require a common substrate for building, training, evaluating, distilling, and maintaining agentic systems, yet existing tooling typically addresses these stages in isolation. We present AgentTune, a source-available Python library that provides a unified framework for developing and optimizing tool-using agents. At its core, AgentTune introduces a two-tier EventLog representation that preserves agent trajectories while supporting consistent projections for training, evaluation, and auditing. Building on this substrate, the library provides a shared agent runtime, tool-calling reinforcement learning, agentic distillation, retrieval-augmented generation, decision workflows, evaluation utilities, and a designed path toward self-healing agents. These components are exposed through composable interfaces so that agent strategies, training methods, evaluation procedures, and recovery mechanisms can be combined without requiring separate representations or pipelines. We demonstrate the framework across agentic tasks including legal contract search and domain-specific applications, illustrating its use for trajectory-based optimization, tool-use evaluation, and cross-task agent development. AgentTune is released as a source-available library at https://github.com/Lexsi-Labs/AgentTune

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentTune，一个开源 Python 库，通过双层 EventLog 表示和统一运行时，将智能体构建、训练、评估、蒸馏与维护整合为可组合框架，并展示了其在法律合同检索等任务上的应用。
AI.motivation: 工具使用型智能体在构建、训练、评估、蒸馏与维护各阶段需要通用基础设施，但现有工具链彼此割裂，缺乏统一表示与流水线，导致各阶段难以复用与协同。
AI.method: 核心是双层 EventLog 表示，既保留完整智能体轨迹，又支持面向训练、评估与审计的一致投影。在此基础上提供共享智能体运行时、工具调用强化学习、智能体蒸馏、检索增强生成、决策工作流、评估工具以及面向自愈智能体的路径，并通过可组合接口暴露，使策略、训练方法、评估流程与恢复机制可自由组合。
AI.result: 在法律合同检索及领域特定任务等智能体任务上验证了框架，展示了其用于基于轨迹的优化、工具使用评估与跨任务智能体开发的能力。
AI.conclusion: AgentTune 以统一表示和可组合接口解决了智能体开发阶段割裂的问题，提供端到端的开发与优化能力，并以开源库形式发布。

title: Knowing Whether, Not Just Where: Anchor-Probing Distillation for Open-Set Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
summary: Open-set visual grounding in remote sensing requires models to determine not only where a queried object is located, but also whether the image provides sufficient evidence for the query at all. Existing closed-set grounding models, however, tend to return plausible boxes even for absent objects, blurring localization confidence with genuine Visual Support. We introduce AnchorProbe-Distill (APD), a teacher-student framework that recasts open-set grounding as Visual Support learning. APD builds on the insight that supported queries should induce coherent spatial anchors, whereas unsupported or mismatched queries tend to produce unstable or misleading localization patterns. APD-T therefore uses the Original Query as a Reference Anchor to interpret query perturbations: Semantic-Preserving Queries retain the annotated target, Near-Category Ambiguous Queries are resolved according to whether they form a reliable alternative anchor or collapse onto the Reference Anchor, and Far-Category Counterfactual Queries provide rejection supervision. This reference-aware reasoning is distilled into APD-S, enabling unified localization and rejection from a single image--query pair. Experiments show that APD enables the resulting model to reject absent targets while also improving its localization of present targets.

AI.tldr: APD是一个教师-学生框架，将遥感开放集视觉定位重构为"视觉支撑"学习：教师模型以原始查询为参考锚点，通过语义保持、近类歧义、远类反事实三类查询扰动进行参考感知推理，并蒸馏到学生模型，实现单图像-查询对的统一定位与拒识。
AI.motivation: 遥感开放集视觉定位不仅要确定查询目标的位置，还要判断图像是否有足够证据支撑该查询。现有闭集定位模型即使面对不存在的目标也会返回看似合理的框，把定位置信度与真实视觉支撑混为一谈，缺乏拒识能力。
AI.method: 提出AnchorProbe-Distill（APD）教师-学生框架。核心洞察：被支撑的查询应产生空间一致锚点，而不被支撑或错配的查询会产生不稳定或误导性定位模式。APD-T以原始查询作为参考锚点，通过扰动查询进行参考感知推理：语义保持查询保留标注目标；近类歧义查询依据其是否形成可靠替代锚点或坍缩到参考锚点来判定；远类反事实查询提供拒识监督。随后将该推理蒸馏到APD-S，使学生模型仅凭单一图像-查询对即可统一定位与拒识。
AI.result: 实验表明，APD使模型能够拒识缺失目标，同时提升对存在目标的定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 将开放集定位建模为视觉支撑学习、并借助参考锚点与查询扰动监督进行蒸馏，是一种可行且有效的方案，可同时改善拒识与定位。

title: Understanding Mamba-3 Through Oscillatory Dynamics
summary: Mamba-3 introduces input-dependent rotations into recurrent state updates, but their contribution beyond state retention remains unclear. We interpret these ro- tations as underdamped second-order dynamics, providing a framework for in- vestigating the role of oscillation in sequence modeling. Controlled comparisons show that underdamped dynamics outperform non-oscillatory damping regimes on state-tracking tasks, while language-model pretraining demonstrates benefits for long-context prediction and length generalization. Interventions in pretrained models further establish the importance of learned phase, and state analysis sug- gests that rotation regulates how retained information combines with incoming up- dates. Taken together, these findings identify underdamped dynamics as a useful mechanism for recurrent computation and suggest that oscillation supports long- context processing by regulating how information accumulates.

AI.tldr: 该论文将 Mamba-3 中引入的输入依赖旋转解释为欠阻尼二阶动力学，验证了振荡在序列建模中调控信息积累的作用。
AI.motivation: Mamba-3 在循环状态更新中引入输入依赖旋转，但除状态保持之外这些旋转的具体贡献尚不清楚，需建立理论框架以探究振荡在序列建模中的作用。
AI.method: 将输入依赖旋转解释为欠阻尼二阶动力学；通过受控对比实验比较欠阻尼与非振荡阻尼机制；开展语言模型预训练实验；对预训练模型进行干预以考察学习到的相位的重要性，并分析状态以揭示旋转的作用机制。
AI.result: 欠阻尼动力学在状态跟踪任务上优于非振荡阻尼机制；在语言模型预训练中提升了长上下文预测与长度泛化能力；干预实验证实学习到的相位具有重要性；状态分析表明旋转调控保留信息与传入更新的结合方式。
AI.conclusion: 欠阻尼动力学是循环计算的有效机制，振荡通过调控信息积累方式支持长上下文处理。

title: Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS
summary: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种置信度感知的误差驱动致密化方法，在固定预算MCMC框架下用图像误差替代不透明度来放置新图元，从而改善背景重建不足问题。在24个场景上，从100k到2M预算均优于3DGS-MCMC，并在中等及以上预算下超越ConeGS和EDGS等需先验的固定预算方法。
AI.motivation: 3DGS-MCMC已成为固定图元预算下无先验致密化的事实标准，但其基于不透明度的采样使新图元大多落在已重建良好的前景，导致背景重建不足；低预算时ConeGS、EDGS等基于先验的方法表现更好，但代价是需要预训练辐射场或密集图像匹配以及额外的初始化阶段。作者主张在固定预算MCMC框架内重新引入误差驱动的致密化。
AI.method: 方法保留3DGS-MCMC的固定预算与渐进增长机制，但依据图像误差而非不透明度来放置图元：新图元主要绘制在屏幕空间梯度较大处，偏好学习置信度低的图元（标示重建解释较差的区域），并将对渲染图像贡献最小的图元重定位到这些位置。该方法本质上无需先验，同时也能利用先验。
AI.result: 在24个场景的平均结果上，方法在100k至2M每个预算下的PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS均优于3DGS-MCMC。在100k时，无需先验或初始化阶段即可恢复ConeGS相对3DGS-MCMC领先的1.05dB PSNR中的0.84dB；从500k起，在所有对比的固定预算方法（含ConeGS和EDGS）中取得最高PSNR和SSIM。从ConeGS或EDGS初始化出发时，可在100k匹配ConeGS的PSNR和SSIM，并在500k时三项指标均为最优。
AI.conclusion: 置信度感知的误差驱动致密化在固定预算MCMC框架内有效解决了不透明度采样导致的前景偏置与背景欠重建问题，无需先验即可全面超越3DGS-MCMC，并在中高预算下达到固定预算方法的最优性能；同时该方法可兼容并利用ConeGS、EDGS等先验初始化，进一步取得领先结果。

title: Hidden Data Challenges in Clinical Machine Learning
summary: Widely reused preprocessing pipelines for electronic health records can encode assumptions about when information became available, what clinical episode a label represents, and what missingness means. These assumptions are rarely audited systematically and may propagate across subsequent studies when preprocessing pipelines are reused or adapted. Using MIMIC-IV as a case study, we identify and quantify violations of three complementary forms of preprocessing alignment, i.e., temporal, semantic, and population alignment, which manifest as temporal leakage, feature-task misalignment, and biased imputation. We show how ambiguities in timestamp semantics, episode definitions, endpoint construction, modality selection, and missingness handling can alter the information available to a model and affect the interpretation of its predictions. Through analyses of MIMIC-IV data and empirical case studies, we demonstrate that such choices may remain largely invisible in aggregate predictive performance while changing the signals on which models rely. We derive practical recommendations for temporally valid, clinically aligned, and reproducible preprocessing of MIMIC-IV and related electronic health record datasets. The code for our experiments, including our proposed preprocessing, is available at: https://github.com/m2l-lab/mimic-iv-preprocess.

AI.tldr: 该论文以MIMIC-IV为例，系统审计电子健康记录预处理中的时间、语义与人群对齐问题，揭示其如何导致时间泄漏、特征-任务错位与偏见插补，并给出可复现的预处理建议。
AI.motivation: 广泛复用的EHR预处理流程隐含了关于信息何时可用、标签代表何种临床事件、缺失值含义等假设，但缺乏系统审计，且随流程复用被传播到后续研究，影响模型可用信息与预测解释。
AI.method: 以MIMIC-IV为案例，识别并量化三类预处理对齐违背：时间对齐（时间泄漏）、语义对齐（特征-任务错位）、人群对齐（偏见插补）；分析时间戳语义、事件定义、终点构建、模态选择与缺失处理的歧义，并通过数据分析与实证案例研究进行验证。
AI.result: 这些预处理选择在总体预测性能上往往不可见，却会改变模型所依赖的信号；时间戳语义、事件与终点定义、模态与缺失处理等歧义会影响模型可用信息与预测解释。
AI.conclusion: 提出面向MIMIC-IV及相关EHR数据的时间有效、临床对齐且可复现的预处理实践建议，并公开实验与预处理代码。

title: MOSAIC: Multi-Scale Object-Centric Slot Adaptation with Image-Guided Prototype Conditioning for Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution
summary: Pretrained diffusion Transformers provide powerful generative priors for image restoration, yet adapting them to structure-sensitive tasks remains challenging. Existing methods mainly rely on dense low-resolution features as conditions, which often entangle salient objects with dominant backgrounds and provide limited abstraction for recurring structures across scales and samples. We propose MOSAIC, an object-centric representation learning framework that learns compact structural conditions for generative model adaptation. MOSAIC organizes degraded observations into structural slots that capture complementary object-level and layout-level evidence, integrates them across resolutions, and retrieves recurring priors from a shared prototype memory to complement incomplete image-specific information. The resulting representations are injected into selected layers of a frozen diffusion Transformer through lightweight residual modulation, preserving its pretrained generative prior. We instantiate MOSAIC for remote sensing image super-resolution, where small objects, repetitive structures, and large-scale variation provide a challenging testbed. Experiments on UCMerced, AID, and RSSCN7 show consistent PSNR improvements across $\times 2$ and $\times 4$ settings and favorable LPIPS results at $\times 4$. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved preservation of small objects, structural boundaries, and repetitive spatial patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出MOSAIC框架，学习面向对象的紧凑结构条件，通过轻量残差调制注入冻结的扩散Transformer，用于遥感图像超分辨率，在多个数据集上取得一致的PSNR提升。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散Transformer虽能提供强大生成先验，但适配到结构敏感任务仍困难：现有方法依赖稠密的低分辨率特征作为条件，易将显著目标与主导背景纠缠，且对跨尺度、跨样本重复出现的结构抽象能力有限。
AI.method: MOSAIC将退化观测组织为结构槽（structural slots），捕捉互补的对象级与布局级证据；跨分辨率整合这些槽；从共享原型记忆中检索重复出现的先验，以补全不完整的样本特异信息；最终通过轻量残差调制注入冻结扩散Transformer的选定层，保持其预训练生成先验。以遥感图像超分辨率为实例验证。
AI.result: 在UCMerced、AID、RSSCN7上，×2与×4设置下PSNR一致提升，×4时LPIPS表现良好；定性结果显示小目标、结构边界和重复空间模式的保持能力增强。
AI.conclusion: 对象中心的结构化条件表示能有效适配冻结扩散Transformer至结构敏感的图像复原任务，遥感超分辨率实验验证了其在定量与定性上的优势。

title: Opening the Black Box of Classifier-Free Guidance via Information Bottleneck
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard technique for improving conditional generation in diffusion models, yet its activation schedule is usually selected heuristically. In practice, most existing CFG-based methods rely on a pre-defined activation policy throughout inference, while recent dynamic variants often depend on hand-designed schedules without a principled theoretical explanation of when conditional information is most useful. In order to understand how the informational relevance between conditioning inputs and the score function evolves over the course of generation, we explore when guidance should be activated from an information-theoretic perspective. In this work, we formulate the diffusion trajectory as a time-dependent information bottleneck and show that the effectiveness of conditional information is not uniform throughout sampling, but becomes significantly stronger after a critical stage characterized by a Fisher-information balance condition. Motivated by this insight, we propose a training-free dynamic CFG strategy for inference. Rather than prescribing a fixed schedule in advance, our method constructs a stochastic process from conditional and unconditional score statistics and activates guidance when the estimated guidance gain crosses a prescribed threshold. This yields an adaptive activation rule that aligns condition injection with the underlying generation dynamics, while also recovering interval-based guidance as a limiting special case. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures and tasks, demonstrate that our method is effective, robust, and broadly applicable. Beyond empirical improvements, our framework provides an interpretation of dynamic guidance methods and a principled foundation for inference-time control in conditional diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文将扩散采样轨迹建模为时间依赖的信息瓶颈，发现条件信息的有效性在采样过程中不均匀，存在由Fisher信息平衡条件刻画的临界阶段；据此提出免训练的动态CFG策略，自适应激活引导，实验证明其有效、稳健且通用。
AI.motivation: 现有CFG的激活调度多为启发式或手工设计，缺乏对"何时条件信息最有用"的理论解释，因此需要从信息论视角理解条件输入与分数函数之间信息相关性的演化规律。
AI.method: 将扩散轨迹形式化为时间依赖的信息瓶颈，证明条件信息的效用非均匀分布，并在Fisher信息平衡条件对应的临界阶段后显著增强；基于此提出免训练的动态CFG策略——不预设固定调度，而是由条件与无条件分数统计构造随机过程，当估计的引导增益超过给定阈值时激活引导，形成自适应激活规则，并将区间式引导作为极限特例纳入统一框架。
AI.result: 在多种架构和任务上的大量实验表明，该方法有效、稳健且具有广泛适用性；同时为动态引导方法提供了理论解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为条件扩散模型的推理时控制提供了有原则的理论基础，并统一解释了动态引导方法。

title: Auditing VLM Benchmarks from Existing Evaluation Runs
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation? (non-archival). Code and artifacts: https://github.com/avos-rnd/vlm-bench
summary: Every evaluation run of a vision-language model (VLM) already produces per-question artifacts (predictions, judged correctness, metadata) that leaderboards reduce to a single score and then discard. We reuse those artifacts to audit the benchmark itself, and add an audit layer to VLMEvalKit: six detectors that run as post-processing over saved outputs, plus one additional text-only rerun with visual inputs removed, emitting a per-question report. The layer reports per-question findings together with aggregate audit statistics; for the headline quantities, it attaches permutation-null excess where applicable, interval estimates for proportions, and sensitivity to the model pool. Auditing MMStar, a benchmark curated specifically so that the image is indispensable, with three models, we find zero aggregate accuracy gain from the image on 20.2% of its questions. An item-matched permutation null accounts for 17.0%, leaving a +3.2 pp excess (corrected permutation p = 0.001). This excess is concentrated in the mathematics and science categories and is absent from coarse perception, a localization consistent with knowledge substituting for visual evidence; confirming that mechanism would require item-level review. A second detector flags 134 questions on which every model that answered in parseable form picked the same non-gold option, and these candidates peak in the perception categories, whereas the zero-gain excess is largest in mathematics and science & technology. Replacing the LLM judge with exact string matching changes no conclusion, and every scoring discrepancy between the two traces to one model whose free-form answers a parser cannot read. On a binary yes/no benchmark the detectors measurably fall out of calibration, a scope boundary that we measure and report. The audit layer, the prediction artifacts and the generated reports accompany this submission.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在VLMEvalKit中增加一个"审计层"，复用VLM评测中已被排行榜丢弃的逐题产物（预测、判定、元数据），通过六个检测器加一个去图像的纯文本重跑，对基准本身进行审计。在MMStar上审计三个模型发现：20.2%的题目图像带来零聚合准确率增益，经置换零假设校正后仍有+3.2 pp超额（p=0.001），集中于数学与科学类；另有134道题所有可解析模型均选同一非金标选项，峰值出现在感知类。
AI.motivation: VLM评测每次运行都产生逐题产物，但排行榜只把它们压缩成单一分数后丢弃，导致基准自身的质量问题（如题目是否真需图像、是否存在标注疑点）未被检验。作者希望复用这些已有产物来审计基准，而非仅评估模型。
AI.method: 在VLMEvalKit上添加审计层：六个检测器作为对已保存输出的后处理，外加一次移除视觉输入的纯文本重跑，输出逐题报告与聚合统计。对头部指标附加置换零假设超额（permutation-null excess）、比例区间估计以及对模型池的敏感性分析。用三个模型审计MMStar，并做item-matched置换零假设校正；另用精确字符串匹配替代LLM判定做稳健性检验。
AI.result: MMStar上20.2%的题目图像零准确率增益；item-matched置换零假设解释17.0%，余下+3.2 pp超额（校正置换p=0.001），集中于数学与科学类，感知类无此现象，与"知识替代视觉证据"一致。第二个检测器标记出134道所有可解析模型均选同一非金标选项的题目，峰值在感知类。替换判分方式不改变结论，两轨迹间的评分差异均源于某模型不可解析的自由文本。在二元yes/no基准上检测器明显失准，作为范围边界被测量并报告。
AI.conclusion: 审计层表明现有VLM评测产物可用于诊断基准自身缺陷：图像在多题上对准确率无贡献且部分超出置换零假设预期，提示可能存在知识替代视觉证据及标注疑点。该方法附带范围边界（二元基准上失准）。审计层、预测产物与生成的报告一并随投稿提供。

title: BLOKS: Scaling Kernel Solvers with Sketched Block Preconditioning
summary: Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) is a theoretically sound algorithm for nonparametric learning, which is also often used to investigate properties of deep learning. However, the exact KRR formulation incurs time and memory costs preventing applicability to large datasets, motivating the development of approximate solvers. These algorithms rely on (i) iterative methods, to avoid the computational burden of direct solutions; (ii) sketching or batching, to reduce the problem size; and (iii) preconditioning, to accelerate convergence. While crucial for fast convergence, preconditioning incurs memory costs that can be managed by lowering the number of free parameters of the model, potentially at the expense of expressivity and hence accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose BLOKS, a Conjugate Gradient-based solver for Nyström-sketched KRR built around a novel preconditioner that combines a block Jacobi approximation with sketching. The BLOKS preconditioner has memory cost independent of both the dataset size and the number of parameters, allowing scaling to large models. We provide a memory-efficient, GPU-accelerated implementation and show that BLOKS achieves excellent accuracy while retaining favorable time/memory complexity. Indeed, on standard large-scale datasets used to benchmark kernel solvers, BLOKS achieves comparable or better performances than state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLOKS，一种面向Nyström草图化KRR的共轭梯度求解器，其核心是结合块Jacobi近似与草图的新型预条件器，内存开销与数据集规模和参数数量均无关，可在GPU上高效实现并取得优于或媲美SOTA的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 精确KRR的时间和内存成本过高，难以扩展到大数据集，因此需要近似求解器。主流近似方法依赖迭代求解、草图/分批降规模、预条件加速收敛，但预条件的内存开销通常通过减少模型自由参数来控制，这会牺牲表达能力与精度。作者希望在保持快速收敛的同时，使预条件的内存成本不依赖数据集规模和参数数量。
AI.method: 提出BLOKS：基于共轭梯度（Conjugate Gradient）的Nyström草图化KRR求解器。其新型预条件器将块Jacobi近似（block Jacobi approximation）与草图（sketching）结合，使其内存成本独立于数据集规模和参数数量，并给出内存高效、GPU加速的实现。
AI.result: 在用于基准测试核求解器的大规模标准数据集上，BLOKS达到与最先进方法相当或更优的性能，同时保持良好的时间/内存复杂度。
AI.conclusion: BLOKS通过将块Jacobi近似与草图结合的预条件策略，解决了预条件内存开销与模型表达能力之间的权衡问题，实现了可扩展至大模型的高精度、高效率KRR近似求解。

title: ELMA: Benchmarking Anaphoric Compositions for Long-Term Text-to-Motion Generation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Text-guided long-term human motion generation is essential for applications such as continuously operating digital avatars. Despite recent progress on short clips, existing models struggle with multi-segment instructions that involve anaphora, where constraints established in earlier segments must be preserved over time. In this paper, we introduce a novel task of long-term motion generation from such anaphoric compositions. To mitigate this, we present ELMA, an episodic long-term motion dataset with dense segment-level annotations that preserve cross-segment dependencies. Built via a fully automated collection and filtering pipeline, ELMA extracts high-quality, continuous 30-second clips from in-the-wild videos, capturing the episodic narratives necessary for long-range state modeling. Leveraging this dataset, we fine-tune state-of-the-art motion generation models to incorporate long-range context. Extensive experiments reveal fundamental shortcomings in current models when handling context-dependent instructions. We demonstrate that ELMA enables significant improvements in both global physical realism and semantic alignment, setting a robust new baseline for long-term motion synthesis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"指代性组合指令下的长期人体动作生成"新任务，并发布ELMA数据集（30秒连续片段、密集分段标注、保留跨段依赖），据此微调现有动作生成模型，显著提升全局物理真实性与语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 文本引导的长期人体动作生成对持续运行的数字人等应用至关重要。现有模型虽在短片段上取得进展，但在含指代（anaphora）的多段指令上表现不佳——前段建立的约束需在后续时间段持续保持，即需要长程状态建模能力。目前的瓶颈在于缺乏带有跨段依赖标注的长期动作数据。
AI.method: 1) 定义新任务：从指代性组合指令生成长期动作；2) 构建ELMA数据集，通过全自动采集与过滤流水线，从野外视频中提取高质量、连续的30秒片段，并提供密集的分段级标注以保留跨段依赖；3) 基于ELMA对当前最先进的动作生成模型进行微调，使其融入长程上下文信息。
AI.result: 大量实验揭示了现有模型在处理上下文依赖指令时的根本性缺陷；同时表明ELMA可显著提升全局物理真实性与语义对齐，为长期动作合成建立了新的强基线。
AI.conclusion: 长期动作生成的关键瓶颈在于跨段上下文保持与数据缺失，ELMA通过数据与微调范式为该任务提供了有效解决方案与新的性能基准。

title: PlacePulse: Learning Transferable Place Representations from Structural Geographic Data
summary: Geospatial machine learning often depends on task-specific feature engineering over large collections of sociodemographic, business, and environmental variables. Geospatial foundation models offer reusable representations of place, but leading approaches typically encode dynamic signals, such as mobility and search activity, or visual signals from satellite imagery. Few models represent the static structural composition of places (who lives and works there, which businesses operate there, and which risks they face) as transferable embeddings at fine spatial resolution. We introduce PlacePulse, a structural geospatial foundation model that compresses 572 attributes, expanded to 2,288 inputs through H3 neighborhood aggregates, into 256-dimensional unit-norm embeddings for 1,055,537 H3 resolution-7 cells in the United States. We also introduce a reusable two-axis benchmark that separates intrinsic representation quality from downstream predictive utility across multiple targets and spatial supports. Intrinsically, the embeddings reconstruct standardized inputs with mean $R^2 = 0.853$, use 251 of 256 approximately decorrelated dimensions, and show strong spatial organization, with Moran's $I = 0.93$ on the leading principal component and autocorrelation persisting beyond the input radius. Extrinsically, across 74 held-out targets from 12 external sources and four spatial supports, PlacePulse outperforms a dimensionality-matched feature-selection baseline on targets unrelated to the training inputs and is competitive with Google's Population Dynamics Foundation Model, leading on health, economic, election, economic-mobility and social-vulnerability outcomes, with relative strengths that vary by domain. These findings position structural composition as a distinct and complementary modality for geospatial foundation models, not simply a fallback where behavioral or imagery data are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PlacePulse，一个面向"结构性"地理空间基础模型，将572个属性扩展为2288个输入并压缩为256维单位范数嵌入，覆盖美国1,055,537个H3分辨率7网格；并设计双轴基准，从内在表示质量与外在预测效用评估，显示结构性构成是互补且独立的地理空间模态。
AI.motivation: 地理空间机器学习依赖任务特定的特征工程；现有地理空间基础模型多编码动态信号（移动性、搜索活动）或卫星视觉信号，少有模型将地点的静态结构构成（居民、从业者、企业、风险）建模为可迁移的细粒度空间嵌入。因此需要验证结构性构成能否成为独立且互补的模态。
AI.method: 以572个属性、经H3邻域聚合扩展为2288个输入，压缩为256维单位范数嵌入，覆盖美国1,055,537个H3分辨率7网格单元；同时提出可复用的双轴基准，将内在表示质量与下游预测效用分离，跨多目标与多空间支持评估。
AI.result: 内在指标：嵌入重建标准化输入的均值R²=0.853，256维中251维近似去相关，空间组织强（第一主成分Moran's I=0.93），自相关延续至输入半径之外。外在指标：在12个外部来源、4种空间支持的74个留出目标上，PlacePulse在训练输入无关目标上优于维度匹配的特征选择基线，并与Google Population Dynamics Foundation Model相当，在健康、经济、选举、经济流动性与社会脆弱性结果上领先，相对优势随领域变化。
AI.conclusion: 结构性构成可作为一种独特且互补的地理空间基础模型模态，而非行为或影像数据不可用时的退路；该工作为地点的静态结构表示提供了可迁移嵌入与可复用评估框架。

title: Learning Holistic Scene Layout against View Shifts in Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view geo-localization remains challenging due to drastic appearance variations and geometric distortions caused by viewpoint changes. Existing methods primarily rely on discriminative feature learning or explicit geometric alignment, yet often overlook an important observation: humans tend to match scenes by integrating the spatial context of multiple landmarks rather than relying solely on isolated local visual cues. Inspired by this, we propose a Spatial Context Modeling (SCM) module, which traverses feature maps along four orthogonal directions and models interactions among the resulting directional representations at each spatial position. By aggregating complementary directional observations, SCM constructs richer scene layout representations. Since reliable spatial context depends on robust visual features, we introduce a High-Frequency Information Guidance (HFIG) module that extracts stable structural cues from the frequency domain. By emphasizing edges and contours that are less sensitive to appearance variations, HFIG encourages the model to learn more robust representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance on standard cross-view geo-localization benchmarks while exhibiting strong robustness under more challenging scenarios with unknown orientations and limited fields of view (FoVs).

AI.tldr: 提出SCM（空间上下文建模）与HFIG（高频信息引导）两个模块，通过四方向遍历建模方向表征交互并利用频域结构线索，提升跨视角地理定位的鲁棒性与精度。
AI.motivation: 跨视角地理定位受视角变化引起的剧烈外观差异与几何畸变影响，难度大。现有方法多依赖判别性特征学习或显式几何对齐，却忽略了人类匹配场景时倾向于整合多个地标的空间上下文，而非仅依赖孤立的局部视觉线索。
AI.method: 1) SCM模块：沿四个正交方向遍历特征图，在每个空间位置建模各方向表征之间的交互，聚合互补的方向观测以构建更丰富的场景布局表征；2) HFIG模块：从频域提取稳定结构线索，强调对外观变化不敏感的边界与轮廓，从而引导模型学习更鲁棒的表征。
AI.result: 在标准跨视角地理定位基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并在朝向未知、视场受限（FoV）等更具挑战的场景下展现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将空间上下文建模与频域结构引导相结合，可有效提升跨视角地理定位的表征鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: Why Linear Models Can Still Work in a Complex and Changing World
summary: Linear models can predict well in complex domains even when underlying mechanisms are nonlinear. We argue that this can occur because the complexity of the world exceeds the complexity that can be learned reliably from finite, partially observed data. Flexible models can exploit curvature, thresholds, and interactions that fit one hospital, period, population, policy setting, or measurement process but fail elsewhere. When this instability lies mainly in the nonlinear component, omitting it can give linear models lower prediction error in a new environment. We connect this claim to work on simple linear rules, bias and variance, regularization, best linear prediction, measurement error, distribution shift, invariance, Rashomon sets, and underspecification. Proposition 1 gives a simple squared-error case in which a nonlinear rule learned in the training environment raises target error because it transfers too weakly; finite-sample estimation error can strengthen this result. Partial observation alone is not enough: the link between observed variables and unobserved factors must vary across environments. Stable nonlinear structure favors flexible models, and linear models remain vulnerable to linear spurious relationships. Model complexity should therefore be chosen by cross-environment stability as well as training-data accuracy.

AI.tldr: 线性模型在复杂非线性领域中有时能取得更低泛化误差，原因在于世界的复杂度超出有限、部分观测数据所能可靠学习的复杂度；当非线性成分跨环境不稳定时，省略它反而更优。
AI.motivation: 作者试图解释一个反直觉现象：在机制本质为非线性的复杂领域，线性模型为何仍能预测良好。其核心动机是将这一现象归因于世界复杂度超出有限、部分观测数据可可靠学习的上限，并强调模型复杂度应按跨环境稳定性而非仅按训练精度来选择。
AI.method: 论证为概念与理论结合：把这一主张与简单线性规则、偏差-方差分解、正则化、最优线性预测、测量误差、分布偏移、不变性、Rashomon集与欠定（underspecification）等文献联系起来；并给出命题1，在一个简单的平方误差情形中展示训练环境学到的非线性规则因迁移过弱而抬高目标环境误差，同时指出有限样本估计误差会强化该结果；进一步论证仅有部分观测不足，观测变量与未观测因素之间的连接必须跨环境变化。
AI.result: 命题1表明：在平方误差设定下，训练环境中习得的非线性规则跨环境迁移能力弱，因而提高目标误差；有限样本估计误差可加强这一效应。同时得出条件性结论：仅部分观测不足以造成该现象，需观测变量与未观测因子的关联跨环境变化；稳定的非线性结构有利于灵活模型，而线性模型仍易受线性虚假关系影响。
AI.conclusion: 模型复杂度应由跨环境稳定性与训练数据精度共同决定。当非线性成分跨环境不稳定时，线性模型可能更具泛化优势；但若非线性结构稳定，灵活模型仍更优，线性模型则难以抵御线性伪相关。

title: What We Talk About When We Talk About Emotion Editing
summary: Emotional image editing aims to change the emotion a scene conveys while preserving its essential content. Because the same scene can support different emotional interpretations, achieving an emotional goal requires visual changes grounded in the source context. Motivated by the Component Process Model, which links emotional responses to event appraisal, we investigate neural representations as a reference for these editing decisions. Using TRIBE v2, an fMRI encoding model, we analyze 400 source-target pairs across eight emotion categories. Hidden states from EmoEdit, EmoEditor, and AffectDelta correspond more strongly to predicted target-image responses in visual regions than in affect-related regions. This imbalance motivates ROI-ReFT, which combines source visual responses as a content reference with a predicted affective response change as an editing direction. Two interacting branches use both conditions to guide a frozen editor throughout generation. Predicted responses of the generated image supervise affective change and constrain visual drift. On a post hoc selected subset of 400 editing requests, ROI-ReFT achieves 91.75% target-emotion accuracy and 83.25% joint success, with the same output both matching the target emotion and reaching source-output DINO-I of at least 0.80. Our code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 基于TRIBE v2 fMRI编码模型分析情感图像编辑的神经表征，发现现有方法隐藏状态偏向视觉区域而非情感区域，据此提出ROI-ReFT方法。
AI.motivation: 情感图像编辑需在保留内容的同时改变场景传达的情感。由于同一场景可有多种情感解读，实现情感目标需要以源上下文为基础的视觉改动。受Component Process Model（将情感反应与事件评估相联系）启发，作者希望以神经表征作为编辑决策的参考，探究现有方法是否真正针对情感相关脑区进行建模。
AI.method: 使用TRIBE v2（fMRI编码模型）分析8个情感类别、400对源-目标样本。将EmoEdit、EmoEditor、AffectDelta的隐藏状态与预测的目标图像反应进行对比，发现其在视觉区域的相关性强于情感相关区域。基于此提出ROI-ReFT：以源视觉反应作为内容参考，以预测的情感反应变化作为编辑方向，用两个交互分支在生成过程中引导冻结的编辑器；生成图像的预测反应监督情感变化并约束视觉漂移。
AI.result: 在事后选取的400个编辑请求子集上，ROI-ReFT达到91.75%的目标情感准确率和83.25%的联合成功率，即输出同时匹配目标情感且源-输出DINO-I不低于0.80。
AI.conclusion: 现有情感图像编辑方法的神经表征更偏向视觉区域，存在情感建模的失衡；通过引入源视觉反应与预测情感反应变化作为双重引导，ROI-ReFT在情感准确性与内容保持的联合指标上取得良好表现。代码与数据集将公开。

title: Accelerating Linear Bandits with Persistent Candidate Sets
summary: Exhaustive optimistic scoring can make action selection costly in linear bandits with a large fixed set of $K$ actions, requiring $\mathcal{O}(K)$ score evaluations per round. We introduce Persistent Candidate LinUCB (\textsc{PC-LinUCB}), which maintains $k$ active actions and samples $q$ challengers uniformly from the remaining $K-k$ actions at each round. By scoring only these $k+q$ candidates, \textsc{PC-LinUCB} reduces the number of score evaluations per round to $\mathcal{O}(k+q)$. We establish problem-independent and problem-dependent high-probability regret bounds consisting of a standard linear-bandit learning term and an additive discovery cost of order $\mathcal{O}\left((K-k)\log(K-k)/q\right)$ at fixed confidence. Notably, this additional cost does not grow with the horizon. For fixed gaps and sufficiently long horizons, we establish an $Ω\left((K-k)/q\right)$ regret lower bound under uniform challenger sampling, showing that partial candidate access itself imposes an unavoidable regret cost. Experiments show that \textsc{PC-LinUCB} substantially accelerates LinUCB while maintaining comparable regret, and that the persistent candidate mechanism can extend beyond LinUCB.

AI.tldr: 提出PC-LinUCB，通过持久候选集+均匀挑战者采样，将每轮评分从O(K)降到O(k+q)，并给出问题无关/相关问题的高概率后悔界及下界。
AI.motivation: 在动作集固定且规模K很大的线性bandit中，穷举乐观评分导致每轮需O(K)次评分评估，计算开销高，因此需要降低动作选择的评分成本。
AI.method: PC-LinUCB维护k个活跃动作，每轮从剩余K-k个动作中均匀采样q个挑战者，仅对这k+q个候选做评分，从而把每轮评分评估数降到O(k+q)。
AI.result: 建立问题无关与问题相关的高概率后悔界：标准线性bandit学习项加上固定置信度下的O((K-k)log(K-k)/q)发现代价，且该额外代价不随horizon增长；在固定gap与足够长horizon下，针对均匀挑战者采样给出Ω((K-k)/q)后悔下界。实验显示PC-LinUCB显著加速LinUCB且后悔相近，持久候选机制可扩展到LinUCB之外。
AI.conclusion: 部分候选访问会带来不可避免的后悔代价，但PC-LinUCB能在保持可比后悔的同时显著降低每轮计算成本，且该候选机制具有通用性。

title: Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound Images with Conformal Uncertainty Estimation
summary: Thyroid nodules affect a large proportion of the general population. Although most are benign, a non-negligible fraction is malignant. Ultrasound imaging is the primary diagnostic modality, and accurate nodule segmentation is a prerequisite for CAD systems to classify malignancy and assess metastatic risk.\\ In this work, we propose a thyroid nodule segmentation framework that integrates a DeepLabV3+, channel-attention modules and post-hoc conformal prediction, providing both accurate mask and pixel-level uncertainty estimates. We address thyroid ultrasound nodule segmentation as the first stage of a pipeline that also includes malignancy classification and metastatic risk prediction. We adopt DeepLabV3+, whose Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) captures multi-scale context, with an EfficientNet-B5 backbone for its accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, we test three channel-attention modules: Squeeze-and-Excitation, CBAM and Grouped Channel Attention (GCA), paired with two loss formulations (Dice-BCE and Boundary).\\ Since binary masks do not indicate prediction confidence, we wrap the trained model with a split conformal prediction layer that produces pixel-level uncertainty maps with statistical coverage guarantees.\\ We evaluate all configurations on the TN3K public benchmark using a fixed split and directly compare them with state-of-the-art methods. The plain backbone already improves upon previously reported results, with CBAM + Dice-BCE emerging as the best overall configuration.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出整合DeepLabV3+、通道注意力模块与事后保形预测的甲状腺结节分割框架，同时输出精确掩膜与像素级不确定性估计，并在TN3K基准上取得优于现有方法的结果。
AI.motivation: 超声是甲状腺结节诊断的主要模态，精确的结节分割是CAD系统进行恶性分类与转移风险评估的前提；同时二值掩膜缺乏预测置信度信息，需要提供像素级不确定性以保证可靠性。
AI.method: 以DeepLabV3+为分割主体，利用空洞空间金字塔池化（ASPP）捕获多尺度上下文，骨干采用EfficientNet-B5以平衡精度与效率；测试三种通道注意力模块（SE、CBAM、GCA）与两种损失（Dice-BCE、Boundary）；并在训练后的模型外接split conformal prediction层，生成具有统计覆盖保证的像素级不确定性图。该方法定位为包含恶性分类与转移风险预测的级联流程的第一阶段。
AI.result: 在TN3K公开基准上使用固定划分进行评估并与最先进方法直接对比：仅使用原始骨干（plain backbone）即已超越先前报道结果；CBAM + Dice-BCE为整体最优配置。
AI.conclusion: 将EfficientNet-B5骨干的DeepLabV3+与CBAM及Dice-BCE结合，并叠加split conformal prediction，可在甲状腺超声结节分割中同时获得高精度掩膜与带覆盖保证的像素级不确定性，优于现有方法，适合作为CAD级联流程的可靠前置分割模块。

title: In-Context Learning for System Identification: Probabilistic Formulation, Long-Sequence Handling, and Benchmark Validation
summary: Traditional system identification typically involves two steps: initially, training data is processed to estimate a model of the system of interest; then, the model is used to predict outputs for new input queries. In contrast, recent in-context learning approaches learn a meta model that maps directly from training data and query inputs to outputs in a zero-shot fashion, bypassing explicit model estimation. This approach leverages a meta model trained offline, on large sets of synthetically generated data, to emulate the behavior of a system identification algorithm. In this work, we advance this meta-learning framework for system identification in three directions. First, we develop a unified probabilistic meta-identification architecture that combines a Transformer-based encoder-decoder with tailored mechanisms for handling long training sequences, enabling calibrated predictions over long horizons. Second, we show how a pre-trained meta model can act as an uncertainty-aware synthetic data generator for classical system identification, providing task-specific data that regularize parametric models when real data are scarce. Third, we systematically evaluate the framework on standard nonlinear system identification benchmarks and on a challenging out-of-distribution scenario, demonstrating competitive accuracy with state-of-the-art methods and strong generalization, including cases where input-only adaptation is sufficient to handle significant distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 该论文推进了用于系统辨识的元学习框架，提出统一的概率元辨识架构、将预训练元模型用作不确定性感知合成数据生成器，并在标准非线性系统辨识基准及分布外场景中验证了其竞争性精度与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统系统辨识需先估计模型再预测，流程为两步；而近期上下文学习通过离线在大规模合成数据上训练元模型，直接由训练数据与查询输入零样本映射到输出，绕过显式模型估计。本文旨在推进这一元学习框架，解决长序列处理、预测校准、数据稀缺下的正则化及分布偏移泛化等问题。
AI.method: 第一，提出统一的概率元辨识架构，将基于Transformer的编码器-解码器与针对长训练序列的定制机制相结合，实现长时域上的校准预测；第二，展示预训练元模型可作为不确定性感知的合成数据生成器，为经典系统辨识提供任务特定数据，在真实数据稀缺时正则化参数模型；第三，在标准非线性系统辨识基准及具有挑战性的分布外场景中系统评估该框架。
AI.result: 在标准非线性系统辨识基准和分布外场景中，该方法达到与最先进方法相当的精度，并展现出强泛化能力，包括仅需输入自适应即可应对显著分布偏移的情形。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从概率架构、合成数据生成和系统评估三个方向推进了元学习系统辨识框架，验证了其在精度、校准与泛化方面的有效性，尤其在数据稀缺和分布偏移场景下具有优势。

title: OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?
summary: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OccludeBench 基准与 OccludeTrace 诊断框架，研究视觉语言模型（VLM）对图像中被完全遮挡物体的恢复能力，发现模型在依赖物理线索的直接场景中存在显著推理瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有研究尚不清楚 VLM 能否基于图像中残留的视觉证据推断被遮挡的物体。作者希望系统评估并定位这一"缺失内容推理"能力的失败环节。
AI.method: 构建人工标注的 OccludeBench 基准，区分"直接"（依赖阴影、反射等具体物理线索）与"推断"（依赖整体场景语境）两类案例；评测 5 个 VLM 与人类表现。提出四阶段诊断工具 OccludeTrace 以定位推理断点，并测试扩展推理、工具调用、少样本提示及"先修复再验证"（inpaint-then-confront）干预。
AI.result: 模型在直接案例准确率 42.7%，推断案例 62.7%，差距 20.0 分；人类分别为 63.4% 与 68.5%，无显著差距。瓶颈出现在"从全图投影中恢复相关物体"阶段：失败样本仅 50% 成功，而正确样本达 91%。提示工程类干预效果不稳定；inpaint-then-confront 干预将差距缩小至统计不显著（对具备图像生成能力的模型）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可控、可追踪的诊断框架，用于隔离和分析 VLM 在缺失视觉内容推理上的具体失败机制，并表明生成—验证式干预可有效缓解该瓶颈。

title: CUBE: Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence for Open-Set Insect Species Recognition
summary: Open-set insect species recognition faces significant challenges when deployed in real-world biodiversity scenarios, particularly when encountering unknown species that are visually close to known training classes. Unlike generic out-of-distribution samples, fine-grained unknown insects are often not visually anomalous. They instead tend to appear near the decision boundary of specific known species, leading to unreliable closed-set predictions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence (CUBE)}, a novel evidence-based framework that models unknownness around each known species rather than as a single global unknown class. Our key idea is to evaluate a test sample relative to the known species it most closely resembles, enabling local rejection for visually confusable unknown insects. CUBE learns class-conditioned boundary evidence from auxiliary species, preserves auxiliary species as shadow references during inference, and incorporates taxonomic candidate calibration to verify biological plausibility. When ecological metadata is available, we further introduce CUBE-E, which adds a lightweight location-consistency term without modifying the visual backbone. Experiments on the Open-Insect C-America benchmark show that CUBE achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines with 95.8\%, 98.7\%, and 99.1\% AUROC on local, non-local, and non-moth unknown splits, respectively, while maintaining 94.9\% closed-set accuracy. With ecological metadata, CUBE-E further improves the results to 96.0\%, 99.7\%, and 99.5\% AUROC with 95.2\% closed-set accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出CUBE框架，将未知性建模为围绕各已知物种的类别条件边界证据，实现细粒度昆虫开放集识别，并可扩展为融合生态元数据的CUBE-E。
AI.motivation: 真实生物多样性场景中的开放集昆虫识别面临挑战：未知细粒度昆虫常在视觉上与已知训练类接近，并非视觉异常样本，而是落在特定已知物种的决策边界附近，导致闭集预测不可靠。现有将未知视为单一全局类别的做法难以应对。
AI.method: CUBE以证据学习为基础，不把未知建模为全局单一类别，而是针对每个已知物种建模未知性：将测试样本与其最相似的已知物种进行比较，实现局部拒绝。方法从辅助物种学习类别条件边界证据，在推理时保留辅助物种作为影子参照，并引入分类学候选校准以验证生物学合理性。CUBE-E进一步在生态元数据可用时，以轻量位置一致性项扩展，且不修改视觉骨干网络。
AI.result: 在Open-Insect C-America基准上，CUBE在local、non-local、non-moth未知划分上分别取得95.8%、98.7%、99.1% AUROC，闭集准确率94.9%，优于现有最先进基线。加入生态元数据的CUBE-E进一步提升至96.0%、99.7%、99.5% AUROC，闭集准确率95.2%。
AI.conclusion: 类别条件、局部化的未知边界证据建模能有效处理与已知类视觉混淆的细粒度未知昆虫，分类学校准与生态元数据可带来额外增益，为真实生物多样性开放集识别提供了有效方案。

title: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is increasingly recorded by wearable and clinical devices at enormous scale, and a growing number of PPG foundation models (FMs) have been developed to compute reusable representations for various downstream tasks. These models are difficult to compare: different evaluations use different datasets, task definitions, preprocessing, downstream heads, hyperparameter tuning, and baselines. We present PPG-Bench, a unifying open-source benchmark evaluating five public PPG FMs across nine open-access datasets and 26 tasks spanning cardiovascular state estimation, activity, sleep, screening, and identification. We evaluate models under four downstream regimes of increasing adaptability (linear probing, random forests, frozen MLP probes, and end-to-end finetuning), with model-specific hyperparameter optimization and subject-disjoint cross-validation. We also evaluate against three controls: random/constant baseline, a deterministic pulse-rate-variability (PRV) feature set, and a generic time-series FM (MOMENT). Across all 68 task-regime combinations, 35.3% show no meaningful FM advantage over the random/constant baseline, and in 83.8% no PPG-specific FM outperforms both PRV and MOMENT. We also find that added downstream head capacity generally improves performance, but can cause significant degradation if the model is performing at chance/constant level. Current PPG FMs therefore cannot yet claim to provide generalised and transferrable representations of PPG signals, and future evaluation in this field should include checks against simple, non-learned controls. Code for the benchmark and instructions to evaluate more models can be found here - https://github.com/mannas-ai/ppg-bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PPG-Bench，一个统一的开源基准，用于在可比的评估设置下系统比较 PPG 基础模型（FM）的表示能力。
AI.motivation: PPG 基础模型数量增长迅速，但现有评估在数据集、任务定义、预处理、下游头、调参与基线等方面差异巨大，导致结果不可比，也难以判断这些模型是否真正学到了通用、可迁移的表示。
AI.method: 构建 PPG-Bench，统一评估 5 个公开 PPG FM，覆盖 9 个开放数据集、26 个任务（心血管状态估计、活动、睡眠、筛查、身份识别）；采用四种适配度递增的下游范式（线性探测、随机森林、冻结 MLP 探针、端到端微调），并进行模型特定超参优化与受试者不相交交叉验证；同时设置三类对照：随机/常数基线、确定性 PRV 特征集、通用时序 FM（MOMENT）。
AI.result: 在全部 68 个任务-范式组合中，35.3% 未显示 FM 相对随机/常数基线的有意义优势；83.8% 的组合中没有任何 PPG 专用 FM 同时优于 PRV 和 MOMENT。增加下游头容量通常提升性能，但当模型处于随机/常数水平时可能导致显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 当前 PPG 基础模型尚不能声称提供了通用且可迁移的 PPG 表示；该领域未来评估应纳入简单、非学习型对照，PPG-Bench 提供了可复用的基准与扩展评估代码。

title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.

AI.tldr: QTestBench：首个以独立benchmark checker为判据、评估LLM生成量子测试套件判别能力的跨框架基准，覆盖8个PennyLane QHack挑战与10个Qiskit HumanEval任务，对5个LLM进行评测。
AI.motivation: LLM在经典代码生成与单元测试编写上表现优异，但量子软件的测试更困难：量子程序具有概率性、依赖数值容差，且由领域专用checker判定，因此一个形式上正确的测试仍可能与benchmark结论相矛盾。现有量子benchmark只衡量模型能否生成正确解，而不衡量其测试能否区分正确实现与错误实现，这一空白正是本文动机。
AI.method: 提出QTestBench框架：对每个任务提示模型生成语法、语义、行为三类测试，在运行时注入候选实现，并将每条测试判定结果与独立benchmark checker的标签进行比对，从不将测试本身视为ground truth；设计三个验证队列，各自回答不同的诊断性问题。评测5个LLM，覆盖8个PennyLane QHack挑战与10个Qiskit HumanEval任务，并引入oracle验证的合成变异体以补充自然错误解稀缺的情形。
AI.result: 生成的测试套件几乎总能执行，但判别力明显不足：最佳生成器在QHack上测试质量仅0.71，在Qiskit HumanEval上仅0.34，说明可执行性会高估测试质量。Oracle验证的合成变异体在自然错误解稀缺时可稳定bug检测估计，例如10个Qiskit任务中有3个无法获得任何自然错误解。
AI.conclusion: QTestBench为LLM生成量子测试的可信度提供了可复现、跨框架的评测基准。核心结论是：测试可执行不等于测试有效，判别力才是关键指标；合成变异体是弥补自然错误样本不足的有效手段。后续应聚焦提升LLM测试的故障区分能力。

title: Benchmarking Answer-Grounding Consistency in Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
comment: Under review at ICASSP 2027. Code available at https://github.com/pingggg516/AESP-Evaluation
summary: In grounded remote sensing visual question answering, a model produces a textual answer and identifies relevant objects in the image as grounding evidence. Existing evaluations measure answer correctness and localization quality, but do not directly assess answer-grounding consistency. We propose the Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP) to assess this consistency through evidence support: whether the grounding evidence supports the model's own answer. AESP applies task-specific rules to existence, counting, and comparison questions. We further construct the Grounded Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (G-RSVQA) benchmark, containing 15,027 samples with questions, reference answers, and all related object-level annotations. Experiments on seven grounded vision--language models reveal failures of evidence support across all three question types. Up to 50.82% of correct answers in the evidence evaluation subset are not supported by the provided grounding evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP)评估框架与G-RSVQA基准，用于检验接地的遥感视觉问答中答案与接地证据的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅分别衡量答案正确性与定位质量，未直接评估答案-证据一致性，即接地证据是否支持模型自身的答案。
AI.method: 提出AESP协议，针对存在性、计数、比较三类问题应用任务专用规则，判定接地证据是否支持模型答案；并构建含15,027个样本（问题、参考答案及全部相关目标级标注）的G-RSVQA基准。
AI.result: 在七个接地视觉-语言模型上，三类问题均出现证据支持失效；证据评估子集中最多50.82%的正确答案得不到所提供接地证据的支持。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确并不等于证据充分，AESP与G-RSVQA揭示了接地视觉-语言模型在答案-证据一致性上的系统性缺陷。

title: Beyond Temporal Proximity: Explanatory World Models for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Explanatory World Models (EWM)，用解释（explanation）作为信用分配信号，将延迟结果归因到更早的关键事件上，从而缓解强化学习中按时间邻近度传播奖励导致的样本低效问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐中，强化学习常需优化决策后数百甚至数千次交互才出现的结果。标准 RL 按时间邻近度而非显式相关性传播奖励，会削弱远距离但重要动作的信号，造成样本低效。因此需要一个能识别"哪些早期事件真正促成最终结果"的信用分配机制。
AI.method: 提出 EWM 归因框架：用前沿语言模型生成解释，识别可能对已实现结果有贡献的早期事件；将这些解释作为学习信号，通过保序的分层算子（conservative hierarchical operator）递归重分配奖励，同时保持未折扣的回合回报不变。并基于三种理论视角——Halpern 的实际因果、Lombrozo 的解释简洁性、Deutsch 的难以变易解释——实现三种互补变体。
AI.result: 在 Crafter、WordCraft 两个长时程 RL 基准上显著优于 PPO 和 LaRe，奖励延迟越大增益越明显；在 KuaiRand 离线场景优于 SFT 和 LaRe，在线优于 A2C；在工业级生成式推荐器的离线评估中大幅提升 Recall，并改善行为代理指标。
AI.conclusion: 解释可以为延迟结果的学习提供结构化、可复用的信用信号，说明基于解释的归因是提升长时程强化学习与生成式推荐样本效率的有效途径。

title: PhysForge: Material-Controllable 3D Reconstruction with Separable Components
summary: Recent advances in physical 3D generation have enabled visually faithful assets with simulatable mechanical behavior. However, existing methods provide limited control over material behavior beyond appearance-based inference and struggle to estimate physical properties from complex interactions between objects and semantic parts. Therefore, we present PhysForge, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM)-based framework for addressing these challenges, comprising two complementary modules for material-controllable physical fitting and componentlevel interaction modeling. The first, PhysFit, leverages material-conditioned VDM dynamics as references for physical-property fitting, introducing windowed fitting to focus on material-revealing interactions and Hallucinated Forcing to disentangle nonphysical motion hallucinated by the VDM from material responses. The second, PhysComp decomposes complex interactions into individual objects and semantic components, enabling their physical parameters to be optimized independently and flexibly composed for joint simulation. Experiments on PhysAssets and Google Scanned Objects demonstrate that, compared with existing methods, PhysForge provides stronger control over material-dependent physical responses while supporting component-level physical modeling for complex interactions. It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements. Our project page is available at https://masterwanna.github.io/PhysForge.html .

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysForge，一个基于视频扩散模型（VDM）的框架，用于实现材料可控的物理拟合与组件级交互建模。
AI.motivation: 现有物理3D生成方法对材料行为的控制有限，且难以从物体与语义部件间的复杂交互中估计物理属性。
AI.method: PhysForge包含两个互补模块：PhysFit利用材料条件化的VDM动力学作为参考进行物理属性拟合，引入窗口化拟合以聚焦材料交互，并提出幻觉受力（Hallucinated Forcing）以分离VDM幻觉的非物理运动与材料响应；PhysComp将复杂交互分解为单个物体和语义组件，支持物理参数独立优化与灵活组合的联合仿真。
AI.result: 在PhysAssets和Google Scanned Objects上，PhysForge在常见与罕见材料上均取得最佳CLIP和物理可控性分数，定性比较、组件级消融和用户研究进一步支持了这些改进。
AI.conclusion: PhysForge相比现有方法提供更强的材料相关物理响应控制，并支持复杂交互的组件级物理建模。

title: FedPCD: Priority-Constrained Federated Aggregation
summary: Federated learning (FL) seeks to optimize a shared global model from decentralized client data. While effective for average performance, this process can produce unfair performance across clients, particularly under statistically heterogeneous data distributions. Existing fairness-aware and multi-objective FL methods address this through client re-weighting, gradient correction, or common-descent formulations, but often change the global optimization direction or treat client objectives symmetrically. We propose FedPCD, a priority-constrained federated optimization framework that separates the global optimization objective from client protection. FedPCD preserves the conventional federated aggregate as the primary objective, while allowing only the minimum correction necessary to meet client performance constraints. Across heterogeneous FL benchmarks, FedPCD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the highest global accuracy across all configurations and leading worst-10% client accuracy in nearly all. FedPCD further preserves competitive trade-offs between global accuracy and client performance variability. Beyond this trade-off, FedPCD demonstrates faster empirical convergence, reaching matching or superior performance in substantially fewer communication rounds.

AI.tldr: 提出FedPCD，一个优先级约束的联邦优化框架，将全局优化目标与客户端保护分离，在保持传统联邦聚合为主目标的前提下，仅施加满足客户端性能约束所需的最小修正。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在统计异构数据下虽能优化平均性能，但会造成客户端间性能不公平。现有公平性或多目标联邦方法通过客户端重加权、梯度修正或共同下降等方式处理，但往往改变了全局优化方向，或对称地对待各客户端目标，缺乏优先级区分。
AI.method: FedPCD采用优先级约束的联邦优化框架：把常规联邦聚合结果作为主目标保持不变，客户端性能作为约束条件，仅在违反约束时施加最小必要的修正量，从而在保护客户端性能的同时不主导全局优化方向。
AI.result: 在多个异构联邦学习基准上，FedPCD稳定优于现有最优基线，在所有配置下取得最高全局精度，并在几乎所有配置下取得最佳的最差10%客户端精度；同时保持了全局精度与客户端性能波动之间具有竞争力的权衡，并展现出更快的经验收敛速度，在显著更少的通信轮数内达到相当或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: FedPCD通过优先级约束机制有效解耦全局优化与客户端保护，在提升全局与最差客户端性能的同时不牺牲收敛效率，为公平联邦学习提供了一种兼顾效率与公平的优化方案。

title: X-AVDD: Cross-Attentive Audio-Visual Dataset Distillation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Camera-ready version forthcoming. 17 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables
summary: Audio-visual dataset distillation aims to synthesize a small dataset from a large paired audio-visual dataset, while nearly preserving the training utility for neural networks.
