Existing approaches such as DM and AVDD face two critical limitations: 1) they are memory-intensive, making them difficult to scale to complex architectures and higher samples-per-class (SPC) settings, and 2) they often fail to preserve strong cross-modal semantic correspondence. To tackle these issues, we propose X-AVDD, a cross-attention-based distillation method that explicitly captures inter-modal relationships during synthesis. By decoupling cross-modal alignment from joint optimization, X-AVDD is substantially more memory-efficient, reducing end-to-end synthesis cost by $\sim 8\times$ GPU-hours, while producing highly aligned synthetic data. Empirically, X-AVDD significantly outperforms other audio-visual distillation methods. On VGGSound, an audio-visual dataset of short YouTube clips, X-AVDD improves top-1 test accuracy from $8.2\%\rightarrow24.0\%$ at SPC=$10$ and $9.8\%\rightarrow26.5\%$ at SPC=$20$. Furthermore, X-AVDD improves cross-architecture generalization (e.g., $25.5\%\rightarrow35.3\%$ for a ViT target on AVE dataset at SPC $=50$) and successfully scales to complex architectures such as AudioCLIP, achieving $62.3\%$ accuracy using only $5.65\%$ of the full dataset, against the full dataset accuracy of $72.4\%$ while completing in $9\times$ lower training time compared to the full dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出X-AVDD，一种基于交叉注意力的音视频数据集蒸馏方法，通过解耦跨模态对齐与联合优化，在保持强跨模态语义对应关系的同时大幅降低显存开销，并显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频数据集蒸馏方法（如DM、AVDD）存在两大局限：1）显存占用高，难以扩展到复杂架构和更高的每类样本数（SPC）设置；2）难以保持强跨模态语义对应关系。
AI.method: 提出X-AVDD，一种基于交叉注意力的蒸馏方法，在合成过程中显式捕捉模态间关系；通过将跨模态对齐与联合优化解耦，提升显存效率。
AI.result: 端到端合成成本降低约8倍GPU小时；在VGGSound上，SPC=10时top-1准确率由8.2%提升至24.0%，SPC=20时由9.8%提升至26.5%；在AVE数据集SPC=50时，ViT目标架构的跨架构泛化由25.5%提升至35.3%；可扩展至AudioCLIP等复杂架构，仅用5.65%数据达到62.3%准确率（全数据集为72.4%），训练时间缩短9倍。
AI.conclusion: X-AVDD在显存效率、跨模态对齐质量、蒸馏性能与跨架构泛化能力上均优于现有音视频数据集蒸馏方法，并能有效扩展至复杂模型与低数据占比场景。

title: Simulating Training Spikes of Deep Neural Networks by Layer-wise Random Feature Models
summary: Intermittent ``spikes'' in loss, during the pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs), remains a mysterious phenomenon both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we show that simple quadratic models with heavy-tailed, power-law distributed inputs can replicate these spikes. We introduce a theoretical framework and simulation algorithm to model per-layer training dynamics of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), using such quadratic models. In a case study on an Adam hyperparameter configuration (where $β_2$ is set close to $1$) known to induce spikes in Transformer LMs, our simulation successfully predicts bumps indicating spiky behavior from a given checkpoint. Furthermore, we derive an appropriate $β_2$ schedule from observed metrics, which empirically improves performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文用带重尾（幂律）输入输入的简单二次模型复现了LLM预训练中的loss spike现象，并提出可建模DNN逐层训练动态的理论框架与仿真算法，验证了Adam中β2接近1时的spike预测，并据此导出改进性能的β2调度。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练过程中出现的间歇性loss尖峰（spike）现象在理论与实证上都缺乏清晰解释，作者希望揭示其成因机制。
AI.method: 构建带重尾、幂律分布输入的简单二次模型；提出理论框架与仿真算法，用二次模型刻画DNN的逐层训练动态；在Adam超参数配置（β2接近1）引发Transformer LM尖峰的案例中进行验证；从观测指标推导β2调度。
AI.result: 仿真能从给定checkpoint成功预测出表明尖峰行为的bump；由观测指标导出的β2调度在实验中提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 重尾二次模型足以复现LLM预训练中的loss spike，该框架可用于预测尖峰并指导优化器超参数调度，从而改善训练表现。

title: Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation
comment: 21 pages total, previously published at Society of Photo-Optical Instrumentation Engineers (SPIE) Conference Series, Volume 14046
summary: In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition. If critical input conditions---such as time-of-day, weather, or scene location---are underrepresented in this test dataset, T&E results can be misleadingly due to this semantic coverage gap. We propose a three-stage generative AI pipeline to detect and fill such semantic gaps without requiring ground-truth labels of these semantics. First, vision-language models (VLMs) perform zero-shot binary labeling of semantic factors, and an embedding-space clustering step identifies which semantics most affect downstream model behavior. Second, diffusion-based image-to-image models transform existing covered images into the underrepresented semantic domain, preserving scene content while augmenting high-level appearance. Third, statistical analysis of the augmented image embeddings verifies that the synthetic imagery improves dataset coverage before it is incorporated. Crucially, the synthetic data is used only to enrich the test set and no model retraining is performed for T&E. We validate the full pipeline on both image classification and object detection under day/night semantic gaps, showing that the augmented test datasets better distinguish models with and without exposure to the missing semantic, thereby yielding T&E conclusions that more closely match those of an ideal, fully covered dataset. Code available at https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段生成式AI流水线，用于检测并填补AI模型测试集中的语义覆盖缺口，提升T&E结论可靠性。
AI.motivation: AI模型测试评估通常只能访问留出测试集，不了解训练数据及其语义构成。若关键输入条件（如时段、天气、场景位置）在测试集中代表性不足，会产生语义覆盖缺口，导致T&E结果产生误导。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：1）用视觉语言模型（VLM）对语义因子进行零样本二分类标注，并通过嵌入空间聚类识别对下游模型行为影响最大的语义；2）用基于扩散的图像到图像模型将已有覆盖图像转换到代表性不足的语义域，在保留场景内容的同时增广高层外观；3）对增广图像嵌入进行统计分析，验证合成图像是否提升数据集覆盖度后再纳入。
AI.result: 在图像分类和目标检测上针对昼夜语义缺口的验证表明，增广后的测试集能更好地区分有无接触缺失语义的模型，使T&E结论更接近理想全覆蓋数据集的结果。
AI.conclusion: 无需这些语义的真值标签即可检测并填补测试集语义缺口；合成数据仅用于丰富测试集、不进行模型重训练，可有效提升T&E评估的准确性。

title: Probabilistic Ship Trajectory Forecasting using Transformer Models on AIS Data
comment: Manuscript written in 2021. 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
summary: Anticipation of vessel trajectories is an essential task when navigating at sea. This applies to both human navigators and autonomous surface vessels. Trajectory forecasting enables sub-routines such as collision avoidance to assess the situation and react accordingly in time. This paper investigates Transformer and Performer models for trajectory prediction of surface vessels in confined waters. Using widely available position data from the Automatic Identification System (AIS), candidate models are trained and evaluated. Historical information on how other vessels have moved in the local area surrounding each agent is conveyed using positional heat maps. The heat maps are generated using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) and encoded with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) before entering the Transformer models. The models are trained with quantile loss to efficiently obtain a model-aware prediction interval, as this is crucial for timely collision avoidance. The proposed model architectures are shown to greatly outperform previous work while the inclusion of local heat maps enables the prediction of vessel movement that is not otherwise indicated from the previous positions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Transformer与Performer模型用于受限水域水面船舶轨迹预测，利用AIS数据并引入基于KDE生成的位置热力图，经CNN编码后输入模型，采用分位数损失获得预测区间，性能显著优于既有工作。
AI.motivation: 海上航行（无论人工领航还是自主水面船舶）均需提前预判船舶轨迹，以便避碰等子模块及时评估态势并作出反应；同时碰撞规避需要模型感知的预测区间，而既有方法在受限水域的预测能力有限。
AI.method: 使用广泛可得的AIS位置数据；以核密度估计（KDE）生成位置热力图，编码周边区域其他船舶的历史运动信息；热力图经卷积神经网络（CNN）编码后输入Transformer与Performer模型；以分位数损失训练，直接获得模型感知的预测区间。
AI.result: 所提出的模型架构大幅优于先前工作；引入局部热力图后，能够预测仅凭历史位置无法指示的船舶运动。
AI.conclusion: Transformer与Performer结合局部KDE-CNN热力图表示及分位数损失，可有效提升受限水域船舶轨迹预测性能并给出预测区间，对避碰等应用具有价值。

title: GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models
summary: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.

AI.tldr: GLIMPSE 提出一种全局-局部记忆接口，用带状多精度坐标与几何条件化谱衰减，降低对不准确投影地址的敏感性，在固定读取预算下提升几何对应与光度一致性。
AI.motivation: 相机可控的视频世界模型在相机回到先前场景时需保持一致性。将存储特征渲染到目标帧的记忆机制会把深度与位姿误差转化为重影或结构重复；位置传输虽通过迁移历史 patch 的地址而非内容来避免重采样，却对不准确的投影仍赋予完整的位置精度，导致敏感性问题。
AI.method: 提出 GLIMPSE：一种全局-局部记忆接口，包含带状多精度坐标（band-wise multi-precision coordinates）与几何条件化谱衰减（geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation）。局部 patch 记忆提供视角相关外观，循环全局记忆提供场景上下文；采用足迹引导检索（footprint-guided retrieval），在固定局部读取预算下选择历史 patch。
AI.result: 在匹配的检索与读取预算下，GLIMPSE 相比确定性位置传输，改善了几何对应与光度一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过多精度坐标与几何条件化衰减降低对不准确投影地址的敏感性，并在固定预算下结合局部与全局记忆，可有效提升视频世界模型在相机回访时的场景一致性。

title: Rationally Linearized MLPs
summary: We present Rationally Linearized Multilayer Perceptrons(RaLiMPs), a new approach to efficiently linearizing MLPs using low-degree rational approximations of standard activation functions. Inspired by polynomial-based MLP linearization, we show that rational approximations can provide accurate representations at substantially lower degree. RaLiMPs exploit these approximations to construct kernel representations with narrow bottlenecks, enabling efficient composition across MLP layers. We provide theoretical guarantees for the resulting approximation and evaluate RaLiMPs across applications ranging from implicit 3D models to large language models. Our experiments demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency tradeoffs, with RaLiMPs achieving competitive or improved accuracy while substantially reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RaLiMPs，用低阶有理逼近替代多项式逼近来实现MLP线性化，在保证精度的同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 基于多项式的MLP线性化方法需要较高阶数才能准确逼近激活函数，导致核表示维度高、计算开销大。作者希望借助有理逼近以更低阶数获得准确表示。
AI.method: 对标准激活函数采用低阶有理逼近，并将其用于构建具有窄瓶颈的核表示，从而支持MLP各层之间的高效组合；同时给出该逼近的理论保证。
AI.result: 在从隐式3D模型到大规模语言模型的多类应用中验证，RaLiMPs取得有竞争力甚至更优的精度，同时大幅降低推理成本，呈现良好的精度—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 有理逼近相比多项式逼近能以更低阶数实现准确线性化，RaLiMPs是一种高效且通用的MLP线性化方案。

title: State-Isolated Vision Mamba via Update-Tendency Routing for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Vision Mamba has recently emerged as an efficient alternative to convolutional and Transformer-based architectures by modeling long-range spatial dependencies through recurrent state evolution. Existing studies primarily improve token serialization, scanning strategies, or expert routing, yet largely overlook a state level question question: how should recurrent states be organized for spatially heterogeneous visual restoration? In this paper, we show that forcing tokens with heterogeneous update behaviors to recurrently modify a shared hidden state leads to persistent cross-content interference, which we term \textbf{State Contention}. We further argue that effective recurrent modeling should organize state evolution according to token compatibility rather than token ordering. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{State Isolation}, a new recurrent state organization principle for Vision Mamba,tokens with compatible state-update tendencies evolve within independent recurrent state streams. To instantiate this principle, we propose \textbf{IsoMamba}, a $Δ$-guided architecture that constructs model-intrinsic update representations, discovers update-compatible token groups through label-free clustering, and routes them to isolated Mamba experts following a \textbf{cluster--route--isolate} paradigm. In addition, we develop a dynamic channel-wise reweighting objective to compensate for wavelength-dependent reconstruction difficulty in underwater images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IsoMamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks while providing cleaner hidden state responses, validating the effectiveness of state isolated recurrent modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"状态争用"问题，并基于"状态隔离"原则设计IsoMamba，通过聚类-路由-隔离范式将更新倾向兼容的token分配到独立的Mamba专家状态流中，在水下图像增强任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有Vision Mamba研究主要聚焦于token序列化、扫描策略或专家路由，却忽视了状态层面的核心问题：如何为空间异质的视觉复原任务组织循环状态。作者发现，让更新行为异质的token共同递归修改同一共享隐藏状态，会导致持续的跨内容干扰，即"状态争用"。
AI.method: 提出状态隔离原则：更新倾向兼容的token应在独立循环状态流中演化，按token兼容性而非token顺序组织状态演化。据此设计IsoMamba：采用Δ引导架构，构建模型内在的更新表示，通过无标签聚类发现更新兼容的token分组，并按"聚类-路由-隔离"范式路由至隔离的Mamba专家。另引入动态通道重加权目标，补偿水下图像中波长相关的重建难度差异。
AI.result: 在多个水下图像增强基准上持续取得SOTA性能，同时产生更干净的隐藏状态响应，验证了状态隔离循环建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 有效的循环建模应按token兼容性组织状态演化，而非依赖token排序；状态隔离为Vision Mamba提供了一种新的状态组织原则，并通过IsoMamba实例化证明了其优越性。

title: Simultaneous Competitive and Regret Guarantees for TCP Acknowledgment
summary: We study simultaneous competitive and regret guarantees for TCP acknowledgment. Each acknowledgment serves all pending packets, and the objective is to minimize the total acknowledgment and waiting costs. It is well known that no deterministic online algorithm achieves a competitive ratio better than $2$. Given $k$ randomized online experts and $0<\varepsilon<1$, we construct a randomized online algorithm whose realized total cost is always at most $(2+\varepsilon)$ times the offline optimal cost $\mathrm{OPT}$ and whose expected regret against the expert with the smallest realized cost is $O(\sqrt{\mathrm{OPT}\log(k+1)}+\log(1/\varepsilon))$. The algorithm requires no advance knowledge of the number of packets or $\mathrm{OPT}$. Our algorithm controls switching costs between experts and uses the gap between the permitted competitive bound and its current cost to determine when to learn. We also prove lower bounds showing that, for $k\ge 2$, this regret bound is asymptotically optimal in $\mathrm{OPT}$, $k$, and $\varepsilon$, and that $\varepsilon>0$ is necessary for sublinear regret.

AI.tldr: 研究TCP确认问题的在线算法，同时实现竞争比保证与后悔界。
AI.motivation: TCP确认中每个确认服务所有待定包，目标是最小化确认与等待总成本。已知任何确定性在线算法的竞争比下界为2，但如何在竞争保证下同时获得对最优专家的次线性后悔尚未解决。
AI.method: 给定k个随机在线专家与0<ε<1，构造随机在线算法，控制专家间切换成本，利用允许竞争界与当前成本之间的差距决定何时学习，无需预知包数或OPT。
AI.result: 实现总成本至多(2+ε)OPT，期望后悔对最小实现成本专家为O(√(OPT log(k+1))+log(1/ε))；证明k≥2时该后悔界在OPT、k、ε上渐近最优，且ε>0是次线性后悔的必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法在TCP确认中同时达到近似最优竞争比与渐近最优后悔，并给出匹配下界。

title: LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos
comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026; 24 pages including appendix
summary: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.

AI.tldr: LAPT-Scale 提出一种可扩展的潜在动作预训练范式，通过连续潜在动作从大规模第一视角人类视频中提取隐式监督，训练 VLA 策略，显著提升真实机器人任务成功率并具备泛化性。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略的扩展受限于具身交互数据采集成本高昂；大规模第一视角人类视频是丰富替代来源，但缺乏机器人动作标签，且现有动作标注方法在真实世界视觉复杂性与多样操作动力学下噪声较大。
AI.method: 包含两个组件：LAPT-Scale-LAM 通过学习帧间视觉转换来解释人类视频并生成连续潜在动作，作为人类派生监督；不同于以往向量量化 LAM，采用连续潜在空间以保留细粒度运动与交互动力学，并融合感知、语义与光流对齐信号改进转换级监督。LAPT-Scale-Policy 通过人类视频潜在动作预训练、目标机器人具身对齐及任务特定后训练训练 VLA 策略。
AI.result: 在 23.3K 小时第一视角视频上训练，随标注人类视频从 1K 增至 5K 小时，取得一致的规模化增益，真实机器人成功率从 63.3% 提升至 85.0%，且策略可泛化至未见视觉条件。
AI.conclusion: 连续潜在动作预训练结合多信号对齐，可有效利用大规模人类视频为机器人策略提供可扩展的隐式动作监督，提升真实机器人性能与视觉泛化能力。

title: $L_0$ Feature Selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search in High-Dimensional Financial Regression
comment: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26). 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Feature selection is a central problem in high-dimensional financial regression, where large numbers of engineered variables and strong correlations among predictors reduce model stability and interpretability. $L_1$ regularization (Lasso) is widely used for sparse regression, but its shrinkage can be restrictive when informative signals are spread across correlated variables. Exact sparse regression avoids this shrinkage but requires solving a combinatorial optimization problem that is computationally difficult and is typically fit to minimize in-sample rather than out-of-sample error. This paper presents a feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA). Feature selection is formulated as a sequential decision process, and candidate subsets are scored by their out-of-sample validation performance rather than training error. The method also supports a lexicographic objective accounting for subset size and multicollinearity. We study this approach on a contemporaneous explanatory regression task: explaining the weekly return of the NASDAQ-100 index from 1,072 engineered features spanning market, macroeconomic, and factor data. This isolates the value of subset selection under multicollinearity from the separate problem of predictive forecasting. On this task, the proposed method identifies sparse feature subsets with higher out-of-sample explanatory power than an optimized Lasso baseline, reaching an out-of-sample $R^2$ of 0.6961 versus 0.6313 for Lasso. These results suggest that Monte Carlo Tree Search is a practical alternative to convex regularization for sparse explanatory feature selection in financial regression, with potential value for factor attribution and risk decomposition where transparency matters as much as out-of-sample fit.

AI.tldr: 提出基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）与GNRPA的特征选择框架，以样本外验证性能为评分标准，在NASDAQ-100周收益率解释任务上取得优于Lasso的稀疏子集。
AI.motivation: 高维金融回归中工程化变量多、预测因子间相关性强，导致模型不稳定、可解释性差。Lasso虽广泛用于稀疏回归，但其收缩在有效信号分散于相关变量时受限；而精确稀疏回归需解组合优化问题，计算困难，且通常以样本内误差为拟合目标而非样本外误差。
AI.method: 将特征选择建模为序贯决策过程，采用蒙特卡洛树搜索结合广义嵌套滚动策略自适应（GNRPA）进行搜索；候选子集以样本外验证性能而非训练误差进行评分；并支持兼顾子集规模与多重共线性的字典序目标。
AI.result: 在同期解释性回归任务（用1,072个覆盖市场、宏观经济与因子数据的特征解释NASDAQ-100指数周收益率）上，所提方法得到的稀疏特征子集样本外解释力高于经优化的Lasso基线，样本外R²为0.6961，Lasso为0.6313。
AI.conclusion: 蒙特卡洛树搜索是金融回归中稀疏解释性特征选择的实用替代方案，可替代凸正则化方法；在因子归因与风险分解等重视透明度与样本外拟合的场景中具有潜在价值。

title: KVeil: First-Place Solution to ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos
comment: Technical report for the winning solution (1st place, both phases) of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos against Diffusion-based Customization
summary: The rapid development of personalized video generation has raised serious concerns over identity privacy, as a few facial videos of a person now suffice to reproduce their identity in synthetic videos. This report presents the first-place solutions to both phases of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos, which aims to protect facial videos from unauthorized customization under a limited and imperceptible perturbation budget. For Phase 1, we introduce Reference Capacity Collapse, a pair of complementary losses that degrade the information carried by the reference condition while keeping subsequent video representations dependent on it, together with a Motion-Guided EOT mechanism that improves robustness across unknown inference conditions. Phase 2 further considers tuning-based customization and unseen generative models. To address both threats within a single perturbation, we design a two-layer framework that protects the facial and background regions separately, constructing structure-aligned perturbations from a synthetic target identity in the former and strengthening the white-box disruption of Phase 1 in the latter. Our method achieves nearly perfect protection under white-box reference-based customization, and remains effective under other customization paradigms, various models, and temporal attacks. Both solutions are built upon our recent work LETHE. We hope our solutions can inspire future work on protecting facial videos against unauthorized customization. Our code is available at https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil.

AI.tldr: 该报告提出ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP挑战赛（不可学习视频）两阶段的第一名方案：Phase 1使用参考容量坍缩损失与运动引导EOT；Phase 2提出双层框架分别保护人脸与背景区域，在有限不可感知扰动下实现近乎完美的白盒防护并泛化到其他定制范式与攻击。
AI.motivation: 个性化视频生成的快速发展带来身份隐私风险：少量人脸视频即可在合成视频中复现个人身份。因此需要在有限且不可感知的扰动预算下，阻止人脸视频被未经授权地定制。
AI.method: Phase 1提出参考容量坍缩（Reference Capacity Collapse），由一对互补损失组成，在降低参考条件所携带信息的同时保持后续视频表示对其的依赖，并引入运动引导EOT机制提升对未知推理条件的鲁棒性。Phase 2面向基于微调的定制与未见生成模型，设计双层框架分别保护人脸与背景区域：前者基于合成目标身份构造结构对齐扰动，后者强化Phase 1的白盒破坏效果。两方案均基于LETHE工作。
AI.result: 在白盒基于参考的定制下达到近乎完美的防护效果，并在其他定制范式、多种模型以及时间攻击下仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为保护人脸视频免遭未经授权定制提供了有效思路，期望启发后续研究；代码已开源。

title: EchoTab: Learning Measurement-Grounded Representations for Echocardiographic Diagnosis through Tabular Reconstruction
summary:
Diagnostic information in multi-view medical imaging studies, like echocardiography, is distributed across views, each capturing different aspects of cardiac structure and function. In clinical practice, these views are first interpreted through quantitative measurements, which then support specific diagnoses. However, existing echo representation learning methods do not explicitly model measurements as an intermediate representation between views and diagnosis. As a result, individual measurements are not explicitly represented in a form that downstream diagnostic tasks can selectively use, hindering accurate diagnosis.
  Inspired by this hierarchical clinical workflow, we introduce EchoTab, a measurement-grounded representation learning framework that represents multi-view echocardiography studies using measurement-specific tokens as an intermediate representation between echo views and diagnosis. Each measurement token selectively attends to the views relevant to its estimation and is trained through tabular reconstruction to predict the corresponding measurement value. The resulting tokens form a factorized echo representation, which encode clinically meaningful structural and functional properties and can be selectively used for downstream diagnosis. Unlike the commonly used contrastive approaches, EchoTab does not require negative samples or large batch sizes. Experiments on two datasets demonstrate that EchoTab learns effective measurement-grounded representations that improve diagnosis classification in multi-view echocardiography and its learned attention aligns with established measurement-view relationships used by cardiologists. Our code is accessible at https://github.com/michelleespranita/EchoTab.

AI.tldr: EchoTab是一种以测量为中介的多视角超声心动图表示学习框架，用测量专属token编码视图并支持下游诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有超声心动图表示学习方法未显式将临床定量测量建模为视图与诊断之间的中间表示，导致单个测量无法以可被下游诊断任务选择性利用的形式表达，影响诊断准确性。
AI.method: 受临床分层工作流启发，提出EchoTab：以测量专属token作为视图与诊断间的中间表示；每个测量token选择性关注与其估计相关的视图，并通过表格重建预测对应测量值，形成因子化表示；无需负样本或大批量。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上，EchoTab学习到有效的测量支撑表示，改善了多视角超声心动图的诊断分类，且其学习到的注意力与心脏病专家使用的测量-视图关系一致。
AI.conclusion: 以测量为中介的表示学习可提升多视角超声心动图诊断性能，并具备临床可解释性。

title: Gaussian Splatting with Reflections Guided by What is Seen
summary: While novel view synthesis methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown impressive performance on common scenes, they often struggle with capturing view-dependent specular effects, particularly near-field reflections. Existing methods utilize environment maps, which only represent lights from infinity, or environment Gaussians, which rely solely on indirect supervision from reflections, are insufficient for accurately modeling such effects. Here, we propose a framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) that leverages directly observable environment information in input images. Our approach also integrates a hybrid reflection appearance representation and view-dependent specular modeling. Experiments on public benchmarks and a newly curated near-field reflection dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and geometric accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出基于2DGS的框架，利用输入图像中直接可观测的环境信息，结合混合反射外观表示与视角相关高光建模，提升近场反射的渲染质量与几何精度。
AI.motivation: NeRF与3DGS等新视角合成方法在常见场景表现优异，但难以捕捉视角相关的高光效果，尤其是近场反射。现有方案存在局限：环境贴图仅能表示无穷远处的光照，环境高斯仅依赖反射的间接监督，均无法准确建模此类效果。
AI.method: 基于2D Gaussian Splatting（2DGS）构建框架，直接利用输入图像中可直接观测的环境信息；并引入混合反射外观表示（hybrid reflection appearance representation）与视角相关高光建模。
AI.result: 在公开基准以及新构建的近场反射数据集上的实验表明，该方法在渲染质量和几何精度方面均达到更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接观测的环境信息与混合外观表示，该框架有效改善了近场反射下视角相关高光的建模，验证了2DGS在该问题上的适用性。

title: A small cognitive core explains human behavior at scale
summary: Psychology has proposed many principles of cognition. Each, however, was developed in isolation, leaving their combined explanatory power unknown. We assembled a small set of established principles into one model, which we call COntextual Retrieval and Encoding (CORE). CORE consists of a hierarchy of episodic memories into which prediction errors are written and whose encoding, retrieval, and forgetting depend on context. Fitted jointly to 7,036,442 choices from 137 experiments, the model predicts human choices better than black-box models and reproduces 75% of reported behavioral effects when simulated. Moreover, its latent variables show classic signatures of Bayesian learning and event segmentation. Taken together, these findings suggest that a small cognitive core accounts for much of human behavior. They also open a path toward making psychology more than the sum of its parts, by building computational models on the entire experimental record.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CORE模型，将若干既有认知原则整合为层级情景记忆框架，联合拟合137个实验共7,036,442次选择数据，预测人类选择优于黑盒模型，并复现75%已报告的行为效应。
AI.motivation: 心理学已提出众多认知原则，但各自孤立发展，其组合后的解释力尚不清楚；作者希望整合这些原则，探索一个小的认知核心能否解释大部分人类行为，并推动心理学从"部分之和"走向整体性计算建模。
AI.method: 将一小组既有认知原则整合为名为COntextual Retrieval and Encoding（CORE）的模型。CORE包含层级式情景记忆，预测误差被写入其中，编码、提取与遗忘均依赖上下文；并在来自137个实验的7,036,442次选择上进行联合拟合。
AI.result: CORE在预测人类选择上优于黑盒模型；在模拟中复现了75%的已报告行为效应；其潜在变量显示出贝叶斯学习与事件分割的经典特征。
AI.conclusion: 一个小的认知核心即可解释人类行为的很大一部分，这为在完整实验记录上构建计算模型、使心理学超越诸原则简单加和提供了路径。

title: Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability
summary: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues. Extensive experiments show that Neurons++ achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction and competitive image reconstruction across standard benchmarks. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, neural-to-visual analyses indicate that Neurons++ exhibits qualitative directional controllability under neural perturbation, that its fMRI encoder read-out is sensitive to stimulus-relevant cortical features, and that it supports ROI-guided semantic modulation. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus.

AI.tldr: Neurons++是一个视觉流fMRI重建框架，统一支持静态图像与动态视频重建，通过串行皮层启发式解码替代并行任务条件化，在视频重建上达到SOTA，图像重建具备竞争力，并展现神经可控性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 从fMRI解码视觉体验对理解人类感知与脑机接口至关重要。现有生成式解码方法虽能重建看似合理的图像与视频，但视觉逼真度本身并不能保证输出忠实于脑活动，即缺乏对神经信号的真正依赖性。
AI.method: 提出Neurons++框架：先进行图像-fMRI预训练以获得稳定的空间-语义初始化，再分别针对图像和视频重建进行被试特异性微调；用串行皮层启发的解码替换并行任务条件化，将fMRI表征组织为显式的空间、语义、语言层与时间线索；覆盖视频流重建范式，由仅视频扩展到图像与视频的视觉流重建。
AI.result: 在标准基准上实现SOTA的视频重建与有竞争力的图像重建；神经-视觉分析表明，在神经扰动下模型呈现定性方向可控性，其fMRI编码器读出对刺激相关皮层特征敏感，并支持ROI引导的语义调制。
AI.conclusion: Neurons++通过串行皮层启发解码统一图像与视频重建，在重建保真度之外提供神经依赖性与可解释性证据；代码与模型权重已在GitHub（xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus）开源。

title: Private and Distributionally Robust Federated Multiclass Classification
summary: Fault diagnosis in asset-intensive industries requires multiclass models trained on noisy, sensitive data collected across geographically distributed client sites. Federated learning enables collaborative training without centralizing data, but most approaches do not provide formal privacy guarantees for individual records stored at client sites and can degrade under label noise. To address these limitations, we develop a differentially private, distributionally robust framework for federated multiclass classification that provides sample-level privacy for records stored at each client. We build on a federated Wasserstein distributionally robust multiclass objective with the Crammer-Singer loss, solved using an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm. To protect the released client updates, our method injects calibrated Gaussian noise into the proximal linearized client updates of both the local model and the local distributionally robust variable before aggregation at the central server, and we quantify the cumulative privacy loss using the moments accountant. We provide per-round sample-level $(ε,δ)$-differential privacy guarantees and an overall composed privacy guarantee across all training rounds, together with convergence results and an explicit privacy-utility tradeoff. Experiments on simulated industrial fault data and UCI benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms differentially private federated empirical risk minimization and stochastic gradient descent baselines in most tested settings, with the largest gains under strong privacy-induced noise.

AI.tldr: 提出一种差分隐私、分布鲁棒的联邦多分类框架，基于Wasserstein DRO与Crammer-Singer损失，用ADMM求解，在客户端更新上注入高斯噪声实现样本级隐私并提供收敛与隐私-效用权衡分析。
AI.motivation: 资产密集型工业故障诊断需在跨地理分布的客户端上训练多分类模型，数据含噪且敏感。联邦学习可避免数据集中，但多数方法未对客户端单条记录提供形式化隐私保证，且在标签噪声下性能退化。
AI.method: 构建联邦Wasserstein分布鲁棒多分类目标（采用Crammer-Singer损失），用基于ADMM的算法求解；在中心服务器聚合前，向本地模型与本地分布鲁棒变量的近端线性化客户端更新注入校准高斯噪声；用矩会计量化累积隐私损失。
AI.result: 给出每轮样本级(ε,δ)-差分隐私保证及所有训练轮次的组合隐私保证，并给出收敛结果与显式的隐私-效用权衡。在模拟工业故障数据与UCI基准数据集上，多数测试设置下优于差分隐私联邦经验风险最小化和随机梯度下降基线，在强隐私噪声下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 该框架同时提供样本级差分隐私与对标签噪声的分布鲁棒性，实验验证其优于差分隐私联邦基线，尤其在隐私噪声较强时优势明显。

title: Shortcut Learning in Geospatial Foundation Model Embeddings for Cross-Disaster Damage Assessment
summary: Geospatial foundation models can support disaster damage assessment, but high accuracy on familiar disasters may hide shortcut learning: prediction from event or scene characteristics rather than evidence that transfers to a new disaster. We study embeddings from TerraMind, Prithvi-EO-2.0, DOFA, and DINOv3 on the multi-disaster datasets xView2 and BRIGHT. Holding out an entire disaster, instead of randomly splitting image tiles, reduces mean balanced accuracy from 0.807 to 0.638 on xView2 and from 0.818 to 0.568 on BRIGHT. Four sets of tests examine what information supports prediction: event and acquisition context, before/after image inputs, building count, and correct image pairing. Pre-event images remain predictive, and a classifier given only the annotated number of buildings reaches balanced accuracy of 0.629 and 0.653. Combining before/after features performs best on average on xView2, but does not improve over pre-only features on BRIGHT. Shuffling image pairs within the same disaster and damage class causes modest losses. Motivated by these findings, we test whether feature transformations learned only from training disasters improve generalization to unseen disasters. These transformations improve performance, with supervised contrastive learning performing best on xView2 and PCA on BRIGHT. Our results highlight the importance of evaluation on unseen domains for assessing model robustness and show that simple feature-level transformations can improve generalization. Code and experiments can be found at https://github.com/alishibli97/gfm-shortcut-learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究地理空间基础模型在灾害损伤评估中的"捷径学习"问题，发现按事件（而非随机切分图块）留出评估会大幅降低平衡准确率，且事件/场景上下文、灾前影像甚至建筑数量等非损伤证据即可支撑较高预测性能；通过在训练灾害上学习简单的特征变换（监督对比学习、PCA）可改善对未见灾害的泛化。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型可用于灾害损伤评估，但在熟悉灾害上的高精度可能掩盖"捷径学习"，即模型依赖事件或场景特征而非可迁移到新灾害的损伤证据，导致对新灾害的鲁棒性被高估。
AI.method: 研究TerraMind、Prithvi-EO-2.0、DOFA、DINOv3的嵌入表示；在多灾害数据集xView2和BRIGHT上，以留出整个灾害（而非随机切分图块）的方式评估；设计四组测试考察事件与采集上下文、灾前/灾后影像输入、建筑数量、影像配对正确性对预测的支持作用；并测试仅用训练灾害学习到的特征变换以提升对未见灾害的泛化。
AI.result: 留出整个灾害时，xView2平均平衡准确率由0.807降至0.638，BRIGHT由0.818降至0.568；灾前影像仍具预测性，仅输入标注建筑数量的分类器可达0.629和0.653；xView2上灾前+灾后特征平均最优，但BRIGHT上未优于仅灾前特征；同灾害同损伤类别内打乱影像配对仅造成轻微性能下降。特征变换可提升性能，xView2上监督对比学习最佳，BRIGHT上PCA最佳。
AI.conclusion: 评估模型鲁棒性必须采用未见域（留出整个灾害）的设定；简单的特征级变换能够有效改善对未见灾害的泛化，说明结果受评估协议影响显著。

title: PANDA: Prior-guided Attentional Dual-path Architecture
summary: Hypergraph Neural Networks (HNNs), designed to model higher-order relations beyond pairwise interactions, typically rely either on fixed structural weights or on normalised attention. Fixed weights can propagate misleading information in heterophilic settings, while normalisation makes attention coefficients competitive, in the sense that, in a message-passing framework, increasing the weight of one sender must reduce the weight of others in the same aggregation set. Our main contribution is the introduction of PANDA (Prior-guided AttentioNal Dual-path Architecture), a plug-in for two-stage message passing HNNs applicable to both undirected and directed settings. The main path interpolates between learned receiver-normalised attention and structural incidence priors, while a non-competitive (not normalised) auxiliary path lets each sender contribute its own transformed information. We also show that, with fixed structural coefficients, PANDA recovers a certain complex-valued convolution operator adopted in previous works. Across four HNNs spanning spatial and spectral methods in both directed and undirected settings, plugging PANDA in yields an average improvement of 5.18 percentage points across eight real-world benchmark datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/jainris/panda.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用模块PANDA，通过先验引导的双路径注意力改进两阶段消息传递超图神经网络，在8个真实数据集上平均提升5.18个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有超图神经网络依赖固定结构权重或归一化注意力：固定权重在异配（heterophilic）场景下会传播误导信息；归一化使注意力系数具有竞争性，即提升某发送者权重必然压低同一聚合集合内其他发送者权重，限制表达能力。
AI.method: PANDA（Prior-guided Attentional Dual-path Architecture）是一种面向两阶段消息传递HNN的即插即用模块，适用于有向与无向超图。主路径在学得的接收者归一化注意力与结构关联先验之间做插值；辅助路径采用非竞争的（不归一化）注意力，使每个发送者可独立贡献自身变换后的信息。理论分析表明，当结构系数固定时，PANDA可退化为既有工作采用的某类复值卷积算子。
AI.result: 将PANDA接入4种覆盖空间与谱方法、有向与无向设置的HNN，在8个真实世界基准数据集上平均提升5.18个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 双路径设计同时缓解固定权重的异配缺陷与归一化注意力的竞争性约束，且与已有复值卷积形式保持理论一致性，作为通用插件具有良好可移植性；代码已开源。

title: READ: Reading the Selective Scan for Faithful Video Attribution
summary: Selective state-space models are an efficient approach to long-sequence video modeling. However, their recurrent computation makes it difficult to determine which video tokens drive a prediction. Existing attribution methods often require additional backward passes or repeated model evaluations, making them substantially more expensive than the forward inference they aim to explain. In this work, we introduce READ, a parameter-free attribution method for selective state-space models that unrolls the recurrence at the position read by the classifier. READ traces the contribution accumulated in the recurrent state back to the video tokens that contribute to the final prediction. By anchoring attribution at the classifier's readout, it produces a single spatiotemporal relevance map from which frame- and region-level relevance can be obtained directly. Despite requiring only one forward pass, READ achieves competitive faithfulness and localisation compared with substantially more expensive attribution methods. Experimental results show that READ avoids the systematic relevance biases of existing methods while recovering meaningful temporal and class-specific structure across datasets and backbones. More broadly, our results show that the recurrence underlying selective state-space models is not only an efficient mechanism for inference, but also a direct source of interpretable evidence for their predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出READ，一种针对选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的无参数归因方法，通过在分类器读取位置展开递归，仅需一次前向传播即可生成时空相关性图。
AI.motivation: 选择性状态空间模型是长序列视频建模的高效方案，但其递归计算导致难以判断哪些视频token驱动了预测。现有归因方法通常需要额外的反向传播或重复模型评估，成本远高于其试图解释的前向推理。
AI.method: READ在分类器读取的位置展开递归，将递归状态中累积的贡献回溯到对最终预测有贡献的视频token。通过将归因锚定在分类器读出点，生成单一时空相关性图，可直接从中获得帧级和区域级相关性，且仅需一次前向传播。
AI.result: 尽管仅需一次前向传播，READ在忠实性和定位上与成本高得多的归因方法相比具有竞争力。实验表明READ避免了现有方法的系统性相关性偏差，同时在不同数据集和骨干网络上恢复了有意义的时序与类别特定结构。
AI.conclusion: 选择性状态空间模型底层的递归不仅是高效的推理机制，也是其预测可解释证据的直接来源。

title: SelectArena: A Modern Benchmark for Feature Selection on Real-world Tabular Data
summary: Selecting a subset of features (columns) from a tabular dataset is a ubiquitous challenge in real-world applications. Industry experts seek to minimize model training costs, climate scientists require an interpretable subset of factors to understand extreme weather events, and clinicians need to choose among diagnostic tests due to financial and time constraints. When looking at the scientific literature to determine which feature selection method to use, practitioners across domains face an unrepresentative landscape of benchmarking. Despite extensive research, existing feature selection benchmarks provide limited guidance because they rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, or artificially generated data that do not reflect real-world problems. To close the gap between scientific benchmarking and real-world applications, we introduce SelectArena, a modern benchmark for feature selection. We compare 15 widely used feature selection methods on 71 manually curated real-world tabular datasets, covering classification and regression problems, using standardized evaluation protocols and state-of-the-art tabular (foundation) models. Our results reveal clear trade-offs across predictive performance, runtime, stability, and validity. Tree-based methods, CART and RFImportance, along with F-Test are Pareto-optimal when taking into account predictive performance and runtime. F-Test, information-theory-, and distance-based methods lead on stability and validity, with F-Test emerging as a balanced choice across our metrics. Search-based methods are slow, unstable and achieve low performance. SelectArena turns these findings into practical guidance and, as an extensible platform, supports future feature selection research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SelectArena，一个面向真实应用的特征选择基准，在 71 个真实表格数据集上以标准化协议和先进表格模型比较 15 种方法，揭示性能、运行时间、稳定性与有效性之间的权衡并给出实践指南。
AI.motivation: 真实应用（工业、气候、临床）需要挑选特征子集以降低训练成本、提升可解释性或满足资金与时间约束。但现有特征选择基准使用过时模型、临时性评估协议或人工生成数据，无法反映真实问题，导致从业者难以据此选择方法。因此需弥合科学基准与实际应用之间的差距。
AI.method: 构建 SelectArena 基准：在 71 个经人工筛选的真实表格数据集（涵盖分类与回归）上，采用标准化评估协议和最先进表格（基础）模型，对 15 种广泛使用的特征选择方法进行比较，评估维度包括预测性能、运行时间、稳定性和有效性。
AI.result: 各方法呈现明显权衡：综合预测性能与运行时间，基于树的方法 CART、RFImportance 及 F-Test 处于帕累托最优；F-Test、信息论方法与距离方法在稳定性和有效性上领先，其中 F-Test 在各指标上表现均衡；基于搜索的方法速度慢、稳定性差且性能较低。
AI.conclusion: SelectArena 将上述发现转化为实践指导，并作为可扩展平台支持未来特征选择研究。

title: Detection of extremely rare dead cells in fluorescence microscopy images
summary: Dead cell detection in fluorescence microscopy is essential for phenotypic screening and drug efficacy assessment. However, automated identification remains challenging due to signal variability, optical artifacts, and colocalization ambiguities across multiple channels. Markers that define nuclear boundaries do not neatly coincide spatially or temporally with apoptotic markers. Furthermore, marker accumulation kinetics vary across individual cells and apoptosis stages, making universal thresholds unreliable. We present a systematic comparison of several computational approaches for detecting apoptotic cells in nucleus-stained specimens: (1) heuristic methods using intensity thresholds, distributions, correlations, and domain guidance; (2) classification using numerical features (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM) and image features (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0); and (3) anomaly detection, also using numerical features (Isolation Forest, one-class SVM and PCA reconstruction) and image features (convolutional autoencoders and Deep SVDD). Using a dataset of 258 images containing 65,527 cells/nuclei across multiple scenes with 243 manually annotated ground truth dead cells, we evaluate each method on metrics such as PR-AUC, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and macro-F1. Our results indicate that classification using image features (deep learning) and numerical features (traditional) achieved the best performance, with ResNet-18 and XGBoost significantly outperforming manually designed heuristics and anomaly detection methods. Our findings demonstrate that such biomedical problems remain highly challenging to solve even with the state-of-the-art computational and learning techniques. We aim to provide an effective decision-support tool to researchers while tackling such problems either fully-automatically or in a human-in-the-loop setting as an aide to domain scientists.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了多类计算方法在荧光显微镜下检测凋亡/死亡细胞的效果，发现基于图像特征的深度学习（ResNet-18）与数值特征的集成学习（XGBoost）表现最佳，显著优于启发式方法和异常检测方法。
AI.motivation: 死亡细胞检测在表型筛选和药效评估中至关重要，但因信号变异、光学伪影、多通道共定位模糊、核边界标记与凋亡标记在时空上不一致、标记积累动力学在细胞与凋亡阶段间差异大等问题，使通用阈值不可靠，自动化识别仍具挑战，因此需要系统性比较不同计算方法的适用性。
AI.method: 基于258张图像、65,527个细胞/核、243个人工标注死亡细胞的数据集，对比三类方法：(1)启发式方法（强度阈值、分布、相关性及领域先验）；(2)分类方法，含数值特征（Logistic回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM）与图像特征（ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0）；(3)异常检测，含数值特征（Isolation Forest、单类SVM、PCA重构）与图像特征（卷积自编码器、Deep SVDD）。评价指标包括PR-AUC、Precision、Recall、F1及macro-F1。
AI.result: 基于图像特征的深度学习分类与基于数值特征的传统分类表现最佳，其中ResNet-18与XGBoost显著优于人工设计启发式方法和异常检测方法。结果表明即便采用先进计算与学习技术，该类生物医学问题仍极具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为研究人员提供决策支持工具，可在全自动或人机协同（human-in-the-loop）模式下辅助领域科学家处理此类问题。

title: TabReliBench: Evaluating Tabular Foundation Models Beyond Predictive Accuracy
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular for their strong predictive performance. Many also provide posterior predictive distributions (PPDs), whose reliability remains less studied. We assess reliability through point prediction, distributional quality, marginal and subgroup calibration, and interval efficiency. We then introduce TabReliBench, a large classification and regression benchmark for these comparisons and dataset-level analyses. We find that TFMs' rankings change between TabArena and our benchmark and across reliability metrics. Regression TFMs usually achieve near-nominal marginal coverage and retain narrow intervals, but this favorable marginal behavior does not imply valid conditional coverage. Dataset-level analyses show that classification difficulty often accompanies poor calibration, whereas regression predictive performance is not a reliable indicator of calibration. Ensembling improves predictive performance but does not consistently improve calibration of PPDs; TFMs also benefit little from conformal post-processing, which does not reliably resolve subgroup gaps. Reliable TFM selection therefore requires multidimensional evaluation beyond aggregate rankings. Code is available at https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/TabReliBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TabReliBench，从点预测、分布质量、边际/子群校准与区间效率多维评估表格基础模型（TFM）后验预测分布（PPD）的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）预测性能强且常提供后验预测分布（PPD），但其PPD可靠性研究不足；仅凭聚合排名难以可靠选择模型。
AI.method: 构建TabReliBench大型分类与回归基准，从点预测、分布质量、边际与子群校准、区间效率等维度评估TFM，并进行数据集级分析；同时考察集成与保形后处理的影响。
AI.result: TFM排名在TabArena与本文基准间及不同可靠性指标间发生变化；回归TFM通常具近名义边际覆盖且区间较窄，但边际有效不代表条件覆盖有效；分类难度常伴随校准不佳，回归预测性能不能可靠指示校准；集成提升预测性能但不稳定改善PPD校准；保形后处理收益有限且不能可靠消除子群差距。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的TFM选择需要超越聚合排名的多维评估。代码已开源。

title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
summary: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.

AI.tldr: SimVTA 是一种基于仿真的驾驶世界动作模型后训练框架，将轨迹优化与视频监督相结合，通过 3DGS 重建真实场景并渲染高奖励候选轨迹的未来视频，配合 GRPO 与流匹配损失更新共享表征，在 NAVSIM 与 HUGSIM 上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 驾驶世界动作模型（WAMs）依赖成对的轨迹与未来观测进行学习，而强化学习后训练可让策略探索替代轨迹并利用驾驶奖励改进规划。但驾驶日志仅对实际记录的轨迹提供未来视频，替代轨迹缺乏对应的视觉监督，导致轨迹优化与视频监督难以对齐。
AI.method: 提出 SimVTA：1）对每个观测采样候选轨迹，利用真实世界模拟器（如 World Engine）在经 3DGS 重建的真实场景中为高奖励候选渲染未来视频，提供与模型自身预测无关的、轨迹匹配的监督；2）在有限渲染预算下，优先为渲染候选中误差较高的未来分配视频监督；3）用 GRPO 优化轨迹规划，并在匹配视频上使用流匹配损失更新共享表征。推理时模型直接预测轨迹，无需调用模拟器。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上，将 SimVTA 应用于 WAM 初始化可将 PDMS 从 86.2 提升至 91.3（+5.1）；在 NAVSIM v2 上取得 88.2 EPDMS；在 HUGSIM 闭环评估中平均 HD-Score 达 38.8。消融实验表明，用视频监督更新共享表征可改善规划，而在高奖励轨迹中优先监督高误差未来可进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: SimVTA 通过仿真渲染弥补了替代轨迹缺乏视觉监督的问题，验证了视频监督更新共享表征与误差优先采样策略对驾驶规划的有效性，并在多个基准上取得一致增益。

title: Pretraining and Test-Time Training Budgets Matter for ARC: A Controlled Study of VARC and TRM
summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is increasingly used to evaluate whether neural networks can infer task-specific transformations from few demonstrations. Recent ARC models differ in architecture, but also in broader training and evaluation protocols, including pretraining data, data augmentation, test-time setup, and optimization budgets, making conclusions about architecture benefits debatable. In this work, we study how the performance of the vision-inspired VARC and recursion-based TRM models is affected by pretraining and test-time training (TTT) budgets under a common inductive protocol on ARC-AGI-1. We cross five pretraining budgets with four TTT budgets for each test task. Each budget specifies a task-variant count and total sample presentations, defining the controlled training budgets. We observe that increasing TTT sample presentations improves the standard ARC pass@2 metric in all settings for both models. Increasing the TTT task-variant count consistently helps only TRM, whereas VARC often performs better with fewer variants. VARC also remains competitive without pretraining, while TRM benefits much more from it. These results show that pretraining and TTT budgets affect ARC evaluation and motivate reporting at comparable budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的归纳式训练/评测协议下，系统考察预训练预算与测试时训练（TTT）预算对 VARC 与 TRM 两个 ARC 模型性能的影响，发现预算配置显著改变模型对比结论。
AI.motivation: 近期 ARC 模型在架构之外还存在预训练数据、数据增强、测试时设置与优化预算等协议差异，导致"架构优势"的结论难以比较，因此需要控制预算变量、在可比条件下重新评估。
AI.method: 在 ARC-AGI-1 上采用统一归纳协议，对视觉启发的 VARC 与递归式的 TRM，将 5 种预训练预算与每个测试任务的 4 种 TTT 预算交叉组合；每个预算由任务变体数量与总样本呈现次数（sample presentations）共同定义，实现受控训练预算。
AI.result: 增加 TTT 样本呈现次数在所有设置下均提升两模型的 pass@2 指标；增加 TTT 任务变体数量仅稳定有利于 TRM，VARC 反而常在较少变体时表现更好；VARC 在无预训练时仍具竞争力，而 TRM 更依赖预训练。
AI.conclusion: 预训练与 TTT 预算会显著影响 ARC 评测结果，模型间比较应在可比预算下进行并明确报告预算设置。

title: On the Encoding of Calendar Features in Covariate-Informed Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) increasingly offer covariate support, with calendar information being the most common type of categorical covariate in practice, as it is available for every point in time. However, how these features are encoded is largely treated as an implementation detail rather than as an object of study, despite encoding being one of the few design choices left for pretrained models at inference time. With the present study, we demonstrate that the way information is propagated into the model substantially affects forecast accuracy of TSFMs. Therefore, we systematically compare seven calendar encodings, including three conventional target-agnostic representations (ordinal, one-hot, and cyclic) and four target encodings, across four state-of-the-art TSFMs on nine datasets from multiple domains in a zero-shot rolling evaluation. The nine datasets are influenced by social activities, such as weekends and holidays, making calendar information particularly relevant for forecasting. We find that encoding choice affects forecast accuracy across all models, with MASE differences of up to 9.9 % on non-holidays and 83 % on holidays within a single model. Effectiveness and utilization vary substantially across models. Improvements are concentrated around holidays, where calendar information provides signals unavailable from target history, while some model encoding combinations also improve non-holiday forecasts. A SHAP-based attribution analysis locates the contribution of the covariates relative to the autoregressive component and explains why some model-encoding combinations degrade performance. Our findings suggest that current benchmarks for covariate-informed TSFMs can distort model comparisons by imposing fixed encoding strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了七种日历特征编码方式（三种目标无关：序数、独热、循环；四种目标编码）在四个先进时间序列基础模型（TSFM）、九个数据集上的零样本滚动预测表现，发现编码选择显著影响预测精度，MASE差异在非节假日最高达9.9%、节假日最高达83%。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型日益支持协变量，日历信息是最常见的分类协变量，但对这类特征的编码方式长期被视为实现细节而非研究对象；而编码恰恰是预训练模型在推理阶段为数不多的可选设计之一。作者希望揭示编码方式对预测精度的影响，并指出当前基准测试以固定编码策略可能扭曲模型比较。
AI.method: 在零样本滚动评估框架下，系统比较七种日历编码（序数、独热、循环三种传统目标无关编码，以及四种目标编码），覆盖四个最新的时间序列基础模型与来自多领域的九个数据集；九个数据集受周末、节假日等社会活动影响，使日历信息与预测高度相关。并采用基于SHAP的归因分析，定位协变量相对于自回归成分的贡献。
AI.result: 编码选择影响所有模型的预测精度，单一模型内MASE差异在非节假日最高达9.9%、在节假日最高达83%；编码有效性与利用程度在不同模型间差异显著。性能提升主要集中在节假日，此时日历信息提供了目标历史无法提供的信号；部分模型-编码组合也能改善非节假日预测。SHAP归因解释了某些模型-编码组合性能退化的原因。
AI.conclusion: 日历编码并非无足轻重的实现细节，而是实质影响协变量增强型TSFM预测精度的关键设计选择；现有基准若固定编码策略，会扭曲模型间的比较。因此建议将编码策略纳入评估与报告范畴。

title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM) 概念与 SpatialASM 框架，通过训练时的空间模拟将主动视角规划与场景想象能力内化到 LVLM 中，在七个空间推理基准上提升多个骨干模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 人类在解决复杂空间推理任务时会主动从任务相关视角重新观察场景并重建空间布局，而当前 LVLM 缺乏这种主动空间心理建模能力（ASM），且空间思维链（CoT）监督数据稀缺，限制了模型的主动视角探索与心理场景模拟。
AI.method: SpatialASM 采用可扩展的训练时空间模拟框架：使用异中心（allocentric）新视角生成器将假设视角锚定在视觉证据上，并产生两类互补监督——(i) 显式 ASM 轨迹，教导 LVLM 何时以及如何自适应地调用视角规划与想象；(ii) 自动构建的视角采择任务，强化以视角为条件的场景想象能力。
AI.result: 在覆盖感知导向空间理解到多图像、跨视角、视角变换推理的七个基准上，SpatialASM 在四种 LVLM 骨干上均带来空间推理性能提升，同时保持原有通用视觉能力，并提高了七个空间基准的平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，SpatialASM 有效内化了主动空间心理建模能力；ASM 轨迹的合成提供了一条可扩展路径，缓解空间 CoT 监督稀缺问题，从而激发主动视角探索与心理场景模拟。

title: VQIL: Visible Quantum Interference Learning for Perturbation Response Ranking on Graphs
summary: Learning how local perturbations affect a network is important for identifying which components drive or absorb a system's response. We formulate this as seed-conditioned response ranking: given a perturbation at one seed node, ranking all other nodes by response strength. This is challenging when the model is given only the interaction topology, while the mechanism governing how perturbations propagate must be learned from data. We present VQIL (Visible Quantum Interference Learning), a trainable Szegedy quantum walk for seed-conditioned ranking. Edge weights, link phases, and per-node phase rotations are optimized end-to-end by backpropagation while the walk operator remains unitary throughout training. Node scores are obtained from a geometrically discounted coherent sum of quantum-walk amplitudes, enabling quantum interference before the final squared-norm readout. Because each learned parameter is attached to a named edge or node, the trained model provides directly inspectable hypotheses about the roles of individual graph components in the propagation mechanism. On AC power-flow perturbations over six transmission grids, with electrical parameters withheld from the model, VQIL improves Spearman rank correlation from 0.147 for the untrained walk to 0.831 and outperforms an identically trained random-walk model. On gene perturbation over five protein-protein interaction networks with Perturb-seq supervision, VQIL improves rank correlation from 0.171 to 0.620, outperforming the strongest learned classical and neural baselines. These results show that trainable quantum-walk interference provides a scalable and interpretable inductive bias for learning seed-conditioned response rankings on graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VQIL——一种可训练的 Szegedy 量子游走模型，用于「种子条件响应排序」：给定单点扰动，排序全图其余节点的响应强度；在电力潮流与基因扰动任务上显著优于未训练游走及经典/神经基线，并提供可解释的传播假设。
AI.motivation: 识别网络中哪些组件驱动或吸收系统响应，是理解局部扰动传播的关键。当仅已知交互拓扑、而扰动传播机制需从数据中学习时，如何对全节点响应强度进行排序具有挑战性；作者将其形式化为种子条件响应排序问题，并寻求兼具可扩展性与可解释性的归纳偏置。
AI.method: VQIL 是一种可训练的 Szegedy 量子游走：(1) 端到端反向传播优化边权、连边相位与逐节点相位旋转，训练全程保持游走算子酉性；(2) 节点得分来自量子游走振幅的几何折扣相干求和，使量子干涉发生在最终平方范数读出之前；(3) 每个可学习参数绑定到具名边或节点，故训练后模型可直接检视各图组件在传播机制中的角色。
AI.result: 在六个输电网的交流潮流扰动任务上（模型不提供电气参数），VQIL 将 Spearman 秩相关从未训练游走的 0.147 提升至 0.831，并优于同样训练的随机游走模型；在五个蛋白–蛋白相互作用网络、以 Perturb-seq 为监督的基因扰动任务上，秩相关从 0.171 提升至 0.620，优于最强的可学习经典与神经基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可训练的量子游走干涉为图上的种子条件响应排序提供了一种可扩展且可解释的归纳偏置。

title: Event-based Action Recognition by Pre-Training on Multi-Frame Representations
summary: Action recognition is a crucial task in domains like robotics, patient monitoring, or surveillance. Recently, event-based action recognition has attracted much attention due to the event camera's ability to capture fast motions and its improved privacy over conventional vision cameras. While frame-based event representations work well for short event sequences, their discriminative ability declines sharply with longer and more complex event sequences. In this work, we introduce a multi-frame representation that greatly improves recognition performance over its single-frame counterpart. We adopt a masked auto-encoding framework to pre-train a Vision Transformer using a sparsity-aware masking algorithm and token selection mechanism to improve downstream performance and control computational complexity. We also introduce multiple mask tokens for the decoder with a position-aware attention mechanism, leading to further improved performance. Our proposed method shows impressive performance for challenging long-duration and complex event sequences, yielding state-of-the-art performance on THU-EACT-50 CHL and DailyDVS-200.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多帧表示与掩码自编码的Vision Transformer预训练方法，用于事件相机动作识别，在长时复杂事件序列上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 事件相机能捕捉快速运动且隐私性优于传统相机，但现有的基于帧的事件表示在短序列上表现良好，随着事件序列变长、变复杂，其判别能力急剧下降，因此需要更强的表示与预训练方法。
AI.method: 引入多帧表示以替代单帧表示；采用掩码自编码（MAE）框架预训练Vision Transformer，结合稀疏感知掩码算法与token选择机制以提升下游性能并控制计算复杂度；解码器使用多个mask token并配以位置感知注意力机制。
AI.result: 多帧表示显著优于单帧；所提方法在长时且复杂的事件序列上表现优异，在THU-EACT-50 CHL与DailyDVS-200数据集上达到state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 多帧表示与稀疏感知掩码、token选择及位置感知多mask token解码相结合，可有效提升事件基动作识别在长时复杂序列上的性能。

title: Transformer-based In-Context Score Operator Learning for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models typically learn the generative dynamics of a single target distribution or a family of distributions indexed by conditioning variables fixed during training. This limits their ability to adapt to a previously unseen distribution from only a small set of examples. We introduce an in-context solution operator learning framework for diffusion models, in which each target distribution is treated as a task drawn from a meta-distribution and is specified at inference time by an empirical context set. Our method learns an in-context score operator that maps the context samples, a noisy query point, and the diffusion time to the task-dependent score, enabling reverse-diffusion sampling on unseen tasks without retraining or parameter updates. A key observation is that the task-dependent score admits a Gaussian-kernel conditional-mean representation. Its empirical Nadaraya--Watson approximation can be represented exactly by a model in our constructed transformer class, providing a principled foundation for the proposed query-dependent attention architecture. The operator is trained through amortized denoising score matching across task distributions. We establish generalization-error bounds that quantify the effects of the context size, the numbers of training tasks and within-task samples, model complexity, and intrinsic and ambient dimensions. Numerically, we evaluate the method on a range of scientific and visual datasets, including Navier-Stokes, ERA5 climate data, QuickDraw sketches, and Food-101. The results show that the proposed method performs well on relatively simple task families, while its performance degrades as task complexity increases, thereby illustrating both the promise and the limitations of in-context learning for diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向扩散模型的上下文内解算子学习框架，将目标分布视为元分布中的任务，通过上下文集在推理时指定，学习上下文内分数算子以实现无需重训练的反向扩散采样。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型通常只学习单一目标分布或训练时固定条件变量所索引的分布族，难以仅凭少量样本适应训练时未见的分布。
AI.method: 将每个目标分布视为从元分布抽取的任务，推理时由经验上下文集指定；学习一个上下文内分数算子，将上下文样本、含噪查询点与扩散时间映射到任务相关分数。基于任务相关分数具有高斯核条件均值表示，其经验Nadaraya–Watson近似可由所构造的Transformer类精确表示，从而导出查询依赖的注意力架构；通过跨任务的摊销去噪分数匹配训练该算子。
AI.result: 建立了泛化误差界，量化上下文规模、训练任务数与任务内样本数、模型复杂度以及内在维度与外在维度的影响。在Navier-Stokes、ERA5气候数据、QuickDraw草图和Food-101等科学与视觉数据集上评估：在相对简单的任务族上表现良好，随任务复杂度增加性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了上下文内学习用于扩散模型的潜力，同时也揭示了其局限：性能随任务复杂度上升而退化。

title: Revisiting the Task of Building Damage Assessment by Satellite Imaging
summary: Natural disasters such as earthquakes, tropical storms, and floods cause extensive damage to buildings, and rapid, reliable damage maps are essential to guide emergency response. Automating this task, referred to as building damage assessment (BDA), from satellite imagery, has become an active research topic at the intersection of remote sensing, computer vision, and machine learning, particularly since supervised deep learning methods were shown to outperform earlier handcrafted approaches. Yet, despite a decade of intense activity and the release of several large-scale datasets, the field lacks a shared foundation. This chapter revisits the task of BDA from first principles, organized around three pillars: data, evaluation, and methods. We first clarify the candidate task for- mulations and argue for a sensor-agnostic, instance-based definition that tolerates missing pre-event imagery. We then review existing datasets along the axes of sensing modality, temporal configuration, and geographic coverage. On the evaluation side, we show that prevailing practices, largely based on a single aggregate score, are theoretically fragile, and we lay the foundations of a more informative, ranking-based, multi-score protocol. We further review methods ranging from task-specific deep networks to recent Earth observation foundation models, noticing that generalization to unseen events and regions remains an open difficulty. Finally, we discuss how these elements can inform the organization of a BDA challenge, including cross-validation, challenge, and private data-sharing setups designed to build trust between developers and users.

AI.tldr: 该章节从第一性原理出发，围绕数据、评估与方法三大支柱重构建筑损毁评估（BDA）任务，提出传感器无关、基于实例且容忍缺失震前影像的任务定义，批评现有单一聚合评分的脆弱性并倡导排序式多分数评估协议，综述从任务专用深度网络到地球观测基础模型的方法，并讨论如何组织BDA挑战赛以促进开发者与用户之间的信任。
AI.motivation: 地震、热带风暴和洪水等自然灾害对建筑造成广泛破坏，快速可靠的损毁地图对指导应急响应至关重要。尽管监督式深度学习已超越早期手工特征方法，且领域已有十年密集研究与多个大规模数据集，但BDA领域仍缺乏共同基础，尤其在任务定义、数据集比较、评估协议等方面存在分歧，亟需系统性梳理。
AI.method: 采用综述与立场论文的写法，从第一性原理重新审视BDA，按数据、评估、方法三条主线组织：澄清候选任务表述并论证传感器无关、基于实例、容忍缺失震前影像的定义；沿传感模态、时序配置、地理覆盖三个维度回顾现有数据集；分析现有以单一聚合分数为主的评估实践的理论脆弱性，构建基于排序的多分数评估协议框架；综述从任务专用深度网络到近期地球观测基础模型的方法。
AI.result: 指出主流单一聚合评分在理论上不稳健，提出更信息丰富的排序式多分数评估协议的初步框架；综述表明，尽管方法从任务专用网络发展到地球观测基础模型，但对未见事件与区域的泛化仍是未解决的难点；并给出可用于组织BDA挑战赛的方案，包括交叉验证、挑战赛及私有数据共享等设置。
AI.conclusion: BDA领域需要一个共享基础，包括统一的任务定义、可比的数据集描述、更稳健的评估协议以及面向泛化的方法研究；通过精心设计的挑战赛（含交叉验证与私有数据共享机制），可增强开发者与用户之间的信任，推动领域从碎片化走向规范化。

title: Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal
summary: Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. We establish this guarantee using purely first-order updates, with minimal assumptions and without gradient preconditioners. By extending state-of-the-art lower bounds to continuous parametric policies, we establish an $Ω(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity limit, confirming our framework is minimax-optimal up to logarithmic factors and horizon terms.

AI.tldr: 提出LVR-PG统一框架，用一阶递归更新与防御性重要性采样实现弱梯度支配下 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 的全局收敛，并证明 $\Omega(\epsilon^{-2})$ 下界，达到极小极大最优。
AI.motivation: 标准策略梯度依赖蒙特卡洛更新导致高估计方差；现有离策略方差缩减方法要达到最优样本复杂度，通常需要均匀有界重要性权重等强假设，或依赖不切实际的二阶运算。
AI.method: 提出 Loopless Variance-Reduced PG（LVR-PG）统一理论框架，抽象出一类将递归更新与防御性重要性采样结合的一阶估计器，涵盖 PAGE-PG、STORM-PG 等已知方法；在弱梯度支配条件下，仅用纯一阶更新、无梯度预条件器、且假设极弱地证明收敛性。
AI.result: 证明该算法类在一般参数化策略下达到 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 的末迭代全局收敛；通过将最新下界推广到连续参数化策略，得到 $\Omega(\epsilon^{-2})$ 的样本复杂度极限，表明该框架在忽略对数因子和时域项意义下是极小极大最优的。
AI.conclusion: LVR-PG为一个统一算法类提供了紧致的样本复杂度保证，在弱假设与一阶运算下达到极小极大最优，统一并推广了既有方差缩减策略梯度方法。

title: LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time
summary: Modern vision and language models process ever longer token sequences, and reducing them is the main lever on downstream cost. Token compression, however, faces a fundamental trade-off: selecting tokens discards information, while existing merging methods preserve it only through pairwise token-to-token matching or $MN$ token-to-output interactions. We introduce LapMerge, a differentiable merging operator that resolves this trade-off for ordered sequences: a learned mass distribution partitions the sequence into exactly $N$ equal-mass segments under a Laplace-kernel density, and prefix/suffix scans aggregate each segment, so both the forward and the backward pass run in $\mathcal{O}(M+N)$ time. This combination - an exact output budget, end-to-end differentiability, and linear cost - is precisely what previous reducers trade off against one another. The budget can be changed without changing operator parameters, and the learned mass doubles as a token-level map of where the budget is allocated. Across vision and vision-language tasks, LapMerge matches or improves on strong token reducers while being up to two orders of magnitude faster at large sequence lengths; it is particularly effective when token order reflects spatial or temporal locality, and works both as a drop-in reduction module and as a trainable architectural component.

AI.tldr: LapMerge 是一种可微分的 token 合并算子，通过 Laplace 核密度下的学习质量分布将序列划分为恰好 N 个等质量段，实现 O(M+N) 的前向与反向计算，兼具精确输出预算、端到端可微与线性复杂度。
AI.motivation: 视觉与语言模型的 token 序列日益增长，压缩 token 是降低下游成本的主要手段。但现有 token 压缩面临根本性权衡：直接选择 token 会丢失信息，而现有合并方法仅通过成对 token 匹配或 M×N 的 token-to-output 交互来保留信息，难以兼顾信息保留、精确预算与计算效率。
AI.method: LapMerge 针对有序序列设计：在学习得到的质量分布下，利用 Laplace 核密度将序列划分为恰好 N 个等质量段；随后通过前缀/后缀扫描对每个段进行聚合。该设计使前向和反向传播均在 O(M+N) 时间内完成，并支持在不改变算子参数的情况下变更输出预算，学习到的质量同时可作为 token 级别的预算分配图。
AI.result: 在视觉与视觉-语言任务上，LapMerge 匹配或优于强 token 压缩器，且在长序列下速度最高快两个数量级；当 token 顺序反映空间或时间局部性时效果尤为显著，既可作为即插即用的压缩模块，也可作为可训练架构组件。
AI.conclusion: LapMerge 首次将精确输出预算、端到端可微性与线性计算成本三者统一，解决了以往 token 压缩器只能在此三者间取舍的问题，为长序列视觉与多模态模型提供了高效且灵活的 token 压缩方案。

title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
summary: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. Although our framework supports calibrators ranging from temperature and matrix scaling to NN layers, our results show that using the final classification layer itself as the calibrator yields accurate, well-calibrated models with no additional parameters. Our approach outperforms SOTA calibrators with minimal added complexity, while also avoiding the multiplicative overhead of separate calibration components in settings such as multi-task learning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于双层Stackelberg优化的端到端后处理校准框架，用交叉熵联合优化精度与校准，仅需校准器学习率一个超参数，甚至可直接用最终分类层作校准器。
AI.motivation: 神经网络虽灵活但校准性差。传统后处理校准需独立校准数据集与额外校准参数，导致校准器与模型需分开优化，并带来后续模型选择的开销；在多任务学习等场景下还存在成倍的组件开销。
AI.method: 将标准后处理校准器与骨干网络通过双层Stackelberg 公式进行端到端联合训练，从而无需单独的校准集和专门的校准损失，仅用交叉熵即可同时优化精度与校准，并只引入一个额外超参数（校准器学习率）。框架兼容温度缩放、矩阵缩放及神经网络层等多种校准器形式。
AI.result: 以最终分类层自身作为校准器时，可获得精度高、校准良好的模型，且不增加任何额外参数；该方法在仅增加极小复杂度的情况下优于当前最先进（SOTA）的校准器，并避免了多任务学习等场景中独立校准组件的乘性开销。
AI.conclusion: 后处理校准无需独立校准集与额外组件，通过双层Stackelberg端到端训练即可在极简配置下实现优于SOTA的校准性能，具有低复杂度、无额外参数和多任务友好等优势。

title: Make It Flow: Animating Water in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
summary: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将静态3DGS场景中的水体进行动画化的方法：从参考图像或渲染图的2D光流估计并提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场，借鉴cinemagraph思路对高斯原语进行形变，实现无需动态采集或物理模拟的、时间无缝循环的水流动画，同时保持实时渲染与自由视角导航。
AI.motivation: 现有显式3D场景表示（如3DGS）假设场景静态，难以表现真实世界中普遍存在的动态现象。对于连贯运动（如行人、车辆）可被捕获重建，但像流水这类高频效果在随意拍摄条件下难以处理——因为无法进行密集多视角、高速采集。作者希望在没有动态采集与物理模拟的前提下，让静态3DGS场景中的水流动起来，提升视觉真实感。
AI.method: 1) 从参考图像或模型渲染结果估计2D光流；2) 将该2D光流提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场；3) 借鉴cinemagraph（微动图）思想设计算法，用该运动场对高斯原语（Gaussian primitives）进行形变，生成时间上无缝循环的动画。
AI.result: 在新建的野外瀑布场景数据集上进行评估，在视觉质量和计算效率上均明显优于先前的动态高斯泼溅与3D微动图（3D cinemagraph）生成工作；生成的表示保持实时渲染性能，并保留场景内的自由视角导航。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在静态3DGS场景中为水体添加视觉上合理的运动，无需动态采集或物理模拟，实现实时、可自由视角浏览的无缝循环动画，显著提升感知真实感，为静态3D表示引入高频动态效果提供了实用途径。

title: Towards Understanding the Training of GFlowNets: A Theoretical Perspective
summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn policies that sample discrete objects in proportion to a positive reward. They are trained by minimizing balance objectives, whose exact satisfaction guarantees correct sampling. However, a comprehensive theory linking nonzero balance loss and approximate stationarity to sampling accuracy, especially under evolving sampling distributions and backward policies, is still lacking. To bridge this gap, we develop a unified theory for Flow Matching, Detailed Balance, and Trajectory Balance in this regime. We first bound terminal symmetric KL by the square root of the expected balance loss. Then, we show that approximate stationarity controls this distribution error up to a tangent-space residual measuring parameterization incompleteness. Finally, we establish finite-time convergence under fixed or controlled sampling and fixed, balance-trained, or separately updated backward policies. Under standard smoothness assumptions, with fixed or controlled sampling and a fixed or balance-trained backward policy, the expected loss is $O(\barε^2+T^{-1})$ and expected terminal symmetric KL is $O(\barε+T^{-1/2})$ under uniform coverage. For a separately updated backward policy, we characterize the sufficient update decay to approach the residual neighborhood and preserve these rates. These results connect balance objectives to sampling accuracy and clarify how parameterization, coverage, and moving components govern GFlowNet training.

AI.tldr: 该论文为 GFlowNets 建立了统一理论，将平衡损失、近似平稳性与采样精度联系起来，并给出了有限时间收敛率。
AI.motivation: GFlowNets 通过最小化平衡目标训练，其精确满足可保证正确采样，但现有理论缺乏将非零平衡损失与近似平稳性同采样精度（尤其在采样分布和反向策略演化时）联系起来的综合分析。
AI.method: 针对 Flow Matching、Detailed Balance 与 Trajectory Balance，建立统一理论框架：首先用期望平衡损失的平方根界定终端对称 KL；随后证明近似平稳性通过切空间残差（衡量参数化不完整性）控制分布误差；最后在固定或受控采样，以及固定、平衡训练或单独更新的反向策略下证明有限时间收敛。
AI.result: 在标准光滑性假设下，固定或受控采样且反向策略固定或经平衡训练时，期望损失为 O(ε̄²+T⁻¹)，均匀覆盖下期望终端对称 KL 为 O(ε̄+T⁻¹/2)。对单独更新的反向策略，刻画了可接近残差邻域并保持上述速率的充分更新衰减条件。
AI.conclusion: 该理论将平衡目标与采样精度直接关联，阐明了参数化、覆盖度与动态组件如何共同主导 GFlowNet 的训练过程。

title: Tracking the Invisible: Self-Supervised Wheel Track Detection with Thermal-RGB Fusion
summary: Accurate detection of drivable area is essential for autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. While state-of-the-art methods focus on general traversability estimation, they prove inadequate for snow-covered roads where following existing wheel tracks offers crucial advantages: improved traction, predictable vehicle dynamics, and verified path stability. To address this, we propose a low-cost, self-supervised approach detecting safety-critical wheel tracks using synchronized RGB-I (RGB + Long-Wave Infrared) imagery. Our method automatically generates training labels by projecting future wheel trajectories from recorded GNSS data. A neural network is designed to identify wheel tracks with the 4-channel RGB-I images from challenging, white-out road surfaces. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in visually monotonous and featureless adverse environment, offering a robust and cost-effective alternative for winter autonomy. The newly introduced ThermalTrack dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/thermaltrack/.

AI.tldr: 提出低成本自监督方法，用同步RGB-I（可见光+长波红外）图像检测雪覆盖道路上的车轮轨迹，并发布ThermalTrack数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有可行驶区域检测方法侧重通用可通行性估计，在雪覆盖道路上表现不足；而沿既有车辙行驶可提升抓地力、保证车辆动力学可预测性与路径稳定性，因此需要专门检测安全关键的车辙。
AI.method: 自监督流程：利用GNSS轨迹将未来车轮轨迹投影生成训练标签，无需人工标注；设计神经网络，基于4通道RGB-I图像识别车辙。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法在视觉单调、缺乏纹理的恶劣环境中有效，为冬季自动驾驶提供稳健且低成本的方案；同时公开ThermalTrack数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该自监督RGB-I车辙检测方法可作为冬季自动驾驶的稳健、低成本替代方案。

title: Machine Unlearning for Federated Socially Fair k-Means Clustering
comment: 53 pages, 7 figures, including appendices. The first three authors contributed equally. Supplementary code, data and scoped Lean proofs (v1.0.0): https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc/releases/tag/v1.0.0
summary: Federated clustering can support applications such as patient stratification across hospitals and customer segmentation across distributed financial datasets. Responsible AI calls for fair representation of demographic groups and support for data deletion, motivated in part by rights such as the GDPR's right to erasure. These goals interact: deleting records can change the balance between groups and alter the clustering of the remaining population. We study exact machine unlearning for federated socially fair $k$-means, whose objective is to minimize the largest group-average squared distance to the nearest center. Our approach keeps separate local summaries for each group, so summaries at unaffected institutions remain valid as global fairness weights change. For two groups, we prove an initialization approximation guarantee independent of client group proportions under ideal sampling, and we show that same-seed replay reproduces retraining exactly. Reuse pays off most when a whole client withdraws: across three datasets, replay is $35.8\times$ faster than retraining for the initialization-only model and remains $2.4\times$ and $1.7\times$ faster with one and two fair-refinement rounds, which improve worst-group cost. For individual record deletions, gains are modest (about $1.06\times$), and certifying cached assignments can cost more than it saves. These results map where exact unlearning can profitably reuse computation. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联邦社会公平 k-means 的精确机器遗忘，通过按群体保存本地摘要实现计算复用，在客户端退出场景下显著加速，并给出初始化近似保证与同种子重放等价性证明。
AI.motivation: 负责任 AI 要求公平表示各人口群体并支持数据删除（如 GDPR 的被遗忘权）。在联邦聚类中，删除记录会改变群体间平衡，进而改变剩余人群的聚类结果。公平性与可删除性相互影响，因此需要研究联邦社会公平 k-means 下的精确遗忘问题。
AI.method: 针对目标为最小化最大群体平均平方距离的联邦社会公平 k-means，为每个群体分别保存本地摘要，使未受影响机构的摘要在全局公平权重变化时依然有效。理论分析针对两组情形，证明在理想采样下与客户端群体比例无关的初始化近似保证，并证明同种子重放可精确复现重训练过程。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，当整个客户端退出时复用收益最大：仅初始化模型下重放比重训练快 35.8 倍；加入一轮和两轮公平精化后仍分别快 2.4 倍和 1.7 倍，且精化能改善最差群体代价。对单条记录删除，加速有限（约 1.06 倍），且对缓存分配进行认证可能得不偿失。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了精确遗忘可有效复用计算的具体场景：客户端级别退出收益显著，而单记录删除收益有限。代码与复现材料见 https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc。

title: Beyond the Snowflakes: Disentangling Weather Effects from Confounding Meta-Factors in LiDAR Object Detection
summary: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) is critical for autonomous perception, yet its performance is known to degrade in adverse weather. While existing literature models snow as atmospheric noise that degrades performance, our granular evaluation on the WADS-3D and CADC datasets reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon: detection accuracy consistently improves as snow intensity increases. Through ablation study and meta-information analysis, we reconcile this by confirming that while falling snow acts as noise, its negative impact is outweighed by a dominant, concurrent factor: significantly increased object point count. We hypothesize that this object point count boost acts as a geometric enhancement, driven by snow accumulation increasing vehicle surface area and a shift from specular to diffuse reflectance. Our findings demonstrate that evaluating perception systems using broad weather-severity bins without accounting for correlated object-level data can lead to misleading conclusions about detector robustness. We conclude that accurate evaluation requires decoupling atmospheric noise from surface accumulation effects and outline future research to validate these physical models. The WADS-3D dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/wads-3d/.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过细粒度评估发现，降雪强度增加时LiDAR检测精度反而提升，原因在于积雪带来的目标点云数量增加这一几何增强效应压倒了雪花噪声的负面影响。
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将雪视为退化LiDAR性能的大气噪声，但缺乏对雪天场景中目标级数据的细致分析，可能导致对检测器鲁棒性的误判。
AI.method: 在WADS-3D和CADC数据集上进行细粒度评估，结合消融研究与元信息分析，解耦降雪的大气噪声效应与目标表面积雪效应，并提出积雪通过增大车辆表面积及镜面反射向漫反射转变来解释点云数量增加。
AI.result: 检测精度随降雪强度增加而一致提升；雪花噪声确实存在，但其负面影响被同时出现的显著目标点云数量增加所压倒，后者起到几何增强作用。
AI.conclusion: 使用宽泛天气严重程度分箱而不考虑相关目标级数据的评估方式会产生误导；准确的评估需解耦大气噪声与表面积雪效应，并需后续研究验证这些物理模型。

title: Amortized Counterfactual Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
summary: Counterfactual inference asks how an observed outcome might have differed under different circumstances, such as whether a patient would have recovered had they received a different treatment. Such questions arise whenever decisions depend on the outcomes of alternatives that were not observed. Answering counterfactual queries generally requires knowledge of the underlying causal structure, which is often unavailable in practice. A common approach is therefore to first estimate the causal graph from observational data and then perform counterfactual inference. However, errors in the estimated causal graph can propagate to downstream counterfactual predictions. To address this challenge, we introduce the Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP), an end-to-end approach that answers counterfactual queries directly from observational data without first estimating a causal graph. CFGNP uses Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to exploit the dual-graph structure by restricting cross-world message passing to corresponding factual--counterfactual variables.
